jobs.summary: About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. About Flexport : At Flexport , we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of...
jobs.description:
About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward.

About Flexport :

At Flexport , we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The Opportunity:

Flexport IT is looking for a Senior IT Systems Engineer to support our SaaS based Collaboration and Endpoint Management platforms. In this role, you will be responsible for the configuration, integration, administration, and support of Google Workspace, Slack, Office365, Confluence, Jira, Okta, Jamf, and Intune. You will play a critical role in ensuring these platforms are secure, scalable, and optimized. The candidate will have broad knowledge across IT as a whole, in-depth hands on working knowledge, and a strong security mindset.

Your expertise will be critical in automating workflows, protecting sensitive systems and data, mitigating security risks, and maintaining compliance. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, lead IT engineering projects, and provide day to day operations support.

You Will

- Administer and provide escalation support for our SaaS platforms.

- Implement and maintain policies, software deployment, patching, and security compliance for our Mac and Windows endpoints, using Jamf and Intune.

- Own the lifecycle management across our core collaboration and endpoint management platforms.

- Develop automation scripts and workflows to improve administrative efficiency and user experience (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Okta Workflows).

- Monitor system health, performance, and usage; proactively resolve or escalate issues.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Security, Engineering, HR, Legal) to ensure proper alignment and integration of SaaS tools with company infrastructure and processes.

- Perform investigations/discovery across our systems for Legal and HR.

- Assist in vendor management and product evaluations.

- Drive solutions and project work.

- Onboard new applications for single sign-on.

- Develop and maintain technical operating procedures, policies, and engineering roadmaps.

- Work closely with the Security team to ensure the platform is designed and implemented with security best practices.

- Provide Tier 3 IT support.

You Should Have

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field (or comparable experience).

- 3+ years of experience in supporting SaaS Collaboration tools, Mac and Windows endpoint management.

- Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

- In-depth knowledge of email delivery flow, IT security, and IAM concepts.

- Understanding of RBAC and permissions models across core SaaS applications.

- Scripting and automation experience.

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range displayed, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education and / or training. Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at Flexport , which also includes bonus, equity, and comprehensive benefit offerings such as medical, dental, and flexible time off.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
Hiring Manager- Max Sanna Recruiter- Chloe Joyce Advisory Consultant, Microsoft 365What You'll AchieveAs an Advisory Consultant – Microsoft 365, you will serve as a trusted advisor and hands-on technical consultant, combining deep Microsoft 365 platform expertise, modern workplace strategy, security and compliance knowledge, and AI productivity enablement to help enterprise customers transform their digital workplace.

Hiring Manager - Max Sanna

Recruiter - Chloe Joyce

Advisory Consultant, Microsoft 365

What You'll Achieve

As an Advisory Consultant – Microsoft 365, you will serve as a trusted advisor and hands-on technical consultant, combining deep Microsoft 365 platform expertise, modern workplace strategy, security and compliance knowledge, and AI productivity enablement to help enterprise customers transform their digital workplace. You will partner with executive stakeholders across EMEA to define M365 strategy, architect solutions, drive adoption, and deliver measurable improvements in employee productivity, collaboration, security posture, and operational efficiency across Dell's Modern Workplace portfolio.

You will:

-
Define and deliver Microsoft 365 cloud productivity strategies — conducting maturity assessments, facilitating executive workshops, and architecting solutions across Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Purview, and Power Platform, translating findings into prioritised roadmaps and measurable business outcomes.

-
Lead Microsoft Copilot and AI productivity enablement — driving Copilot for M365 readiness assessments, data governance prerequisites, Copilot Studio custom agent development, and adoption strategies aligned to Dell's AI Productivity and Workplace AI offers.

-
Deliver end-to-end M365 platform implementations — including tenant architecture, migrations, hybrid identity, Teams voice and Rooms, Windows Autopilot, Intune device management, Windows 11 migrations, and Azure Virtual Desktop solutions.

-
Advise on security and compliance posture — designing strategies across Microsoft Defender suite and Microsoft Purview for information protection, data loss prevention, and Zero Trust architecture to defend Microsoft AI and 365 workloads.

-
Drive practice growth and portfolio value — supporting pre-sales activities and solution scoping, identifying cross-sell opportunities across DEX, ServiceNow, and Workplace AI, and contributing to methodology refinement and offer development within the End User Computing & Productivity pillar.

Take the First Step Towards Your Dream Career

Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here's what we are looking for with this role:

Essential Requirements

- Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert (or equivalent) plus Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate or Security Administrator Associate, with at least one additional relevant Microsoft certification.

- Deep hands-on expertise across the Microsoft 365 platform including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Purview, Copilot for M365, and PowerShell/Graph API automation.

- Strong customer-facing consulting, executive communication, stakeholder management, and workshop facilitation skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic alignment.

- Proven experience leading maturity assessments, governance frameworks, strategic roadmaps, solution architecture, and value realisation reporting within enterprise M365 environments.

- Strong EUC, Digital Workplace, Cloud Productivity, or Microsoft 365 consulting experience with proven customer-facing advisory delivery.

Desirable Requirements

- Experience within a Modern Workplace or Digital Workplace consulting practice; familiarity with DEX platforms such as Nexthink, ServiceNow integration, and Microsoft 365 GCC environments; experience supporting tenant transformations including mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures.

- Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Copilot Administrator certifications; ITIL Foundation or higher; Adoption & Change Management certification.

Here's Our Story; Now Tell Us Yours

Dell Technologies helps organizations and individuals build a brighter digital tomorrow. Our company is made up of more than 150,000 people, located in over 180 locations around the world. We're proud to be a diverse and inclusive team and have an endless passion for our mission to drive human progress.

What's most important to us is that you are respected, feel like you can be yourself and have the opportunity to do the best work of your life — while still having a life. We offer excellent benefits, bonus programs, flexible work arrangements, a variety of career development opportunities, employee resource groups, and much more.

We started with computers, but we didn't stop there. We are helping customers move into the future with multi-cloud, AI and machine learning through the most innovative technology and services portfolio for the data era. Join us and become a part of what's next in technology, starting today.

You can also learn more about us by reading our latest Diversity and Inclusion Report and our plan to make the world a better place by 2030 here.

Application closing date: 15 September 2026

jobs.description:
Role OverviewThe Workspace Technology Engineer is responsible for supporting, maintaining, and improving end-user workspace technologies within the organisation.

Role Overview

The Workspace Technology Engineer is responsible for supporting, maintaining, and improving end-user workspace technologies within the organisation. This role is expected to work independently on day-today operations while contributing to design, improvement, and project initiatives

Key Responsibilities

End-User Computing & Device Management

- Manage device lifecycle activities including provisioning, patching, upgrades, and decommissioning

- Administer endpoint management platforms such as Microsoft Intune and/or SCCM

- Troubleshot complex endpoint and workspace-related issues

- Workspace & Collaboration Technologies

- Support Microsoft 365 services including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint

- Assist with collaboration and productivity tool enhancements

- Support virtual desktop or remote access solutions (e.g. AVD, VDI) where applicable

Security & Compliance

- Implement and maintain endpoint security controls such as BitLocker, Defender, and compliance policies

- Support identity and access management using Entra ID (Azure AD), MFA, and Conditional Access

- Ensure workspace environments meet internal security, audit, and compliance requirements

User Support & Operations

- Provide Level 2 / Level 3 support for workspace-related incidents and service requests

- Perform root cause analysis and implement long-term solutions for recurring issues

- Collaborate with Service Desk and infrastructure teams to improve support efficiency

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

- Maintain technical documentation, SOPs, and operational runbooks

- Participate in technology refresh, pilot, and proof-of-concept (POC) activities

- Proactively identify opportunities (automation; AI etc.) to improve user experience, stability, and security

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills

- Strong experience with Windows 11 and Microsoft 365

- Administrator experience in Intune, and SCCM Admin Portal (Mandatory)

- Administrator experience in Virtual environment (Azure Admin Portal) (Mandatory)

- e.g. Creating AVD, Runbooks & etc.

- Working knowledge of Entra ID (Azure AD), Group Policy, and endpoint security controls

- Basic to intermediate PowerShell scripting skills

- Familiarity with ITIL-based support processes 3–5 years of experience in Workspace role

- Experience supporting enterprise or corporate IT environments

- Exposure to audit, compliance, or regulated environments is an advantage

Soft Skills

- Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills

- Good communication skills with both technical and non-technical users

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

- Team-oriented with a proactive and responsible mindset

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

- Microsoft certifications related to Modern Workplace or Endpoint Management

- Experience with ServiceNow or other ITSM tools

- Exposure to AI (Copilot Bot creation), automation, VDI, or zero-trust security models

jobs.description:
GuideIT is a US based technology services company focused on providing value to its customers through technology alignment and optimization.

GuideIT is a US based technology services company focused on providing value to its customers through technology alignment and optimization. We are currently looking for a Senior System Administrator to join our team.
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior System Administrator with a strong background in server infrastructure, cloud platforms, and enterprise collaboration services. The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of hands-on systems administration experience and deep expertise in Windows Server and Active Directory, public cloud infrastructure with an emphasis on AWS and secondary exposure to Azure, and Microsoft 365 administration across Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, Intune, and Entra ID.
Primary duties

- Administer, maintain, and support server and cloud infrastructure as directed by the client’s designated lead.

- Provide services focused on systems build-out, documentation, support, and new environment and site deployments.

- Deploy, configure, and maintain infrastructure and platform services, including but not limited to:

- Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and file and print services.

- AWS compute, storage, networking, and identity services (EC2, S3, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch).

- Azure IaaS, Entra ID, and hybrid identity and directory synchronization.

- Microsoft 365 workloads, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, and Intune.

- Supporting network services such as VPNs, load balancers, and firewall policy changes.

- Perform system maintenance and upgrades, including applying service packs, patches, hot fixes, and security baselines across on-premises and cloud estates.

- Monitor system, platform, and network performance to ensure availability and reliability.

- Conduct resource monitoring, trending, and capacity planning across server, storage, and cloud workloads, including cloud cost and consumption review.

- Administer backup, replication, and disaster recovery processes, and participate in periodic restore testing.

- Automate recurring administrative tasks using PowerShell, Bash, or comparable scripting and infrastructure-as-code tooling.

- Adhere to established configuration and change management policies, ensuring all changes are reviewed, approved, and successfully implemented.

- Collaborate with the company’s security team to select and implement security tools, policies, and procedures, including identity, endpoint, and cloud posture controls.

- Provide escalation-level technical support for system, cloud, and network-related issues within strict SLA windows.

- Mentor junior administrators and support staff, and contribute to runbooks, standards, and knowledge base documentation.

required skills

- 5+ years of hands-on system administration experience in enterprise or managed services environments.

- Expertise in Windows Server administration, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, certificate services, and MFA.

- Hands-on experience administering AWS infrastructure (EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch), with secondary working knowledge of Microsoft Azure.

- Proficiency administering Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, Intune, and Entra ID (Azure Active Directory).

- Working knowledge of networking technologies, including routers, switches, and firewalls (Cisco, Meraki, Palo Alto).

- Understanding of routing, switching, and VPN technologies, as well as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SMTP, IMAP, POP3, and other communication protocols.

- Experience using PowerShell or other scripting tools to improve administrative efficiency.

- Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere or Hyper-V.

- Strong familiarity with ITIL standards and maintaining compliance in regulated environments.

- Knowledge of ticketing systems with a proven ability to manage and resolve tickets promptly.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively across teams and clients.

- Availability to participate in an on-call rotation and to perform maintenance during scheduled after-hours windows.

- Authorized to work in the US, with occasional travel to customer locations as needed.

Desired Skills

- Microsoft certification such as AZ-104 (Azure Administrator Associate) or MS-102 (Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert).

- AWS certification such as Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.

- ITIL training or hands-on experience.

- Experience with monitoring and observability tools for system, cloud, and network performance.

- Familiarity with patch management and endpoint configuration processes.

- Experience with Linux systems administration (RHEL, Ubuntu).

- Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tooling (Terraform, Ansible, Bicep/ARM, CloudFormation).

- Exposure to backup and disaster recovery platforms (Veeam, Rubrik, Azure Backup, AWS Backup).

Additional Information

- This position requires a highly proactive individual with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively. The candidate should demonstrate a commitment to maintaining secure, reliable, and high-performing systems and cloud environments, while mentoring less experienced team members and contributing to the team’s overall success.

Education

- Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience required.

Position Location

- Remote or hybrid within the US, with occasional travel to customer locations as needed.

More about GuideIT
Headquartered in Plano, Texas, our services and solutions are designed to align technology with business outcomes, maximize value through cost management, and allow rapid, proactive response to change. At GuideIT , we are looking for candidates that have a high level of integrity and thrive in a team environment centered on mutual trust and respect. Our team members are results oriented and highly adaptable. In addition to a dynamic environment, GuideIT offers competitive pay, performance-based bonuses, 401K, health, dental and vision insurance coverage, paid holidays and paid time off.

GuideIT is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity. It is the policy of GuideIT to encourage and support equal employment opportunity for all Team Members and applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, color, ancestry, religious creed, national origin, pregnancy, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, disabled veteran, or Vietnam era veteran status.

About the Role

Our client partners with leading brands to translate behavioral insights into action, enabling smarter decisions and stronger outcomes at the point of purchase. In this role, you'll be part of a small, senior IT team supporting a growing, cloud-first organization. The role is hands-on and operational, with responsibility across identity, security, cloud infrastructure, and core IT systems. You'll have real ownership and influence over how systems are run and improved, serving as primary owner for some platforms and backup owner for others.

- Own the day-to-day operation and ongoing improvement of identity and access management platforms, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, and Duo

- Administer Microsoft 365 services with a focus on security, reliability, and best practices

- Proactively assess systems to reduce operational risk, technical debt, and single points of failure

Qualifications

- Strong depth in one or more of the following domains:

- Identity, authentication, and security tooling (such as Entra ID, Okta, MFA, endpoint protection)

- Level-headed, analytical approach to incident handling and system changes

Who We Are:

Our vision is to grant the wish of every eligible child. Through our mission, we are uniting communities to grant life-changing wishes. As the world’s largest wish-granting organization, we strive to create a sense of community and an environment where we warmly embrace our wish families, volunteers, and colleagues.

Remote positions are open to applicants based anywhere in the continental U.S. Hybrid positions are open to applicants based in the Phoenix, Arizona area.

Position Summary:

Works on a growing Information Technology Security team to protect the organization’s information, infrastructure, and stakeholders. Designs, builds, and manages security solutions including Identity and Access Management (IAM), endpoint security, firewalls, email security, application security (including software development security) and security awareness. This position requires a hands-on technical specialist who can handle the complex and detailed technical work necessary to establish security systems such as firewalls, monitoring software, encryption technology, cloud security and threat hunting across the enterprise. Conducts security assessments, develops policies and procedures, and is the subject matter expert for security-related issues. Provide security engineering expertise through all phases of Technology/Project Life Cycle.

Knowledge and Abilities:

- Demonstrated successful problem-solving abilities

- Proficiency in project management, research, and data analysis

- Critical thinking and analytical skills to identify and diagnose threats

- Possess strong written and verbal communication skills

- Engage effectively with professionals at all levels of the organization

- Organizational skills to create detail reports

- Multitasking skills to complete other tasks while monitoring data systems

- Organize work and prioritize to meet deadlines. Make timely decisions with sound judgment

Duties and Responsibilities:

- Expertise in designing secure networks, systems, and application architectures

- Manage/implement design, installation, configuration, setup, testing, troubleshooting, documentation of security solutions including IAM, endpoint security, firewalls, email security, content filtering and security awareness.

- Proficient with networks, systems, applications, and cloud security

- Proficiency with risk assessment and vulnerability scanning tools, technologies, and methods

- Escalation point for security-related incidents

- Proactively report possible threats and or vulnerabilities

- Find cost-effective solutions to cybersecurity problems

- Information Technology Security representative on IT projects to provide security advice, expertise, and recommendations

- Conduct security awareness training

- Planning, researching, and developing security policies, standards and procedures

- Ensure the tuning and effectiveness of security tools deployed across the environment

- 24/7 Availability for Identity & Access Management, Security Incident Response and Escalation

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technology field or equivalent experience required.

- 5+ years of total experience with 2+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and supporting enterprise information technology security solutions

- Relevant and Current Certifications Preferred: e.g., CompTIA Security+, PenTest+, OSCP, CEH, CISSP, CCSP, CISM, CCNP Security, CISA, etc.

Working Conditions:

Domain Consultants also help to create successful and happy customers by building relationships and technical trust with customers. The Domain Consultant is seen internally and externally as a technical expert on Palo Alto Networks products, as well as an industry expert in Identity and End Point security.

- Earn customer trust by demonstrating expertise in the area of endpoint and user security.

- Present and evangelize during tradeshows and customer events.

Qualifications

- Strong presentation skills and professional demeanor. Ability to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Ability to anticipate risks and devise solutions in the moment; adaptable.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking an Senior IT Systems Engineer to build and maintain our tech stack supporting mission critical programs. You will have the opportunity to work with and learn from some of the world’s best engineers and cybersecurity professionals as you help to implement cutting-edge systems. You will work directly with development groups and systems deployed across the globe, all while gaining invaluable experience in navigating complex IT environments.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Design, deploy, and manage infrastructure solutions across cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises environments (VMware).

- Monitor, maintain, and optimize the performance and reliability of critical infrastructure systems.

- Experience with server and storage technologies, including but not limited to Pure Storage or VAST Data.

- Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and management using infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.

- Collaborate with development, security, and operations teams to ensure seamless integration and deployment of applications.

- Provision, configure, and maintain databases to ensure high availability, performance, and security.

- Ensure data integrity and security through regular backups, disaster recovery planning, and adherence to best practices.

- Familiarity with virtualization technologies and VDI solutions.

- Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure-related issues and outages promptly.

- Document infrastructure designs, processes, and procedures for future reference and knowledge sharing.

- Stay current with the latest industry trends and emerging technologies to continually improve infrastructure capabilities.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 7+ years of experience in IT infrastructure engineering, with a strong focus on both on-premises and cloud technologies.

- Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and their respective services.

- Proficiency in infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.

- Experience with automation and scripting using languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

- Proficiency in Linux configuration and administration, including system optimization, security hardening, and troubleshooting.

- Solid understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, and load balancing.

- Experience with virtualization technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V.

- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.

- Excellent communication and documentation skills.

- Ability to obtain and maintain a US Secret Security Clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Datacenter / colo experience

- GPU/CPU HPC experience a plus

- Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or CloudWatch.

US Salary Range

$143,000 - $191,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

- Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

- Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-

What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Systems Administrator to independently administer, troubleshoot, maintain, and secure enterprise Windows and Linux systems in classified environments. Senior Systems Administrators are expected to perform nearly all routine and advanced administration with little to no assistance, serve as a technical escalation point, mentor other administrators, and lead operational work. Assistance should generally be limited to unfamiliar technologies, high-risk changes, architecture decisions, or issues requiring specialized engineering expertise.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Independently administer and troubleshoot Windows Server/desktop and Linux systems, Active Directory, enterprise authentication, permissions, services, applications, and domain-connected systems.

- Administer and troubleshoot enterprise Windows services including Group Policy (GPO), WSUS/patch management, DNS, DHCP, file services, certificates/PKI dependencies, and related system components.

- Create, modify, test, validate, and troubleshoot GPOs, including inheritance, precedence, OU targeting, security filtering, gpresult, and Resultant Set of Policy (RSoP).

- Administer WSUS or equivalent patching solutions, including synchronization, targeting, approvals, deployment status, failed updates, reporting, and patch-compliance remediation.

- Interpret DISA STIG requirements; use applicable STIG tools/checklists; implement and validate remediations, including GPO-based security configurations; document findings; and troubleshoot operational impacts.

- Independently administer and troubleshoot existing VMware, Hyper-V, or similar virtualization environments and virtual machines.

- Troubleshoot complex issues across operating systems, identity, applications, virtualization, storage, certificates, and network dependencies using logs and diagnostic tooling.

- Use PowerShell, Bash, and other scripting/automation methods for administration, bulk changes, data collection, troubleshooting, and repeatable tasks.

- Research and resolve unfamiliar issues using vendor documentation, technical references, logs, DISA guidance, and available tooling before requiring escalation.

- Plan and lead system changes, maintenance, upgrades, and migrations with implementation, validation, rollback, documentation, and change-control considerations.

- Serve as an escalation point and mentor for Junior Systems Administrators and Systems Administrators; provide peer review and technical guidance.

- Identify recurring problems, technical debt, security/configuration gaps, and process deficiencies and lead practical improvements within established architecture.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Active TS/SCI security clearance.

- Active CompTIA Security+ certification or higher DoD 8140/8570-aligned certification.

- Strong hands-on Windows and Linux systems administration experience with demonstrated ability to work independently.

- Hands-on experience with Active Directory, GPO administration/troubleshooting, enterprise patch management/WSUS, and domain-connected systems.

- Experience interpreting and remediating DISA STIG findings within secure or regulated environments.

- Working knowledge of VMware, Hyper-V, or comparable virtualization technologies.

- Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, subnetting, and network troubleshooting.

- Experience with PowerShell, Bash, or similar administrative scripting.

- Demonstrated ability to independently research and resolve complex technical problems, lead technical work, mentor others, and produce effective documentation.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Advanced Microsoft, Linux, VMware, networking, or cybersecurity certifications.

- Experience supporting engineering, manufacturing, or specialized technical applications.

- Experience leading infrastructure upgrades, migrations, maintenance events, or cross-functional technical efforts.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

A successful Senior Systems Administrator can be given an existing environment or system and independently run, secure, maintain, and troubleshoot it. They do not need every answer memorized, but are expected to research unfamiliar problems and drive them to resolution with limited assistance. Systems Engineering engagement is primarily required when work crosses into new architecture, major redesign, specialized engineering, or high-risk technical decisions.

US Salary Range

$146,000 - $194,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

- Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

- Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-

What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are hiring an experienced Google Workspace Administrator/Architect to join our Bangalore IT team in a hybrid capacity. Reporting to the Director of Business Applications Support, this role is responsible for end-to-end administration, design, implementation, and support of our Google Workspace platform, with a focus on enhancing team productivity, collaboration, employee experience, and driving the strategic adoption of AI tools like Google Gemini company-wide.

What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)

- Lead the design, implementation, and long-term strategic vision for enterprise Google Workspace tools (Gmail, Drive, Meet, Calendar, Docs) and integrated generative AI capabilities (Google Gemini).

- Champion and drive the rollout, administration, governance, and organizational adoption of Google Gemini Enterprise capabilities across all Workspace applications.

- Develop automation scripts using Google Apps Script, Google Apps Manager (GAM), and APIs to optimize group management, administrative workflows, and AI-enabled automations.

- Configure SAML-based SSO and SCIM provisioning/deprovisioning for seamless, automated user lifecycle management and role-based access control.

- Implement robust security policies, compliance standards, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), AI governance frameworks, and Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions to secure corporate data across endpoints.

- Resolve complex technical escalations, partner with Google/third-party vendors, deliver end-user training on Workspace and Gemini productivity enhancements, and analyze performance metrics to continuously improve collaboration.

Who You Are (Success Profile)

- Thrives in Ambiguity: You are comfortable building the path as you walk it, viewing dynamic environments and emerging technologies like Generative AI as raw material to build something meaningful.

- Acts Like an Owner: You possess a strong bias for action, operating with integrity and balancing high-level strategy with hands-on execution.

- Laser-Focused Problem-Solver: You love running toward technical challenges, focused on finding innovative solutions and AI-driven efficiencies that deliver maximum organizational impact.

- High-Trust Collaborator: You are ambitious for the team, fostering a culture of trust through ongoing, clear, and respectful feedback.

- Dedicated Learner: You hold a true growth mindset, actively exploring cutting-edge AI capabilities and seeking feedback to continuously refine your skills and support your team.

What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

- Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain.

- 10+ years of experience administering and managing enterprise-grade Google Workspace environments.

- Practical experience configuring, managing, or piloting Google Gemini for Workspace and implementing enterprise AI security and usage policies.

- Deep proficiency with Google Admin Console, Google Vault, Google Apps Script, GAM, and API integrations.

- Practical experience configuring SAML for SSO and SCIM for user lifecycle management.

- Proven track record implementing Mobile Device Management (MDM) policies and device compliance controls.

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

- Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

- Google Workspace Administrator Certification.

- Google Cloud Professional Collaboration Engineer certification or specialized credentials in Google Cloud AI / Gemini.

- Demonstrated track record of leading company-wide Gemini/AI onboarding programs, user training, and productivity initiatives.

jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

Elastic Security is hiring a Senior Director of Product Management to lead our Endpoint Security & XDR business. This role reports to the GM of Elastic Security. You will be paired with our most senior engineering leader, a VP who leads all of Elastic Security engineering and whose day-to-day focus is endpoint, sharing accountability for the line's outcomes with you. You will also peer with the product lead of our SIEM and analytics business as we build one platform together. The endpoint is where we meet the adversary directly, and where the people we serve, the analysts and defenders protecting hospitals, banks, and government networks, need us most. Their mission is our mission, and this role carries that responsibility for the endpoint and XDR market. Like Elastic itself, the role is distributed by design.

This business was born when Elastic acquired Endgame in 2019, a pioneer in endpoint prevention, detection, and response with roots in defending national security networks. We extended that protection philosophy to Linux and cloud-native environments with the Cmd acquisition in 2021. The result today is Elastic Defend, and its record in independent testing reflects the quality of the work: Elastic Security was the only vendor to score 100% protection in both the AV-Comparatives Real-World and Malware Protection Tests for all of 2025, and the only vendor among 16 to earn a perfect malware protection score in the 2026 Business Security Test, with zero false alarms on the software businesses actually run. And unlike most of this market, we do that work in the open: our protection artifacts and detection rules are public for anyone to inspect.

This role is open for a straightforward reason. Our product leader is retiring, and we are organizing product management around our two core businesses: SIEM and analytics, which will be led by a proven leader already at Elastic, and endpoint, where we are looking outside for someone who brings a fresh perspective from this market. The timing is deliberate in another way as well: security operations are shifting toward agentic workflows, and as a challenger in this market we can move faster than the incumbents. Our focus with this role is business expertise: we are looking for a business owner who understands endpoint security deeply and who will grow this line with the care of someone who owns the outcome. You will have genuine room to lead. The strategy, the priorities, and how we compete are yours to shape with your engineering partner.

What You Will Be Doing

- Drive the business-driven OKRs for the Endpoint Security & XDR line: revenue contribution, competitive win rate, platform attach, retention, and expansion.

- Set the product strategy for the line and represent it with sales leadership, customers, and analysts: a clear diagnosis of the market, a guiding policy, and coherent actions that follow from it.

- Own the agentic detection and response strategy for the endpoint: where AI-driven and autonomous capabilities genuinely help prevention, detection, and response at the edge, working closely with the SIEM and analytics line so customers experience one agentic platform, not two roadmaps.

- Shape where we invest and where we choose not to, building the case with data and customer evidence.

- Own how endpoint and XDR fit the broader Elastic Security platform story, so a customer who lands with endpoint expands into the platform and a SIEM customer sees why our endpoint belongs next to it.

- Put customers first. Visit them where they are, participate in deals and win/loss reviews, enable the field, and represent Elastic at tradeshows and industry events. This work requires regular travel.

- Partner with your engineering counterpart as a true pair, sharing one set of outcomes for the line.

- Lead and develop a team of product managers, helping each of them connect their work to the customer's mission and the business.

What You Bring

- Genuine care for the people this product protects. Customers can tell whether the person across the table is invested in their mission, and this business runs on the trust you earn by caring consistently over time.

- Business expertise running a product line or business unit in security, with comfort in the full picture: revenue, win rates, retention, pricing and packaging, and competitive positioning.

- Earned credibility in endpoint security: EPP, EDR, XDR, and enough understanding of what an agent does on a machine to have real conversations with engineers and practitioners.

- A strong working partnership with go-to-market teams, including experience enabling sellers and supporting deals alongside the field.

- A habit of deciding with evidence: win/loss data, customer conversations, and market signals inform your calls.

- A point of view on how a challenger competes and differentiates against well-funded incumbents.

- Clear executive communication with executive leadership, CISOs, sales leadership, and industry analysts.

Bonus Points

- Experience competing with or working at endpoint-focused security vendors, with perspective on the strengths and gaps across the market.

- Experience helping a security business scale from a few hundred million toward $1B.

- Familiarity with public efficacy testing (AV-Comparatives, MITRE ATT&CK evaluations) and how to participate in the open.

- Experience serving customers in hard environments: regulated industries, classified networks, air-gapped and OT deployments.

- A thoughtful position on AI and agentic capabilities at the endpoint, with healthy skepticism of silver bullets and a clear sense of where they genuinely help the defender.

- Contributions to open source or the security community. Our work is public, and we value people who build in the open.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below.

These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.

An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program. Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

The typical starting salary range for this role is:

$192,500 - $304,500 CAD

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

- Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary

- Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

- Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles

- Generous number of vacation days each year

- Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

- Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love

- Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

jobs.summary: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500,...
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

Elastic Security is hiring a Senior Director of Product Management to lead our Endpoint Security & XDR business. This role reports to the GM of Elastic Security. You will be paired with our most senior engineering leader, a VP who leads all of Elastic Security engineering and whose day-to-day focus is endpoint, sharing accountability for the line's outcomes with you. You will also peer with the product lead of our SIEM and analytics business as we build one platform together. The endpoint is where we meet the adversary directly, and where the people we serve, the analysts and defenders protecting hospitals, banks, and government networks, need us most. Their mission is our mission, and this role carries that responsibility for the endpoint and XDR market. Like Elastic itself, the role is distributed by design.

This business was born when Elastic acquired Endgame in 2019, a pioneer in endpoint prevention, detection, and response with roots in defending national security networks. We extended that protection philosophy to Linux and cloud-native environments with the Cmd acquisition in 2021. The result today is Elastic Defend, and its record in independent testing reflects the quality of the work: Elastic Security was the only vendor to score 100% protection in both the AV-Comparatives Real-World and Malware Protection Tests for all of 2025, and the only vendor among 16 to earn a perfect malware protection score in the 2026 Business Security Test, with zero false alarms on the software businesses actually run. And unlike most of this market, we do that work in the open: our protection artifacts and detection rules are public for anyone to inspect.

This role is open for a straightforward reason. Our product leader is retiring, and we are organizing product management around our two core businesses: SIEM and analytics, which will be led by a proven leader already at Elastic, and endpoint, where we are looking outside for someone who brings a fresh perspective from this market. The timing is deliberate in another way as well: security operations are shifting toward agentic workflows, and as a challenger in this market we can move faster than the incumbents. Our focus with this role is business expertise: we are looking for a business owner who understands endpoint security deeply and who will grow this line with the care of someone who owns the outcome. You will have genuine room to lead. The strategy, the priorities, and how we compete are yours to shape with your engineering partner.

What You Will Be Doing

- Drive the business-driven OKRs for the Endpoint Security & XDR line: revenue contribution, competitive win rate, platform attach, retention, and expansion.

- Set the product strategy for the line and represent it with sales leadership, customers, and analysts: a clear diagnosis of the market, a guiding policy, and coherent actions that follow from it.

- Own the agentic detection and response strategy for the endpoint: where AI-driven and autonomous capabilities genuinely help prevention, detection, and response at the edge, working closely with the SIEM and analytics line so customers experience one agentic platform, not two roadmaps.

- Shape where we invest and where we choose not to, building the case with data and customer evidence.

- Own how endpoint and XDR fit the broader Elastic Security platform story, so a customer who lands with endpoint expands into the platform and a SIEM customer sees why our endpoint belongs next to it.

- Put customers first. Visit them where they are, participate in deals and win/loss reviews, enable the field, and represent Elastic at tradeshows and industry events. This work requires regular travel.

- Partner with your engineering counterpart as a true pair, sharing one set of outcomes for the line.

- Lead and develop a team of product managers, helping each of them connect their work to the customer's mission and the business.

What You Bring

- Genuine care for the people this product protects. Customers can tell whether the person across the table is invested in their mission, and this business runs on the trust you earn by caring consistently over time.

- Business expertise running a product line or business unit in security, with comfort in the full picture: revenue, win rates, retention, pricing and packaging, and competitive positioning.

- Earned credibility in endpoint security: EPP, EDR, XDR, and enough understanding of what an agent does on a machine to have real conversations with engineers and practitioners.

- A strong working partnership with go-to-market teams, including experience enabling sellers and supporting deals alongside the field.

- A habit of deciding with evidence: win/loss data, customer conversations, and market signals inform your calls.

- A point of view on how a challenger competes and differentiates against well-funded incumbents.

- Clear executive communication with executive leadership, CISOs, sales leadership, and industry analysts.

Bonus Points

- Experience competing with or working at endpoint-focused security vendors, with perspective on the strengths and gaps across the market.

- Experience helping a security business scale from a few hundred million toward $1B.

- Familiarity with public efficacy testing (AV-Comparatives, MITRE ATT&CK evaluations) and how to participate in the open.

- Experience serving customers in hard environments: regulated industries, classified networks, air-gapped and OT deployments.

- A thoughtful position on AI and agentic capabilities at the endpoint, with healthy skepticism of silver bullets and a clear sense of where they genuinely help the defender.

- Contributions to open source or the security community. Our work is public, and we value people who build in the open.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.

The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is listed below. In select locations (including Seattle WA, Los Angeles CA, the San Francisco Bay Area CA, and the New York City Metro Area), an alternate range may apply as specified below.

These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.

An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program. Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

The typical starting salary range for this role is:

$199,700 - $315,900 USD

The typical starting salary range for this role in the select locations listed above is:

$239,800 - $379,300 USD

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

- Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary

- Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

- Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles

- Generous number of vacation days each year

- Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

- Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love

- Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

jobs.description:
#### Company Description

Meritis is an IT consulting, management, and development firm founded in 2007 with offices in Paris, Sophia-Antipolis, Aix-en-Provence, Montpellier, Toulouse, Nantes... And soon in new territories! Our mission? To connect the best talent with companies to give them a competitive edge.

We support our clients with all their digital transformation needs across numerous areas of expertise: Software Engineering, Finance, Project Management, Devops, Data, Cloud, Cybersecurity, and Agility.

Operating in sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Telecommunications, Industry, and Transport, 40% of CAC40 companies are now Meritis clients.

Driven by our values of excellence, humility, kindness, and proximity, we now have over 900 employees.

We make it a point of honor to be close to our employees and to support them individually, regardless of their role in the company. Certified as a Great Place To Work since 2013, our concept of well-being at work goes far beyond a simple label; our employees describe it best: [https://www.glassdoor.fr/Avis/Meritis-Avis-E1163008.htm](https://www.glassdoor.fr/Avis/Meritis-Avis-E1163008.htm).

#### Job Description

You will work for one of our clients in the specialized sports retail sector. As part of their infrastructure modernization, an initial project is underway with a service provider, and the goal is to extend this momentum to the store network.

Your main missions:

- Manage the service provider in charge of the scoping study: scoping the perimeter and workload, monitoring the schedule and milestones, facilitating follow-up meetings, and resolving blockers
- Challenge and secure the study deliverables (current state analysis, scenarios, target trajectory, prerequisites, costing, risk analysis) before client validation
- Contribute to defining the migration trajectory for messaging from Exchange On-Premises to Exchange Online for the store perimeter
- Contribute to defining the deployment scenario for the Microsoft 365 Apps suite across the store fleet (packaging, update channels, licenses, remote operation constraints)

#### Qualifications

- Microsoft 365: Exchange Online and migration from Exchange On-Premises, Microsoft 365 Apps (deployment, licenses, update channels), tenant administration
- Identity and Access Management: Active Directory, Entra ID, Entra Connect, identity models, and privileged account management
- Windows 10 / 11 workstation: domain or Entra ID join, master and packaging, management via Intune and / or SCCM, patch management
- Workstation security: removal of local administrator rights, handling of generic accounts and automatic login
- Multi-site environments such as store networks: network constraints, remote operation, absence of local IT support
- Project and service provider management: planning, deliverable review, risk management, reporting, and governance

#### Additional Information

Becoming a Meritis employee means:

- Tailor-made professional paths (career development, adapted training, mentoring...);
- Having a choice of mission and personalized support throughout your career;
- Evolving in an environment where learning is encouraged: certifying training, e-learning, meetUps, coding competitions, development paths, etc.;
- Being part of expert communities that share their knowledge and experience within our centers of excellence;
- A friendly environment with numerous festive events (annual party, seminars & teambuilding, lunches, and afterworks...);

_"Meritis is committed to Corporate Social Responsibility. We value our positive impact on society and the environment. Our CSR approach guides each of our actions to promote equity, sustainability, and the well-being of our employees. Join us to be part of this responsible approach, where each of our talents contributes to building a better future._

_Our differences are our strengths. That is why Meritis is committed to diversity and non-discrimination. All our positions are accessible to people with disabilities."

jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust.

At Jamf , we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #One Jamf .

What you’ll do at Jamf :

The Consulting Engineer's (CE) primary role is to partner within Sales and other departments to achieve sales and revenue goals, serving as technical authority and escalation resource for complex opportunities. This role blends deep Apple ecosystem expertise with advanced security knowledge across endpoint protection, identity management, and network security, enabling you to design and deliver integrated enterprise solutions that drive innovation and support our customers beyond traditional device management. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing teams, as well as industry partners, to deliver secure, scalable, and innovative solutions for enterprise environments.

This position is only available internally for employees located in The Netherlands, The United Kingdom, Germany or France. We are only able to accept applications for those based in The Netherlands, The United Kingdom, Germany or France and have sponsorship to live and work in The Netherlands, The United Kingdom, Germany or France #Li-Remote

What you can expect to do in this role:

- Perform all job responsibilities in alignment with the core values, mission and vision of the organization

- Provide technical consultation and technical escalation for Sales and other departments

- Serve as technical escalation resource for Sales Engineers on complex, strategic opportunities requiring advanced architecture expertise or executive engagement

- Continuously update expertise and demonstrate deep understanding of subject matter specific to role assignment, including but not limited to:

- Architecture of Jamf 's comprehensive platform solutions: Jamf for Mac, Jamf for Mobile, Jamf for K-12, and Jamf for Small Business

- Architecture of Android device management and security solutions

- Architecture of identity management solutions leveraging Platform SSO and enterprise directory integration

- Architecture of enterprise security infrastructure (SIEM, SOAR, IAM platforms)

- Architecture of Apple-centric zero-trust network frameworks such as Managed Device Attestation and WireGuard

- Architecture of cross-platform security frameworks for enterprise environments

- Architecture of Apple and Android-centric security frameworks for enterprise environments

- Understanding of common and emerging threat vectors and risks specific to Apple and Android enterprise environments

- Architecture of advanced Jamf configurations including automation frameworks and API integrations

- Custom workflows and automation for large-scale enterprise deployments

- Lead response to complex RFPs requiring comprehensive Apple enterprise expertise

- Deliver technical presentations and executive workshops for enterprise prospects and customers

- Collaborate with Sales, Professional Services, and Product teams to architect custom Apple enterprise solutions spanning management, endpoint security, and network security

- Build and maintain strategic partner relationships with complementary solution providers (Apple, Microsoft, CrowdStrike, Zscaler, Okta)

- Develop and deliver internal training and knowledge transfer on Apple enterprise best practices and emerging capabilities

- Create reusable implementation templates, automation tools, and methodologies for Apple enterprise deployments

- Serve as an escalation point for Sales, Marketing, and Product teams on Apple enterprise matters

- Represent Jamf as an Apple enterprise expert at industry events, conferences, and community forums

- Drive innovation initiatives to address gaps in current solutions or where no solution exists

- Contribute to product roadmap through field feedback and customer requirements

- Active participation in professional development opportunities and industry training

- Understand cross-platform integration scenarios and coexistence strategies in enterprise environments

- Special projects assigned by management

What are we looking for:

- Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in Apple device management, endpoint and/or network security (Required)

- Experience working in consultative sales, pre-sales engineering, or technical sales support roles (Required)

- Advanced knowledge of Apple Enterprise Management technologies, endpoint protection, identity management, and zero-trust network architectures (Required)

- Advanced knowledge of Jamf products and solutions (Required)

- Advanced knowledge of IT ecosystem and key partner integrations/complementary solutions including but not limited to Apple, Okta, Microsoft, CrowdStrike, Zscaler, SIEM/SOAR (Preferred)

- Specialized expertise in minimum 2 of the following areas: endpoint security architectures, identity and access management, zero-trust network architectures, SIEM/SOAR integration, API development and automation frameworks, Infrastructure as Code, emerging technologies (AI/ML, Apple Intelligence) (Preferred)

- Familiarity with scripting and automation languages (Go, Python, PowerShell, bash, Terraform, Ansible) and Apple developer languages (Swift, SwiftUI, Objective-C, Apple SDKs, Xcode) (Preferred)

- Experience responding to RFPs and developing comprehensive solution proposals (Required)

- Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes for executives and decision-makers (Required)

- Strong workshop and facilitation skills to align technical and business stakeholders (Preferred)

- Excellent written and oral communication skills in English (Required)

- Comfortable engaging with a wide range of personnel, from technical to executive positions (Required)

- Experience identifying solution gaps, ability to propose innovations, and execute subsequent implementation strategies (Preferred)

- Active participation in the Apple enterprise community including conferences, forums, user groups, thought leadership content, or public speaking (Preferred)

Education and certifications

- Secondary school diploma or equivalent (Required)

- 4 Year / Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent qualification) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Preferred)

- A combination of professional relevant experience and education may be considered

-
Jamf Certifications 300, 370, 400 (Preferred)

- Relevant partner or security certifications aligned with focus area (Preferred)

- Commitment to maintaining current certifications and pursuing emerging technology education

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

- Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.

- Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.

- Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf .

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

- Ability to travel for customer visits, conferences, or internal events approximately 20% of the year

- Flexible working hours may be required to accommodate regional business needs and collaboration with global teams

How we help you reach your best potential:

- We’re so proud to announce we've been named in @G2's 2025 Best Software Awards for:

🏆 Best Software for Enterprise Business

🏆 Best Software for Mid-Market Business

🏆 Best Software Companies
🏆 Best IT Management Software Products

-
Jamf is a 2024 TrustRadius Tech Cares Award Winner!

-

Jamf Protect has received the honor of Endpoint Security Solution of the Year in

CyberSecurity Breakthrough Awards, 2022.

-
Jamf Protect received the Security Software Solution of the Year, and Jamf Threat Defense has earned the title of Mobile Security Solution of the Year, in the 2022 Computer Security Awards.

What it means to be a Jamf ?We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #One Jamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do? Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf , customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #One Jamf

Jamf is committed to creating an inclusive & supportive work environment for all candidates and employees. Candidates with disabilities or religious beliefs are encouraged to reach out if they need additional support or alternative options to our recruiting processes to accommodate their disability or religious belief. If you need an accommodation, please contact your Recruiter or Recruiting Coordinator directly. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially by Recruiting and will not be shared with the hiring manager.
