jobs.description:
The Role

The Endpoint Intelligence & Automation Engineer is responsible for defining how General Motors measures, understands, and improves the health, performance, and digital experience of end user endpoints across the enterprise.

This role owns the strategy and execution for endpoint telemetry, reporting, and experience insights across computers and endpoint management systems. You will gather and connect data from endpoint platforms, management tooling, support systems, and operational sources to build a clear view of endpoint health, compliance, reliability, and user experience.

You will help establish the guardrails for how endpoint intelligence is collected, interpreted, and communicated — determining what signals matter most, how those signals are correlated, what constitutes a healthy endpoint experience, and how engineering and leadership teams should use that information to make decisions.

This role partners closely with endpoint engineering, platform teams, security, infrastructure, support, and leadership stakeholders to translate endpoint telemetry into actionable reporting, automation, and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Do

Own the endpoint telemetry, reporting, and digital experience insights strategy as part of the broader End User Engineering mission Gather, normalize, and analyze telemetry from computers, endpoint management platforms, support systems, and related operational data sources Define and maintain key performance indicators for endpoint health, stability, compliance, performance, and user experience Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reports for engineers, operational teams, and leadership audiences, with opportunities to leverage AI-assisted reporting and insight generation Translate telemetry signals into clear recommendations that improve endpoint reliability, supportability, security, and end user experience Partner with engineering teams to turn endpoint intelligence requirements into scalable data pipelines, automation, and reporting capabilities Create automated collection, correlation, and reporting processes that reduce manual effort and improve visibility across the environment, including the use of AI to help surface trends and relationships in data Support root cause analysis by connecting telemetry signals to incidents, degradations, misconfigurations, and service disruptions Measure the impact of platform changes, OS updates, policy changes, patching, and engineering initiatives using data-driven reporting Establish reporting standards, data quality practices, and governance for endpoint intelligence and experience measurement Communicate trends, risks, and improvement opportunities clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders Contribute to roadmap planning by using endpoint data and experience insights to inform priorities and investment decisions Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Analytics, or equivalent experience 6+ years in endpoint engineering, endpoint management, digital experience monitoring, IT operations, analytics, or related infrastructure roles Strong experience gathering telemetry and operational data from computers, endpoint management systems, and enterprise support platforms Experience creating comprehensive reports, dashboards, and presentations for engineering teams, operational stakeholders, and leadership audiences Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, and actionable insights from large or complex data sets Hands-on experience with enterprise endpoint ecosystems, including Windows, macOS, Linux, and/or VDI in a medium-to-large enterprise environment Experience with scripting and automation using tools such as PowerShell, Python, SQL, or similar technologies Demonstrated ability to translate technical data into operational recommendations, executive summaries, and measurable engineering actions Excellent communication skills and comfort working across engineering, security, infrastructure, operations, and business partners Solid background in: Endpoint telemetry collection and data correlation Reporting, dashboarding, and data visualization practices Endpoint management platforms and device compliance reporting Root cause analysis using operational and endpoint experience data Automation of recurring data collection, reporting, or remediation workflows Preferred Qualifications

Experience with digital employee experience, endpoint analytics, or experience monitoring platforms Experience with enterprise reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms Experience integrating data across endpoint management, asset, service management, monitoring, and support ecosystems Familiarity with modern endpoint management practices in large-scale enterprise environments Experience building automation that supports proactive detection, reporting, or remediation of endpoint issues Understanding of security, compliance, and data governance considerations related to endpoint telemetry Familiarity with Zero Trust principles and how endpoint health and device posture support access and security decisions Experience supporting executive reporting, operational reviews, or service performance management What Success Looks Like

Engineering teams have clear, trusted visibility into the health and digital experience of GM end user endpoints Leadership has concise, meaningful reporting on endpoint reliability, experience trends, risks, and opportunities Endpoint issues are identified earlier through telemetry and trend analysis rather than through reactive escalations alone Manual reporting effort is reduced through automation and repeatable data pipelines Platform changes and engineering investments are measured consistently with clear outcomes and supporting data A measurable improvement in endpoint experience: devices are more stable, performance issues are surfaced earlier, and end users experience fewer disruptions

jobs.title: Systems Engineer - Endpoint Automation & Management
jobs.summary: The Systems Engineer is responsible for engineering, standardizing, automating, and maintaining Windows endpoint environments across our managed customer base. This role owns the platforms and processes used to monitor, configure, patch, secure, and...
jobs.description:
The Systems Engineer is responsible for engineering, standardizing, automating, and maintaining Windows endpoint environments across our managed customer base. This role owns the platforms and processes used to monitor, configure, patch, secure, and deploy software to endpoints at scale, with particular ownership of the company’s Remote Monitoring and Management platform and PowerShell automation.

This is not primarily a traditional help desk or desktop support position. The focus is to reduce manual work and recurring issues by creating reliable standards, reusable automation, measurable controls, and repeatable deployment processes. The engineer will also serve as an escalation resource when endpoint issues expose gaps in our tooling, standards, or automation.

Core Responsibilities:

RMM Platform Ownership

• Own the administration, health, and continuous improvement of the company’s RMM platform across customer environments.

• Design and maintain standardized policies for monitoring, alerting, patching, agent health, software deployment, and automated remediation.

• Audit newly onboarded and existing environments against established standards and develop practical remediation plans.

• Identify recurring technician work and convert it into reliable RMM automation wherever practical.

• Maintain dashboards and reporting that provide visibility into endpoint health, patch compliance, failed jobs, and unmanaged or non-reporting devices.

PowerShell Automation and Software Deployment

• Design, test, and maintain production-ready PowerShell scripts for software deployment, configuration, auditing, remediation, and reporting across large numbers of endpoints.

• Build reusable deployment packages that support unattended installation, detection logic, version control, rollback or recovery planning, logging, and clear exit codes.

• Use pilot groups and phased rollouts to validate changes before broad deployment across customer environments.

• Develop scripts that safely handle different Windows versions, hardware platforms, customer configurations, and systems that may be intermittently connected.

• Maintain a controlled script library with documentation, change history, testing requirements, error handling, and support ownership.

Endpoint Management and Standardization

• Establish and maintain company standards for workstations, including operating system configuration, required applications, security settings, browsers, utilities, and support tools.

• Reduce unnecessary configuration differences between customers while allowing for legitimate business and application requirements.

• Develop repeatable workstation deployment, replacement, and lifecycle processes that minimize manual technician effort.

• Evaluate whether software and configuration changes should be delivered through RMM, Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, WinGet, Microsoft Store, or another approved platform.

Microsoft Intune and Entra ID

• Support Microsoft Entra joined and hybrid joined Windows environments and help customers move toward modern cloud-managed endpoint practices.

• Develop and maintain Windows Autopilot standards, enrollment profiles, Enrollment Status Pages, device groups, and repeatable deployment processes.

• Troubleshoot enrollment, synchronization, compliance, application deployment, identity, and policy issues.

• Evaluate new Microsoft endpoint management capabilities and recommend how they should be incorporated into company standards.

Patching, Security, and Endpoint Health

• Own the workstation patch management strategy across managed customers, including deployment rings, schedules, reboot policies, maintenance windows, compliance reporting, and failed-update remediation.

• Manage Windows feature update and end-of-support upgrade strategies using controlled, phased rollouts.

• Coordinate with the security team to ensure endpoint protection, EDR, encryption, firewall, and other required agents are installed, healthy, and reporting.

• Maintain BitLocker deployment and recovery key standards and assist with Microsoft security baselines and recommended Windows security settings.

• Identify unsupported operating systems, outdated applications, unhealthy agents, and improperly configured endpoints before they become operational or security emergencies.

Customer Onboarding and Engineering Escalation

• Assess endpoint configurations, management tools, patching, security agents, local administration practices, and software during new customer onboarding.

• Deploy and validate RMM, security, monitoring, and management agents, then bring endpoints into company standards through a phased remediation plan.

• Assist with workstation migrations involving Active Directory, Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, profiles, applications, and endpoint management platforms.

• Serve as an escalation resource for complex Windows, RMM, Intune, Entra ID, software deployment, patching, authentication, profile, policy, and endpoint security issues.

• Identify root causes and use escalations as input for better standards, documentation, monitoring, or automation rather than repeatedly treating symptoms.

Documentation and Continuous Improvement

• Maintain clear documentation for RMM policies, Intune configurations, scripts, deployment packages, patching standards, security configurations, and workstation build requirements.

• Create technical procedures and checklists that support engineers and technicians can follow consistently.

• Review ticket trends and operational data to identify problems that can be prevented through engineering or automation.

• Communicate changes to standards and tooling so the support team understands the intended process and expected outcome.

• Work collaboratively with support, systems, network, cloud, and security teams when endpoint issues cross technical boundaries.

Qualifications and Experience

• Experience administering and troubleshooting Windows 10 and Windows 11 in business environments.

• Experience with SCCM or an RMM platform, including monitoring, automation, patching, software deployment, agent health, or reporting.

• Working knowledge of PowerShell for software deployment, configuration, auditing, or remediation.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and modern Windows device management.

• Understanding of Windows application packaging, unattended installations, patch management, Active Directory, Group Policy, BitLocker, and endpoint security concepts.

• Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

• MSP experience, Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Graph or REST APIs, source control, and experience managing endpoints across multiple customer environments are helpful but not required.

Company DescriptionPioneer Technology is a nationwide Managed Services Provider with a strong focus on healthcare and
enterprise customers. We deliver secure, scalable IT solutions across cloud, networking, systems, and
security. Our mission is to help organizations modernize their technology environments while protecting
them against evolving cyber threats.

We are seeking a Senior Manager to join our Corporate Communications team. Reporting to the SVP, Internal Communications, this role will guide the product strategy, governance and adoption of NBCUniversal’s corporate employee channels – with a focus on intranet, email and Microsoft collaboration channels.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who can build strong partnerships across Communications, HR, Technology, functional teams and our NBCU businesses while independently driving day-to-day work from strategy through execution. The ideal candidate will be a visible champion for a more modern, connected and cohesive employee ecosystem at an exciting and critical time for NBCUniversal as it prepares to become a public, standalone company.

Key Responsibilities

NBCUNow Experience: Serve as product manager and day-to-day site owner for the reimagined NBCU employee intranet, partnering with business and corporate contributors across the company to ensure information remains current, relevant, accessible and aligned with platform standards. Employee Messaging Governance: Support the strategy and governance of NBCU internal messaging platforms, including enterprise email, app and AI agent communications. Provide clear guidance on which tools and channels to use for different communications needs, as well as the appropriate tone of voice for each. Establish standards, processes and best practices that create a consistent, effective employee communications experience. Content Owner Training and Support: Collaborate on training and development for content owners and channel managers across NBCU, including resource materials, office hours, best practices and communications about platform and governance updates. AI and Emerging Capabilities: Explore responsible opportunities to use AI and emerging technologies to improve employee communications systems, with a focus on integrating AI capabilities into the intranet. Platform Strategy and Product Support: Partner with Technology teams, vendors and Communications leaders to gather requirements, support platform roadmaps, coordinate enhancements and contribute to the ongoing evolution of NBCU’s digital workplace tools. Collaboration Platform Governance: Partner with stakeholders to define and reinforce how enterprise collaboration channels such as Microsoft Teams and Slack are used for employee communications, including ownership, access, publishing and channel-management standards. Platform Communications: Develop clear, actionable communications for content owners, channel managers and stakeholders related to publishing expectations, governance changes, platform enhancements and new capabilities.

Qualifications

Basic Requirements:

5+ years of experience in digital communications, digital product management or a related field. Experience managing or supporting intranets, content management systems, employee email platforms or enterprise collaboration tools. Solid stakeholder management skills and demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in a matrixed organization. Experience developing governance standards, publishing processes, templates, training materials or content-owner resources. Ability to interpret analytics and translate performance data into practical recommendations. Proven project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders and deadlines. Interest in leveraging AI and emerging technologies to improve and transform the employee experience Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $100,000-$125,000(bonus eligible).

Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you’ll do at Jamf:

The Consulting Engineer's (CE) primary role is to partner within Sales and other departments to achieve sales and revenue goals, serving as technical authority and escalation resource for complex opportunities. This role blends deep Apple ecosystem expertise with advanced security knowledge across endpoint protection, identity management, and network security, enabling you to design and deliver integrated enterprise solutions that drive innovation and support our customers beyond traditional device management. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing teams, as well as industry partners, to deliver secure, scalable, and innovative solutions for enterprise environments.

This position is only available for employees located in The Netherlands, The United Kingdom, Germany or France. We are only able to accept applications for those based in The Netherlands, The United Kingdom, Germany or France and have sponsorship to live and work in The Netherlands, The United Kingdom, Germany or France #Li-Remote

What you can expect to do in this role:

- Perform all job responsibilities in alignment with the core values, mission and vision of the organization

- Provide technical consultation and technical escalation for Sales and other departments

- Serve as technical escalation resource for Sales Engineers on complex, strategic opportunities requiring advanced architecture expertise or executive engagement

- Continuously update expertise and demonstrate deep understanding of subject matter specific to role assignment, including but not limited to:

- Architecture of Jamf's comprehensive platform solutions: Jamf for Mac, Jamf for Mobile, Jamf for K-12, and Jamf for Small Business

- Architecture of Android device management and security solutions

- Architecture of identity management solutions leveraging Platform SSO and enterprise directory integration

- Architecture of enterprise security infrastructure (SIEM, SOAR, IAM platforms)

- Architecture of Apple-centric zero-trust network frameworks such as Managed Device Attestation and WireGuard

- Architecture of cross-platform security frameworks for enterprise environments

- Architecture of Apple and Android-centric security frameworks for enterprise environments

- Understanding of common and emerging threat vectors and risks specific to Apple and Android enterprise environments

- Architecture of advanced Jamf configurations including automation frameworks and API integrations

- Custom workflows and automation for large-scale enterprise deployments

- Lead response to complex RFPs requiring comprehensive Apple enterprise expertise

- Deliver technical presentations and executive workshops for enterprise prospects and customers

- Collaborate with Sales, Professional Services, and Product teams to architect custom Apple enterprise solutions spanning management, endpoint security, and network security

- Build and maintain strategic partner relationships with complementary solution providers (Apple, Microsoft, CrowdStrike, Zscaler, Okta)

- Develop and deliver internal training and knowledge transfer on Apple enterprise best practices and emerging capabilities

- Create reusable implementation templates, automation tools, and methodologies for Apple enterprise deployments

- Serve as an escalation point for Sales, Marketing, and Product teams on Apple enterprise matters

- Represent Jamf as an Apple enterprise expert at industry events, conferences, and community forums

- Drive innovation initiatives to address gaps in current solutions or where no solution exists

- Contribute to product roadmap through field feedback and customer requirements

- Active participation in professional development opportunities and industry training

- Understand cross-platform integration scenarios and coexistence strategies in enterprise environments

- Special projects assigned by management

What are we looking for:

- Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in Apple device management, endpoint and/or network security (Required)

- Experience working in consultative sales, pre-sales engineering, or technical sales support roles (Required)

- Advanced knowledge of Apple Enterprise Management technologies, endpoint protection, identity management, and zero-trust network architectures (Required)

- Advanced knowledge of Jamf products and solutions (Required)

- Advanced knowledge of IT ecosystem and key partner integrations/complementary solutions including but not limited to Apple, Okta, Microsoft, CrowdStrike, Zscaler, SIEM/SOAR (Preferred)

- Specialized expertise in minimum 2 of the following areas: endpoint security architectures, identity and access management, zero-trust network architectures, SIEM/SOAR integration, API development and automation frameworks, Infrastructure as Code, emerging technologies (AI/ML, Apple Intelligence) (Preferred)

- Familiarity with scripting and automation languages (Go, Python, PowerShell, bash, Terraform, Ansible) and Apple developer languages (Swift, SwiftUI, Objective-C, Apple SDKs, Xcode) (Preferred)

- Experience responding to RFPs and developing comprehensive solution proposals (Required)

- Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes for executives and decision-makers (Required)

- Strong workshop and facilitation skills to align technical and business stakeholders (Preferred)

- Excellent written and oral communication skills in English (Required)

- Comfortable engaging with a wide range of personnel, from technical to executive positions (Required)

- Experience identifying solution gaps, ability to propose innovations, and execute subsequent implementation strategies (Preferred)

- Active participation in the Apple enterprise community including conferences, forums, user groups, thought leadership content, or public speaking (Preferred)

Education and certifications

- Secondary school diploma or equivalent (Required)

- 4 Year / Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent qualification) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Preferred)

- A combination of professional relevant experience and education may be considered

- Jamf Certifications 300, 370, 400 (Preferred)

- Relevant partner or security certifications aligned with focus area (Preferred)

- Commitment to maintaining current certifications and pursuing emerging technology education

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

- Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.

- Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.

- Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

- Ability to travel for customer visits, conferences, or internal events approximately 20% of the year

- Flexible working hours may be required to accommodate regional business needs and collaboration with global teams

How we help you reach your best potential:

- We’re so proud to announce we've been named in @G2 's 2025 Best Software Awards for:
🏆 Best Software for Enterprise Business
🏆 Best Software for Mid-Market Business
🏆 Best Software Companies
🏆 Best IT Management Software Products

-

Jamf is a 2024 TrustRadius Tech Cares Award Winner!

-

Jamf Protect has received the honor of Endpoint Security Solution of the Year in
CyberSecurity Breakthrough Awards, 2022.

-

Jamf Protect received the Security Software Solution of the Year, and Jamf Threat Defense has earned the title of Mobile Security Solution of the Year, in the 2022 Computer Security Awards.

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

jobs.description:
Leidos has opportunities for an experienced Project Manager to lead large-scale, complex technology migration initiatives spanning enterprise endpoints, network infrastructure, and related IT services.

Leidos has opportunities for an experienced Project Manager to lead large-scale, complex technology migration initiatives spanning enterprise endpoints, network infrastructure, and related IT services. This role will be responsible for planning and executing high-impact migration programs across multiple business units, locations, technology platforms, and stakeholder groups.

The ideal candidate is a strong delivery leader with demonstrated experience managing large-scale endpoint, network, infrastructure, or data center migration programs . The Project Manager will coordinate cross-functional technical teams, vendors, business stakeholders, and leadership to ensure migrations are executed safely, efficiently, and with minimal disruption to business operations.

This role requires exceptional organizational and communication skills, strong technical fluency, disciplined project governance, and the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams in a highly complex enterprise environment.

Key Responsibilities

-
Lead end-to-end planning and execution of large-scale endpoint and network migration programs , from strategy and discovery through implementation, validation, and operational handoff.

-
Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering scope, schedule, milestones, dependencies, resources, risks, issues, and deliverables.

-
Coordinate multiple technical workstreams, including endpoint engineering, network engineering, infrastructure, security, identity, application teams, service desk, field support, and vendors.

-
Establish migration waves, deployment schedules, readiness criteria, cutover plans, rollback procedures, and post-migration validation processes.

-
Manage migrations involving large populations of users, devices, offices, network sites, applications, and infrastructure components.

-
Drive project execution across geographically distributed locations and potentially multiple time zones.

-
Identify critical dependencies and proactively resolve risks and issues that could impact migration timelines, business operations, or user experience.

-
Establish and manage project governance, including status reporting, steering committee meetings, RAID logs, action tracking, and executive communications.

-
Partner with technical leads to ensure migration designs, implementation plans, testing strategies, and operational procedures are sufficiently mature before deployment.

-
Coordinate change management and communications activities to ensure impacted users and business stakeholders are prepared for migration events.

-
Manage vendor and third-party deliverables, schedules, commitments, and performance.

-
Track project financials, resource requirements, procurement needs, and vendor costs where applicable.

-
Lead cutover and command-center activities for high-risk or business-critical migration events.

-
Monitor migration performance and operational metrics, including deployment progress, success rates, incidents, defects, rollback events, and outstanding remediation.

-
Ensure appropriate documentation, knowledge transfer, and transition to operational support teams following each migration wave.

-
Escalate critical risks and decisions appropriately and provide clear recommendations to senior leadership.

-
Continuously improve migration processes, templates, governance, and execution methodologies based on lessons learned.

Required Qualifications

-
Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline , and 12+ years experience .

-
7+ years of project management experience , preferably within enterprise IT infrastructure or technology transformation environments.

-
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale endpoint, network, infrastructure, workplace technology, or similar migration programs .

-
Experience managing complex projects involving multiple technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and geographically distributed environments.

-
Strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure, including endpoints, networking, identity, security, infrastructure, cloud, and IT operations.

-
Proven experience developing and managing detailed project plans, migration schedules, dependencies, risks, issues, and resource plans.

-
Experience managing complex cutovers, deployment waves, go/no-go decisions, and rollback planning.

-
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and executive leadership.

-
Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills.

-
Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

-
Experience with standard project management methodologies and tools.

Preferred Qualifications

-
PMP, PgMP, or equivalent project/program management certification.

-
Experience leading migrations involving thousands or tens of thousands of endpoints and/or hundreds of network locations .

- Experience with enterprise endpoint management and deployment technologies such as Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager/SCCM, Autopilot, Jamf, or equivalent platforms.

-
Experience with network transformation or migration initiatives involving LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, firewalls, wireless, routing/switching, VPN, or network modernization.

-
Experience with Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, identity modernization, or cloud migration programs.

-
Experience working within large enterprise, highly regulated, or geographically distributed organizations.

-
Familiarity with ITIL-based service management and operational transition processes.

-
Experience with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies.

-
Experience using tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent project management platforms.

* Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en soporte técnico de segundo nivel.

jobs.description:
**About Persistent:**

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.5M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. Our 26,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We won the ++2025 ISG Star of Excellence™ Award for AI and Data Excellence++ and were named a ++Leader in the Everest Group Talent Readiness for Next-generation Data, Analytics and AI Services PEAK Matrix® Assessment 2025++.

**Role:** Microsoft 365 Intune Architect / SME

**Location:** Mexico

**Experience:**10+ years overall IT experience with 5+ years of Microsoft Intune Architecture experience

**Job Type:** FTE

**Mandatory 3 Skills:** Microsoft Intune \| Windows Autopilot \| Microsoft Entra ID

**About Position**

The Microsoft 365 Intune Architect is responsible for designing, governing, and implementing enterprise endpoint management solutions using Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Defender, Conditional Access, and Microsoft 365 services. The role provides technical leadership, architecture governance, security best practices, migration strategy, and operational excellence for modern device management.

**What You'll Do**

* Design enterprise-scale Microsoft Intune architecture across Windows 10/11, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, Android Enterprise, and Windows 365 Cloud PCs.
* Define endpoint management strategy, governance frameworks, and technology roadmaps.
* Create High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs), solution architectures, and implementation plans.
* Design hybrid and cloud-native endpoint management solutions.
* Design and implement Microsoft Entra ID integration, Conditional Access, MFA, and Zero Trust frameworks.
* Define compliance and security baselines aligned with CIS and NIST best practices.
* Design and govern Windows Autopilot, Apple Business Manager (ABM), ADE, and Android Enterprise deployment strategies.

jobs.description:
**Position Summary** Designs, engineers, integrates, and continuously improves enterprise endpoint security capabilities protecting workstations, servers, mobile devices, and virtual desktop environments. Develops secure endpoint engineering patterns, hardening standards, reference configurations, security telemetry, and technical controls across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms. Partners with Security Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Endpoint and Infrastructure teams, Security Operations, Vulnerability Management, and technology owners to translate cybersecurity requirements into secure, scalable, and operationally supportable endpoint solutions.

This role maintains deep hands-on technical expertise and supports engineering, implementation, verification, and complex troubleshooting of security capabilities, while partnering with appropriate technology and operations teams for routine production administration and lifecycle operations.

**What will you do:**

* Design, engineer, integrate, and continuously improve enterprise endpoint security capabilities including EDR/XDR, endpoint protection, encryption, application and device control, attack-surface reduction, and device security compliance.
* Develop and maintain secure endpoint engineering standards, hardening baselines, reference configurations, technical documentation, and implementation guidance for Windows, macOS, Linux, servers, virtual desktops, mobile devices, and applicable systems supporting manufacturing environments.
* Partner with Security Architecture and Enterprise Architecture to translate cybersecurity requirements, Zero Trust principles, standards, and risk requirements into implementable endpoint security designs and controls.
* Lead endpoint security engineering for new capabilities, platform changes, migrations, major upgrades, and complex technology initiatives, including development of reference implementations and proofs of concept.
* Perform endpoint security assessments, technical risk analyses, architecture and configuration reviews, and control-effectiveness testing to identify security gaps and recommend scalable improvements.
* Engineer and verify endpoint security telemetry, logging, and integrations supporting Security Operations, Incident Response, and Vulnerability Management.
* Participate in complex cybersecurity investigations and incidents, providing advanced endpoint security and forensic expertise including telemetry analysis, containment design, and verification of endpoint response controls.
* Develop automation using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph APIs, platform APIs, scripting, and enterprise management technologies to improve security consistency, repeatability, verification, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with endpoint management teams to integrate and verify security requirements throughout the device and system lifecycle.
* Evaluate emerging endpoint security technologies, AI-enabled security capabilities, vendor capabilities, and industry practices; conduct technical evaluations and provide recommendations regarding enterprise adoption and applicable compliance requirements.

**What you need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related discipline required; Master's degree preferred.
* Certifications preferred: CISSP, Microsoft security or endpoint certifications, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Tanium, Jamf, cloud security certifications, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
* Advanced training or demonstrated expertise in endpoint protection, EDR/XDR, endpoint management technologies, Windows and Linux security, OS hardening, application control, endpoint telemetry, and security automation preferred.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Minimum 6 years of enterprise endpoint security engineering experience.
* Deep hands-on experience with one or more enterprise endpoint security ecosystems such as Microsoft Defender for Endpoint/XDR, CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with enterprise endpoint management and security platforms such as Microsoft Intune, Tanium, Jamf, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong knowledge of securing Windows, macOS, Linux, server, virtual desktop, and mobile operating environments.
* Experience developing and implementing endpoint hardening standards, CIS Benchmarks, Microsoft Security Baselines, encryption, application/device control, attack-surface reduction, and device security compliance.
* Experience analyzing endpoint vulnerabilities and misconfigurations and developing scalable remediation or compensating-control strategies.
* Experience with EDR telemetry, endpoint investigation, forensic artifacts, threat hunting, and supporting cybersecurity incident response.
* Experience scripting and automating endpoint security functions using PowerShell, APIs, Microsoft Graph, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience supporting cloud and hybrid enterprise environments and modern endpoint/device management architectures.
* Working knowledge of Zero Trust principles, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, emerging AI security considerations, and applicable cybersecurity and regulatory requirements.

Summary:
VIAVI (NASDAQ: VIAV) is a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. VIAVI is also a leader in light management technologies for 3D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications.

We are the people behind the products that help keep the world connected at home, school, work, at play, and everywhere in between. VIAVI employees are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.
Duties & Responsibilities:

VIAVI is seeking an experienced IT End User Support Client Engineering Manager to lead the day-to-day delivery, engineering, and operational support of enterprise end-user computing services. This role will supervise client engineering and end user support activities across device lifecycle management, endpoint configuration, software deployment, patching, workplace technology support, and service improvement initiatives.

You will play a key leadership role in improving employee experience, strengthening endpoint security and compliance, standardizing support operations, and enabling scalable, reliable workplace technology services across a global enterprise environment.

- Supervise daily end user support and client engineering operations to ensure timely resolution of incidents, service requests, and escalations in alignment with service expectations.

- Lead endpoint lifecycle management activities, including provisioning, deployment, refresh, relocation, recovery, and decommissioning of laptops, desktops, mobile devices, and related peripherals.

- Oversee client engineering standards for endpoint configuration, operating system images, software packaging, patching, policy enforcement, and device compliance.

- Drive continuous improvement in end user computing services through automation, standardization, self-service capabilities, and operational process enhancements.

- Partner with cybersecurity, infrastructure, identity, networking, and collaboration teams to deliver secure, integrated, and reliable workplace technology solutions.

- Monitor ticket queues, service trends, endpoint health, and support metrics to identify root causes, improve service quality, and reduce recurring issues.

- Coach and develop support and client engineering staff, establish clear priorities, and promote a culture of accountability, customer service, and continuous learning.

- Coordinate major endpoint-related rollouts, upgrades, and technology refresh initiatives with minimal disruption to business operations.

- Maintain and improve operational documentation, support procedures, knowledge articles, and technical standards to support consistency and audit readiness.

- Support onboarding, transfers, and offboarding processes by ensuring timely device readiness, access coordination, and asset control.

- Collaborate with vendors and internal stakeholders to evaluate new technologies, improve support models, and align end user services with business priorities.

- Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 8+ years of experience in end user support, desktop engineering, endpoint management, or workplace technology roles in a corporate enterprise environment.

- 2+ years of experience in a supervisory, team lead, or people management capacity supporting technical teams.

- Strong experience supporting Windows endpoints, Microsoft 365, collaboration tools, mobile devices, and enterprise productivity applications.

- Strong understanding of device imaging, patch management, software packaging, asset lifecycle controls, and endpoint security practices.

- Experience managing escalations, prioritizing operational workloads, and driving service delivery improvements using support metrics and root cause analysis.

- Strong communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in high-tech manufacturing or other complex global enterprise environments.

- Experience with modern device provisioning and management capabilities such as Windows Autopilot, Apple Business Manager, mobile device management, and zero-touch deployment models.

- Knowledge of endpoint security controls, encryption, compliance baselines, conditional access, and zero trust principles.

- Experience supporting conference room, collaboration, and workplace technology services.

- Familiarity with ITIL-based service management processes, knowledge management, and continual service improvement practices.

- Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, ITIL, Jamf, or CompTIA are a plus.

- Experience working with global teams, vendor partners, and onsite-offshore support delivery models.

jobs.description:
This position functions around the clock, 24/7/365, to deliver extensive support for the enterprise RHEL server environment.

This position functions around the clock, 24/7/365, to deliver extensive support for the enterprise RHEL server environment. The role involves the installation, configuration, management, operation, and maintenance of all RHEL server systems and RHEL Clusters (including Pacemaker). It is essential to ensure system stability through daily operations, patch management, monitoring, and troubleshooting, as well as providing support for SAP environments that operate on RHEL.

Key Responsibilities:

- Install, configure, and manage Linux servers and applications to ensure optimal performance and high availability.

- Monitor system performance, perform routine maintenance, and apply updates as needed.

- Identify and resolve issues related to the operating system, hardware, and network configurations.

- Implement and enforce security best practices within Linux environments, including firewalls, user permissions, and file integrity measures.

- Assist in the deployment and management of applications hosted on Linux servers.

- Document system configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting documentation for reference by the team.

- Support backup and recovery processes to maintain data integrity and availability.

- Collaborate with development teams to enhance deployment processes and ensure effective integration of Linux applications. Ensure that all RHEL systems are managed in accordance with vendor recommendations and security best practices, while also maintaining compliance with NCA, NIC, and SEC Cybersecurity regulations.

- Contribute to the management of the operating system lifecycle, including planning for version upgrades and decommissioning.

- Install, configure, manage, operate, and maintain RHEL server systems and clusters (e.g., RHEL 7, 8, 9). Provide daily operational support, including OS installation, monitoring, troubleshooting, virus protection, and resource management. Manage RedHat HA Extension (PACEMAKER) clusters and support SAP, SAP HANA, and SAP S/4HANA environments on the RHEL platform. Regularly review system logs and OS behavior to proactively monitor and address potential issues.

- Build strong relationships with the ERP, application, database, and web hosting teams for daily support, troubleshooting, and scheduled maintenance activities.

- Manage and maintain client agents for server monitoring (SCOM, AppDynamic) and server management (SCCM). Create and maintain technical and detailed design documentation, as well as technical operation documentation. Create, maintain, and delete user/group accounts and implement account policies. Raise and manage support tickets with RedHat, including troubleshooting, log collection, and follow-up.

Requirements

Requirements:

- Degree: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

- Years of Experience: 3-5+ years of practical experience in Linux System Administration (RHEL/CentOS) in an enterprise context.

- Special Technical Skills: Proficient in RHEL (versions 7, 8, 9) and RHEL Clustering (Pacemaker). Extensive experience in supporting SAP/SAPHANA on RHEL. Demonstrated ability in the installation, monitoring, troubleshooting, and patch management of operating systems. Experience in managing user and group accounts. Familiarity with monitoring solutions such as SCOM/AppDynamics and management tools like SCCM.

- Special Generic Skills: Capability to work in a 24/7/365 shift environment. Excellent documentation skills, including design and operational documentation. Strong teamwork abilities for effective collaboration with application and database teams. Awareness of cybersecurity regulations (NCA, NIC).

- Decision Authority Matrix: Authorized to install, configure, patch, and maintain all RHEL systems and clusters. Responsible for daily operations, monitoring, and troubleshooting of the RHEL environment. Empowered to create and manage user/group accounts and their associated policies. Oversee the entire lifecycle of vendor support tickets for RedHat.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Certifications such as Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Linux Professional Institute Certification (LPIC) are a plus.

- Experience with cloud services (AWS, Azure) for deploying and managing Linux applications.

- Familiarity with configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Puppet).

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong communication skills to work effectively with remote teams.

Benefits

Why Join Us:

Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team.

Competitive salary and benefits package.

Exciting projects and innovative work environment.

About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners , a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Solutions Engineer – IT Security & Compliance

We are looking for a high-performing Solutions Engineer specializing in IT Security and Compliance to join our teami. Acting as the technical backbone of our sales process, you will serve as the trusted advisor for our security portfolio—delivering high-impact product demonstrations, designing layered security architectures, and guiding customers through pre-sale strategies and post-sale implementations.

Key Responsibilities:

-

Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the technical expert across Kaseya’s security landscape, including Email Security, Microsoft 365 Defense, SIEM/MDR, and User-Based Security (Security Awareness Training & Identity Protection).

-

Technical Discovery & Demonstrations: Conduct deep-dive technical discoveries and deliver customized, scenario-based product demonstrations aligned with client threat profiles.

-

Architecture & Solution Design: Partner with Account Executives to design robust, multi-layered security and compliance frameworks tailored to client environments.

-

Compliance Advisory: Help clients align their security posture with major regulatory frameworks (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, NIST, CMMC) using Kaseya’s compliance and auditing tools.

-

Implementation & Best Practices: Provide post-sale technical consulting, assisting with deployment strategies, threat detection configurations, and ongoing security optimization.

-

Feedback Loop: Collaborate with Product Management to advocate for feature enhancements based on real-world threat intelligence and customer feedback.

Requirements:

-

Technical Experience: 3+ years of pre-sales or technical solution architecture experience in cybersecurity, email security, or managed security solutions.

-

Core Security Expertise: Hands-on knowledge of Email Security (phishing defense, DMARC/DKIM/SPF), Microsoft 365 security management, SIEM log analysis, and MDR workflows.

-

User-Centric Defense: Solid understanding of user-based security, including Identity and Access Management (IAM), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Security Awareness Training strategies.

-

Compliance & Governance: Strong working knowledge of security standards and frameworks, including HIPAA, PCI-DSS, NIST (800-171/800-53), and CMMC.

-

Infrastructure & Vulnerability Management: Deep familiarity with core IT infrastructure (Active Directory, Azure/Entra ID, core networking) and vulnerability assessment tools (e.g., OpenVAS, Nessus).

-

Channel & ITSM Knowledge: Familiarity with MSP service delivery models, Security Operations Center (SOC) workflows, and ITSM practices (ITSM/ITIL certification a plus).

-

Communication & Sales Acumen: Proven ability to translate complex threat vectors and compliance requirements into clear business value for C-level executives, technical leads, and non-technical stakeholders alike.

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives !

Additional information

MDM Data Engineer- Tampa, Florida

Be a part of a revolutionary change!

At Philip Morris International (PMI), we’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future.

With huge change, comes huge opportunity. So, if you join us, you’ll enjoy the freedom to dream up and deliver better, brighter solutions and the space to move your career forward in endlessly different directions. Our success depends on people who are committed to our purpose and have an appetite for progress.

About the Role:

As an Analyst Data Enablement, you will be the point of contact for all aspects of data engineering within the MDM data domain. This role involves taking end-to-end engineering accountability, understanding the technology and business needs, and articulating them effectively into technical design MDM space and implementing data pipelines to meet the business requirements. Your role is instrumental in delivering on time, on budget, and with utmost quality data engineering pipelines within the architecture and governance framework.

Your Day-to-Day:

Ensure Data Quality and Compliance by applying expertise in MDM and data governance principles, including data governance frameworks and practices, to ensure the relevancy, quality, security, and compliance of master data.Develop MDM Platform Requirements while articulating requirements for MDM frameworks and tools in platforms like Profisee, Informatica, Reltio, and advocate their adoption across teams.Design and Model master data entities in collaboration with data modelers, data governance leads, and business stakeholders.Build, test, deploy, and evolve the capabilities for data curation and publishing into the data platform using standards and best practices to deliver high quality, standardized and harmonized consumable data domains for consumption by Advanced Analytics and Operational use cases.Closely partner and collaborate with other team members from architecture, Data Engineering, Data Governance, Product Managers, Delivery, Data Management Services to curate ingested source data across multiple sources from cleansing and validating to standardizing, harmonizing and transforming for a single view to the enterprise.Collaborate with Data Governance and business intelligence, driving engineering and technical implementation of the master data solution & services, ensuring accountability across the organizationLead MDM initiatives to establish a single source of truth, ensuring consistency and accessibility across business domains.Apply MDM Solutions to business problems by addressing business challenges by applying MDM and data governance concepts, leading workshops and gathering information to evaluate readiness for data governance strategies.Improve the current level of automation and Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) of our MDM platform as well as do code reviews for your peers.Provide direction to vendor staff within engineering domain for MDM tracking their quality of work and output.

Who we’re looking for:

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Information Management, or Information Technology.5+ years of experience as an MDM Engineer with end to end design and development and hands on experience with MDM Tools (Profisee, SAP MDG, informatica, Reltio etc.) and Snowflake, Azure SQL database.Knowledge of standard data models within master data domains – Product, Customer, Finance, Reference Data, etc.Advanced SQL programming and building ETL/ELT processes using cloud platforms like Azure Data Factory or Matillion.Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Information Management, or Information Technology.Legally authorized to work in the U.S.Commutable distance to Tampa, Florida.

Annual Base Salary Range: $88,000-$110,000

What we offer:

We offer a competitive base salary, annual bonus (applicable based on level of position), great medical, dental and vision coverage, 401k with a generous company match, incredible wellness benefits, commuter benefits, pet insurance, generous PTO, and much more!We have implemented Smart Work, a hybrid model of working that promotes flexibility in the workplace.Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore.Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture where everyone’s contribution is respected; Collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong.Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provides endless opportunities to progress.Take pride in delivering our promise to society: To improve the lives of millions of smokers.

PMI is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

PMI is headquartered in Stamford, Conn., and its U.S. affiliates have more than 3,000 employees.

PMI has been an entirely separate company from Altria and Philip Morris USA since 2008. PMI’s affiliates first entered the U.S. market following the company’s acquisition of Swedish Match in late 2022. Philip Morris International and its U.S. affiliates are working to deliver a smoke-free future. Since 2008, PMI has invested $12.5 billion globally to develop, scientifically substantiate and commercialize innovative smoke-free products for adults who would otherwise continue to smoke with the goal of transitioning legal-age consumers who smoke to better alternatives. In 2022, PMI acquired Swedish Match – a leader in oral nicotine delivery – creating a global smoke-free champion led by the IQOS and ZYN brands. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has authorized versions of PMI’s IQOS electronically heated tobacco devices and Swedish Match’s General snus as Modified Risk Tobacco Products and renewal applications for these products are presently pending before the FDA. For more information, please visit www.pmi.com/us and www.pmiscience.com.

jobs.title: Executive Director Employee Technology & Digital Workplace
jobs.summary: This role leads Employee Technology & Digital Workplace, a significant function within Digital and Technology, directing the Service Desk and ServiceNow ITSM platform, employee lifecycle technology (onboarding/offboarding), digital workplace engineering,...
jobs.description:
This role leads Employee Technology & Digital Workplace, a significant function within Digital and Technology, directing the Service Desk and ServiceNow ITSM platform, employee lifecycle technology (onboarding/offboarding), digital workplace engineering, field/deskside support, and M365 and collaboration platform delivery through subordinate management. The Executive Director determines the organizational structure and operational direction for the function and participates with senior management in developing the strategic plans and objectives that govern it, ensuring the function's direction remains tied to company-wide performance and responds effectively to Regeneron's constantly changing business needs.

The Executive Director brings in-depth knowledge of the functional area, Regeneron's business strategies, and the company's goals to reposition employee-facing IT as a modern, consumer-grade digital experience. Decisions on strategy, investment, and operating model in this function have a measurable, long-term effect on employee productivity, cost-to-serve, and the company's ability to attract and retain talent — the Executive Director is expected to bring strength and clarity to the function during periods of growth or major change, and to lead effectively even where direction is ambiguous.

This is the next iteration of IT service delivery at Regeneron — evolving the function from a ticket- and SLA-driven operation into a proactive, experience-led organization measured on employee sentiment, self-service adoption, and time-to-resolution, not just uptime. The Executive Director partners closely with Enterprise Architecture on technical standards and platform decisions, and with IT Strategy & Transformation, which sponsors chartered modernization initiatives into this tower without assuming direct reporting authority.

Where and When

This is an on-site position 4 days/week, primarily based at our Sleepy Hollow, NY or Warren, NJ office. If eligible, we can offer relocation benefits; we cannot offer a fully remote option.

What You'll Lead

Employee Technology Strategy & Digital Experience Vision

Participate with senior IT and business leadership in developing the strategic plans and objectives for employee technology, ensuring the function's direction stays tied to company-wide performance and adapts to constantly changing business needs. Define and own the vision, roadmap, and operating model for Employee Technology & Digital Workplace, positioning IT as a modern, consumer-grade digital experience rather than a traditional service organization. Translate employee and business feedback into a prioritized modernization roadmap across service desk, ITSM, endpoint, and lifecycle technology. Champion a "digital-first, self-service-first" philosophy, shifting volume away from live support and toward intuitive, automated, and AI-enabled experiences. Partner with IT Strategy & Transformation to align sponsored modernization initiatives (e.g., virtual agent/AI deflection, unified employee portal) with this tower's operational roadmap and capacity. Service Desk & ITSM Operations (ServiceNow)

Own end-to-end Service Desk operations, including tiered support, major incident management, and escalation processes across a global, follow-the-sun model. Drive continuous modernization of the ServiceNow platform — intelligent routing, virtual agent/chatbot deflection, knowledge management, and workflow automation — to reduce ticket volume and resolution time. Establish and monitor experience-led metrics (CSAT, first-contact resolution, deflection rate, mean time to resolve) as the primary measures of success, alongside traditional SLAs. Ensure ticketing, request, and knowledge processes are simple, consistent, and easy for employees to navigate regardless of how they choose to engage (portal, chat, phone, walk-up). Own GRC, vendor risk management (VRM), and policy exception workflows on the ServiceNow platform, ensuring timely processing and audit-ready records. Own portal and content management for the ServiceNow platform, ensuring employees can easily find and act on the right services and policies. Employee Lifecycle Technology (Onboarding & Offboarding)

Own the technology experience for onboarding, transfers, and offboarding, ensuring new hires are productive on day one and departures are secure and frictionless. Modernize onboarding/offboarding into an automated, orchestrated workflow spanning identity, access provisioning, equipment, and collaboration tools — eliminating manual handoffs across HR, IT, and Security. Partner with HR, Security, and Facilities to design a seamless, employee-centric lifecycle journey, with clear accountability for every step and status transparent to the employee and their manager. Continuously reduce time-to-productivity for new hires and time-to-deprovision for departures, tracking both as core experience and risk metrics. Digital Workplace Engineering & Endpoint Experience

Own engineering and lifecycle management for employee-facing technology: endpoints, mobility, unified endpoint management (UEM), collaboration tools, and meeting room/AV technology. Drive modernization of the digital workplace — proactive device health monitoring, zero-touch provisioning, self-healing endpoints, and simplified software deployment — to minimize disruption to employees. Ensure collaboration and meeting technologies (video, conferencing, messaging) provide a consistently excellent experience across office, lab, and hybrid work settings. Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Security to ensure digital workplace standards remain secure, scalable, and aligned to enterprise architecture principles. M365 & Collaboration Platform Delivery

Own service delivery for the M365 platform — Teams, SharePoint, Exchange, OneDrive, and Power Automate — including platform guardrails, governance, and adoption. Own voice and unified communications service delivery, ensuring reliable, modern calling and conferencing capability across the enterprise. Drive continuous improvement of collaboration tooling to reduce friction and support hybrid and global ways of working. Partner with Enterprise Architecture on platform roadmap decisions and with Security on data governance within M365 workloads. Field & Deskside Support Operations

Own field and deskside support across all Regeneron sites, ensuring consistent, high-quality in-person support where self-service and remote resolution aren't sufficient. Right-size the deskside support model as digital self-service and remote resolution capabilities mature, reallocating capacity toward higher-value, in-person needs (labs, executive support, events). Ensure support models scale appropriately across site types (corporate, R&D/lab, manufacturing) with services tailored to how each site's population actually works. Own end-to-end lifecycle management of end-user assets — procurement coordination, deployment, tracking, refresh cycles, and secure disposal/decommissioning. Maintain accurate asset inventory and compliance reporting to support audit, cost management, and security requirements. Experience Measurement & Continuous Improvement

Establish a consistent employee experience measurement framework (CSAT, NPS, effort scores) across every touchpoint in this tower, replacing purely operational SLA reporting. Run a continuous improvement cadence — mining ticket, sentiment, and usage data to identify friction points and prioritize fixes before they become recurring complaints. Report employee technology experience trends and improvement outcomes to executive stakeholders, connecting operational data to business and workforce impact. Vendor & Platform Management

Own vendor relationships and contracts for service desk, ITSM, endpoint, and digital workplace tooling, ensuring value, performance, and roadmap alignment. Establish a vendor governance cadence — performance scorecards, quarterly business reviews, and value/ROI tracking — holding vendors accountable to continuous improvement commitments rather than static contract terms. Partner with Finance and Procurement to manage the cost-to-serve for employee technology, balancing experience improvements against operating budget discipline. Evaluate emerging digital workplace and AI-enabled support technologies, building the business case for adoption where they meaningfully improve employee experience or reduce cost-to-serve. People Leadership, Mentoring & Team Culture

Determine the organizational structure and operational direction for the function, directing critical work through subordinate managers and senior leaders. Build, lead, and develop a high-performing, globally distributed organization across service desk, lifecycle technology, digital workplace engineering, and field support. Mentor and coach people leaders across the organization, investing in career growth, succession planning, and bench strength. Model and reinforce a customer-obsessed, continuous-improvement culture, holding the team accountable to employee experience outcomes, not just ticket throughput. Champion development and team culture within the function, fostering collaboration across a global, follow-the-sun operating model. Key Working Relationships

This role is viewed across Regeneron as a role model for employee-centric technology delivery and is regularly sought out by leaders at all levels for advice on employee technology matters. Because much of this role's influence runs through governance and partnership rather than direct authority over every function it touches, it also serves as the principal spokesperson for employee technology and digital workplace matters on highly significant issues, and is expected to negotiate difficult matters with senior management and functional heads, both internally and externally.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Engineering, or a related field is required. A master's degree or MBA is preferred. 17+ years of progressive experience in IT service delivery, end-user computing, digital workplace, or IT operations leadership roles. Deep expertise in ITIL or equivalent service management frameworks, and hands-on experience modernizing an ITSM platform (ServiceNow strongly preferred). Proven experience redesigning employee lifecycle technology (onboarding/offboarding) into an automated, cross-functional workflow spanning IT, HR, and Security. Strong grounding in digital workplace and end-user computing technologies — unified endpoint management, collaboration platforms, mobility, and AV/conferencing. Track record of building and using experience metrics (CSAT, NPS, deflection rate, first-contact resolution) to drive continuous improvement, not just SLA compliance. Experience leveraging automation, self-service, and AI/virtual agent technologies to reduce support volume and improve employee experience. Proven ability to build, scale, and lead large, globally distributed service organizations, including hiring, developing, and retaining talent across a follow-the-sun model. Experience operating in a matrixed, governance-driven environment — partnering with peers in Enterprise Architecture and IT Strategy & Transformation without direct authority over their teams. Strong vendor and contract management experience, including negotiating and managing platform and outsourced support relationships, with a track record of driving ongoing vendor performance and value through structured governance (scorecards, business reviews). Sound business and financial acumen, with experience managing cost-to-serve and building business cases for employee technology investment. Proven ability to bring strength and clarity to a business during periods of growth or major change, exercising sound judgment and taking a positive leadership role amid ambiguity or limited direction. Se valorarán conocimientos sobre despliegue e implantación de soluciones Endpoint y XDR, aunque estas funciones no constituirán el foco principal del puesto.

Esta posición representa una excelente oportunidad para profesionales apasionados por la ciberseguridad que deseen contribuir activamente a la protección de organizaciones de alto nivel.

Responsabilidades:

* Analizar eventos, alertas y registros de seguridad procedentes de plataformas Endpoint, EDR, XDR y SIEM para identificar amenazas potenciales y actividades sospechosas.
* Investigar incidentes de ciberseguridad, participando en las actividades de detección, análisis, contención y seguimiento hasta su resolución.
* Administrar y optimizar las capacidades de monitorización, detección y respuesta de las soluciones Endpoint y XDR.
* Colaborar en la definición y mejora de casos de uso, reglas de detección, procedimientos operativos y playbooks de respuesta.
* Realizar análisis de amenazas, indicadores de compromiso (IoC) y tendencias emergentes para fortalecer la postura de seguridad.
* Colaborar con otros equipos de seguridad y operaciones para mejorar la capacidad de prevención, detección y respuesta ante incidentes.
* Participar en la integración y puesta en marcha de nuevas capacidades de protección Endpoint y XDR, aportando conocimientos funcionales y operativos.
* Mantenerse actualizado/a sobre las últimas amenazas, vulnerabilidades, técnicas de ataque y tendencias del sector de la ciberseguridad.

Requisitos:

* Titulación en Informática, Ciberseguridad o áreas afines. Se valorará experiencia equivalente.
* Más de 5 años de experiencia en ciberseguridad, con foco en tecnologías Endpoint, EDR, XDR y SIEM.
* Experiencia en administración, monitorización y análisis de soluciones de protección Endpoint y XDR.
* Conocimientos en análisis de logs, correlación de eventos, detección de amenazas y Threat Hunting.
* Experiencia en gestión e investigación de incidentes de ciberseguridad.
* Conocimiento de procesos de respuesta ante incidentes, casos de uso y buenas prácticas de operaciones de seguridad.
* Conocimientos de integración y despliegue de soluciones Endpoint y XDR, valorándose experiencia en proyectos de implantación.
* Capacidad analítica, orientación a la resolución de problemas y buenas habilidades de comunicación.
* Certificaciones de seguridad como Security+ (deseable ), CySA+, SC-200, SC-100, CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator/Analyst, CEH, GSEC o CISSP.

*Únete a un equipo que impulsa la innovación y trabaja en proyectos de alto impacto.*

*Ofrecemos la oportunidad de asistir, junto al equipo de ciberseguridad, a conferencias, ponencias y charlas en Congresos de Seguridad Informática, como Navaja Negra, RootedCON, Hacken, jornadas CCN STIC, etc. al ser patrocinadores de muchos de estos eventos.*

*Ponemos a tu disposición un amplio catálogo formativo en competencias tecnológicas y certificaciones de acuerdo con las exigencias de los proyectos y clientes. Formación en idiomas, donde podrás elegir entre 12 opciones. Formación en habilidades personales dentro del ámbito profesional. Uso de otras plataformas adicionales como Udemy y OpenWebinars.*

*Te ofrecemos una retribución a la carta, pudiendo elegir diferentes productos y modelar tú mismo cómo distribuirlos: seguro de salud, tickets de comida, guardería, tarjeta transporte y formación. Además, contarás con un seguro de vida incluido como parte de tus beneficios. También tendrás acceso a ventajas del grupo de empresa, como descuentos en diversos productos y servicios.*

*El contrato será indefinido, con un horario flexible de oficina, con posibilidad de teletrabajar para poder conciliar de la mejor forma tu vida personal-profesional. Proporcionamos estabilidad y un excelente ambiente laboral, formado por los mejores profesionales en el ámbito de la Ciberseguridad.*

*Ofrecemos una atractiva carrera profesional en función de la experiencia y potencial personal, dentro de una compañía en continua evolución y con un sólido crecimiento.*
