jobs.description:
**The Basics**

We are seeking a highly skilled IT Infrastructure Engineer with expertise in Systems Administration to join the IT Engineering team at Tanium. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in designing, implementing, and managing our hybrid systems infrastructure to ensure the availability, security, and maintenance of our systems.

**_This position follows the Company’s hybrid schedule which currently requires employees to work in the office at one of the following locations a minimum of three days per week: Addison, TX; Bellevue, WA; Durham, NC; or Emeryville, CA._**

**What you'll do**

- Embrace Tanium’s mission and core values.
- Act as member of IT Infrastructure Engineering team with a focus on systems management and project delivery
- Perform infrastructure deployment, management, planning, scaling, scheduling, etc.
- Drive and enhance automation wherever possible in the name of efficiency, scalability, and consistency
- Work with a variety of key business groups to architect and implement technology and solutions
- Be accountable for ensuring all technology is documented, deployed and configured securely and in alignment with best practices
- Leverage AI and automation tools extensively for daily tasks, integrations and operationand management of IT and business services
- Follow the change management process for system configuration, installations, and maintenance
- Collaborate with other technical teams to resolve operational challenges and streamline workflows
- Participate in projects related to iInfrastructure, business execution, security, etc
- Solve incidents and administrative tasks related to infrastructure services and other escalations from end-user support.
- Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, processes, and procedures.
- Effectively communicate technical concepts and solutions to non-technical stakeholders, fostering a collaborative and productive working environment.
- Participate in on-call rotations
- Be a team player who is adaptive, self-motivated, and solution-oriented

**We’re looking for someone with**

4+ years as a Systems Administrator, Operations Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Engineer or similar, with relevant enterprise experiencein the following areas:

- Strong background with Linux, Windows andVMware(or similar) systems administration and deployment.
- Direct administration experience with Cloud Computing & Networking Environments. Azure (preferred), AWS, and GCP.
- Experience with Bash, Python and PowerShell scripting
- Experience with TCP/IP networking and troubleshooting.
- Experience with backups, high availability and overall infrastructure resiliency for cloud and on-premises technology required
- Familiarity with monitoring and management of enterprise systems running on physical and cloud infrastructure required
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code toolsets – e.g. Terraform, Vault.
- Experience with Configuration Management toolsets - Ansible (Preferred).
- Experience with SAN storage arrays and troubleshooting.
- Ability to estimate and manage cloud usage costs and identify and operationalize cost control mechanisms preferred
- Familiarity with CI tools - GitHub Actions (preferred)
- Familiarity with Docker and other container technologies (Kubernetes, Amazon ECS/EKS)
- Demonstrated ability to work with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, GRC, Product Engineering and other teams to drive architectural decisions for cloud and on-premises technologies

**About Tanium**

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. Driven by AI and real-time endpoint intelligence, Tanium Autonomous IT empowers IT and security teams to make their organizations unstoppable.

Many of the world’s leading organizations trust Tanium’s single, unified platform for endpoint management and security to innovate faster, stay resilient and move business forward with confidence, at scale. To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business – visit [www.tanium.com](http://www.tanium.com/) and follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/tanium) and [X](https://twitter.com/Tanium).

**On a mission. Together.**

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.

Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most.

**What you’ll get**

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $113,000 to $173,000. This range is an estimate for what Tanium will pay a new hire. The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, location, education, skills, training, and experience.

In addition to an annual base salary, team members will receive equity awards and a generous benefits package consisting of medical, dental and vision plan, family planning benefits, health savings account, flexible spending account, transportation savings account, 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, life, accident and disability coverage, business travel accident insurance, employee assistance programs, disability insurance, and other well-being benefits.

Tanium is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected Veteran status, or other legally protected categories. If you require a reasonable accommodation in searching for a job opening, completing an application, interviewing, or completing any pre-employment testing or requirements, please contact [accommodations@tanium.com](mailto:accommodations@tanium.com). For more information refer to the “Know Your Rights” poster which is available here - [https://www.eeoc.gov/poster](https://www.eeoc.gov/poster).

Please be aware of job offers coming from people claiming to be Tanium employees. Tanium employees will only use @tanium.com email addresses to communicate with you, will have video interviews with you, and will never ask you for money.

The machine-readable files are formatted to allow researchers, regulators, and application developers to more easily access and analyze data.

For more information on how Tanium processes your personal data, please see our [Privacy Policy](https://www.tanium.com/privacy-policy/).

jobs.description:
Job Title
Intune Administrator

Location
Downers Grove, IL

Duration
Contract 6 months with potential to extend

Visa
GC/USC/W2 Only

Job Description

We are seeking a skilled Intune Administrator to join our End User Technology team and help build a modern endpoint management platform from the ground up.
This role will focus on Windows Autopilot and zero-touch deployment, while also supporting application packaging and enabling scalable growth as the business expands globally. Experience with other platforms (macOS, iOS, Android) is a plus.

Responsibilities

Design and implement Windows Autopilot for zero-touch provisioning of Windows devices.
Build and maintain modern deployment workflows to support large-scale growth.
Administer and maintain Microsoft Intune for Windows devices; assist with macOS/iOS/Android as needed.
Configure compliance policies, configuration profiles, and conditional access rules.
Package and deploy applications (Win32, MSI, Microsoft Store, Winget) via Intune.
Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts and automation workflows (Graph API experience preferred).
Collaborate with InfoSec on compliance and security baselines (CyberArk EPM, Qualys).
Support global deployments and integration efforts to accommodate anticipated business growth.
Maintain documentation for Autopilot setup, Intune configurations, and app packaging standards.
Stay current with Intune and Autopilot updates, recommending improvements to enhance device management.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of experience managing Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot in an enterprise environment.
Proven experience building Autopilot and zero-touch deployment from scratch.
Strong knowledge of Windows 10/11 and modern device management (MDM).
Hands-on experience with application packaging and deployment (Win32, MSI, Winget).
Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation and troubleshooting.
Understanding of Azure AD, Conditional Access, Defender for Endpoint, and compliance policies.
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

jobs.description:
Job Description Exciting opportunity for a Senior Endpoint Security Engineer to join our Transport & Cybersecurity Services (TCS) team in Springfield, VA. TCS is a long-term, contract with the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) in support of the customer's GEOINT mission. The Endpoint Security Engineer will support our Intelligence Community customer's Endpoint Security Solutions platform. * Implement and apply technologies, processes, and practices designed to protect networks, devices, programs, and data from malicious attack, damage, or unauthorized access.

Provide engineering and sustainment support for the various endpoint security solutions. Establish computing environment by designing system configuration, directing system installation, and defining, documenting, and enforcing system standards. Provide specific, detailed information for hardware and software selection, implementation techniques, and tools for the most efficient solution to meet business needs, including present and future capacity requirements. Work with both the software vendor and the customer to research, analyze, and implement enterprise-wide security solutions/capabilities/enhancements to support customer business/mission goals and objectives. Assist with design, analysis, testing and implementation of state-of-the-art secure architectures. Oversee security infrastructure sustainment, maintenance, and advanced configuration (policy management, database administration and security management tools.) Oversee the reporting, documentation and investigation of all security related incidents; lead the development and implementation of corrective measures.

jobs.description:
Title: Senior Endpoint Engineer with strong AVD exp

Location: Alpharetta, GA; Charlotte, NC; Chicago, IL; Conshohocken, PA; Denver, CO; Fargo, ND; Garden City, NY; Houston, TX; Lubbock, TX; Morristown, NJ; Mt Juliet, TN; New York, NY; Purchase, NY; Topeka, KS – Hybrid 03 days per week from day 1 – Need local resources only

Duration: Long Term

Visa: Any

Type: Contract (C2C/ 1099)

ROLE SUMMARY

Designs, engineers, and supports enterprise endpoint computing solutions across Microsoft Intune, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows endpoints, and endpoint security platforms. Ensures secure, reliable, and efficient end-user computing services through automation, endpoint lifecycle management, policy governance, and platform optimization, enabling workforce productivity and maintaining a stable enterprise computing environment.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

• Drive delivery of roadmap initiatives on schedule and in accordance with established quality standards.

• Provide advice, guidance, and direction to carry out plans and procedures, ensuring schedule attainment, product development process adherence and performance.

• Provide last tier support for operations and support teams, including root cause analysis and preventative analysis.

• Provide technical support with expert knowledge and act as an escalation point for the Desktop Operations team and anything related to the End User Computing environment, focusing on our Endpoint Security Protection, and application management.

• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to design and implement endpoint solutions.

• Manage the Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) environment, including creating images, deploying virtual machines, monitor platform performance.

• Develop automated solutions for deploying software packages, application patches/updates and workstation images.

• Engineer, maintain, and support multiple Windows desktop images.

• Manage the entire lifecycle of our global standard desktop and laptop models.

• Design and implement Microsoft Intune solutions that meet end user requirements.

• Create and manage Intune policies for application deployment, device compliance, and security configurations.

• Ensure seamless integration with other Microsoft 365 services.

• Windows 11 Provisioning: Design and deploy Windows 11 provisioning processes using Intune Autopilot. Configure and manage Windows Update for Business policies. Develop and maintain standardized 11 deployment images.

• Active Directory Group Policy Management: Design and manage Group Policy Objects (GPOs) in Active Directory to enforce security and configuration policies. Collaborate with the Active Directory team to ensure alignment with broader infrastructure goals.

• Security and Compliance: Implement security best practices and compliance policies within Intune. Monitor and respond to security incidents related to mobile devices and endpoints.

• Documentation and Training: Create detailed documentation of Intune configurations, Windows provisioning processes, and Group Policy settings.

• Maintain desktop images and modify SCCM task sequences as needed.

• Package, test, validate, and deploy enterprise applications.

• Maintain and expand the End User Computing knowledge base.

• Create new and maintain existing support documents to maintain high standards of quality in the delivery of End User Computing services.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of IT infrastructure and endpoint engineering experience, including 5+ years designing and implementing Microsoft Intune solutions.

• 5+ years of systems engineering experience in a complex enterprise environment.

• Enterprise desktop engineering and endpoint support experience.

• Proven experience with Windows 11, Active Directory, and Group Policy management.

• Experience developing and testing software packages using InstallShield or equivalent packaging technologies.

• Experience managing VDI environments, preferably Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD).

• Expert-level experience in endpoint protection engineering and security controls.

• Advanced expertise with Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) and Microsoft Intune.

• Expert knowledge of patch management, including BIOS, firmware, operating system, and application updates.

• Basic database administration knowledge, particularly Microsoft SQL Server.

GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong collaboration and stakeholder engagement skills.

• Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

• Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.

EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university.

Regards,

Martin

jobs.summary: Erias Ventures was founded to serve its customers with an entrepreneurial mindset. We value creative problem-solving, open communication, and empowering our employees to make decisions and put forth new ideas. Our staff includes technical experts working...
jobs.description:
Erias Ventures was founded to serve its customers with an entrepreneurial mindset. We value creative problem-solving, open communication, and empowering our employees to make decisions and put forth new ideas.

Our staff includes technical experts working across multiple disciplines, bringing diverse perspectives to every project. We are seeking engineers who wish to grow their careers and want to become part of a technically strong and growth-oriented company focused on bringing innovative solutions to the difficult mission problems facing our customers.

Description

We are seeking a System Engineer Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM) Administrator to serve as the SME for on premise identity and Access Management (IAM) platform which, in this case, is MIM (Microsoft Identity Manager). This role focuses on ensuring data integrity across disparate internal systems, maintaining the health of the MIM sync engine and managing the full lifecycle of internal identities without external cloud dependencies. MIM Engine Management - Direct oversight of the MIM Synchronization Service including configuration of Management Agents (MAs) like AD, SQL, file-based extensions and LDAP sources.

Management - Direct oversight of the MIM Synchronization Service including configuration of Management Agents (MAs) like AD, SQL, file-based extensions and LDAP sourcesIdentify Lifecycle Automation - Understanding the "Joner-Mover-Leaver" process to ensure automated provisioning and de-provisioning across the internal networkDeclarative Provisioning - Maintaining Synchronization rules and attribute flow within the MIM Portal and Sync EngineCustom Extension Development - Debugging custom DLLS using C#/.NET for complex logic that cant' be handled by standard rulesData Reconciliation - Conducting regular audits to ensure identity data in the Metaverse matches authoritative sources and downstream sources

Clearance

A current Top-Secret/SCI with polygraph security clearance is required. Candidates cannot be sponsored or nominated for a government security clearance under this position.

Experience

The Controls Fleet team is responsible for supporting some of Amazon's most critical infrastructure services. As part of Amazon Web Services, we power the infrastructure behind the world's premier e-commerce and cloud computing environments. To meet the growing demand for AWS services worldwide, we seek exceptionally motivated individuals driven by learning and innovation. By joining us, you'll become part of a world-class team in a dynamic environment with the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up. jobs.description:
Edgewater Federal Solutions is seeking an Endpoint Engineer to support a major national laboratory.

This role provides advanced technical expertise for diagnosing and resolving complex endpoint issues, leading provisioning and lifecycle activities during high demand periods. It analyzes performance trends to drive workflow improvements, develops technical documentation, and collaborates with engineering, cybersecurity, and operations teams to define and uphold endpoint standards. The Endpoint Engineer position applies independent judgment to select methods and tools that enhance reliability and service quality.

Responsibilities

Serve as a subject-matter expert for advanced troubleshooting, diagnostic analysis, and remediation of endpoint and business application issues, leveraging deep technical expertise to resolve escalations and prevent recurrence. Provide advanced-tier technical support and troubleshooting for Windows and macOS endpoints, including operating systems, applications, endpoint agents, clients, services, connectivity, and configuration issues. Perform weekly Windows patching activities, including monitoring patch deployments, creating associated change requests, validating patch results, and performing light troubleshooting when patches fail. Perform endpoint remediation activities in coordination with Endpoint Engineering, including troubleshooting failed automations, scripts, software deployments, and endpoint configurations, and supporting the testing, validation, and production deployment of endpoint solutions. Support endpoint provisioning, configuration management, upgrade planning, and lifecycle optimization during surge periods or complex engagements, ensuring alignment with engineering standards. Support vulnerability management activities by reviewing vulnerability dashboards and reports, researching affected endpoints, executing established remediation scripts and processes, developing or modifying remediation scripts, deploying approved remediation, and managing associated tickets and change requests. Perform manual remediation of individual endpoints with multiple vulnerabilities, failed agents or clients, corrupted applications, or other conditions requiring hands-on troubleshooting. Monitor endpoint health and compliance dashboards and reports, identify endpoints that fall out of compliance, and perform appropriate remediation to restore endpoint health and compliance. Evaluate trends in endpoint performance, incident patterns, and operational workflows to recommend and implement improvements that enhance efficiency and support a shift-left strategy. Participate in the development, testing, and production deployment of solutions for special-purpose machine configurations and project-based endpoint deployments in collaboration with Endpoint Engineering. Analyze Windows Event Viewer, macOS Console, application logs, and endpoint management-agent logs to diagnose issues and support remediation. Develop documentation, technical runbooks, and knowledge base articles to enable operational excellence and support continuous improvement. Collaborate with cross-functional engineering, cybersecurity, and operations teams to support and uphold endpoint standards and ensure adoption of best practices. Exercise independent judgment in selecting methods, tools, and techniques to address technical challenges and improve endpoint reliability.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s preferred or equivalent experience. Minimum of 8 years related endpoint engineering or technical support experience. US Citizenship is required

The standard work schedule for this position is Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

To support operational demands and customer requirements, occasional evening, after-hours, and weekend work may be required.

Required Skills:

Strong Windows and macOS expertise. Experience with endpoint management platforms such as Microsoft Intune and/or Jamf. Working knowledge of PowerShell, Bash, or other shell scripting sufficient to execute, troubleshoot, and modify endpoint automation and remediation scripts. Strong customer service and technical communication skills

Prefereed Skills:

ADDITIONAL / PLUS EXPERIENCE: Windows/macOS hardening, deeper vulnerability management framework experience, advanced automation/ scripting experience.

Additional benefits include:

Competitive salary: $80,000 - $85,000 Paid Time Off & Holiday Pay Medical Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Disability, Life Insurance, and AD&D Flexible Spending Accounts 401K with employer matching contribution Tuition and Education Reimbursement Exercise Reimbursement Tech Reimbursement Employee Assistance Program Opportunities for professional development and growth Collaborative and dynamic work environment

About Us:

Edgewater Federal Solutions is a privately held government contracting firm located in Frederick, MD. The company was founded in 2002 with the vision of being highly recognized and admired for supporting customer missions through employee empowerment, exceptional services and timely delivery. Edgewater Federal Solutions is ISO 9001, 20000-1, 270001 certified, appraised at CMMI Level 3 Maturity for Development and Services, and has been named in the Top Workplaces in the Greater Washington Area Small Companies for 2018 through 2025.

It has been and continues to be the policy of Edgewater Federal Solutions to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, and/or other statuses protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Profisee MDM Engineer
jobs.summary: About the Role You'll be the hands-on MDM engineer on a data modernization program for a large financial services client. The platform is built on Databricks and Delta Lake; your job is to own the Profisee MDM layer — configure it, connect it, and keep...
jobs.description:
About the Role

You'll be the hands-on MDM engineer on a data modernization program for a large financial services client. The platform is built on Databricks and Delta Lake; your job is to own the Profisee MDM layer — configure it, connect it, and keep golden records flowing cleanly into the downstream warehouse.

This is an implementation role, not an advisory one. You'll write code, configure match rules, and debug pipeline failures.

What You'll Do

* Configure and tune Profisee match and survivorship rules for Client and Advisor entities (probabilistic + deterministic matching, confidence thresholds, conflict resolution).

* Build and maintain the integration between Databricks Delta Lake and Profisee — ingestion of staging records into Profisee, and write-back of golden records to the Lakehouse.

* Set up the Profisee stewardship portal for data steward workflows — exception queues, match review, and record correction.

* Work with upstream pipeline engineers to ensure records are correctly partitioned and flagged before they hit the MDM layer.

* Monitor MDM pipeline health — match rates, queue depth, golden record lag — and fix issues when they arise.

* Document match rules, survivorship decisions, and integration patterns for the team.

Must-Have

* 3+ years with Profisee MDM — you've implemented it, not just administered it. You know match rules, survivorship policies, and Profisee Connect.

* Strong SQL and Python — you can write and debug pipeline code independently.

* Profisee integration experience — connecting Profisee to an external data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, SQL Server, or equivalent) via API or connector.

* Match/merge configuration — candidate generation, scoring, threshold tuning, and survivorship.

* Cloud environment experience — AWS or Azure.

Nice to Have

* Databricks / Delta Lake experience (DLT, MERGE, Change Data Feed).

* Financial services domain knowledge — client data, advisor data, accounts.

* Experience with other MDM tools (Reltio, Informatica, Semarchy).

* Kafka / event-driven pipeline experience.

You're a Good Fit If…

* You can configure a Profisee match rule from scratch and explain why you set the thresholds where you did.

* You've debugged a golden record that wasn't writing back correctly and can walk through how you found the issue.

* You don't need someone to hand you an architecture diagram before you can ask good questions.

jobs.description:
The Endpoint Engineer is responsible for **end-to-end management and support of endpoint management platforms** , primarily **Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM)** and **Microsoft Intune (MEM)**.

This role covers **device lifecycle management, patching, application packaging \& deployment, policy enforcement, and troubleshooting** . The engineer is expected to **resolve complex endpoint issues, ensure compliance, and maintain platform health** across enterprise environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Endpoint Platform Support (SCCM \& Intune)**

* Administer and support:
* SCCM (ConfigMgr) infrastructure
* Microsoft Intune (MDM/MAM)
* Co-management (SCCM Intune integration)
* Monitor platform health (site servers, distribution points, connectors, sync status)
* Troubleshoot client-side and server-side issues

**Patch Management (Critical Responsibility)**

* Plan, deploy, and monitor **monthly patching cycles** (Windows updates via SCCM/Intune)
* Ensure compliance with defined SLAs and patch baselines
* Troubleshoot patch failures and deployment issues
* Generate patch compliance and audit reports
* Coordinate with application and business teams for patch validation

**Application Packaging \& Deployment**

* Package applications using:
* MSI / EXE / Intune Win32 formats
* Deploy applications via SCCM and Intune
* Handle:
* Application testing and validation
* Version upgrades and rollback strategies
* Troubleshoot deployment failures and detection logic issues

**Device Management \& Policy Enforcement**

* Manage device configurations using:
* Group Policy (GPO)
* Intune configuration profiles
* Compliance policies and conditional access
* Enroll and manage devices (Windows, mobile devices if applicable)
* Ensure endpoint compliance with security standards

**Incident \& Problem Management**

* Act as **L2 resolver group** for endpoint-related incidents
* Troubleshoot issues such as:
* Software deployment failures
* Patch compliance gaps
* Device enrollment issues
* Policy conflicts (GPO vs Intune)
* Identify recurring issues and support Problem Management

**Automation \& Optimization**

* Use PowerShell for:
* Automation of deployment tasks
* Reporting and remediation scripts
* Improve deployment efficiency and reduce manual effort
* Optimize collections, deployments, and update rings

Job Summary

Castalia Systems is seeking an Endpoint Security Engineer to support our Intelligence Client s mission sets. As an Endpoint Security Engineer you will design, deploy, and operationalize active, behavior-based endpoint detection and response (EDR/XDR) capabilities across one of the largest private operational fleets in North America. Protecting an enterprise comprising 600,000+ employees and 30,000+ physical sites, you will maintain rigorous security posture across traditional end-user computing (EUC) devices (laptop, desktop, mobile devices & retail terminals), on-premise physical & virtual servers & containerized workloads, and dynamic multi-cloud workloads (AWS, Azure, GCP).

In this role, you will balance proactive protection with business continuity partnering directly with end-users and application owners to tune policies and eliminate operational friction, while providing tier-3/tier-4 technical escalations to Security Operations Center (SOC) analysts and IT Operations staff during active investigations.

Roles And Responsibilities

A qualified candidate will perform the following duties and responsibilities, but are not limited to:

Fleet-Wide Behavioral Defense & Control Engineering

Engineer, deploy, and maintain Next-Gen Antivirus (NGAV) and Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR/XDR) agents (e.g., CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne) across hundreds of thousands of heterogeneous endpoints.Implement active behavioral protections against zero-day malware, living-off-the-land binaries (LotLBs), fileless execution, and credential dumping.

Application Owner & End-User Engagement (Business Impact Management)

Serve as the primary technical partner to application owners and business units, establishing baseline behavior profiles to minimize false positives, performance degradation, or operational downtime across critical retail, logistics, and supply chain applications.Manage allowlisting, exception workflows, and phased ring deployments (canary/pilot/production) to ensure silent, high-efficacy protection without disrupting day-to-day warehouse or logistics operations.

SOC & IT Operations Event Investigation Support

Act as endpoint security escalation lead for SOC analysts during high-severity threat detection and response events.Act as endpoint operations escalation lead for IT administrators during high-impact event investigation and remediation efforts.Perform advanced host forensics, process-tree reconstruction, memory analysis, and script-based live remediation (e.g., host isolation, automated artifact collection, registry rollbacks).

Hybrid & Multi-Cloud Workload Protection

Extend endpoint security standards across private data center virtualization layers (VMware/Nutanix) and ephemeral multi-cloud infrastructure (EC2, Azure VMs, Compute Engine, containerized hosts).

Control Efficacy & Continuous Validation

Continuously measure and test security control efficacy using automated attack simulation (BAS) tools and Purple Team exercises.Track and report on agent health, tamper-resistance, telemetry pipeline integrity, and coverage metrics aligned with enterprise asset management systems.

Required Qualifications

A minimum of 7+ years of progressive experience in technical cybersecurity engineering or infrastructure security roles.At least 3 5 years directly engineering and administering enterprise-grade EDR/XDR platforms across 50,000+ endpoints in a distributed hybrid environment.Demonstrated track record supporting active SOC investigations and collaborating cross-functionally with system owners in large-scale enterprise environments.Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or equivalent practical enterprise experience.EDR/XDR Engineering: Expert-level proficiency administering enterprise-scale endpoint platforms across Windows, macOS, Linux distributions, and container runtime environments.Behavioral Analysis & Threat Hunting: Deep mastery of process lineage, behavioral IOAs (Indicators of Attack), Sysmon telemetry, and detection authoring using query languages such as SQL, KQL (Kusto Query Language), Splunk SPL, or YARA.Hybrid Infrastructure & OS Internals: Deep understanding of Windows/Linux kernel architectures, API hooking, hypervisor isolation, and multi-cloud workload identity integrations.Automation & Scripting: Strong programming/scripting abilities in PowerShell, Python, or Bash to orchestrate fleet-wide remediations and automate policy compliance at scale.Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning: Fluency applying appropriate AI/ML technologies and analytics platforms (Splunk, Databricks, Elastic) to streamline and/or automate activities including but not limited to research, developing documentation, and supporting development of executive communications. Fluency applying appropriate AI/ML technologies to automate security activities to improve timeliness or full automation of event response activities.Abilities & Core CompetenciesStakeholder Empathy & Impact Analysis: Proven ability to balance stringent security controls with business operational velocity, ensuring minimal disruption to end-user productivity and mission-critical COTS/proprietary software.Crisis Leadership & Composure: Capable of methodically triaging active enterprise threats under pressure and articulating complex host-based attacks to executive leadership.Operational Scale Management: Mindset geared toward "Infrastructure-as-Code" and policy automation rather than manual device-by-device intervention.

Preferred Certifications

GIAC Certified Enterprise Defender (GCED), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), or GCFA (Forensic Analyst).CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional).

Physical Requirements/Work Environment

Normal Office environment

Travel

As needed

jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

In April 2022, we introduced a new, more affordable, ad-supported tier for our customers, marking a significant milestone for Netflix. Our focus is now on expanding choices for consumers and providing advertisers with a premium TV brand experience that surpasses traditional linear formats. The challenge ahead involves scaling our ad tech to maximize its impact on our business.

Our Team

The Ads Platform Engineering teams build advertising systems and integrations that power the delivery of ads using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads - unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state of the art content delivery system, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers. We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving, members only see the most appropriate ads for them.

The Ads Member Experience group is responsible for identifying and building the ad formats that will define the future of advertising on the Netflix streaming platform, including live events. The team will drive the definition of such formats and how they are standardized across delivery platforms (TV, mobile, web). It will lead the experimentation needed to make the experience optimal for both users and advertisers.

Our team is new and yet faced with the enormous ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

This role is part of the company's strategic initiative to build a world-class advertising ecosystem following the launch of their ad-supported tier. We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

* 8+ years of software development experience, with 5+ years of experience in the Ads domain

* Professional experience with ad formats and ad delivery systems, including experimentation with ad creatives and/or native ads.

* Experience with architecting and building large-scale infrastructure for real-time, low-latency, online advertising environments.

* Thorough understanding of the advertising marketplace and landscape, with a focus on publisher side challenges like optimizing fill rates, adjusting ad load, and maximizing advertiser value.

* Proven track record of building systems that power sophisticated user experimentation, A/B testing and lift studies.

* Strong analytical and strategic thinking with demonstrated product sense and leadership in the working environment.

* Expertise in developing systems that measure and optimize end-user advertising experiences, delivering the right advertisement at the right time for the right user.

* Track record of collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders from product, engineering, design, etc. and of delivering complex features with critical business impact

Nice to haves:

* Familiarity with SDUI (Server-Driven User Interface) architectures.

* Experience building unique ad formats and ad products at scale across multiple advertising channels (CTV, DOOH, Mobile, and Web).

* Programmatic advertisement experience.

* Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g. VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

* Familiarity with legal compliance and changing landscape of ads regulations around the world.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $499,000.00 - $900,000.00.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. Caterpillar’s Cybersecurity Team is seeking a Security Analyst to join our Caterpillar IT Cybersecurity Team. Collaborate with engineering, architecture, and SOC teams to implement detection logic and improve threat visibility.

Contribute to the development of automated detection and response capabilities.

Be a part of continuous vulnerability lifecycle management within the Caterpillar environment including the collection, reporting and assessment of impact for vulnerability related data from external and internal sources.

Serve as liaison between Corporate Cybersecurity and our business partners to help understand their operations and maintain global security processes, while building collaborative relationships.

Knowledge of developing cybersecurity policies, standards, and procedures; ability to develop and communicate policies, standards and procedures that guide interactions with customers.

System and Technology Integration:

• Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases, and technology platforms.
• Experience with Host Group, Prevention Sensor, and Policy Configuration

• Experience with Windows/MacOS Frameworks

Description

We are seeking a mid-level Project Manager to support the planning and execution of large-scale customer technology migrations, with a primary focus on network infrastructure and endpoint migrations. This role will coordinate cross-functional teams, customers, vendors, and technical stakeholders to ensure migrations are delivered safely, efficiently, and with minimal disruption to business operations. The ideal candidate is an organized, proactive project leader who can manage multiple concurrent migration workstreams, drive accountability across technical teams, communicate effectively with customers and executives, and identify and resolve risks before they impact delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end project planning and execution for large-scale customer network and endpoint migration initiatives.

Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, RAID logs, and cutover plans.

Coordinate migration activities across network engineering, endpoint engineering, security, infrastructure, service delivery, operations, vendors, and customer teams.

Manage multiple concurrent migration projects and prioritize activities based on customer impact, technical dependencies, and business timelines.

Facilitate project kickoffs, status meetings, technical working sessions, migration readiness reviews, and executive updates.

Establish clear ownership, deadlines, and escalation paths across internal and external stakeholders.

Track project scope, schedule, risks, issues, dependencies, and resource requirements through completion.

Coordinate migration waves, pilot deployments, production cutovers, validation activities, and post-migration stabilization.

Partner with technical teams to ensure migration prerequisites, testing, documentation, rollback plans, and operational readiness are completed before cutover.

Proactively identify project risks and develop mitigation and contingency plans.

Manage customer communications and provide clear, concise status reporting on progress, risks, decisions, and next steps.

Support change management and ensure project activities align with established change-control and operational processes.

Drive post-migration lessons learned and incorporate improvements into subsequent migration waves.

Maintain accurate project documentation and ensure appropriate handoffs to operational support teams.

Required Qualifications

Requires a BA degree and 8 – 12 years of prior relevant experience or Masters with 6 – 10 years of prior relevant experience.

Active DoD Secret clearance

3–6 years of project or program management experience, preferably supporting technology infrastructure or IT transformation initiatives.

Experience managing large-scale infrastructure, network, endpoint, cloud, data center, or technology migration projects.

Demonstrated ability to coordinate complex projects involving multiple technical teams and stakeholders.

Strong understanding of project management fundamentals, including scope, schedule, dependencies, risk management, change control, and stakeholder management.

Experience working directly with customers or business stakeholders in a delivery environment.

Strong communication, organization, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to manage competing priorities and multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Comfortable working with technical teams and translating technical project information into clear business-level communications.

Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Confluence, or similar platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

PMP, CAPM, or similar project management certification.

Experience with network migrations, LAN/WAN transformations, SD-WAN, network modernization, endpoint refreshes, device migrations, or enterprise infrastructure consolidation.

Experience managing large customer migration programs involving multiple sites, business units, or geographic regions.

Familiarity with ITIL, Agile, or hybrid project delivery methodologies.

Experience coordinating third-party vendors, managed service providers, or technology partners.

Experience with migration planning, cutover management, rollback planning, and hypercare/stabilization.

Technical background or sufficient technical fluency to effectively partner with network, endpoint, infrastructure, and security engineering teams.

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Securing Your Data

Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.summary: Plans, implements, and maintains enterprise systems and software applications, including servers, data storage systems, infrastructure services, and related hardware and software. Manages and maintains data centers, disaster recovery relocation...
jobs.description:
Plans, implements, and maintains enterprise systems and software applications, including servers, data storage systems, infrastructure services, and related hardware and software. Manages and maintains data centers, disaster recovery relocation facilities, and services hosted in the cloud.
Develops server specifications, performs capacity planning and installation of server hardware and software.

Installs, configures and maintains server operating systems (OS), applies OS patches and upgrades on a regular basis, uses administrative tools and utilities and adds new services, as necessary.

Plans, installs and maintains server and application virtualization technologies including VMWare, VMWare View, Citrix, AWS and Azure.

Develops enterprise storage system specification, provides strategic planning and implementation of storage area network (SAN), network attached storage (NAS) systems, and cloud storage technologies.

Plans, installs and maintains enterprise back-up systems. Performs daily back-up operations. Ensures all required file systems, databases and applications data are successfully backed up to the appropriate media, recovery tapes or disks are created and media is recycled and sent off site, as necessary.

Maintains disaster recovery systems for critical City business applications and data. Develops and maintains detailed DR plan documentation, conducts annual DR exercises.

Plans, installs and maintains enterprise applications including e-mail, unified communications and collaboration, presence and instant messaging systems, including enterprise productivity applications and services hosted in public clouds.

Plans, installs and maintains email security, SPAM, data loss prevention (DLP), and web filtering appliances. Generates web activity and Internet traffic reports, as requested.

Plans, installs and maintains mobile device and mobile app management (MDM/MAM) systems, provisions MDM polices for BYOD and City issued devices, ensures secure access to City's information from mobile devices.

Plans, installs and maintains data center environmental and monitoring equipment including electrical, Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS), cooling, fire suppression and building management systems.

Responds to and executes electronic discovery tasks for information pertaining legal matters and public records requests.

Manages and maintains infrastructure services including Active Directory (AD), AD Premium for Azure, ADFS, domain controllers (DC), domain name services (DNS), antivirus and security systems, enterprise printing services, server management and monitoring tools.

Leads technical research and development to enable continuing innovation within the Information Technology (IT) infrastructure.

Provides technical supervision to assigned staff, as required by the needs of specific projects.

Responds to systems outages and critical e-mail alerts, and performs maintenance.

Manages vendor and consultant activities; evaluates vendors/products; prepares feasibility studies; recommends and establishes program objectives, priorities and schedules.

Performs other related duties, as assigned.
Knowledge, Ability and Skills:
Knowledge of:

Server hardware and Operating Systems (OS) including Windows Server 2008 through 2016, VMWare, Hyper-V and Linux.
Storage systems including storage area network (SAN), network-attached storage (NAS) and Internet Small Computer System Interface (iSCSI).
Enterprise back-up hardware and software including magnetic tape libraries, virtual tape or disk-based libraries, and file/e-mail archiving solutions.
Information security best practices.
Network topologies, Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model, Ethernet, Transmission Control Protocol and Internet Protocol (TCP/IP) and Fiber-Channel communications.
Infrastructure services including Active Directory (AD), AD group policies, domain controllers/back-up domain controller (PDC/BDC), Directory Sync and Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS), Domain Name System (DNS), Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP), Windows Internet Name Service (WINS), SNPM, Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP), Post Office Protocol (POP3) and Internet Message Access Protocol (iMAP).
E-mail systems and enterprise productivity applications including Microsoft Exchange, Office 365 and SharePoint.
Unified communications and collaboration solutions including Microsoft Skype for Business.
Logon scripts, windows command line and PowerShell commands.
Cloud services including Azure, AWS & EC2, HP Helion or others.
Effective customer service techniques.

Ability to:

Investigate and troubleshoot complex technical issues.
Repair and recover from hardware or software failures.
Perform system performance tuning and resource optimization.
Research and recommend innovative, and automated approaches for system administration tasks.
Prepare request for proposals (RFP) and statement of work (SOW).
Develop and maintain installation and configuration procedures.
Develop and maintain system standards and best practices.
Perform systems administration tasks on servers, storage systems and enterprise applications.
Implement new IT solutions and services.
Provide effective customer service.
Establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships with City employees, consultants, vendors, and the general public.

Skill in:

IT systems administration and implementation.
Computer systems, software, server hardware configuration, maintenance and troubleshooting.
Project management.
Diagnosing complex computer hardware/software problems and implementing solutions.
Team work and team building.
Written and verbal communication.

Minimum Qualifications:

Graduation from an accredited college or university with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems or a closely related field.

Three years of recent, paid work experience in provisioning, installation/configuration, operations, and maintenance of enterprise systems hardware and software and related infrastructure.

Licenses and Certificates:

Possession of a valid Class C driver license or the ability to utilize an alternative method of transportation when needed to carry out job-related essential functions.

How to Apply:
Applicants must submit a completed on-line City Application along with any required supplemental application materials with the Human Resources Department by the filing deadline. If you do not submit your on-line application by the filing deadline, you will not be considered for this position. Please note, applications may be rejected if incomplete. Resumes, CVs and cover letters are not reviewed as part of the application screening process.
Note: Applicants who indicate that they completed college-level coursework or earned a degree from a foreign institution may be required to provide U.S. credential equivalency verification. Diploma or transcript copies must still be attached for all applicants. To verify degrees from international universities, you may use the IAU database of international institutions at IAU Global Members. If the school is not listed, applicants must still provide U.S. credential equivalency verification.

SELECTION PROCESS:

All applicants must submit clear, concise and complete information regarding their qualifications for the position. All applicants will be reviewed and only those candidates determined to be most qualified on the basis of experience and education, as submitted, will be invited to participate further in the selection process.

Testing may consist of the following and is subject to change as needs dictate:
Training & Experience Evaluation - Qualifying
Oral Interview - 100%
NOTE: If three or more qualified City employees apply and pass the examination, a promotional list will be established in addition to an open-competitive list. If fewer than three qualified City employees pass the examination, the appointing authority, in accordance with the City's civil service rules and regulations, can decline to use a promotional list, in which case a promotional list will not be established for this position.
BACKGROUND INVESTIGATIONS:
Candidates who have successfully completed all prior phases of the selection process will be subject to a thorough background investigation. The City of Santa Monica is a progressive, inclusive and culturally-rich community. As leaders in public service, we strive to be an employer of choice by attracting and retaining a highly-talented workforce where people of diverse races, religions, cultures and lifestyles thrive. Our goal is to create a welcoming and inclusive environment where our staff are empowered to perform at their highest level and where their differences make a positive impact.

The City is an equal opportunity employer and strives to build balanced teams from all walks of life without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state and/or local law. We aim to create a workplace that celebrates and embraces the diversity of our employees. Join us!

Special assistance with the application and examination process is available, upon request, for persons with disabilities. Call (310) 458-8246, TDD (310) 458-8696 (Hearing Impaired Only).

Please note the request for reasonable accommodations must be made to Human Resources at least three work days prior to the examination.
WORKING CONDITIONS
Work is regularly performed indoors in a home or office environment, in accordance with the City’s Telework/Flexible Workplace Policy, with frequent interruptions. Contact with the public and meeting deadlines is frequently required. Physical demands include sitting, standing, kneeling, bending, reaching, and walking. May occasionally attend meetings after regular work hours and/or weekends.

jobs.title: Enterprise Support Engineer
jobs.summary: At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers...
jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you'll do at Jamf:

At Jamf, we empower people to be their best selves and do their best work. The Enterprise Support Engineer (ESE) serves as a primary escalation point for customers experiencing advanced technical issues, in addition to acting as an initial point of entry for customers and partners that have elected Premium Support or are strategically valuable to Jamf. The ESE demonstrates proficiency in concepts and practices involving device management and security. The ESE works closely with the Technical Account Manager. The ESE is responsible for supporting and troubleshooting issues with the installation, performance, and integration of Jamf products and supporting technologies. The ESE serves as a point of contact for all technical inquiries and escalations.

This is a hybrid position available to individuals residing in the Minneapolis, MN metro area. You will be expected to be in the office 3 days per week. Please note that we are only able to consider applicants who are currently based in the Minneapolis, MN metro area.

What you can expect to do in this role:

Serve as the primary point of contact for Premium Support customers experiencing technical issues.
Handle customer inquiries related to product performance, configurations, custom setups, and integrations.
Diagnose and resolve issues across the full suite of RapidIdentity products.
Use logs, debugging tools, and root cause analysis to efficiently solve technical problems.
Act as a customer advocate and account steward, demonstrate relentless commitment to developing effective solutions to the challenges that customers face in optimizing their deployment.
Work closely with product development and engineering teams to identify and resolve bugs and provide feedback on product improvements.
Interface with product development and support teams to share client feedback, generate requirements and evaluate and test new product solutions
Maintain and increase customer satisfaction and ensure retention
Keep customers informed about the status of their issues and provide regular updates on progress.
Serve as a topic expert in one or more key product features
Contribute to internal and external knowledge bases through the creation and continual review of knowledge base and troubleshooting guides.
Provide support for customers using APIs and third-party integrations, assisting with implementation, configuration, and troubleshooting.
Collaborate with customers' internal teams/stakeholders to address challenges.
Build strong relationships with enterprise customers, acting as their advocate within the company.
Identify patterns in support cases and provide insights to improve the product or internal processes.
Stay current on new product features, technologies, and industry trends to provide the best possible support.
On-Call as needed.
Other duties as assigned.
#LI-Hybrid

What we are looking for:

Minimum 3 years in a customer support or technical support role, preferably in a SaaS or technology environment (Required)
Must demonstrate the ability to read code, troubleshoot logic issues, and make necessary adjustments to correct functionality or implement customer requested changes (Required)
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical details into clear, customer-friendly language.
Strong technical troubleshooting skills, with knowledge of log analysis, debugging, and system diagnostics
Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
Experience with APIs, web technologies, networking and databases (e.g., SQL).
Working knowledge of the architecture and tools relevant to implementation of Jamf products.
Strong problem-solving abilities with a customer-first mentality.
Advanced technical knowledge and an aptitude for learning new software systems.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
Empathetic and patient in dealing with customer issues.
Highly organized, with attention to detail and accuracy.
Self-motivated with a proactive approach to resolving customer issues.
A team player who can collaborate effectively across departments and with both technical and non-technical teams.
Skilled with CRM and support tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Intercom, or similar).
Leads peers and others through change; champions change in the face of uncertainty.
Actively seek opportunities for self-improvement, staying current with the latest industry trends, technologies, and best practices.
Ability to remain calm and professional in high-pressure or critical situations.
Be able to identify not just the symptoms of a problem but understand and address the underlying cause to prevent recurring issues.
A meticulous approach to troubleshooting, ensuring all details are considered, from error logs to system behavior, to avoid overlooking critical factors with an emphasis on finding solutions to business needs.
Ability to critical analyze issues and use sound judgement to make decisions
Provide clear written summaries and technical documentation for internal teams and customers, maintaining professionalism and accuracy in communication.
Bachelor's Degree (Preferred)
Jamf 400 (Preferred)
Jamf 370 (Preferred)

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.
Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.
Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

How we help you reach your best potential:

Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
Named a 2024 Best Technology Company to Work For by U.S. News
Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®
We train and we then we give you the room to grow. We offer a clear and defined customer support career path, but our Jamfs also choose to explore horizontal career growth to discover new interests and opportunities.
Our Support teams are the technical experts solving problems big and small for our loyal customer base. Tech support is human support and you will know you are making a real and meaningful impact for our more than 75,000 global customer base.
Our customers are some of the most loyal in the world. We put people over profits – which is why our customers keep coming back to us!

Pay Transparency

At Jamf, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is set within a defined range. These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role.

What it means to be a Jamf?

We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do?

Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

Jamf is committed to creating an inclusive & supportive work environment for all candidates and employees. Candidates with disabilities or religious beliefs are encouraged to reach out if they need additional support or alternative options to our recruiting processes to accommodate their disability or religious belief. If you need an accommodation, please contact your Recruiter or Recruiting Coordinator directly. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially by Recruiting and will not be shared with the hiring manager. Jamf is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against individuals who request reasonable accommodation for disability or religious beliefs. To request accommodations please email us at recruiting@jamf.com

Ready to take your career global?

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for an MDM (Reltio) Solution Engineer to join our ever-evolving Data & AI team and help shape the future of global commerce. In this role, you will build the trusted data foundation that powers critical business decisions across Global Payments, enabling accurate customer and merchant insights, stronger risk and compliance outcomes, and more effective business operations. You will play a key role in creating scalable Master Data Management capabilities that establish a single source of truth across the enterprise, driving innovation, improving data quality, and helping teams make faster, smarter decisions. As part of a highly collaborative and forward-thinking team, you will influence enterprise-wide data strategy, support modernization efforts, and contribute directly to Global Payments’ mission of delivering exceptional solutions that power commerce around the world.

What you'll own

Build and evolve enterprise Master Data Management capabilities that create trusted customer and merchant golden records, enabling better business decisions, improved operational efficiency, and stronger enterprise-wide data consistency.Drive data quality and identity resolution outcomes by implementing matching, survivorship, validation, and enrichment strategies that increase confidence in critical business data and reduce downstream risk.Enable enterprise connectivity and scalability by delivering robust integrations and data pipelines that seamlessly connect business systems, analytics platforms, and operational processes to trusted master data.Influence the future of data-driven decision making by establishing reliable data foundations that support analytics, reporting, compliance, and business growth initiatives across the organization.Champion continuous improvement and platform excellence by optimizing MDM performance, resolving complex data challenges, and delivering measurable improvements in data accuracy, governance, and operational effectiveness.

What you'll bring

jobs.description:
Overview

At PowerSchool, we power education for students around the world. As the global leader in cloud-based K-12 software, we support the full education ecosystem—from the central office to the classroom to the home. Joining PowerSchool means being part of a mission-driven team that is transforming K-12 education by helping schools operate more effectively and deliver better outcomes for educators, students, and families.

Team Overview

Our Information Technology (IT) team leads all aspects of IT systems and processes across the enterprise, including data services, security, compliance, applications, automation, and end-user services. Through innovative and streamlined technology solutions, this dynamic team enables company growth, protects data, and serves as a critical partner to all departments of PowerSchool.

Responsibilities

This position will be a focused Senior MDM Engineering scope role. You will own our enterprise device management strategy end-to-end. You'll be the go-to expert for endpoint compliance, security, and lifecycle management across Windows, macOS, and mobile devices — using Microsoft Intune as your primary platform, alongside Automox for patching and Autopilot for provisioning. You will also own virtual end points such as Window 365 devices.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint & MDM Engineering

Own end-to-end strategy, architecture, and execution for enterprise device management using Microsoft Intune and related technologies Serve as the primary subject matter expert and accountable owner for endpoint compliance, security posture, and lifecycle governance across the organization Manage and optimize the full device lifecycle — provisioning, enrollment, compliance, patching, and retirement — for all employee devices Develop and maintain configuration profiles, compliance policies, and application deployment strategies Own and oversee planning, execution, coordination, and delivery across supporting administrators and technicians Own complex MDM and patching initiatives end-to-end, including the rollout of new solutions such as PAM (Privileged Access Management), RBAC (Role-Based Access Control), and other enterprise toolsets Serve as the point person for new toolset rollouts, including permission elevation tools and RMM (Remote Monitoring and Management) platforms Own complete OS validation processes for MDM, patching, and compliance ahead of major OS architecture changes — assessing compatibility, testing enrollment and policy behavior, and certifying readiness before enterprise-wide rollout

Systems & Platform Ownership

Engineer and support core endpoint platforms across Windows, macOS, and mobile devices Own the organization's virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), including provisioning, deprovisioning, operational management, and overall service health Manage vendor relationships and coordinate strategic planning for long-term platform sustainability across MDM and VDI environments Partner with infrastructure teams on identity (Entra ID/Azure AD), access, and conditional access policies Monitor system health and performance, proactively identifying and resolving issues Maintain documentation for system configurations, standards, and processes

Asset Management & Technology Standards

Lead the definition and enforcement of enterprise hardware and asset standards that ensure ongoing MDM compliance and compatibility across the device fleet Align hardware and vendor selection decisions with MDM platform requirements, ensuring new devices meet compatibility, compliance, and Autopilot registration standards before deployment Own the process ensuring all new endpoints are properly registered and provisioned through Autopilot, partnering with vendors to streamline registration at time of purchase Evaluate emerging endpoint technologies and market trends; make recommendations on hardware selection and standards for the organization Influence enterprise-wide technology decisions through advanced technical expertise and market awareness

Automation & Optimization

Automate endpoint deployment and management processes (Autopilot, scripting, policy automation) Improve system efficiency by reducing manual processes and standardizing configurations across the endpoint environment Drive enterprise-wide initiatives focused on IT automation and workflow optimization

Technical Leadership & Escalation

Provide technical leadership on major enterprise initiatives, coordinating and directing the work of other administrators and technicians on cross-functional projects Serve as the Tier 3 escalation point for complex endpoint and system issues Collaborate with Service Desk and regional IT teams on incident resolution and root cause analysis Participate in on-call or critical incident response as needed Serve as technical leader for lower-level administrators and technicians, providing assistance with projects, processes, and solution development

Security & Compliance

Define and execute enterprise-wide endpoint security and compliance strategy, including remediation efforts across all devices Implement endpoint security controls aligned with enterprise security standards Manage endpoint patching across Automox and Intune, ensuring consistent, timely patch compliance across all managed devices Apply OS hardening standards and best practices for both macOS and Windows to reduce attack surface and meet enterprise security baselines Support compliance initiatives through policy enforcement and device posture management Partner with InfoSec on risk mitigation and vulnerability management

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field 6-10 years of experience in Systems Engineering, Endpoint Engineering, or a similar role Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune (device management, application deployment, compliance policies) Strong knowledge of Windows and macOS administration Experience with Azure AD / Entra ID, device identity, and access management Solid understanding of endpoint lifecycle management and ITSM processes Experience troubleshooting enterprise-level system and device issues Experience patching endpoints via Automox and Intune, with working knowledge of OS hardening methods for macOS and Windows

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with MDM migration projects (e.g., JAMF to Intune) Familiarity with scripting (PowerShell, Bash) and automation tools Experience with Autopilot, VDI, or Windows 365 Knowledge of ITIL practices and service management platforms (e.g., Freshservice) Certifications such as Microsoft Endpoint Administrator Associate or similar

Compensation & Benefits

PowerSchool Offers The Following Benefits

Comprehensive Insurance Coverage (including Medical, Dental, Vision, Pharmacy benefits, Life Insurance and AD&D) Flexible Spending Accounts and Health Savings Accounts Short-Term Disability and Long-Term Disability Comprehensive 401(k) plan Generous Parental Leave Unrestricted paid time off (known as Discretionary Time Off - DTO) Wellness Program, including ClassPass & Employee Assistance Program Tuition Reimbursement Optional Benefits: Pet Insurance, Identity Theft Protection, Student Debt Repayment Program and Prepaid Legal coverage
