jobs.description:
Coretek is seeking a skilled EUC Support Engineer to join our Managed Services team.

Coretek is seeking a skilled EUC Support Engineer to join our Managed Services team. This role is responsible for the operational support, optimization, automation, and continuous improvement of customer end user computing environments built on Azure Virtual Desktop, Nerdio, and Citrix. The EUC Support Engineer works within our L3 team, supporting enterprise clients and delivering project work that keeps high-performance virtual desktop experiences reliable, secure, and aligned with industry best practices.

The ideal candidate combines deep virtual desktop expertise with a commitment to service excellence, strong troubleshooting ability, and a passion for automation and Infrastructure as Code. This role blends level 3/4 project-based work with operations and managed services engineering, supporting both daily incidents and long-term platform health, governance, and continuous improvement in a cloud-first, customer-obsessed environment.

EUC Operations & Support

- Provide Level 3 and Level 4 support and engineering expertise for managed Citrix and Azure Virtual Desktop environments.

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex virtual desktop, application delivery, user profile, session performance, and endpoint issues.

- Participate in escalation rotations and major incident response activities.

- Perform daily health checks, patching, upgrades, and incident remediation across hosted EUC environments.

- Ensure adherence to established service levels and operational standards.

Citrix & AVD Platform Management

- Manage Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, including Studio, Director, Citrix Policy, Machine Catalogs, and Delivery Groups.

- Deploy, configure, and optimize Azure Virtual Desktop environments and administer Nerdio Manager for Enterprise.

- Manage Citrix Gateway (NetScaler), Citrix Cloud and hybrid configurations, and supporting Azure Resource Manager resources and virtual networking.

Endpoint, Identity & Security

- Deploy and enforce Group Policy Objects, security baselines, and compliance configurations across desktop and server estates.

- Support endpoint management and thin client configurations such as Stratodesk, IGEL, and Unicon.

- Apply Zero Trust principles, Conditional Access, and modern endpoint security integrations.

- Support Imprivata implementation and integration with virtual desktops and authentication workflows.

Automation & Infrastructure as Code

- Implement Infrastructure as Code for environment automation using Terraform, Ansible, and Packer.

- Develop automation using PowerShell, Nerdio automation scripting, Nerdio Runbooks, and image build pipelines.

- Identify opportunities to increase operational efficiency and reduce repetitive manual effort.

Monitoring & Reliability

- Monitor, analyze, and improve system performance, availability, and security posture across client environments.

- Develop and maintain standardized operational documentation, runbooks, and support playbooks.

- Participate in disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution for hosted EUC environments.

Client Success & Advisory

- Serve as a trusted advisor to assigned customers.

- Collaborate with internal architects and client stakeholders to ensure platform integrity and alignment with SLAs.

- Present recommendations related to optimization, modernization, governance, and end user computing best practices.

- Support onboarding of new managed services clients.

- Provide mentoring and knowledge transfer to junior engineers and technicians.

Platform Health & Optimization

- Analyze session performance, capacity, and Azure consumption trends across EUC workloads.

- Identify opportunities to reduce hosting cost through right-sizing, autoscaling, and image optimization.

- Recommend governance improvements and configuration standardization across client environments.

- Participate in customer optimization and modernization initiatives.

Requirements

Experience

- 5+ years of supporting Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops or Azure Virtual Desktop in a managed services or enterprise environment.

- 4+ years of administering production virtual desktop environments, including Machine Catalogs, Delivery Groups, and image management.

- Experience supporting multiple client environments simultaneously.

- Exposure to ITSM ticketing tools such as ServiceNow or Remedy, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues independently and communicate clearly with customers.

Technical Expertise

• Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops

• Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD)

• Citrix Studio, Director, and Citrix Policy

• Nerdio Manager for Enterprise

• Citrix Gateway (NetScaler)

• Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, Packer)

• Group Policy, Active Directory, and Windows internals

• PowerShell automation

• Azure Resource Manager and virtual networking

• Thin client and endpoint management (Stratodesk, IGEL, Unicon)

Preferred Certifications

- Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)

- Microsoft Certified: Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty (AZ-140)

- Citrix Certified Associate – Virtualization (CCA-V)

- Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate

Desired Characteristics

- Strong customer-facing communication skills

- Consultative mindset

- Sense of ownership and accountability

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively

- Strong documentation skills

- Passion for learning and adopting emerging Microsoft, Citrix, and automation technologies

- Commitment to operational excellence and continuous improvement

Success Metrics

Client Experience

- Client satisfaction and trusted-advisor impact

Service Delivery

- SLA adherence and effective escalation support

Technical Quality

- Incident resolution quality and preventive improvements

Automation

- Adoption of repeatable automation and Infrastructure as Code

Optimization

- Documented performance, capacity, and cost efficiency improvements

Knowledge Management

- Quality of runbooks, documentation, and knowledge sharing

Innovation

- Contribution to service improvements and EUC managed services evolution

Collaboration

- Effective teamwork across delivery, security, architecture, and client stakeholders

This role is designed as an L3/L4 EUC Support Engineer / End User Computing Operations Engineer, combining advanced technical support with managed services delivery, project execution, client advisory, automation, governance, and platform optimization.

Your solutions will handle billions of records in AWS while maintaining Amazon's high security standards. You'll collaborate with engineers across Amazon to continuously raise the security bar and enable Customer Service to introduce innovative customer experiences.
You'll play a critical role in every interaction where Customer Service operations personnel access and handle customer data. This includes securing how associates view customer information, how data moves across the network, and how we protect customer trust at every touchpoint.

Key job responsibilities
You will own the design, implementation, and operation of systems and infrastructure that secure Customer Service endpoints. You will dive deep into complex technical problems—debugging issues across operating systems, networking layers, and cloud services—and deliver solutions that are both secure and reliable at scale.
You will define and execute on technical solutions that deliver value to our customers quickly and sustainably. You will spend your time writing code, building automation, and operating the systems that keep Customer Service secure. We are a team dispersed across multiple locations, but mainly in Seattle, Toronto, and Austin. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Por ello, buscamos **un/a Especialista en protección a Endpoint y XDR** para unirse a nuestro equipo de ciberseguridad dinámico y en constante crecimiento. El/la candidato/a ideal tendrá que tener una amplia comprensión de las tecnologías de seguridad de protección a **Endpoint** (Antivirus, Antimalware, EPP, entre otras), **XDR, EDR y SIEM** , así como experiencia en la implementación, administración y optimización de soluciones del tipo Endpoint y XDR. Este puesto es una excelente oportunidad para un/a profesional apasionado/a por la ciberseguridad que busque contribuir a la protección de una organización de alto perfil.

**Responsabilidades**

* Implementar, administrar y optimizar soluciones de protección a Endpoint y XDR de última generación en entornos complejos.
* Integrar herramientas de protección a Endpoint y XDR con otras herramientas de seguridad para obtener una visión holística del panorama de amenazas.
* Analizar logs y eventos de seguridad para identificar y responder a amenazas potenciales de manera oportuna.
* Desarrollar y mantener playbooks de respuesta a incidentes automatizados para garantizar una respuesta rápida y efectiva a los incidentes de seguridad.
* Gestionar incidentes de ciberseguridad desde su detección hasta su resolución, utilizando herramientas y procesos de protección a Endpoint y XDR.
* Colaborar con otros equipos de seguridad para mejorar la postura de seguridad general de la organización.
* Mantenerse actualizado/a sobre las últimas amenazas, vulnerabilidades y tendencias en ciberseguridad.

**Requisitos**

* Ingeniería en Informática, Ciberseguridad o área relacionada.
* Mínimo de 5 años de experiencia en ciberseguridad, con enfoque en Endpoint (Antivirus, Antimalware, EPP, entre otras), XDR, EDR y SIEM.
* Experiencia en la implementación, administración y optimización de soluciones de protección a Endpoint y XDR.
* Sólidos conocimientos de log management, análisis de eventos de seguridad y técnicas de caza de amenazas.
* Experiencia en la gestión de incidentes de ciberseguridad y el desarrollo de playbooks de respuesta.
* Habilidades analíticas y de resolución de problemas excepcionales.
* Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y presentación.
* Inglés avanzado.

**Conocimientos y Experiencia Deseables**

* Experiencia con Cortex XDR, Crowdstrike, Trend Micro, McAfee, Microsoft Defender y suite de seguridad de Microsoft, entre otras.
* Conocimiento de otras tecnologías de seguridad como firewalls, IPS y DLP.
* Experiencia en la gestión de SOC (Security Operations Center).
* Certificaciones en seguridad de la información como CISSP, CEH o GSEC.

**Información adicional** *Únete a un equipo que impulsa la innovación y trabaja en proyectos de alto impacto. En Inetum valoramos la expertise y el conocimiento, y queremos ayudarte a llevar tu carrera al siguiente nivel en un ambiente colaborativo y dinámico.* *Ofrecemos la oportunidad de asistir, junto al equipo de ciberseguridad, a conferencias, ponencias y charlas en Congresos de Seguridad Informática, como Navaja Negra, RootedCON, Hacken, jornadas CCN STIC, etc. al ser patrocinadores de muchos de estos eventos.* *Ponemos a tu disposición un amplio catálogo formativo en competencias tecnológicas y certificaciones de acuerdo con las exigencias de los proyectos y clientes. Formación en idiomas, donde podrás elegir entre 12 opciones. Formación en habilidades personales dentro del ámbito profesional. Uso de otras plataformas adicionales como Udemy y OpenWebinars.* *Te ofrecemos una retribución a la carta, pudiendo elegir diferentes productos y modelar tú mismo cómo distribuirlos: seguro de salud, tickets de comida, guardería, tarjeta transporte y formación. Además, contarás con un seguro de vida incluido como parte de tus beneficios. También tendrás acceso a ventajas del grupo de empresa, como descuentos en diversos productos y servicios.* *El contrato será indefinido, con un horario flexible de oficina, con posibilidad de teletrabajar para poder conciliar de la mejor forma tu vida personal-profesional. Proporcionamos estabilidad y un excelente ambiente laboral, formado por los mejores profesionales en el ámbito de la Ciberseguridad.* *Ofrecemos una atractiva carrera profesional en función de la experiencia y potencial personal, dentro de una compañía en continua evolución y con un sólido crecimiento.*

We are seeking a Senior Endpoint Engineer with deep expertise in Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Graph API, and endpoint automation to drive the migration of enterprise iOS and iPadOS device management from Ivanti EPMM/MobileIron to Microsoft Intune. The ideal candidate will combine strong mobile endpoint engineering, automation, and migration experience to deliver secure, scalable, and supportable solutions within a global enterprise environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the migration of enterprise iOS and iPadOS device management from Ivanti EPMM/MobileIron to Microsoft Intune, including policies, compliance controls, applications, enrollment profiles, and device lifecycle processes.

- Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions using Microsoft Graph API, PowerShell, REST APIs, and Azure automation services to improve operational efficiency and platform management.

- Engineer and support Intune mobile management capabilities including enrollment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, application deployment, reporting, and remediation activities.

- Manage Apple ecosystem integrations, including Apple Business Manager, Automated Device Enrollment (ADE), supervised devices, Apps & Books, and managed application deployments.

- Provide advanced engineering and Level 3 support for mobile endpoint platforms, ensuring platform reliability, security, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

- Collaborate with Security, Identity, Network, and Application teams to deliver secure, compliant, and scalable endpoint management solutions while maintaining technical documentation and operational runbooks.

-
6+ years of experience in Endpoint Management, Mobility Engineering, Modern Workplace Engineering, or a related enterprise infrastructure role.

- Proven experience leading or supporting large-scale MDM/UEM migration projects , preferably from Ivanti EPMM/MobileIron to Microsoft Intune.

- Strong hands-on expertise with Microsoft Intune administration for iOS/iPadOS, including device enrollment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, application deployment, and reporting.

- Proven experience developing automation solutions using Microsoft Graph API, PowerShell, REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, JSON, and Microsoft Entra ID integrations.

- Strong knowledge of Apple enterprise management, including Apple Business Manager, Automated Device Enrollment (ADE), supervised devices, and managed application deployment.

- Experience with Conditional Access, certificate-based authentication, PKI, Git/Azure DevOps, and enterprise security best practices.

Nice to Have

- Experience with Azure Automation, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Power Automate, or other enterprise automation platforms.

- Experience building operational dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Azure Monitor, or Log Analytics.

- Knowledge of ServiceNow workflows, request management processes, and platform integrations.

- Experience with Zero Trust and mobile security technologies such as Microsoft Defender, Zscaler, Zimperium, or Lookout.

- Experience with Python or C# for API integrations, automation, and lightweight application development.

- Microsoft certifications such as Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administrator Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, or Azure Developer Associate.

We offer:

-
Culture of Relentless Performance : join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.

-
Competitive Pay and Benefits : enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program.

-
Growth Mindset : reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.

-
Global Impact : collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.

-
Welcoming Multicultural Environment : be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.

-
Social Sustainability Values : join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

* Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech 's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.

Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in 30+ countries around the world. We currently have R&D centers in Ukraine, India, Poland, Spain, Slovakia, Canada, and our headquarters in the US. As we continue to expand globally, we are seeing India, the United States, Canada, Argentina, and Brazil rapidly evolve into key growth areas in the Miratech network. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%. Our ForeverRemote work culture offers you the utmost flexibility that comes with remote work.

Onsite hybrid

jobs.description:
Company Description
Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

Job Description
We have an opening for a Virtual Desktop Engineer/Desktop Engineer. Working closely with the Desktop Services engineering team, you will operate and support enterprise class desktop management systems used to support the mission of the lab. This position is in the Information Technology Solutions Division (ITSD) within the Computing Directorate, in support of the LivIT Program.

This position requires full-time on-site presence due to the nature of the work.

This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

You will

Recommend, justify, and implement operational service level improvements using an accepted change control methodology.
You will interface directly with end users and work with the engineering team in the performance of root cause analysis of reported problems.
You will work with Engineering and management in the planning of project milestones and staff expansion.
Design and deliver creative solutions and resolve problems in a timely and proactive manner while collaborating within a diverse group.
Ensure service levels are met and highest levels of service reliability are maintained.
Define and maintain support documentation and procedures.
Be a team player, maintain appropriate technology, computer security, and safety knowledge.
Lead and mentor junior operations team members in best practices and procedures.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Additional job responsibilities, at the 393.2 level

Manage multiple complex parallel tasks and priorities of customers and stakeholders, ensuring deadlines are met, while leveraging team member’s skills.
Leverage tools and develop procedures to improve windows configuration management services and automate various complex tasks.

Qualifications

Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field, or the equivalent combination of education and related experience.
Proficiency supporting VDI environments required; VMware Horizon experience preferred.
Experience effectively working in a dynamic, technical team environment with competing priorities.
Strong experience working with Active Directory Group Policy Objects (GPOs).
Strong PowerShell scripting skills with experience automating Windows desktop administration, configuration, software deployment, troubleshooting, reporting, or routine operational tasks.
Broad experience with SCCM/MECM application deployment.
Proficient written and verbal communication and strong interpersonal skills, ability to interact with all levels of management and staff as well as outside vendors, contractors, service providers and consultants.

Additional qualifications at the 393.2 level

Substantial experience architecting and administering highly redundant and fault tolerant enterprise Windows server environments.
Advanced ability to provide innovative approaches and apply new technologies to broadly defined tasks and projects.
Ability to troubleshoot complex network environments.

Qualifications We Desire

Significant experience automating Windows Desktop builds.
Knowledge of thin client administration and support.

Pay Range

$125,310 - $153,444 Yearly at the 393.1 level

$151,620 - $185,640 Yearly at the 393.2 level

This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting; pay will not be below any applicable local minimum wage. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Additional Information
#LI-Onsite

Position Information

This is a Career Indefinite position, open to Lab employees and external candidates.

Why Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory?

Included in 2026 Best Places to Work by Glassdoor!
Flexible Benefits Package
401(k)
Relocation Assistance
Education Reimbursement Program
Flexible schedules (*depending on project needs)
Our values - visit https://www.llnl.gov/inclusion/our-values

Security Clearance

This position requires a Department of Energy (DOE) Q-level clearance. If you are selected, we will initiate a Federal background investigation to determine if you meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information or matter. Also, all L or Q cleared employees are subject to random drug testing. Q-level clearance requires U.S. citizenship.

Pre-Employment Drug Test

External applicant(s) selected for this position must pass a post-offer, pre-employment drug test. This includes testing for use of marijuana as Federal Law applies to us as a Federal Contractor.

Wireless and Medical Devices

Per the Department of Energy (DOE), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory must meet certain restrictions with the use and/or possession of mobile devices in Limited Areas. Depending on your job duties, you may be required to work in a Limited Area where you are not permitted to have a personal and/or laboratory mobile device in your possession. This includes, but not limited to cell phones, tablets, fitness devices, wireless headphones, and other Bluetooth/wireless enabled devices.

If you use a medical device, which pairs with a mobile device, you must still follow the rules concerning the mobile device in individual sections within Limited Areas. Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities require separate approval. Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings.

How to identify fake job advertisements

Please be aware of recruitment scams where people or entities are misusing the name of Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) to post fake job advertisements. LLNL never extends an offer without a personal interview and will never charge a fee for joining our company. All current job openings are displayed on the Career Page under “Find Your Job” of our website. If you have encountered a job posting or have been approached with a job offer that you suspect may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend you do not respond.

To learn more about recruitment scams: https://www.llnl.gov/sites/www/files/2023-05/LLNL-Job-Fraud-Statement-Updated-4.26.23.pdf

Equal Employment Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer that is committed to providing all with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status, age, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Reasonable Accommodation

Our goal is to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates applying and interviewing at the Laboratory. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please use our online form to submit a request.

California Privacy Notice

The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) grants privacy rights to all California residents. The law also entitles job applicants, employees, and non-employee workers to be notified of what personal information LLNL collects and for what purpose. The Employee Privacy Notice can be accessed here.

jobs.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Solutions Engineer – Infrastructure for a Full-Time role based in California. Our client is a well-capitalized, rapidly growing enterprise cloud and high-performance infrastructure provider delivering specialized, large-scale compute environments for data-intensive enterprise workloads. Their platform leverages advanced data center engineering, high-density power and cooling architectures, accelerated compute clusters, and ultra-high-throughput networking fabrics to power modern enterprise computing.

This is an exceptional ground-floor opportunity to join an expanding commercial pre-sales organization as the core technical authority on physical and network infrastructure. The #1 feature of this opportunity is the rare combination of cutting-edge hardware scale and early-stage leadership runway: you will partner directly with commercial sales leaders to drive technical discovery, lead high-impact architectural whiteboarding, and design custom, multi-node infrastructure solutions for enterprise customers. We are looking for an adaptable, hands-on infrastructure technologist who is energized by customer engagement and motivated by a clear path into future technical leadership. You will step into a collaborative, engineering-driven environment that values autonomy, continuous learning on advanced hardware systems, and sustainable work-life balance.

Required Skills & Experience · 7+ years of experience in customer-facing pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, or advanced systems engineering within enterprise data center, cloud infrastructure, or high-performance computing (HPC) environments.

· Deep technical understanding of physical data center design, power planning, high-density rack topologies, and modern thermal management solutions (liquid cooling, direct-to-chip, or hybrid systems).

· Proven track record architecting and sizing enterprise compute clusters and hardware accelerator platforms.

· Solid architectural grasp of high-speed, low-latency fabric networking (such as InfiniBand or high-performance RoCE/lossless Ethernet fabrics).

· Demonstrated experience partnering with enterprise account executives through the complete pre-sales lifecycle, including discovery, technical qualification, and solution design.

· Strong executive presentation, consultative whiteboarding, and technical communication skills.

Desired Skills & Experience · Experience supporting large-scale enterprise deployments, benchmark validations, and formal technical proposals/RFPs.

· Familiarity with cluster management tools, distributed computing platforms, or high-throughput enterprise storage architectures.

· Background working with enterprise hardware vendors, systems integrators, or specialized cloud infrastructure providers.

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

What You Will Be Doing Tech Breakdown

· 40% Data Center Power, Thermal Management & High-Density Rack Architecture

· 30% Enterprise Compute & Hardware Acceleration Platforms

· 30% High-Performance Fabric Networking & Infrastructure Interconnects

Daily Responsibilities

· 45% Customer Architecture Sessions, Technical Whiteboarding & Deal Qualification

· 35% Hands-On Technical Solution Design & RFP/Proposal Development

· 20% Team Collaboration & Strategic Pre-Sales Playbook Development

The Offer • Commission eligible

You will receive the following benefits:

· Medical Insurance

· Dental Benefits

· Vision Benefits

· Paid Time Off (PTO)

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US on a full-time basis now and in the future.

jobs.description:
**Descripción Del Puesto** El **Client Executive Endpoint** apoya a los socios en sus iniciativas a nivel nacional y global, identificando, desarrollando y gestionando relaciones con clientes de múltiples marcas a nivel directivo corporativo. Su objetivo es posicionar el valor global de TD SYNNEX, al tiempo que brinda a la dirección local orientación estratégica y acompañamiento en la ejecución de planes orientados a maximizar la participación de mercado.

¡Lleva tu carrera al siguiente nivel como **Client Executive !** **Lo Que Harás**

* Diseña, estructura y gestiona el plan de negocio y el modelo de precios para los clientes, incluyendo:
* La definición de la propuesta de valor y el portafolio de soluciones del socio.
* El diseño del mapa de cobertura geográfica para maximizar alcance y penetración de mercado.
* El desarrollo de un plan de marketing integral que abarque nuevos clientes, la base instalada y el negocio recurrente (renovaciones y cuotas anuales).
* El establecimiento de objetivos de ventas trimestrales y anuales, así como el seguimiento, análisis y reporte de resultados frente a dichos objetivos.
* La planificación del calendario de participación en programas de formación, certificación y adopción de Solutions Path.
* La realización de revisiones mensuales de desempeño comercial, definiendo planes de acción correctivos y de mejora.
* La ejecución de revisiones trimestrales de negocio junto con la dirección de la unidad de negocio y los equipos de proveedores correspondientes.
* Disponibilidad para viajar hasta un 75 % del tiempo
* Amplía la cobertura de cuentas para fortalecer relaciones estratégicas y acelerar el crecimiento del negocio, mediante:
* Desarrollo de relaciones a nivel directivo con clientes, socios estratégicos e ISVs.
* Incremento de la cuota de mercado a través de nuevas líneas de negocio y una mejor experiencia del cliente con TD SYNNEX, apoyada en servicios y soluciones de valor.
* Identificación de oportunidades comerciales a nivel corporativo y liderazgo de planes para posicionar las capacidades de TD SYNNEX ante la alta dirección del cliente.
* Comunicación proactiva con clientes para detectar problemas de satisfacción, analizar causas raíz y prevenir incidencias.
* Diseño y coordinación de planes de acción correctivos con los equipos internos correspondientes (incluyendo Services).
* Gestión de la estrategia global del cliente.
* Promoción del trabajo colaborativo entre áreas para maximizar el valor de TD SYNNEX y apoyar los objetivos del cliente.

**Lo Que Estamos Buscando**

* Nivel académico requerido: Profesional en Ingenieria de Sistemas o Telecomunicaciones, Electrónica o afines
* 3+ años de experiencia en roles como Product Manager o Business Development Manager.
* Conocimientos técnicos requeridos: en el sector de Tecnología
* Conocimientos o habilidades: Comerciales; Proyección presupuestal; Desarrollo de Negocios; Responsabilidad de Cuota; Conocimientos en soluciones Endpoint
* Competencias: Orientación a los resultados - Comunicación - Impacto e influencia comercial - Proactividad Capacidad de organización, Estructuración.
* Desarrolla soluciones a problemas complejos donde el análisis de situaciones o datos requiere una evaluación profunda de variables.
* Determina el mejor método para lograr resultados y puede hacer sugerencias para mejorar las políticas y los procedimientos.
* El trabajo se realiza sin una dirección apreciable usando criterio y discreción independientes. Ejerce una libertad considerable para determinar los objetivos y enfoques de las asignaciones. El trabajo puede ser revisado a un alto nivel.
* Representa a la organización como contacto principal en proyectos o contratos. Interactúa con frecuencia con los profesionales senior y la gerencia y, a menudo, tiene que coordinar el trabajo entre departamentos u organizaciones.
* Las acciones impactan en la organización. La falta de cumplimiento del trabajo o las decisiones erróneas darán como resultado la incapacidad de alcanzar objetivos organizacionales cruciales y pueden tener un efecto prolongado, además de resultar en el gasto de recursos sustanciales.

**Otra Educación / Certificaciones**

* Especialización o Maestría en Negocios, Mercadeo (Deseable)
* Certificaciones en la industria (Deseable)
* Competente en inglés (nivel B2 o superior) Deseable

**Las Condiciones De Trabajo**

* Entorno Profesional de Oficina (Híbrido).

jobs.description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children's life stories!

**Key Responsibilities** IMPORTANT INFORMATION:

* All CVs should be submitted in English.
* This position is open to candidates based in countries where World Vision International is legally registered to operate.

As an**Endpoint Engineer,** you will play a critical role in maintaining, monitoring, and supporting global IT systems and infrastructure. You will lead multiple projects, providing technical guidance to Endpoint and Systems Administrators, while ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of enterprise computing platforms.

You will be responsible for designing, building, and optimizing the systems operating environment---including servers, storage, and backup solutions---to meet evolving business needs. Your expertise will span across technologies such as Windows, Linux, VMware, Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP. You will also manage access controls, security applications, and system backups, ensuring a secure and highly available environment. This role demands strong troubleshooting skills for complex hardware, software, and basic network issues. You will analyze system failures, respond to incidents, and execute contingency plans to maintain operational continuity. Additionally, you will support 24/7 operations, lead disaster recovery efforts, and manage off-site storage processes.

Success in this role requires excellent communication and collaboration skills. You will work closely with system users, technical teams, and vendors, providing expert support and training as needed. A strong customer service orientation and a proactive approach to problem-solving are essential.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical field
* Minimum of 5+ years of hands-on experience administering enterprise-level servers and IT infrastructure.
* At least 5+ years of experience designing, configuring, deploying, and optimizing server hardware and operating environments.
* 5-7 years of progressive experience in information technology, with a focus on endpoint systems and enterprise computing platforms.

**Continuation Of Major Responsibilities** **PROJECT PLANNING:**

* Leads or consults short- and long-term project planning efforts with team members, clients and other IT groups.
* Develops cost/time estimates.
* Documents discussion and agreements.

**TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:** Works with systems engineers to understand technical requirements.

**DESIGN/DEVELOP:** Integrates solutions with other applications and platforms outside the framework.

**Maintenance**

* Performs routine maintenance tasks for infrastructure systems such as backups, patch management and hot fixes.
* Develops strategies to manage the frequency of appropriate support package/patch application.
* Monitors health of systems and provides appropriate recommendations, when required.

**Administration**

* Coordinates and validates activities.
* Manages user access to, systems, servers, and files.
* Administers the setup of new profiles, creates and updates access permissions and maintains user accounts.
* Installs, configures and maintains system hardware and software components.
* Maintains tracking and configuration documentation and plans.
* Supervising the installation of system upgrades and service packs.
* Determines if inactive accounts should be deleted.
* Administers Storage Area Network (SAN).

**Performance Monitoring**

* Supervises the monitoring procedures and evaluates problems identified by team members.
* Ensures that capacity workload modeling and availability analysis is performed.
* Monitors system-operating capacity in terms of disk space, tape storage, memory and CPU utilization.
* Reviews performance and control reports.
* Recommends settings changes to the operating system to improve performance and reliability.
* Develops, maintains, recommends, documents and supports tools and backend utilities to provide capacity planning management.

**Testing**

* Leads or provides technical direction for the planning, designing, and execution of testing efforts.
* Ensures that tests evaluate all possible impacts on the current infrastructure or application.

**Continuous Improvements**

* Recommends performance metrics.
* Analyzes and reports on operational metrics to understand performance and to ensure success in process improvements.

**System Job Scheduling**

* Translates business and technical requirements to develop automation specifications that span more than one business area.
* Updates job schedule based on current priorities and special handling requests.
* Ensures reliability and availability of platforms.
* Schedules maintenance and repairs.

**Computer Operations**

* Coordinates production job processing.
* Ensures that maintenance procedures are executed.
* Updates job schedule based on current priorities and special handling requests.
* Operates computer hardware systems and related peripheral equipment.
* Monitors systems on a 24x7 schedule.
* Performs maintenance procedures.
* Validates input and output data for completeness and accuracy.
* Analyzes job processes and recommends improvements.
* Reviews historical data for trend analysis.

**Production Support**

* Coordinates problem resolution among team members.
* Documents, monitors, reports, and manages the resolution of systemic issues.
* Works with Systems Engineers and Architects when issues appear systemic or cannot be resolved.
* Recommends procedures and controls for problem resolution or creates temporary solutions until permanent solutions can be implemented.
* Documents problem status and resolution.
* Develops checklists and scripts for resolving routine problems.

**Security**

* Works with IT Security, where needed, in investigations and/or audits of systems.
* Analyzes audit trails to detect systematic security violations.
* Reports security issues when appropriate.
* Ensures security requirements are adhered to.

**Business Continuity**

* Administers archival activities such as installing, upgrading, configuring, and scheduling and monitoring, jobs.
* Performs data image archiving.
* Performs off-site storage procedures.
* Verifies that system backups run successfully.

**POLICIES, PROCEDURES, AND STANDARDS:** Ensures compliance with policies, procedures and standards.

**SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENTS (SLAs):** Monitors production, outputs, and services to ensure that SLA's, and other quality metrics, are being met.

**Documentation/User Guides**

* Writes, reviews and/or maintains technical documentation for product environments.
* Ensures documentation is developed and maintained.

**COMMUNICATIONS/CONSULTATION:** Supports and participates in the formal reporting of project status.

**COACHING/MENTORING:** Provides coaching and guidance to team members.

**RESEARCH/EVALUATION:** Evaluates future technologies and makes recommendations.

**Applicant Types Accepted** Local Applicants Only

*World Vision is a Christian humanitarian organisation with a mission centred on following Jesus Christ in service to the world´s most vulnerable children. Therefore, in all locations to the fullest extent legally permissible, the successful applicant will affirm our core documents, observe conduct compatible with Christian principles, serve at a high level of professional ethics and strive to act in accordance with cultural sensitivities. Furthermore, regular attendance with team and office devotions, chapel and prayer gatherings are expected in line with policies in the World Vision host location and its departments.*

jobs.description:
_At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit [klaviyo.com/careers](http://klaviyo.com/careers) to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny._

At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying.

#### **About the team:**

Klaviyo’s global corporate Information Technology (IT) team is responsible for providing technology systems, administration, and support to Klaviyos around the world. Our main goal is to ensure that Klaviyos everywhere have a strong technology foundation to do great work. The IT Team solves problems using technology and provides Klaviyo’s continued scalability and sustainable employee growth in a rapidly evolving environment.

The IT Systems team is primarily responsible for SaaS systems administration and end-to-end lifecycle management, building automation, and engineering solutions for both other internal teams and the business. The IT Systems team is highly collaborative, working closely with the IT Searchbar team, our end-user support team as well as with our Security, Risk, and Trust teams and the broader Engineering department.

#### **About the role:**

As a Senior IT Systems Engineer on the IT Systems team, you own the design, implementation, and long-term health of the enterprise systems Klaviyo runs on identity, endpoint management, and the SaaS platforms every Klaviyo touches. You will lead projects end to end, from SSO/SCIM rollouts to complex multi-tool integrations and automations, and you will be trusted to take an ambiguous business problem, define the problem statement yourself, and deliver a solution that scales. You will partner with operations, engineering, Security, and the IT Searchbar team, and act as a technical escalation point when systems break.

Klaviyo is building an AI-first future, and IT is where a lot of that gets real. You will use AI fluently in your own work and help design AI-assisted workflows into the systems we run for the rest of the company. This is a senior individual contributor role: no direct reports, high autonomy, and real ownership. We are looking for someone who has already run systems at scale, holds opinions grounded in experience, and can be handed a domain and trusted to run it.

#### **How you’ll have an impact**

- Own systems, not tickets. You will take a domain identity, endpoint, or a set of core SaaS platforms and be accountable for its reliability, security, and roadmap, raising the decisions that need to go higher and driving everything else yourself.
- Lead projects end to end at pace: scope the work, design the solution, plan the rollout and the rollback, communicate the change, and land it without skipping testing, peer review, or documentation to hit a date.
- Turn ambiguous business needs into clear problem statements and systems that hold up, so Klaviyos spend their time on their work instead of fighting their tools.
- Set the technical bar: clean configuration, least-privilege access by default, automation over manual toil, and runbooks the rest of the team can operate from without you in the room.
- Define what success looks like before you build, then prove it with data tickets deflected, provisioning time saved, coverage and compliance gaps closed.
- Raise the people around you: review others’ work, mentor engineers earlier in their careers, and give and receive direct, useful feedback.
- Act as a technical escalation point for complex system issues, drive root cause rather than symptoms, and feed what you learn back into the platform so the same incident does not happen twice.

#### **Requirements:**

- 4+ years of hands-on experience as a systems engineer or systems administrator, with a track record of owning enterprise systems in production not just operating them, but deciding how they should work.
- You define problem statements yourself. You can take a vague or contested business need, scope it, drive alignment with stakeholders, and deliver with minimal direction without losing the thread when priorities shift.
- Deep working knowledge across a wide range of IT systems, including enterprise device management, identity and access management, and endpoint security.
- You have deployed and managed macOS and iOS devices at scale through an MDM (Jamf preferred), including configuration profiles, policies, and OS update strategy. Windows management (Intune, Autopilot) is a strong plus.
- You have administered core SaaS platforms such as Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and Zoom, including their security and admin controls.
- Hands-on experience with IdP configuration, management, and maintenance: SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group and role design, and app onboarding. Experience with Okta or Entra ID (Azure AD) is preferred.
- You have owned the identity lifecycle in practice onboarding, role changes, and offboarding and understand the security and audit consequences of getting it wrong.
- AI proficiency: AI is already part of how you work, and you can show it. You use LLM assistants and agents to research, write and debug code, draft documentation, and compress routine work, and you exercise judgment about when to trust the output. You are actively interested in putting AI into the systems you run automating triage, enrichment, and repetitive workflows for the wider company.
- You automate by default, and you have the scripting skills to do it: Bash, PowerShell, or Python. Python is preferred and AWS Lambda experience is a plus. You have replaced manual, repetitive work with automation other people now rely on, and you can safely read and modify someone else’s script.
- Comfortable working with APIs REST, JSON, authentication, and rate limits and building integrations between systems that do not natively talk to each other.
- You value clean, concise controls and easily editable security functionality within tools, and you can produce evidence for access reviews and audits (SOC 2, SOX) without it derailing your week.
- Disciplined change management: you test, get peer review, plan rollback, communicate to affected users, and document what changed including under pressure.
- You can debug a system problem you have never seen before, drive it to the root cause, and communicate clearly to non-technical stakeholders while it is still unresolved.
- You can evaluate vendors and tools on their merits: security posture, integration surface, total cost and make a defensible recommendation.
- Strong written communication. Your documentation, runbooks, and change notices are good enough that other people can act on them without asking you.
- Participation in an after-hours on-call rotation with the IT Systems team is required for site-specific or business-blocking issues.

#### **Nice to have**

- You have worked with Workato, Okta Workflows, n8n, or other similar SSO and automation solutions, and have built something non-trivial in one.
- Experience with enterprise-scale networking topics, including routing, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and building and maintaining multiple global office networks.
- Experience as a systems administrator or systems engineer in a fast-paced, high-growth IT environment, ideally supporting a globally distributed workforce.
- Experience building with AI beyond the chat window prompt and context engineering, connecting an LLM to systems via APIs or MCP, or running an AI-assisted workflow or agent in production.
- Experience with VPC, EC2, Security Groups, ACLs, and IAM in AWS and GCP.
- Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) or version-controlled configuration management for IT systems.
- Experience administering an ITSM platform such as Freshservice or Jira Service Management, including forms, workflows, SLAs, and reporting.
- Relevant certifications such as Jamf 200/300, Okta Certified Professional or Administrator, or associate-level AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

**Massachusetts Applicants:** It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

The range displayed below reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries for the position across all our US locations. The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant’s job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location.

In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in the company’s annual cash bonus plan, variable compensation (OTE) for sales and customer success roles, equity, sign-on payments, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility.

We’re Klaviyo (pronounced clay-vee-oh). We empower creators to own their destiny by making first-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We see limitless potential for the technology we’re developing to nurture personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. To reach our goals, we need our own crew of remarkable creators—ambitious and collaborative teammates who stay focused on our north star: delighting our customers. If you’re ready to do the best work of your career, where you’ll be welcomed as your whole self from day one and supported with generous benefits, we hope you’ll join us.

For more information about how we process your personal data, see our [Job Applicant Privacy Notice](https://www.klaviyo.com/legal/job-applicant-privacy-notice)._

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, citizenship, national origin, color, religion or religious creed, age, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, veteran or active military status, marital status, criminal record, genetics, retaliation, sexual harassment or any other characteristic protected by applicable law._

We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. jobs.description:
## **Who are we?**

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.

**Role Overview**

The Microsoft 365 Architect at Finastra is a senior, hands-on engineering and operations role responsible for the design and day-to-day management of the global Microsoft 365 environment. This role combines strategic platform architecture with practical administration and L3/L4 support, ensuring services are secure, reliable, and aligned with business needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Architecture & Design: Define and evolve architecture for M365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
- Governance & Compliance: Establish tenant-wide policies for data protection, retention, and regulatory compliance.
- Platform Administration & Monitoring: Administer and troubleshoot M365 services to ensure performance and availability.
- Incident Management & Escalation: Act as SME and escalation point for complex issues, performing root cause analysis.
- Migrations & Projects: Lead tenant-to-tenant migrations and coordinate global delivery.
- Automation & Tooling: Develop PowerShell automation and improve reporting and efficiency.
- Documentation: Maintain runbooks and documentation for operational consistency.
- Collaboration & Leadership: Work with global stakeholders and provide technical leadership.

**Required Technical Skills**

- Deep expertise in Microsoft 365 services (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive).
- Strong knowledge of Entra ID, identity, authentication, and compliance features.
- Advanced PowerShell scripting and automation experience.
- Experience leading large-scale M365 migrations.
- Understanding of governance and change management processes.
- Experience with Intune and endpoint management.

**Desirable Skills**

- Microsoft certifications such as Enterprise Administrator Expert.
- Experience using migration tools like Quest or ShareGate.
- Knowledge of hybrid environments and Zero Trust models.
- Exposure to Graph API or other scripting languages.

**Experience & Qualifications**

- Proven, demonstrable IT experience with strong M365 engineering background.
- Experience working in global enterprise environments in similar roles.
- Bachelor's degree in IT or equivalent experience.

**Success Characteristics**

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Excellent problem-solving abilities.
- Self-motivated and adaptable work style.
- Customer-focused mindset.
- Ownership and accountability in delivery.

We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for:

**Flexibility:** Enjoy unlimited vacation, subject to local regulations and business priorities. Benefit from hybrid working arrangements and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.

**Well‑being:** Access confidential one‑to‑one support through our Employee Assistance Program, connect with our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and take part in monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive—inside and outside of work.

**Health & Financial Security:** Medical, life and disability insurance, retirement plans, lifestyle, and other benefits.*

**Sustainability:** Paid time off for volunteering and donation‑matching opportunities to support causes that matter to you.

**Inclusion:** Get involved in our inclusion communities, such as Count Me In, Culture@Finastra, Proud@Finastra, Disabilities@Finastra, and Women@Finastra—open to everyone who wants to participate and contribute.

**Career Development:** Access online learning and accredited courses through our Skills & Career Navigator tool.

**Recognition:** Take part in our global recognition program, Finastra Celebrates, and share your voice through regular employee surveys that help shape our culture and ways of working.

*Specific benefits may vary by location.

At Finastra, each individual is unique—bringing their own ideas, perspectives, cultural backgrounds, and experiences. We learn from one another, value what makes us different, and create an environment where everyone feels included, supported, and able to be their authentic selves.

Be unique. Be exceptional. Help us make a difference at Finastra.

Reports to: Engineering Manager

Summary: We are seeking a Microsoft Systems Engineer with real-world, hands-on experience managing modern Microsoft cloud environments. This is a production-focused role supporting live tenants.

Key Responsibilities:

Microsoft Endpoint & Identity Management

Administer and manage Microsoft Intune across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android
Configure compliance policies, configuration profiles, and application deployment
Manage Entra ID including Conditional Access, MFA, RBAC, and identity lifecycle
Integrate Intune with Conditional Access and Defender for policy enforcement
Tenant & System Integrations

Manage Microsoft 365 tenant integrations and cross-tenant access (B2B)
Configure app registrations and secure API access
Support tenant-to-tenant migrations and coexistence scenarios
Automation & AI-Driven Operations

Build workflows using Power Automate for onboarding, offboarding, and lifecycle management
Use PowerShell to support and extend automation scenarios
Leverage AI and Copilot-based tools to improve operational efficiency and standardization
Security & Operations

Support Conditional Access and device compliance
Troubleshoot access, device, and policy conflicts in live environments
Document standards, procedures, and automation workflows

4-7+ years of experience in Microsoft systems administration, endpoint engineering, or Microsoft 365 infrastructure support
Strong hands-on production experience with Microsoft Intune, including device enrollment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, application deployment, update rings, Autopilot, and endpoint security baselines across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android
Strong experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, MFA, RBAC, enterprise applications, app registrations, service principals, SSO, access reviews, and identity lifecycle management
Proficiency with PowerShell automation and troubleshooting, including scripting for provisioning, reporting, remediation, and administrative task automation
Experience building and maintaining workflows using Power Automate for onboarding, offboarding, approval, notification, and operational process automation
Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender, endpoint compliance, tenant security posture, and troubleshooting policy conflicts in live environments
Ability to document standards, runbooks, implementation steps, rollback plans, and operational procedures with a production-support mindset

Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)
Microsoft 365 Certified : Microsoft 365 Administrator (MS-102)

Preferred Qualifications:

MSP, consulting, or multi-tenant experience, including migration, coexistence, cross-tenant access, and high-volume operational support, is highly desirable

Candidates should be comfortable making controlled changes in production, validating impact, following change management processes, and supporting business-critical systems with minimal disruption.
Qualified candidates should demonstrate direct ownership of endpoint enrollment, policy deployment, Conditional Access rollouts, application packaging and deployment, Autopilot provisioning, access troubleshooting, incident response, and post-change validation in production environments. jobs.description:
Who We Are

DV is the leader in digital performance solutions, helping our advertiser and agency partners Verify the quality of their digital campaigns, Optimise to improve performance and Prove that they’re achieving their business outcomes, through unbiased 3rd party data and analytics. DV’s mission is to be the definitive source of transparency and data-driven insights into the quality and effectiveness of digital advertising for the world’s largest brands, agencies, publishers, and digital ad platforms. Since 2008, DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies gain the most from their media spend by delivering best-in-class solutions across the digital advertising ecosystem, helping to build a better industry. Learn more at www.doubleverify.com.

About The Role

Role Overview

This is a platform-ownership seat, not a support-ticket seat. Reporting to the Manager, Corporate IT in our NYC Global HQ, the Sr. Corporate Systems Engineer owns end-to-end administration and governance of DoubleVerify's core collaboration stack — Google Workspace and Slack — across roughly 300–400 users and ~100 applications, for a C-suite-heavy headquarters (our CEO, COO, and CFO are in-office regularly).

Key Responsibilities

Own end-to-end administration and governance of Google Workspace and Slack — user and group lifecycle, Drive and shared-drive permissions, channel governance, domain-wide delegation, app security controls, security and compliance settings, third-party integrations, and guest access.Own conference room AV and collaboration technology across the NYC HQ footprint — from hardware rollouts and new conferencing standards (Crestron, Neat, Zoom Rooms, WebEx, Logitech, DisplayLink) through day-to-day reliability, not just break-fix troubleshooting.Own MDM/endpoint management across ~100 applications and 300–400 users, using tools such as Jamf and Workspace ONE.Provide direct, white-glove technical support to C-level executives and leadership — ensuring rapid, discreet, and reliable resolution of their technology needs across devices, collaboration tools, and conferencing.Own the Corporate Systems ticketing queue end-to-end — triaging, prioritizing, and resolving within SLA, and building automations that measurably reduce recurring ticket volume or support time.Build and maintain the department knowledge base — SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and self-service documentation to deflect tickets and standardize resolutions.

About You

We're looking for someone who has been the sole, accountable owner of a Workspace or Slack environment at a prior company — not someone who has helped administer one as part of a shared team. Alongside platform governance, this role owns conference room AV, MDM/endpoint management, and ITSM/ticketing automation, and provides white-glove technical support directly to executive leadership. This is a highly technical, high-trust role that requires both deep hands-on expertise and the judgment and composure to operate in close proximity to senior executives.

Required Experience & Skills

5+ years of hands-on Google Workspace and Slack platform administration/ownership experience — not general IT support tenure.Proven, sole ownership of Google Workspace governance, including domain-wide delegation and app-blocking for security, with real hands-on GAM/Admin console scripting for bulk user and group management (not shadowing).Has built or shipped something on Slack itself — an app, bot, or workflow — not just configured channels and permissions.Has owned a conference room AV project end-to-end — a hardware rollout or new conferencing standard — not just occasional troubleshooting.Hands-on MDM/endpoint management at scale using Jamf and/or Workspace ONE.Experience with ITSM/ticketing platforms (Freshservice, ServiceNow, Zendesk, or equivalent), including having personally built an automation with a measurable, data-backed reduction in ticket volume or support time.Strong experience supporting and troubleshooting macOS and Windows.Genuine white-glove executive support experience.

Preferred Experience & Skills

Okta experience beyond basic app assignment — provisioning rules, SCIM, or group-based access management.Experience with IT onboarding processes and hardware logistics.Experience with enterprise conferencing platforms (Google Meet, Zoom, MS Teams).

This position is full-time and located in our New York City headquarters offices offering a hybrid work model from office and remote.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined by a number of non-discriminatory factors, including qualifications for the role, level, skills, experience, location, and internal equity relative to peers at DV.

The estimated salary range for this role, based on the qualifications set forth in the job description, is between $94,000 $160,000. This role will also be eligible for bonus/commission (as applicable), equity, and benefits.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description; however, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles and recognize that the person we hire may be more or less experienced than this job description as posted.

Not-so-fun fact: Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of job criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes but you’re not sure that you check every box, apply anyway!

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Endpoint Protections
jobs.summary: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500,...
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

The Elastic Security Endpoint Protections team builds the visibility, prevention, and on-device machine learning capabilities at the core of Elastic Defend, our endpoint and SIEM security solution. We work in kernel and user mode across Windows, macOS, and Linux, against adversaries who study how to defeat what we build. Our work reaches the security community as well as the product, through original research and conference talks. We are looking for a Senior Manager who has done this work personally and can still review a design or write code. You will lead a globally distributed team and set the tone for a group that values candid feedback, collaborative learning, and mentorship.

We believe security is a team sport, and our efficacy is independently verified rather than simply claimed: in recent third-party enterprise protection testing, Elastic Security earned a perfect malware protection score with zero false alarms, the top result in the field. If you are energized by leading world-class engineers and making a measurable dent in how the industry defends the endpoint, we would love to hear from you!

What You Will Be Doing

- Lead, mentor, and grow a world-class engineering team. Guide senior research engineers across endpoint internals, prevention engineering, and machine learning. Coach career development, deliver candid feedback, own the hiring pipeline, and set new engineers up to contribute quickly.

- Own the roadmap and drive delivery. Decide where to invest in new visibility and where to deepen existing protection engines, balancing efficacy, performance, and stability across millions of endpoints. Work with product managers to define requirements and land high-quality features on release timelines.

- Connect your team's work to the rest of Elastic Security. Every event source your team adds unlocks new detection and protection capabilities across the product. Invest in the joint planning, working relationships, and shared accountability that get your team's work into customers' hands.

- Direct the team's machine learning work. Set direction on model development, training data quality, and the telemetry features those models depend on, and connect that work to the broader machine learning strategy across Elastic Security.

- Drive cross-platform protection parity. Bring the depth Elastic has on Windows to macOS and Linux, keep the team ahead of new hardware architectures, and sustain the platform vendor relationships that give you early access to emerging operating system security APIs.

- Represent the team externally. Support your engineers in presenting at conferences and publishing on Elastic Security Labs, engage with customers and partners on protection capabilities, and be a credible voice for Elastic in the endpoint security community.

What You Bring

- People-leadership experience managing senior technical individual contributors on a globally distributed team. You lead with curiosity rather than authority, actively solicit feedback, and have a track record of growing people, not just shipping releases.

- You have been a practitioner. Substantial hands-on experience as a security researcher before moving into leadership: analyzing attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), building the protections that counter them, and shipping into software that runs on customer machines at scale.

- Operating system internals knowledge , in both kernel and user mode, earned hands-on rather than through oversight, and deep enough to reason about undocumented behavior and challenge a design on its technical merits. Windows depth is what we need most, with macOS or Linux close behind.

- Hands-on reverse engineering and malware analysis experience. You have done this work yourself, and can still read a disassembly, assess a research finding on its merits, and judge which threats warrant investment.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

The Elastic Security Endpoint Protections team builds the visibility, prevention, and on-device machine learning capabilities at the core of Elastic Defend, our endpoint and SIEM security solution. We work in kernel and user mode across Windows, macOS, and Linux, against adversaries who study how to defeat what we build. Our work reaches the security community as well as the product, through original research and conference talks. We are looking for a Senior Manager who has done this work personally and can still review a design or write code. You will lead a globally distributed team and set the tone for a group that values candid feedback, collaborative learning, and mentorship.

We believe security is a team sport, and our efficacy is independently verified rather than simply claimed: in recent third-party enterprise protection testing, Elastic Security earned a perfect malware protection score with zero false alarms, the top result in the field. If you are energized by leading world-class engineers and making a measurable dent in how the industry defends the endpoint, we would love to hear from you!

What You Will Be Doing

- Lead, mentor, and grow a world-class engineering team. Guide senior research engineers across endpoint internals, prevention engineering, and machine learning. Coach career development, deliver candid feedback, own the hiring pipeline, and set new engineers up to contribute quickly.

- Own the roadmap and drive delivery. Decide where to invest in new visibility and where to deepen existing protection engines, balancing efficacy, performance, and stability across millions of endpoints. Work with product managers to define requirements and land high-quality features on release timelines.

- Connect your team's work to the rest of Elastic Security. Every event source your team adds unlocks new detection and protection capabilities across the product. Invest in the joint planning, working relationships, and shared accountability that get your team's work into customers' hands.

- Direct the team's machine learning work. Set direction on model development, training data quality, and the telemetry features those models depend on, and connect that work to the broader machine learning strategy across Elastic Security.

- Drive cross-platform protection parity. Bring the depth Elastic has on Windows to macOS and Linux, keep the team ahead of new hardware architectures, and sustain the platform vendor relationships that give you early access to emerging operating system security APIs.

- Hands-on reverse engineering and malware analysis experience. You have done this work yourself, and can still read a disassembly, assess a research finding on its merits, and judge which threats warrant investment.

- An adversarial instinct. You anticipate how a protection will be evaded before it ships, and hold the team to designing for resilience rather than for the proof of concept in front of them.

- Clear communication skills , comfortable writing for technical and executive audiences and distilling deeply technical work for non-expert stakeholders.

- Motivation to thrive in a distributed, autonomous environment , with a genuine passion for protecting customers from real-world adversaries.

- Demonstrated experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate feature development, debug complex systems, and optimize existing codebases.

- You possess the ability to comfortably rotate across projects, collaborate across functions and teams, and seamlessly adapt to evolving team structures.

- Prior ownership of an EDR, EPP, or other endpoint security product.

- Personal research output: published vulnerabilities, patents, in-depth technical writing, or conference talks.

- Experience leading machine learning engineers working on security problems.

- Experience partnering with product engineering teams to take research prototypes through to GA release.

- Conference speaking experience (e.g., Black Hat, DEF CON, CODE BLUE, Virus Bulletin).

- Familiarity with the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) and Elastic Security.
