jobs.description:
Company Description
- ------------------

Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,660 hotels in operation and under development in 100+ countries. The Group's overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature *Yes I Can!* service ethos. People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

Job Description
- --------------

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Master Data Management Intern to join our Data Governance and MDM team. This role offers hands-on experience in managing, analysing, and improving enterprise data, while supporting key business processes and digital transformation initiatives.

++Key responsibilities include:++

- Assisting in data collection, cleansing, and validation activities to maintain high data quality

- Supporting master data creation, updates, and enrichment across systems (ERP, CRM, etc.)

- Helping with data quality analysis and reporting using tools like Excel, SQL, or Power BI dashboards

- Documenting data processes, workflows, and governance standards

- Collaborating with business users and IT teams to resolve data-related issues

- Participating in MDM-related projects, including testing and process improvement initiatives

**Start date**: October

**Duration**: 6 months

Qualifications
- -------------

- Eligibility to sign an internship agreement with an academic institution

- Proficiency in English

- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business, or related field

- Basic understanding of databases, data management concepts, or data analytics

- Proficiency in MS Excel; exposure to SQL, Python, or Power BI tools is a plus

- Strong attention to detail and ability to work in a structured, process-driven environment

- Good communication and collaboration skills

Additional Information
- ---------------------

Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?

Live the Magic of Hospitality - Be part of a team that creates exceptional experiences and memorable moments every day. Let your Yes I Can! spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.

Build a Great Career - No matter your background or experience, we invest in your growth, learning, and career development---helping you reach your full potential.

Experience the Team Spirit - Join a workplace that's inclusive, fun, and meaningful. We celebrate diversity, support one another and foster a sense of belonging through our Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives.

Lead with Your Ambition - Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to make a difference---in hospitality, your community and beyond.

Enjoy Global \& Local Perks - No matter where you're located, you'll enjoy exclusive global benefits - like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you'll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!

Enjoy benefits such as - up to 53% off your stay as a Team Member at over 1,500 Radisson Hotels worldwide

Guaranteed minimum of 30% off for your Friends \& Family

Exclusive Discounts on Breakfast, Food \& Beverage, Spa and more

Join us in shaping the future of hospitality! If you're ready to bring your talent, energy, and passion, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and let's make every moment matter.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences. If you need any adjustments during the application process, please let us know.

jobs.description: Descripción del Puesto: El Client Executive Endpoint apoya a los socios en sus iniciativas a nivel nacional y global, identificando, desarrollando y gestionando relaciones con clientes de múltiples marcas a nivel directivo corporativo. Su objetivo es posicionar el valor global de TD SYNNEX, al tiempo que brinda a la dirección local orientación estratégica y acompañamiento en la ejecución de planes orientados a maximizar la participación de mercado. ¡Lleva tu carrera al siguiente nivel como Client Executive ! Lo que harás: Diseña, estructura y gestiona el plan de negocio y el modelo de precios para los clientes, incluyendo: La definición de la propuesta de valor y el portafolio de soluciones del socio. El diseño del mapa de cobertura geográfica para maximizar alcance y penetración de mercado. El desarrollo de un plan de marketing integral que abarque nuevos clientes, la base instalada y el negocio recurrente (renovaciones y cuotas anuales). El establecimiento de objetivos de ventas trimestrales y anuales, así como el seguimiento, análisis y reporte de resultados frente a dichos objetivos. La planificación del calendario de participación en programas de formación, certificación y adopción de Solutions Path. La realización de revisiones mensuales de desempeño comercial, definiendo planes de acción correctivos y de mejora. La ejecución de revisiones trimestrales de negocio junto con la dirección de la unidad de negocio y los equipos de proveedores correspondientes. Disponibilidad para viajar hasta un 75 % del tiempo Amplía la cobertura de cuentas para fortalecer relaciones estratégicas y acelerar el crecimiento del negocio, mediante: Desarrollo de relaciones a nivel directivo con clientes, socios estratégicos e ISVs. Incremento de la cuota de mercado a través de nuevas líneas de negocio y una mejor experiencia del cliente con TD SYNNEX, apoyada en servicios y soluciones de valor. jobs.description:
The Role:

Scale AI is hiring a highly skilled foundational IT Systems Engineer for our Public Sector IT team to design, build, and operate secure, scalable infrastructure that empowers employees to do their best work. You’ll join a creative, fast-moving, solutions-oriented group that architects and implements automation across identity and access management, endpoint management, and our broader SaaS stack. Leveraging Okta Workflows, GCC High/Azure Gov, and your familiarity with federal frameworks (FedRAMP High, IL6, CMMC), you’ll deliver robust, audit-ready systems that meet stringent compliance requirements. The ideal candidate pairs deep IAM best practices and hands-on SaaS administration with a zero-trust mindset, clear documentation, and a genuine drive to make people happy—while protecting system integrity in a fast-paced, high-security environment.

You will:

- Assist with the administration of our tech stack with platforms such as Okta, GCC High, Opal, Slack, Jamf, Jira, and many more

- Provide escalated assistance to the IT Services and Support team

- Partner with Security/Compliance on audit artifacts (SSP updates, POA&Ms, control mappings to NIST 800-53/171, CMMC 2.0).

- Create and update technology documentation for internal IT teams and Scale employees

- Design and maintain Zero-Trust controls (device posture, network segmentation, Conditional Access) across GCC High/Azure Gov and Okta.

- Build Okta Workflows and lightweight services (webhooks/queues) to automate joiner–mover–leaver events, access reviews, and deprovisioning.

- Own change management for IT systems in regulated environments (CAB records, rollback plans, validation evidence).

Ideally you'd have:

- 5+ years of IT systems, infrastructure, and/or engineering experience

- Experience with integrating with SaaS APIs and SDKs

- Experience with leveraging Okta or similar identity management systems for authentication and provisioning methods such as SAML, OIDC, and SCIM

- Scripting experience with Python, Powershell, and/or bash

- Experience working within SCIFs

- Familiarity with IL6 / FedRAMP High / CMMC 2.0 control families and how they translate to concrete IT configs

Nice to haves:

- IT Security and Compliance focused mindset

- Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code for identity/MDM configs (e.g., Terraform providers for Okta/Jamf/Azure)

- Possession of an active Secret or TS/SCI clearance

Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

SIE Studio IT is seeking a Lead Systems Engineer to lead the design, operation, and evolution of our production infrastructure and data center platforms. This role provides technical direction for the Systems Administration team and serves as the senior engineering authority for Linux systems, enterprise server hardware, virtualization, storage, and high-availability infrastructure.

Responsibilities

-

Lead the design, deployment, and operational support of Linux and Windows platforms in a production environment.

-

Architect and support enterprise server hardware, including platform selection, RAID configuration, firmware lifecycle management, hardware diagnostics, and performance troubleshooting.

-

Lead the design, deployment, and operation of enterprise and distributed storage platforms, including technologies such as Ceph, NFS-based NAS, and SAN architectures.

-

Design and maintain high‑availability and load‑balanced systems, including clustered servers.

Define and own the monitoring, alerting, and observability strategy for infrastructure platforms including storage, virtualization, servers, and operating systems.

-

Partner with vendors and internal teams on hardware selection and lifecycle planning.

-

Establish technical standards, patterns, and documentation that can be executed by the Systems Administration team.

-

Review designs, changes, and implementations performed by Systems Administrators to ensure quality, consistency, and reliability.

-

Act as the technical lead during infrastructure incidents, driving restoration efforts and post-incident review actions.

-

Ensure infrastructure designs align with security standards and requirements.

Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

-

Strong Linux and Windows administration and engineering experience in enterprise or production environments.

-

Strong hands-on experience with enterprise server hardware, including troubleshooting, lifecycle planning, and firmware management.

-

Strong experience with enterprise storage and distributed storage systems; Ceph experience strongly preferred.

-

Strong experience architecting and administering Windows and Linux server platforms in enterprise or production environments.

-

Strong understanding of how storage, compute, and virtualization interact in performance‑sensitive production environments.

-

Strong scripting and automation skills, preferably Python and/or PowerShell.

Proficiency with Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP; Infoblox experience is a plus.

Experience designing or overseeing monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions, including dashboarding platforms such as Grafana or equivalent tools.

Job Overview:

Certus operates at the intersection of regulated industry compliance, workforce safety, and skills development — serving customers across construction, food service, automotive, environmental, and occupational health sectors. With a growing catalog of digital training content, assessment tools, and learner data spanning millions of course completions annually, Certus is positioned to become a data-driven leader in the compliance learning market.

The Sr. Systems Administrator plans, develops, maintains, and supports information technology systems and operations. The Systems Administrator provides documentation and training on administering and supporting those solutions to other team members and supports peers when necessary.

Responsibilities:

-
Participate in metrics gathering and monitoring activities, and serving on-call rotations with tools such as Application Insights, Grafana, and OpsGenie

· Ensures workstation/server data integrity by evaluating, implementing, and managing appropriate software and hardware solutions

· Conduct routine hardware and software audits of workstations and servers to ensure compliance with established standards, policies, and configuration guidelines

· Recognizes and troubleshoots problems related to servers and associated technologies; implements solutions, installs, and configures recommendations for customer needs

· Ensures data/media recoverability by implementing a schedule of system backups and database archive operations

· Researches and produces solutions to the most complex technical problems through the analysis, development/programming, testing, and application of emergent technologies both at the server and client endpoint levels

· Performs system patching, vulnerability remediation, system backups, security, and disaster recovery for all essential system and client processes

· Prepares reports to management as needed, or requested

· Develops and maintains scripted automation (e.g., Azure Automation Runbooks) to streamline recurring operational tasks and reduce manual effort

· Manages tickets, service requests, and CMDB records within the ITSM platform, ensuring accurate documentation and timely resolution

· Administers endpoint management tooling to provision, configure, and maintain compliance across workstations and devices

· 3+ years of experience operating Azure and AWS public clouds

· Proficiency in Linux and Windows server administration and networking

· Proficiency in scripting (BASH, Python, or PowerShell) with experience building and maintaining automation such as Azure Automation Runbooks

· Knowledge of security and compliance best practices

· Experience working within an ITSM/ticketing platform (e.g., HaloITSM, ServiceNow) to manage incidents, service requests, changes, and the CMDB

· Experience with endpoint management solutions (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Autopilot) for device provisioning, configuration, and compliance

· Knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, including identity and access management, Conditional Access policies, and access governance/entitlement management, as well as Privileged Identity Management (PIM) for just-in-time privileged access

· Project management with the proven ability to prioritize, handle risk, control costs, adhere to timelines, and manage project teams

· Experience and a desire to mentor less experienced team members.

· Strong organizational skills and excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical stakeholders

· Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

· Prolonged periods of wearing a headset

· Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times

· Ability to travel to the office in Orlando if needed to service and support hardware

· Ensure high system uptime and availability (target: 99.9%) through preventative maintenance, proactive monitoring, and timely stakeholder communication

· Maintain a secure, well-governed environment by ensuring systems are patched, backed up, and compliant with Microsoft Entra Conditional Access and governance policies, demonstrated through regular reporting

· Successfully deliver assigned projects on time and within scope by applying strong project management, organizational, and communication skills to plan, track, and report progress to stakeholders

jobs.description:
Dexian has an immediate opportunity available for a detail-oriented and motivated Endpoint Administrator with MS Intune experience to manage, maintain, and optimize a unified endpoint management environment for our premier aerospace customer. The Endpoint Administrator will be the primary point of contact for the deployment, configuration, compliance, and security of all corporate-owned and BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) endpoints. Utilizing the Microsoft 365 stack-specifically Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID-you will ensure seamless, secure hardware and software lifecycles across Windows and iOS platforms.

A typical workday may consist of the following duties as directed by the client:

Policy & Profile Management: Build, test, and deploy Intune configuration profiles, compliance policies, and security baselines to standardize client environments.Application Packaging & Deployment: Package, test, and distribute internal and third-party software updates, web links, and store apps across the enterprise.Modern Provisioning: Administer and monitor modern device deployment systems, such as Windows Autopilot and Apple Business Manager, ensuring a zero-touch or minimal-touch provisioning pipeline for new hires.Identity & Access Control: Collaborate with identity teams to manage device registration, primary user changes, group memberships, and targeted Conditional Access enforcement.Troubleshooting & Escalations: Act as the Tier 2/3 escalation point for device enrollment failures, application installation blocks, and profile synchronization issues.Reporting & Governance: Monitor Intune reporting dashboards daily to identify non-compliant devices, update patch status deficiencies, and remediate systemic configuration drift.Documentation: Maintain clear, concise documentation outlining deployment processes, app packaging standards, and device lifecycle flows.
REQUIREMENTS AND SKILLS:
To be successful in this role, you should possess the following skills:

Security Stack Exposure: Familiarity integrating Intune with security tools like Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or implementing data protection via MAM (Mobile Application Management) without full device enrollment.Problem-Solving & Analytical Rigor: A structured, logical approach to debugging deployment failures, policy conflicts, and log file analysis.Cross-Functional Communication: The ability to explain technical enrollment steps or security restrictions clearly and empathetically to non-technical business professionals.Adaptability: Curiosity and willingness to stay current with Microsoft's continuous cloud release notes, feature changes, and best-practice evolutions.

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID JR2024769

Job Category IT - Information Technology

Time Type Full time

NVIDIA's Enterprise Security organization is looking for a Senior Security Engineer passionate about platform and device security! This role includes leading device attestation and our enterprise secure browser program's technical direction. You will define how NVIDIA establishes and continuously verifies trust in every endpoint, workload, and browsing session that touches our worldwide infrastructure across cloud, on-premises, and managed device environments.

This role offers a hands-on, high-impact engineering opportunity at the intersection of platform security, endpoint and browser trust, and AI infrastructure. In addition to architecture, you will write production code. A core part of the charter is building SRE agents. These are automation tools powered by intelligent systems. They monitor, diagnose, and fix the security platforms we operate. This work turns manual response playbooks into self-healing systems. You will partner closely with device management, identity governance, network security, and platform engineering to set technical strategy and carry operational ownership.

What You'll Be Doing

Design and implement a device attestation service that produces verifiable, cryptographically backed device posture signals from hardware roots of trust (TPM 2.0, Secure Enclave, measured boot) and makes them consumable as a first-class input to access decisions.Lead the engineering and enterprise rollout of our secure browser platform (Prisma Access Browser), including access policies, data-loss prevention controls, browser-extension governance, telemetry, and integrations with identity, Conditional Access, SASE, and ZTNA platforms. Build SRE agents for security platforms, design, code, and operate agentic automation that detects degradation, triages alerts, correlates telemetry, executes safe remediation, and reduces toil across attestation, endpoint, and browser services.Define reference architectures that bind device trust to session trust, so that browser, CLI, and agentic workflows are all evaluated against consistent, continuously reevaluated posture.Integrate device and browser trust signals into identity and access workflows, enabling access decisions based on user identity, device integrity, browser posture, session risk, and application sensitivity. Scale platform-security capabilities across large and heterogeneous endpoint environments while maintaining reliability, performance, security, compliance, and a positive user experience. Establish service-level objectives, observability, capacity planning, and operational readiness for device-trust and secure-browser services. Lead incident response, post-incident reviews, and implementation of durable corrective actions. Partner with multi-functional collaborators across security, IT and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and long-term operational ownership.

What We Need To See

Bachelor's degree or Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related field.12+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, or security engineering, including significant depth in endpoint or platform security.Strong, current software development skills with a track record of shipping and operating production services.Experience designing, building, and owning large-scale distributed services or security platforms, including the operational responsibility that comes with them.Demonstrated experience automating operations at scale: reducing toil, building self-healing or closed-loop remediation, and running services against defined SLOs.Solid understanding of Zero Trust architecture, device trust and posture models, and endpoint attack techniques, plus how identity, device, and network signals combine into access decisions.Working knowledge of at least one hardware or platform trust primitive (TPM, Secure Enclave, measured boot, TEEs, hardware-bound credentials) and the ability to go deep quickly on attestation.Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable driving architecture decisions across senior and executive audiences.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Hands-on experience building attestation or device posture services that run at enterprise scale with high availability and low latency.Deep understanding of TPM and measured boot internals, remote attestation protocols, and device-bound credentials and tokens (DPoP, mTLS, WebAuthn). Familiarity with securing non-human and machine identities, and with how attestation underpins service-to-service and agentic access patterns.Experience deploying or operating an enterprise browser or secure web access stack (Prisma Access Browser, Island, Chrome Enterprise, SASE/ZTNA, CASB, DLP), especially across a large developer population. Familiarity with browser security internals such as extension models, isolation boundaries, and policy enforcement.Experience building AI agents or ML-assisted automation for reliability or security operations, including guardrails, evaluation, and safe-action design or a demonstrated track record of picking up emerging tooling and shipping with it fast.Experience leading enterprise endpoint or device trust transformations, including migration off legacy agents and posture models at scale.

At NVIDIA, we operate at the core of enterprise security, architecting and protecting the platforms that support some of the most advanced computing systems in the world. This role offers the opportunity to influence strategy, build the automation that runs our security platforms, engage with executives, and leave a lasting security impact, working alongside outstanding engineers and security leaders!

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most intelligent and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 196,000 USD - 310,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 14, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
The Staff Tech Operations Engineer - Payment & POPs is the SONIC payments SME (subject-matter-expert) responsible for ensuring the stability, integrity, and efficient operation of the POPS (payments and point of personalized service) platforms, with the goal to ensures high levels of customer satisfaction by monitoring, maintaining, supporting, and optimizing both the intake and execution of requests (settlements, chargebacks, inventory control, menu items, coupons/discounts, images/videos, digital display layouts, etc.).

This role will manage and continually improve on the processes to go from initial requirements gathering through post launch support (including build & testing and successful launch), including Level 3 Support of payments technologies.

This position will work cross functionally and establish close business relationships with corporate and franchise payments teams through regular communication and business reporting. They will also be key to managing vendor relationships relating to all aspects of the payments & POPS platforms).

RESPONSIBILITIES

Ensures the SONIC brand’s payment & POPS IT products work as expected and provide Level 3 Support for all products within the team’s purview. This includes execution, monitoring, maintenance & coordination of all content changes for all aspects POPS as well as release management of software deployments, testing and QA activities

Leads a who perform Level 3 coordination activities for payment and POPS platforms

Establishes connections with brand & franchisee teams to ensure elevated levels of success, complete understanding of requirements and serves as a brand subject matter expert (SME) in appropriate meetings. Communicate and collaborate with coworkers, management, franchisees, operators, and others in a courteous and professional manner. Use decision-making and negotiation skills. Team-orientation and positive attitude

Mentors, builds knowledge and experience within the team so that each team member can own their work within the project with little oversight

Establishes the strategy and process by which the team executes on the regular operational work to configure content across each of the IT products

Develop executive dashboard reporting for leadership reporting on workload, adherence to schedules, and quality assurance

Effectively ensures the adoption and implementation of the technology goals for the organization

Collaborate with all internal and external teams to gather the appropriate requirements to roll out technology programs

Responsible for adherence to established budgets, including tracking & reporting

Plans effectively and multi-tasks. Utilize time management and organization skills to achieve aggressive deadlines; sets priorities and maintains organizational and filing systems. Responds promptly to others to ensure open and timely communication

Serve as the point of contact for franchisee and vendor escalations owned products. Communicate all issues, status updates, action items, and risks to the management team

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE QUALIFICATIONS

5+ years of experience in design, development, and implementation related to payment technologies in the context of point-of-sale systems

4-year Degree in business administration, Computer Science or related field

Experience in multiband, franchise, retail, foodservice, or consumer-facing industries preferred

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, OR ABILITIES

Strong understanding of how complex technology systems interact including cloud-based platforms, integration layers and scripting languages Proven ability to oversee collaborative programs with executives, business owners and vendors, on complex technology initiatives, which bear tangible results

Working knowledge and existing relationships with restaurant industry leading technology vendors

Strong analytical skills required, including a thorough understanding of how to interpret customer business needs and translate them into operational requirements

Strong presentation skills with ability to clearly communicate to all levels of the organization in all forms (written, verbal & telephone)

Excellent problem-solving skills with he ability to solution in a fast-paced environment

Exceptional organization, communication skills, and keen attention to detail

Ability to meet deadlines and make sound decisions based on data and stakeholder feedback

Ability to work cross functionally within an organization.

PMP (Project Management Professional) certification a plus

JIRA and Confluence skills preferred

Strong skills with the Microsoft Office Outlook, PowerPoint & Word required

Expert level skills with the Microsoft Office Excel required

Ability to analyze problems and escalate issues in a timely manner for quick resolution

Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, build strong relationships, and effectively manage projects with enthusiasm and a people-focused approach

This position is based in our Atlanta Support Center, with an expected on-site presence of 80%.

Inspire is a multi-brand restaurant company whose portfolio includes more than 33,000 Arby’s, Baskin-Robbins, Buffalo Wild Wings, Dunkin’, Jimmy John’s, and SONIC restaurants worldwide.

We’re made up of some of the world’s most iconic restaurant brands, but we’re much more than just a restaurant company. We’re a team of hundreds of thousands who individually and collectively are changing the way people eat, drink, and gather around the table. We know that food is much more than a staple—it’s an experience. At Inspire, that’s our purpose: to ignite and nourish flavorful experiences.

Analysis Skills, Budget Management, Business Administration, Chargebacks, Cloud Computing, Communication Skills, Computer Science, Cross-Functional, Customer Satisfaction, Detail Oriented, Establish Priorities, Fast Food, Inventory Management, Leadership, Mentoring, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office, Multitasking, Negotiation Skills, Operations Management, Organizational Skills, Point of Sale (POS) Systems, Presentation/Verbal Skills, Problem Solving Skills, Process Improvement, Product Support, Product/Service Launch, Project Management Certification, Project Management Professional (PMP), Project Tracking, Project/Program Management, Quality Assurance, Release Management/Engineering, Reporting Dashboards, Requirements Management, Restaurant, Risk Management, Scripting (Scripting Languages), Software Testing, Strategic Planning, Supplier Relationship Management (SRM), Team Player, Technical Leadership, Technical Operations, Technical Support, Testing, Time Management, Vendor/Supplier Relations

jobs.description:
Job Summary
- ----------

We are seeking an experienced Endpoint and Server Security Engineer with expertise in the CrowdStrike Falcon platform to strengthen our global endpoint and server security posture. This role will focus on deploying, configuring, and optimizing Falcon sensors across endpoints and servers, ensuring real-time threat detection, prevention, and response. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with the CrowdStrike platform.

Responsibilities
- ---------------

**Deployment \& Configuration**

· Support infrastructure teams to deploy and configure CrowdStrike Falcon sensors on Windows, Linux, and macOS endpoints and servers.

· Align endpoint and server security policies with organizational security standards and compliance requirements.

· Manage / support various Falcon modules.

**Platform Management**

· Investigate and remediate issues with the platform

· Provide support to SOC teams during incidents / escalation

· Tune detection rules and prevention policies to reduce false positives and improve detection efficacy.

· Produce reporting for operational visibility and compliance tracking.

**Server \& Endpoint Security**

· Maintain security baselines for Windows and Linux systems.

· Ensure all endpoints are protected with Falcon EDR policies.

**Governance \& Reporting**

· Maintain detailed documentation of configurations and operational runbooks.

· Generate executive-level reports on EDR performance, threat trends, and compliance posture.

· Support audit and regulatory requirements by providing evidence of endpoint and server security controls.

Skills and Experience
- --------------------

**English B2 or Higher**

**Experience**

· 3--5 years in endpoint and server security, with 2 years hands-on experience with CrowdStrike Falcon EDR and CrowdStrike NG-SIEM management.

Technical Skills

· Proficiency in CrowdStrike Falcon modules

**Certifications (Preferred)**

· CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA).

· CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Responder (CCFR).

· Industry certifications such as CISSP, CEH, GCFA, or equivalent.

**Preferred Attributes**

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

· Ability to operate in a global environment.

· Excellent communication and documentation skills for technical and non-technical audiences.

jobs.description:
Description

Keeper Security is hiring a Senior Federal Platform Engineer to support the deployment, operation, and sustainment of Keeper solutions across U.S. Government environments, including IL5, IL6, and classified networks. This is a 100% remote position with travel as needed.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help deliver secure, reliable, and compliant platform operations for mission-critical federal environments.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is a leading cybersecurity software company that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in more than 150 countries. Keeper delivers a powerful zero-trust and zero-knowledge solution built to meet the stringent requirements of federal IT environments. Its flagship offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects users, devices, and critical infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized in the Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper combines robust compliance with unmatched visibility and control. With industry-leading certifications, including FedRAMP High and GovRAMP Moderate Authorization, Keeper provides the security assurance public sector organizations require. Learn why federal agencies, including NASA and the DOJ, trust Keeper to defend against today’s sophisticated adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com .

About the Role

The Senior Federal Platform Engineer will be responsible for the hands-on delivery, deployment, automation, and sustainment of Keeper solutions in high-security U.S. Government environments. This role combines DevOps, platform engineering, release engineering, and site reliability responsibilities, with a strong focus on restricted and controlled environments. You will build and maintain deployment pipelines, automate infrastructure, support release and cutover activities, troubleshoot production issues, and help ensure systems remain secure, reliable, and audit-ready across IL5, IL6, and classified deployments. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in environments where change control is strict, access is limited, and operational rigor is critical.

Responsibilities

- Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows for federal environments

- Support software releases, deployment execution, cutovers, validation, rollback planning, and post-release monitoring across IL5, IL6, and classified networks

- Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or similar infrastructure-as-code tools

- Maintain hardened infrastructure, configuration baselines, patching processes, and operational controls for restricted environments

- Troubleshoot complex deployment, infrastructure, application, and platform issues in coordination with Engineering and Security teams

- Build and maintain logging, monitoring, alerting, and operational telemetry to improve system visibility and reliability

- Support incident response, recovery, postmortems, and corrective actions for federal platform environments

- Partner with Engineering, QA, Security, and Product teams to improve deployment readiness, operability, and release quality

- Maintain runbooks, deployment documentation, operational procedures, and configuration records for federal systems

- Support continuous monitoring, audit readiness, and authorization activities by producing required technical evidence and artifacts

- Assist with vulnerability remediation, security hardening, compliance drift detection, and system configuration validation

- Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms to improve automation, troubleshooting, documentation, scripting, and operational efficiency

Requirements

- 6+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE, Release Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or a related technical role

- Hands-on experience deploying and operating systems in IL5, IL6, FedRAMP High, classified, or similarly restricted government environments

- Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines, release automation, deployment workflows, and production change management

- Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, or similar

- Experience with AWS GovCloud and/or Azure Government

- Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar languages

- Strong understanding of secure configuration, patching, logging, access control, and operational hardening practices

- Experience with observability, including logs, metrics, alerting, and production troubleshooting

- Familiarity with federal security and compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, RMF, DoD Cloud Computing SRG, and related operational controls

- Experience working in environments with strict change control, limited access, and formal release processes

- Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to diagnose issues across infrastructure, applications, networking, and deployment pipelines

- Ability and willingness to use AI-assisted tools effectively to support scripting, automation, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational analysis

- Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- Keeper is FedRAMP authorized; therefore all applicants must be a U.S. Person

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting IL6 or classified deployments

- Experience operating Kubernetes or containerized workloads in high-compliance environments

- Experience with DISA STIGs, CIS benchmarks, or automated security hardening

- Familiarity with secrets management, PAM, IAM, or zero-trust architectures

- Experience supporting continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, or audit evidence collection

- Experience working directly with government agencies, primes, integrators, or mission partners

Benefits

- Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)

- Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life

- Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance

- 401K (Roth/Traditional)

- A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)

- Above market annual bonuses

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Classification: Exempt

Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice

This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan).

1. Data We Collect

Information You provide:

- Contact details, CV/resume, cover letter

Information We generate:

- Scheduling information

Information From Others:

- Recruiter/referral information who submit your profile

- Background verification (post offer)

Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information

2. How We Use Your Data

3. Legal Basis

- Legitimate Interests (recruitment management, security and integrity of the hiring process)

4. Who We Share Information With

Third Parties:

- Background verification vendors (post offer)

- Recruitment agencies (where applicable)

- Tools to support communication, collaboration and to securely store your data

Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place.

5. International Transfers

Your data may be accessed by Keeper entities globally as needed for the purposes of hiring and decision making. We protect any such data transfer between Keeper entities using appropriate safeguards under applicable data protection laws.

6. Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, consistent with our industry leading security standards.

7. Retention

We keep your data for 24 months from your last application activity, then delete or anonymize it.

Exceptions:

- You're hired (transfers to employee records)

8. Your Rights

You have the following rights and can contact us at the email below to exercise them:

- Access, correct, or delete your data, subject to applicable law and retention requirements

- Object to or restrict processing

- Withdraw consent (where applicable)

- Request data portability

If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law.

When you request access to your personal data, some information may be redacted if it includes the personal data of other individuals or information that we must protect in order to preserve their privacy rights.

9. Automated Decisions

Keeper does not make hiring decisions using solely automated processing.

10. Contact - Candidates can send privacy questions to: privacy@keepersecurity.com

jobs.description:
Department: IT

Location: Neptune

Description

Trilon is building a supercharged, technology-enabled future for our people and partners. The Senior Endpoint Engineer is the senior technical owner for Trilon's workplace endpoint ecosystem, standards, and operating model across Windows, Apple devices, Microsoft Teams Rooms, and the enterprise copier and plotter fleet.

Reporting to the Vice President, Infrastructure & Operations, this role leads the design, modernization, and reliable operation of endpoint management through Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Windows Autopatch, Patch My PC, Microsoft Entra ID, Apple Business Manager, and related technologies. The goal is a secure, consistent, measurable, and increasingly zero-touch experience for employees across Trilon partner firms.

This is an individual-contributor technical-lead role, not a formal people-manager position. Working within a small, highly capable engineering function, the role sets technical direction and builds the platforms, automation, standards, and documentation that allow endpoint services to operate reliably at scale. Service Delivery and Field Support retain responsibility for routine incidents, requests, onsite assistance, consumables, and first-line troubleshooting. This role becomes directly engaged when platform design, configuration, vendor coordination, automation, or support processes break down, and serves as the senior technical escalation point for complex or systemic issues.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership and Platform Ownership

• Provide hands-on technical leadership, architecture, design review, and practical guidance through expertise and influence, without formal direct-report or performance-management responsibility.

• Establish platform priorities, service ownership, technical standards, cross-training, escalation coverage, and an executable roadmap aligned with enterprise infrastructure and security strategy.

• Serve as the technical authority and senior escalation point for enterprise endpoint management; set technical direction, review engineering work, and maintain an executable roadmap.

• Own endpoint engineering documentation, change control, testing and rollback standards, support handoffs, knowledge transfer, and cross-training so services are repeatable and resilient.

• Establish service metrics and use operational reviews to drive accountability, reliability, security, and continuous improvement.

Endpoint Architecture, Enrollment, and Configuration

• Define and maintain enterprise standards for Windows endpoints, including configuration profiles, security baselines, compliance policies, assignment groups, role-based access, and policy exceptions.

• Own Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot architecture, including OEM registration, deployment profiles, pre-provisioning, Enrollment Status Page design, reset and redeployment workflows, and zero-touch readiness.

• Design enrollment and migration patterns for cloud-native Microsoft Entra join, hybrid Entra join, automatic MDM enrollment, and legacy-device transition while reducing long-term dependence on on-premises infrastructure.

• Maintain clear targeting and group-design standards and validate that enrollment, assignment, compliance, encryption, and application results are measured separately rather than inferred from group membership.

Apple Platform and Mobile Device Management

• Own enterprise management of Mac, iPhone, and iPad devices through Microsoft Intune and Apple Business Manager, including Automated Device Enrollment, supervision, enrollment, configuration and compliance, security, updates, remote actions, mobile application management, and lifecycle.

• Govern Apple platform integrations and controls, including Apple MDM Push certificates, device and MDM server assignments, Apps and Books licensing and location tokens, renewals, administrative access, procurement and reseller assignment, zero-touch setup, inventory, offboarding, secure wipe or recovery, and retirement.

Application Delivery, Patch Management, and Automation

• Own the application packaging lifecycle in Intune, including Win32 packages, PowerShell App Deployment Toolkit (PSADT), requirements, detection rules, dependencies, supersedence, pilot testing, production assignments, remediation, and retirement.

• Use Patch My PC's catalog and Custom Apps capabilities to publish and maintain third-party and specialized applications through Intune; require automated deployment as the standard path and document controlled fallback methods.

• Define the software-delivery model: Required assignments for security and business-critical applications, Company Portal for approved optional or role-specific software, and narrowly scoped blocking applications during Autopilot.

• Develop reliable delivery patterns for large and specialized AEC applications, including Autodesk AutoCAD and Bentley products, measuring end-to-end elapsed time separately from technician labor and improving same-day device readiness.

• Manage Windows Autopatch and update-ring strategy for quality, feature, driver, and firmware updates; monitor results and remediate failed installations and policy exceptions.

• Build and maintain PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, proactive-remediation, API-based, and responsibly governed AI-assisted automation that reduces manual effort, improves engineering throughput, and produces auditable results.

Security, Compliance, and Endpoint Health

• Partner with Cybersecurity to implement and validate Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker, Windows LAPS, Conditional Access device signals, endpoint security policies, and vulnerability remediation.

• Use pilot rings and defined acceptance criteria to test configurations, scripts, applications, and updates before broad production rollout.

• Develop dashboards and reports for enrollment, compliance, encryption, patch posture, deployment success, device health, exception age, and remediation performance.

• Apply least-privilege administration, privileged-role governance, auditability, and separation of duties to endpoint platforms and workflows.

Inventory, Lifecycle, and Vendor Management

• Maintain authoritative endpoint inventory and reconcile device identity and status across Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Freshservice, remote-support platforms, procurement records, and vendor portals using durable identifiers.

• Set standards for endpoint models, warranties, leasing, refresh, recovery, reuse, retirement, and secure disposition; partner with Finance, Procurement, and hardware vendors on forecasts and lifecycle execution.

• Monitor asset, enrollment, compliance, encryption, and ownership exceptions and drive them to resolution with accountable owners.

Workplace Technology Platforms

• Own the enterprise architecture, standards, lifecycle, monitoring, documentation, and vendor coordination for Microsoft Teams Rooms, including device configuration, Intune management, account and licensing dependencies, update strategy, room readiness, health reporting, and escalation paths.

• Own governance of Trilon's copier and plotter fleet, including enterprise standards, vendor and contract coordination, secure configuration, print-management dependencies, firmware and lifecycle planning, inventory, usage and service metrics, and replacement strategy.

• Define clear operating boundaries and support handoffs: Service Delivery and Field Support handle routine incidents, requests, consumables, and onsite troubleshooting, while this role addresses systemic failures, recurring problems, complex escalations, platform changes, and breakdowns in vendor or support processes.

• Use monitoring, service data, root-cause analysis, automation, and documented runbooks to reduce recurring support demand and improve the reliability and user experience of workplace technology platforms.

Integration and Growth Enablement

• Lead endpoint discovery, assessment, planning, and migration for newly acquired firms, including inventories, identity and join state, security posture, applications, deployment dependencies, and local support requirements.

• Define phased integration plans that protect employee productivity while moving devices, policies, applications, and operational processes toward Trilon enterprise standards.

• Partner with Service Delivery and Field Support on onboarding, offboarding, office openings, relocations, refresh events, and complex escalations, with clear ownership and support handoffs.

• Communicate technical risks, decisions, progress, and exceptions clearly to IT leadership and business stakeholders.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• 7 or more years of endpoint management, systems engineering, or modern workplace experience, including hands-on responsibility for managing thousands of endpoints through Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot in a distributed enterprise environment.
• Demonstrated technical leadership, sound judgment, and the ability to influence technical peers, establish standards, coordinate across teams, and communicate clearly without relying on formal reporting authority.
• Expert-level hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Entra ID device management, Windows 11, and endpoint policy architecture.
• Strong experience with enterprise software packaging and delivery, including Win32 applications, detection logic, dependencies, deployment rings, and troubleshooting failed installations; experience using PowerShell App Deployment Toolkit (PSADT) is strongly preferred.
• Experience with Windows Autopatch or equivalent update-ring governance and with third-party application and patch automation; Patch My PC experience is strongly preferred.
• Advanced PowerShell skills and practical experience using Microsoft Graph or other APIs for automation, reporting, and operational controls.
• Strong understanding of endpoint security controls, including Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker, Windows LAPS, Conditional Access, compliance, least privilege, and vulnerability remediation.
• Experience supporting complex, distributed environments and integrating endpoint operations during mergers, acquisitions, or tenant/domain transitions.
• Ability to reconcile data across device-management, identity, asset, remote-support, and service-management systems, plus experience with hardware lifecycle, leasing, vendor coordination, asset governance, and secure retirement.
• Strong hands-on experience managing Mac, iPhone, and iPad through Microsoft Intune and Apple Business Manager, including automated enrollment, compliance, application delivery, and device lifecycle.
• Experience engineering or governing Microsoft Teams Rooms, including Intune-managed room systems, device health, updates, account and licensing dependencies, monitoring, and support escalation, is strongly preferred.
• Experience governing an enterprise copier, printer, or plotter fleet, including vendor coordination, secure configuration, lifecycle planning, inventory, service performance, and print-management dependencies, is preferred.
• Experience with endpoint equipment warehousing and depot operations, including receiving, secure storage, inventory control, device staging, shipping, returns, and lifecycle logistics, is preferred.
• Experience packaging and deploying complex AEC applications, particularly Autodesk AutoCAD and Bentley products, is preferred.

Benefits

Trilon was formed with the vision of building the next Top 20 infrastructure consulting firm in North America by bringing together some of the nation’s best infrastructure consulting firms, focused on delivering practical and sustainable infrastructure solutions. Trilon is backed by Alpine Investors, a PeopleFirst Private Equity Firm. Trilon currently comprises 5,500+ staff across the US. For more information, visit www.trilon.com.

jobs.description:
Nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur Digital Workplace pour devenir le référent de l'évolution de l'environnement de travail numérique pour nos clients et nos collaborateurs.

Nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur Digital Workplace pour devenir le référent de l'évolution de l'environnement de travail numérique pour nos clients et nos collaborateurs.

Devenez le référent de l'évolution de l'environnement de travail numérique pour nos clients et nos collaborateurs. Votre mission ? Déployer, optimiser et assurer l'adoption des outils collaboratifs modernes. Vous serez l'architecte d'une expérience utilisateur fluide, performante et sécurisée, en conciliant innovation technologique et stabilité opérationnelle.

Vos Missions : Entre Transformation (Build) et Excellence (Run)

🛠️ Build & Pilotage de Projets (50%)

-
Stratégie & Design : Définir la stratégie Digital Workplace en alignement avec la feuille de route SI et les enjeux métiers.

-
Déploiement de bout en bout : Piloter les projets de migration et d’évolution des outils ( M365, Teams, Intranet, Device Management ) en gérant les coûts, les délais et la qualité.

-
Expertise Technique : Concevoir et durcir les socles de travail (Windows/macOS) via les outils modernes ( Intune, Autopilot, Azure AD ).

-
Innovation : Assurer une veille technologique constante pour anticiper les nouveaux usages et outils collaboratifs.

⚙️ Run & Amélioration Continue (30%)

-
Maintien en Condition Opérationnelle : Garantir la disponibilité et la performance des outils collaboratifs au quotidien.

-
Expertise N3 : Intervenir sur les incidents complexes et assurer le rôle de référent technique auprès des équipes de support.

-
Industrialisation : Automatiser les tâches récurrentes et les processus de déploiement applicatif (Scripting PowerShell).

Les compétences techniques requises sont :

- Une maîtrise approfondie de l'écosystème Microsoft 365 (M365) : Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Yammer, Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).

-
Bonne expérience en gestion de projet (Cycle en V, Agile/Scrum).

-
Notions avancées sur l'identité (Azure AD / Entra ID) et la sécurité des données (Purview).

-
Anglais professionnel (contexte technique et documentation).

Vous avez le profil idéal si :

- Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bac +5.

- Vous disposez d’un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle.

- Vous avez déjà expérimenté la gestion d'un environnement de transformation ou multi-acteurs.

Le saviez-vous ? Le Groupe Devoteam œuvre pour l'égalité des chances, pour la promotion de ses collaboratrices et de ses collaborateurs au mérite et lutte activement contre toute forme de discrimination. Nous sommes persuadés que la diversité contribue à la créativité, au dynamisme et à l'excellence de notre organisation. Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Devoteam est un leader du conseil en stratégie digitale, plateformes technologiques, cybersécurité et business transformation. Avec 10 000 collaborateurs en Europe, Moyen-Orient et Afrique, Devoteam accompagne les entreprises en mettant depuis plus de 25 ans la Technologie au service de l’Homme.

Les systèmes d’information sont devenus des actifs critiques. Pourtant, trop souvent, leur gestion reste invisible, sous-valorisée, ou fragmentée. Sans une base solide, aucune transformation digitale ne tient dans la durée. Sans un run fiable, il n’y a pas de performance durable.

TopTeam, équipe dédiée au run et à la production des infrastructures IT garantit la paix d’esprit technologique, en assurant la continuité, la fiabilité et la performance des environnements IT. L'équipe de TopTeam est ancrée dans l’opérationnel, portée par la rigueur, la proximité et la culture du service.

Nos experts -Service Delivery Manager, Incident Manager, Chef de Projet Production, Ingénieur de Production, Administrateur Systèmes et Réseaux, Ingénieur Digital Workplace, Support technique N2/N3 et VIP interviennent sur site ou à distance, avec un delivery piloté par les SLA et l’amélioration continue. Nous industrialisons les opérations, fiabilisons les environnements et sécurisons le quotidien.

Notre engagement : tenir le run pour libérer la transformation

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Nous sommes une IA-Driven Company : Né lors des prémices de la révolution tech, Devoteam est le partenaire de confiance qui a accompagné ses clients vers l'évolution d'Internet, du Cloud, et désormais, de la révolution de l'IA. Pour cela, 100% de nos collaborateurs sont certifiés GenAI. Rejoindre Devoteam , c’est apprendre en continu. Avec 75% de collaborateurs certifiés, Devoteam est une Learning Company où l’apprentissage est au cœur de notre modèle. Avec 50 tribus d’expertise composées de leaders technologiques, nous collaborons avec les plus grands partenaires technologiques : Google, AWS, Microsoft, ServiceNow, Snowflake, et bien d’autres. Ce collectif d’experts contribue à animer nos communautés métiers et à présenter chaque année son point de vue sur les technologies via le Tech Radar.

Rejoignez Devoteam et devenez acteur de votre carrière dans un environnement d’excellence, d’apprentissage et d’innovation !

jobs.summary: **Mid-Level IT Manager -- AI \& MDM Focus** **Location:** Remote (Latin America) **Working Hours:** Full-time, aligned with Pacific Standard Time (PST). **Type:** Full-Time Contractor (starts with a 3-month trial). **Pay:** \~$1,800 USD/month during the...
jobs.description:
**Mid-Level IT Manager -- AI \& MDM Focus**

**Location:** Remote (Latin America)

**Working Hours:** Full-time, aligned with Pacific Standard Time (PST).

**Type:** Full-Time Contractor (starts with a 3-month trial).

**Pay:** \~$1,800 USD/month during the trial period, up to $2,000 USD/month post-trial.

**Top Requirements:** 3--5 years of IT experience, strong Artificial Intelligence (AI) implementation skills, hands-on Mobile Device Management (MDM) expertise, and fluent English.

*All CVs must be submitted in English to be considered.*

**ABOUT RUVIXX**

At Ruvixx, our mission is to take the complexity out of software license compliance. We blend a cutting-edge tech platform with a genuinely human-first approach, transforming difficult challenges into clear growth opportunities. Our globally distributed team is driven by the desire to build strong, transparent client partnerships, always choosing collaboration over confrontation. If you are eager to tackle high-stakes problems, champion the use of emerging technologies, and make a measurable impact from your very first day, we'd love to have you on our team.

**THE ROLE**

We are seeking a proactive, mid-level IT Manager to oversee our IT department's day-to-day operations. This role is a perfect stepping stone for an experienced IT Administrator or Support Specialist who is ready to take on department-level ownership.

Working directly under the Chief Technology Officer (CTO), you will ensure our fully remote workforce has the secure, reliable, and modern tech stack they need to thrive. While you will have the continuous support and guidance of leadership, you'll be given the autonomy to run daily operations and spearhead two critical areas: implementing Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools and managing our Mobile Device Management (MDM) ecosystem.

You will explore emerging tech, pilot new tools, and help establish clear guidelines for safe AI usage across our team, all backed by a strong foundation in security compliance.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Drive AI Implementation (Top Priority):** Serve as our go-to resource for practical AI adoption. You will research, test, and implement AI tools that boost team efficiency. Working with the CTO, you will help draft and enforce clear guidelines for safe and effective AI usage across the company.
* **Manage Our MDM Ecosystem (Top Priority):** Administer our MDM solutions (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Jamf). Handle daily device provisioning, policy enforcement, and software deployment across macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android platforms.
* **Oversee IT Operations:** Manage the IT department's daily functions during standard PST working hours. Handle support escalations, run onboarding/offboarding for team members, and execute IT projects aligned with the CTO's vision.
* **Optimize and Document:** Continuously refine current systems, help automate repetitive workflows, and build comprehensive knowledge-base articles to empower our remote team to self-serve when possible.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Mid-Level IT Experience:** 3--5 years of professional experience in an IT administration, senior IT support, or junior IT management role.
* **PST Availability:** Must be able to work full-time hours closely aligned with the Pacific Standard Time (PST) zone.
* **Strong AI Foundation:** Practical experience using AI tools and the technical curiosity to evaluate new platforms. You should be comfortable translating AI capabilities into secure, everyday operational tasks.
* **Hands-on MDM Expertise:** Proven experience administering and deploying MDM solutions (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Jamf, FleetDM).
* **Excellent Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, capable of supporting a global workforce and communicating effectively with leadership.
* **Proactive Problem Solving:** Strong ability to manage daily operations independently, prioritize tasks effectively, and collaborate with leadership on larger strategic goals within a fully remote environment.
* **Core Technical Knowledge:** Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (VPNs, firewalls) and enterprise cloud applications (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365).

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Exposure to or basic understanding of security compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2).
* Relevant industry credentials (e.g., CompTIA Security , ITIL, Microsoft/Jamf certifications, or AI-focused qualifications).

**WHY JOIN US?**

* **Step Up in Your Career:** This is an ideal role for a mid-level professional looking to take ownership of a department, acting as a pivotal player in our technological scaling.
* **Impact from Day One:** Have a direct hand in defining how our company adopts next-generation AI and manages remote infrastructure.
* **Modern Tech Stack:** Work with cutting-edge, cloud-native tools in a forward-thinking, agile environment.
* **True Flexibility:** Enjoy the autonomy of a fully remote contract role based anywhere within Latin America.

**READY TO APPLY?** Ruvixx is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We highly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. We believe great talent comes in many forms.

***Reminder:*** *This is a full-time contractor position starting with a 3-month trial period. All resumes/CVs must be submitted in English to be considered.*

jobs.summary: **Job Description** En **DXC Technology** , aprovechamos el poder de la tecnología para ofrecer servicios de TI de misión crítica que permiten a nuestros clientes modernizar sus operaciones e impulsar la innovación en todo su entorno tecnológico....
jobs.description:
**Job Description** En **DXC Technology** , aprovechamos el poder de la tecnología para ofrecer servicios de TI de misión crítica que permiten a nuestros clientes modernizar sus operaciones e impulsar la innovación en todo su entorno tecnológico. Brindamos servicios a través del **Enterprise Technology Stack** , abarcando outsourcing de procesos de negocio, analítica e ingeniería, desarrollo y gestión de aplicaciones, ciberseguridad, servicios en la nube, externalización de TI (IT Outsourcing) y soluciones de **Modern Workplace** .

Estamos buscando un profesional de **nivel Mid-Senior a Senior en Protección de Endpoints** para formar parte de nuestro equipo de Ciberseguridad. Esta persona será responsable de diseñar, implementar, administrar y mejorar continuamente los controles de protección de endpoints para estaciones de trabajo, servidores y entornos virtuales.

El candidato ideal debe contar con sólida experiencia en **seguridad de endpoints, detección y respuesta ante amenazas, hardening de sistemas operativos, gestión de vulnerabilidades y automatización de seguridad** . Se considera altamente deseable contar con conocimientos adicionales en seguridad en la nube y desarrollo de software.

Responsabilidades principales

Protección de Endpoints

* Diseñar, implementar y mantener controles de seguridad para endpoints.
* Monitorear y responder ante malware, ransomware y amenazas avanzadas.
* Investigar incidentes de seguridad y coordinar las actividades de contención, erradicación y recuperación.
* Desarrollar y optimizar políticas de seguridad, reglas de detección y controles preventivos.
* Realizar hardening de sistemas operativos y establecer configuraciones de referencia.
* Gestionar actividades de aplicación de parches y remediación.
* Realizar threat hunting e investigaciones de seguridad.
* Elaborar reportes operativos y ejecutivos.

Automatización de Seguridad

* Desarrollar scripts para automatizar tareas operativas.
* Integrar herramientas de seguridad mediante APIs.
* Automatizar reportes, gestión de alertas y flujos de trabajo de respuesta.

Seguridad en la Nube (Deseable)

* Brindar soporte en la protección de cargas de trabajo alojadas en entornos cloud.
* Comprender conceptos de identidad, registro de eventos (logging) y monitoreo de seguridad en la nube.

Conocimientos de Desarrollo de Software (Deseable)

* Comprender prácticas de desarrollo de software y principios de programación segura.
* Colaborar con equipos de DevOps y desarrollo cuando sea necesario.

Requisitos

* Licenciatura/Bachillerato universitario en Seguridad de la Información, Ciencias de la Computación, Ingeniería o un campo relacionado.
* Más de 5 años de experiencia en ciberseguridad, con un fuerte enfoque en protección de endpoints.
* Conocimientos avanzados de seguridad en Windows y Linux.
* Sólido conocimiento de malware, ransomware y técnicas de ataque.
* Experiencia en gestión de vulnerabilidades y administración de parches.
* Conocimientos de redes, autenticación y gestión de identidades.
* Experiencia en scripting y automatización.
* Nivel avanzado de inglés, tanto oral como escrito.

Conocimientos técnicos principales

Obligatorios

* Experiencia en protección de endpoints.
* Detección de amenazas y respuesta ante incidentes.
* Sistemas operativos.
* Defensa contra malware y ransomware.
* Threat Hunting.
* Gestión de vulnerabilidades.
* Monitoreo de seguridad y telemetría.
* Extended Detection and Response (XDR).
* Fundamentos de seguridad de redes.
* Fundamentos de gestión de identidades y accesos (IAM).
* Automatización de seguridad.
* Integración mediante APIs.
* Elaboración de reportes y documentación de seguridad.

Deseables

* DevSecOps.
* Seguridad de contenedores.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM).
* Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP).

Unirse a **DXC Technology** significa formar parte de un equipo de profesionales talentosos que impulsan el cambio y aprovechan las oportunidades para desarrollar sus carreras y contribuir al éxito de nuestros clientes. En DXC fomentamos la colaboración, el trabajo en equipo y el apoyo mutuo, tanto a nivel local como global.

Nuestros logros reflejan el compromiso con la excelencia en el servicio que brindamos a nuestros clientes y colaboradores. Formará parte de un equipo comprometido con la creación de una cultura de aprendizaje continuo, diversidad e inclusión, respaldada por sólidos principios éticos y una firme responsabilidad corporativa.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We're committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. More information on employment scams is available** here***.***

jobs.summary: **Descripción del Puesto:** - -------------------------- En TD SYNNEX estamos expandiendo la práctica de Endpoint en MCA y buscamos un Account Manager que lidere el desarrollo del negocio multimarca de Endpoint (PCs, notebooks, monitores, periféricos,...
jobs.description:
**Descripción del Puesto:**
- --------------------------

En TD SYNNEX estamos expandiendo la práctica de Endpoint en MCA y buscamos un Account Manager que lidere el desarrollo del negocio multimarca de Endpoint (PCs, notebooks, monitores, periféricos, impresión y otras soluciones de usuario final; excluye Advanced Solutions). Tendrás a cargo una cartera definida de partners y cuentas clave, con foco en maximizar ingresos, rentabilidad y nuevas líneas de negocio. Serás un referente para nuestros socios del canal, impulsando planificación de cuentas, generación de pipeline, gestión de licitaciones y adopción de nuestras plataformas digitales.

**Lo que harás:**
- ----------------

* Desarrollar y hacer crecer la cartera de partners: planificación de cuenta, mapeo de decisores, detección de oportunidades y activación de campañas.

* Ser una persona de confianza para los clientes, manteniendo relaciones estratégicas con visitas presenciales periódicas.

* Diseñar y ejecutar planes estratégicos para impulsar el negocio actual y el crecimiento incremental.

* Identificar, registrar y hacer seguimiento de oportunidades (pipeline) asegurando la calidad del funnel y el cumplimiento de metas.

* Coordinar recursos internos y liderar la interacción con Inside Sales, Operaciones de Venta y las Unidades de Negocio Especialistas (SBUs).

* Identificar oportunidades/proyectos conjuntamente con los BDM y equipos de Vendor Management.

* Relevar requerimientos del cliente y elaborar propuestas que agreguen valor, protegiendo el margen y el mix de productos/soluciones.

* Gestionar licitaciones y concursos (sector público y privado), coordinando inventario, plazos y documentación.

* Monitorear inventario y forecast, articulando con operaciones y vendors para asegurar disponibilidad y niveles de servicio.

* Detectar necesidades y problemas del cliente, resolviéndolos o escalándolos a las áreas correspondientes.

* Obtener insights mediante el perfilado y análisis de la cartera, generando acciones para maximizar oportunidades y expandir la base de partners.

* Completar en tiempo y forma el reporte y la administración en los sistemas de TD SYNNEX (CRM, reportes, profiling).

* Impulsar el uso de la plataforma de e‑commerce de TD SYNNEX (InTouch), promoviendo sus beneficios y aumentando la adopción.

* Mantener y mejorar los acuerdos de nivel de servicio (SLAs) con clientes y áreas internas.

* Operar bajo las mejores prácticas, políticas y objetivos de TD SYNNEX, asegurando el cumplimiento normativo y ético.

Lo que buscamos
- --------------

* 3 años de experiencia relevante en ventas B2B o gestión de cuentas en la industria de tecnología (mayorista, fabricante u OEM, o reseller), preferentemente en categorías de Endpoint (computación personal, impresión, periféricos, colaboración).

* Red de relaciones y cartera activa en el canal de Argentina, con historial comprobable de desarrollo de partners y crecimiento de cuentas.

* Experiencia multimarca y trabajo con vendors/OEMs; capacidad para priorizar y balancear portafolio protegiendo margen.

* Sólida gestión de pipeline, pronóstico, negociación y cierre; dominio de CRM (ideal Salesforce) y Excel/herramientas de análisis.

* Experiencia en gestión de licitaciones y concursos, deseable con conocimiento del sector público.

* Enfoque a resultados, autonomía, capacidad de influencia sin autoridad formal y colaboración transversal.

* Habilidad para trabajo en campo con viajes frecuentes dentro del país.

* Inglés intermedio/avanzado para interactuar con equipos regionales y materiales de vendors.

Será un plus
- -----------

* Experiencia previa en mayoristas o vendors líderes de Endpoint

* Haber impulsado adopción de plataformas de e‑commerce B2B; conocimiento previo de InTouch.

**Las condiciones de trabajo:**
- ------------------------------

* Entorno Profesional de Oficina (Híbrido).

* Horas de trabajo no estándar, según lo requiera el negocio.

Tú qué sacas de esto?

* **Aprovecha al máximo nuestra Organización Global:**establece contactos con otros nuevos compañeros de trabajo dentro de sus primeros 30 días a través de nuestro programa de incorporación.

* **Haz crecer tu carrera:**nuestra primera prioridad es contratar internamente y ayudar a nuestra gente a crecer. Como compañero de trabajo, tendrás más oportunidades profesionales disponibles.
