jobs.description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream** With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall's, Cornetto and Ben \& Jerry's, loved in 76 countries, we are the world's largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.

We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world's biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.

**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.** We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.

We're curious and ready for what's next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.

Data Lead Americas -- MDM \& S/4HANA

Scope: Regional Americas

Location: Mexico, Tultitlan - Tepalcapa

T\&C: Project role, end of nov 27

The Role

We are seeking a highly experienced **Data Lead Americas** to play a critical role in one of the most significant transformation programs in our company's history: the implementation of **SAP S/4HANA** and the creation of a new standalone organization through the carve-out from Unilever.

This is a unique opportunity to help design and establish the future data foundation of a new company. The role will lead Master Data Management strategy and deployment across the Americas, with a strong focus on **Material and Product Domain Management, Customer Master Data, Data Governance, and S/4HANA data transformation** .

The successful candidate will combine deep Master Data expertise with a strong consulting mindset, influencing senior stakeholders, driving strategic decisions, and ensuring data is fit for purpose to enable business operations from Day 1.

What You Will Be Responsible For

* Lead Master Data Management deployment and governance for the Americas within the SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
* Serve as the regional SME for Material, Product, and Customer Master Data, ensuring alignment with global standards and business needs.
* Partner with global process owners, business teams, data owners, and system integrators to design and implement target-state master data processes.
* Drive data readiness activities, including cleansing, enrichment, validation, and migration to support successful deployments.
* Establish and enhance data governance frameworks, data quality controls, and master data lifecycle management practices.
* Influence stakeholders and promote standardization through adoption of best-in-class data management processes.
* Lead senior stakeholder discussions, manage data-related risks, and provide recommendations, escalation, and mitigation plans.
* Coordinate testing, business validation, cutover, go-live readiness, and post-go-live hypercare and stabilization activities while supporting the future data operating model.

What We Are Looking For

* Extensive Master Data Management (MDM) experience within large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
* Strong expertise in Material, Product, and Customer Master Data, including governance, quality, and lifecycle management.
* Proven track record leading data migration, data governance, and data quality initiatives for ERP implementations.
* Deep understanding of master data processes, governance models, hierarchies, and business rules.
* Ability to influence senior business and technology stakeholders and drive decision-making in complex environments.
* Experience working across global, matrixed organizations with diverse stakeholder groups.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* SAP S/4HANA deployment experience required; carve-out, M\&A, or business separation experience is a plus.

What You Can Expect

* A unique opportunity to help build the data foundations of a newly established company following a major carve-out from Unilever.
* A highly visible leadership role with direct exposure to senior business and transformation leaders.
* The chance to shape Master Data strategy, governance, and operating models from the ground up.
* Participation in a complex, enterprise-wide SAP S/4HANA transformation across the Americas.
* Collaboration with global teams, external partners, and industry experts.
* A dynamic environment where you can combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
* Significant opportunity to leave a lasting impact on how the new organization operates and grows.

**Why join us?** This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!

You'll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you're excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.

**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?** If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.

If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.

We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Client Platform Engineering (CPE) team delivers trusted devices at scale: secure by default, reliable by design, and effortless to use. We own platform capabilities across macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, and Linux, spanning endpoint posture and device trust, application delivery, onboarding, updates, telemetry, workflow orchestration, and employee-facing remediation. The team partners deeply with Security, Research, Applied, and specialized engineering groups to enable and protect OpenAI while reducing friction for the people advancing our mission.

About the Role

As an Engineering Manager for CPE, you will lead a team of engineers responsible for the strategy, delivery, and operation of OpenAI’s cross-platform client foundation. You will combine people leadership with strong technical judgment: setting direction, developing engineers, reviewing architecture and tradeoffs, and creating the operating mechanisms that turn ambiguous needs into durable platform outcomes. This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of security, reliability, developer velocity, and employee experience.

CPE is a highly technical platform engineering organization delivering first-party services, automation, observability, and safe fleet operations. We’re looking for a leader who can guide its next chapter, scaling the team and its systems, partnering across the company, and raising the bar for secure, reliable, low-friction experiences across every supported platform.

In this role, you will:

- Lead and develop a high-performing engineering team; hire thoughtfully, coach engineers, create clarity, and foster an inclusive, high-accountability culture that pushes perceived limits.

- Define and execute a multi-year client-platform strategy and roadmap across macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, and Linux, including how Codex and agents can reshape employee computing.

- Provide technical direction for endpoint posture, device trust, application delivery, device onboarding, updates, fleet telemetry, workflow orchestration, and employee-facing remediation. Lead the team to rethink the platform from first principles as Codex and agent capabilities advance: what software needs to be built, what agents can own end to end, and which employee workflows no longer need to exist.

- Guide architecture and engineering tradeoffs across first-party services, open-source tooling, SaaS platforms, IaC/GitOps, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure. Decide what to build, buy, standardize, retire, or redesign as AI changes what the platform can do.

- Establish clear goals, ownership, planning, design reviews, and execution rhythms that let the team move quickly without sacrificing quality.

- Raise the bar for reliability and evidence-backed security through observability, drift detection, staged rollouts, release gates, rollback paths, incident learning, runbooks, and healthy operational ownership. Use telemetry to see friction, measure outcomes, and improve before issues become tickets.

- Partner with Security, IT, Research, Applied, Product, and specialized engineering teams to align priorities and land company-wide changes, dogfood OpenAI products in real employee workflows, and continuously improve internal platforms.

- Balance strong security and compliance controls with developer velocity, employee experience, and operational simplicity. Define where agents can act, where humans approve, and how actions are evaluated, audited, and reversed.

- Use adoption, reliability, evidence-backed security posture, data freshness, employee experience, workflow completion, friction, agent effectiveness, and operational-load metrics to steer investment and communicate impact.

- Partner with IT and Security teams to compound CPE’s impact across employee experience, security posture, and operational scale.

You may be a fit for this role if you have:

- Built and led teams that owned secure, reliable, mission critical services and infrastructure at scale, from strategy through production operations.

- Delivered internal platforms, tooling, and services that materially improved reliability, security, and employee experience.

- Made sound software and infrastructure engineering decisions at scale. Deep endpoint expertise is strongly preferred.

- Raised production readiness through direct technical review of architecture, automation, code, IaC/GitOps, CI/CD, observability, and operational tradeoffs.

- Operated infrastructure with material security or identity risk through staged rollouts, incidents, and decisions that balanced risk, compliance, and employee or developer experience.

- Committed to joining the team’s engineering on call rotation after ramp up and using firsthand operational context to improve reliability and reduce toil.

- Built inclusive teams that do excellent work, communicated with clarity and candor, and influenced partners across Security, IT, and Product/Engineering.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

- Deep experience with one or more client-platform tool ecosystems such as Jamf, Intune, Android Enterprise, FleetDM/osquery, Munki/AutoPkg, or Linux configuration management.

- Experience building internal platforms or services for app delivery, device posture/trust, onboarding, notifications, workflow orchestration, or fleet telemetry.

- Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, Terraform, Kubernetes/containers, service orchestration, and large-scale observability.

- Experience partnering with security, compliance, or privacy teams in high-assurance environments.

- Experience supporting research, developer, robotics, hardware-lab, or other specialized computing environments.

- A record of contributing to open-source tooling, engineering communities, or cross-company technical standards.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

Deploying and maintaining Microsoft 365 environments
Assisting with cybersecurity, backup, and disaster recovery solutions

Who We Are

RCG, Inc. is a growing federal contracting company delivering technology solutions that support critical government missions. We are proud to be Certified™ as a Great Place to Work® for four consecutive years and are seeking highly qualified professionals to join our team.

The Opportunity

RCG is seeking an experienced Desktop/Endpoint Administrator to support our government client in Boulder, CO. This is a full-time, on-site position responsible for desktop and endpoint administration, end-user technical support, device deployment, software management, and endpoint security. The Desktop/Endpoint Administrator will also participate in and help manage a small desktop support team while ensuring reliable, secure, and effective technical support for government and contractor users.

What You’ll Do

Desktop & Endpoint Administration

Configure, deploy, maintain, and support Windows laptops and desktops, macOS devices, mobile devices, printers, peripherals, and other endpoint equipment.
Deploy and manage applications using BigFix, Microsoft Intune, and Company Portal for iOS devices.
Administer Apple, Android, and other mobile devices through Microsoft Intune.
Manage and support macOS devices using JAMF Pro.
Configure and maintain full-disk encryption using BitLocker or other approved encryption solutions.
Configure and support Microsoft Surface Hub interactive whiteboards.
Provide email provisioning and support for personal productivity applications and approved end-user software.

End-User Technical Support

Troubleshoot and resolve desktop, laptop, software, printer, network, communications, and connectivity issues.
Support both on-site equipment and government-furnished equipment used remotely, including laptops, smartphones, tablets, and VPN tokens.
Perform preventive and remedial hardware maintenance, diagnostic testing, and equipment troubleshooting.
Coordinate the repair or replacement of malfunctioning equipment as necessary.
Install, configure, and maintain local and network printers and peripheral devices.

Software & Asset Management

Install, configure, maintain, and support approved software on endpoints and applicable systems.
Manage software licenses and maintain accurate records of software versions, installations, and locations.
Maintain electronic documentation for hardware, software, technical notes, installation procedures, and related support information.
Monitor software versions and recommend upgrades as appropriate.
Support hardware inventory, equipment moves, installations, component upgrades, and software-driver updates.
Coordinate equipment changes with the appropriate property custodian and maintain required asset records.

Endpoint Security & Incident Support

Monitor and remediate endpoint vulnerabilities using approved security tools.
Help ensure endpoints comply with established security, software, encryption, and configuration requirements.
Support incident response activities and coordinate with cybersecurity teams during investigation, containment, and remediation efforts.

Team & Operational Support

Participate in and help manage a small team providing desktop and endpoint support.
Assist with network and infrastructure support as needed to maintain system performance, availability, connectivity, and security.
Coordinate with technical teams and customer stakeholders to resolve user and endpoint issues efficiently.

What We’re Looking For

Minimum of five (5) years of relevant IT experience, including at least three (3) years of experience in desktop/endpoint administration or enterprise end-user support.
Demonstrated experience supporting Windows, macOS, and mobile devices in an enterprise environment.
Hands-on experience with endpoint management technologies such as Microsoft Intune, BigFix, and JAMF Pro.
Experience with mobile device administration and application deployment.
Experience with BitLocker or comparable full-disk encryption technologies.
Experience troubleshooting hardware, software, printer, network, and connectivity issues.
Knowledge of endpoint vulnerability management and security practices.
Experience with hardware/software inventory, asset tracking, and software license management.
Strong documentation, customer service, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
Ability to work effectively within and help coordinate a small technical support team.

Why Join RCG?

RCG offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, professional development opportunities, and the chance to support mission-critical federal technology programs. As a company Certified™ as a Great Place to Work® for four consecutive years, we are committed to creating a collaborative environment where employees can grow and make a meaningful impact.

jobs.description:
About The Team

OpenAI’s Client Platform Engineering (CPE) team delivers trusted devices at scale: secure by default, reliable by design, and effortless to use. We own platform capabilities across macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, and Linux, spanning endpoint posture and device trust, application delivery, onboarding, updates, telemetry, workflow orchestration, and employee-facing remediation. The team partners deeply with Security, Research, Applied, and specialized engineering groups to enable and protect OpenAI while reducing friction for the people advancing our mission.

About The Role

As an Engineering Manager for CPE, you will lead a team of engineers responsible for the strategy, delivery, and operation of OpenAI’s cross-platform client foundation. You will combine people leadership with strong technical judgment: setting direction, developing engineers, reviewing architecture and tradeoffs, and creating the operating mechanisms that turn ambiguous needs into durable platform outcomes. This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of security, reliability, developer velocity, and employee experience.

CPE is a highly technical platform engineering organization delivering first-party services, automation, observability, and safe fleet operations. We’re looking for a leader who can guide its next chapter, scaling the team and its systems, partnering across the company, and raising the bar for secure, reliable, low-friction experiences across every supported platform.

In This Role, You Will

Lead and develop a high-performing engineering team; hire thoughtfully, coach engineers, create clarity, and foster an inclusive, high-accountability culture that pushes perceived limits.Define and execute a multi-year client-platform strategy and roadmap across macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, and Linux, including how Codex and agents can reshape employee computing.Provide technical direction for endpoint posture, device trust, application delivery, device onboarding, updates, fleet telemetry, workflow orchestration, and employee-facing remediation. Lead the team to rethink the platform from first principles as Codex and agent capabilities advance: what software needs to be built, what agents can own end to end, and which employee workflows no longer need to exist.Guide architecture and engineering tradeoffs across first-party services, open-source tooling, SaaS platforms, IaC/GitOps, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure. Decide what to build, buy, standardize, retire, or redesign as AI changes what the platform can do.Establish clear goals, ownership, planning, design reviews, and execution rhythms that let the team move quickly without sacrificing quality.Raise the bar for reliability and evidence-backed security through observability, drift detection, staged rollouts, release gates, rollback paths, incident learning, runbooks, and healthy operational ownership. Use telemetry to see friction, measure outcomes, and improve before issues become tickets.Partner with Security, IT, Research, Applied, Product, and specialized engineering teams to align priorities and land company-wide changes, dogfood OpenAI products in real employee workflows, and continuously improve internal platforms.Balance strong security and compliance controls with developer velocity, employee experience, and operational simplicity. Define where agents can act, where humans approve, and how actions are evaluated, audited, and reversed.Use adoption, reliability, evidence-backed security posture, data freshness, employee experience, workflow completion, friction, agent effectiveness, and operational-load metrics to steer investment and communicate impact.Partner with IT and Security teams to compound CPE’s impact across employee experience, security posture, and operational scale.

You may be a fit for this role if you have:

Built and led teams that owned secure, reliable, mission critical services and infrastructure at scale, from strategy through production operations.Delivered internal platforms, tooling, and services that materially improved reliability, security, and employee experience.Made sound software and infrastructure engineering decisions at scale. Deep endpoint expertise is strongly preferred.Raised production readiness through direct technical review of architecture, automation, code, IaC/GitOps, CI/CD, observability, and operational tradeoffs.Operated infrastructure with material security or identity risk through staged rollouts, incidents, and decisions that balanced risk, compliance, and employee or developer experience.Committed to joining the team’s engineering on call rotation after ramp up and using firsthand operational context to improve reliability and reduce toil.Built inclusive teams that do excellent work, communicated with clarity and candor, and influenced partners across Security, IT, and Product/Engineering.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You Have

Deep experience with one or more client-platform tool ecosystems such as Jamf, Intune, Android Enterprise, FleetDM/osquery, Munki/AutoPkg, or Linux configuration management.Experience building internal platforms or services for app delivery, device posture/trust, onboarding, notifications, workflow orchestration, or fleet telemetry.Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, Terraform, Kubernetes/containers, service orchestration, and large-scale observability.Experience partnering with security, compliance, or privacy teams in high-assurance environments.Experience supporting research, developer, robotics, hardware-lab, or other specialized computing environments.A record of contributing to open-source tooling, engineering communities, or cross-company technical standards.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.description:
Job DescriptionJob DescriptionHadrian - Manufacturing the Future

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

The Role:

What You’ll Do

Focus on building scalable, automated solutions that ensure seamless deployments, security configurations, and efficient operational workflows for our end-users.

Own, administer, and optimize MDM platforms (Fleet DM, Intune, Workspace ONE) to enforce configuration and drive self-healing by writing OS-level scripts and lightweight tools that resolve recurring user-impacting issues (disk pressure, certificate expiry, drift, broken agents) at the source instead of via tickets.

Proactive Response. We want to gather telemetry data and analytics to develop an understanding of device lifecycles. We want to prevent end-user disruption by understanding when and how to act.

Partner with Security, IT, and Infrastructure to translate compliance requirements (CMMC) into enforceable, code-managed baselines.

Build dashboards and alerts that measure end-user experience as an SLO, not a helpdesk metric.

What We’re Looking For

Ownership. You treat the fleet as a product, take incidents personally, and close the loop with automation rather than a runbook. Strong scripting in Python, Bash, and PowerShell.

Scalability. Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management: Ansible and Terraform (or equivalents like Chef, Salt, Puppet, Pulumi).

Device Management. Working knowledge of at least one major MDM (Fleet DM, Intune, Jamf, Workspace ONE) and its API surface.

Security Remediation. Practical experience with patch management, vulnerability remediation, and endpoint hardening on both macOS and Windows.

What Will Set You Apart

Strong computer science fundamentals. You can reason about systems from the operating system up, demonstrating durable and sustainable solutions.

Experience building self-healing or auto-remediation platforms (remote actions, osquery + response, custom agents). Exposure to OT (Operational Technology) systems.

Comfort operating in an SRE culture: SLOs, error budgets, and blameless postmortems applied to the end-user experience.

Compensation

For this role, the target salary range is $164,000 - $270,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees

401k

Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need.

Flexible vacation policy

Equity

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. , lawful permanent of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Use of AI in hiring

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. ¿Te interesa desarrollar tu carrera trabajando en proyectos del sector aeronáutico?

En ALTEN tenemos claro que el éxito de nuestros proyectos se debe a las personas que forman nuestro equipo. Por eso, nos comprometemos a impulsar tu talento, satisfacer tus expectativas laborales y hacerte sentir como en casa. ¿Quieres construir hoy el mundo de mañana? ¡Sigue leyendo!

* Dar soporte puntual en actividades relacionadas con CATIA, incluyendo la resolución de incidencias y el diseño de útiles para acciones formativas.
* Coordinarse con usuarios y equipos de las diferentes plantas de Airbus, actuando como punto de contacto para consultas, soporte y despliegue de mejoras dentro del ecosistema MDM-R.
* Uso de Windchill para la gestión documental, control de cambios y trazabilidad de la información técnica.
* Interlocución y comunicación transversal con equipos multidisciplinares para coordinar actividades, gestionar incidencias y asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos del proyecto.

* Formación en Ingeniería Aeronáutica, Industrial, Mecánica o similar.

* Integración en un equipo de profesionales altamente cualificado, con un buen clima laboral, innovador y dinámico.
* Formación especializada y desarrollo profesional continuo.

***¿Quiénes somos?***

Somos un equipo. Formamos parte de ALTEN, una multinacional europea especializada en proporcionar servicios de consultoría, tecnología de la información y servicios de ingeniería a las principales compañías del mercado español.

Además, en ALTEN nos enorgullecemos de ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades con independencia de género, edad, diversidad de capacidades o país de origen. Nuestro compromiso está con el talento y con las personas que lo tienen.

jobs.description:
#### Company Description

Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,300 customersto provide better digital experiences to more than 18 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.

#Li-Hybrid

#### Job Description

We are seeking a curious and versatile Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with a strong track record of deploying, integrating, and troubleshooting complex virtualization and cloud environments. As part of our VDI Lab team, you will be responsible for building and evolving the environments that our product teams rely on — standing up new VDI platforms, thin client operating systems, and cloud desktop services, and researching how to integrate emerging technologies into our infrastructure.

Because the position is highly cross-functional, the ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a clear and pragmatic way is essential. You will work side by side with product and engineering teams, and your work will become the foundation on which our endpoint capabilities are built and validated across virtualization and cloud desktop platforms.

**Responsibilities**

- Build and evolve the virtualization environments our endpoint products run on, across the major VDI and cloud desktop platforms.
- Automate it end to end: infrastructure as code, provisioning and image pipelines, so any engineer can get a working desktop on demand.
- Keep it running across public cloud and on-prem — networking, identity, and monitoring.
- Evaluate and integrate emerging endpoint technologies, from proof of concept to supported platform.
- Work with product managers, engineering teams, and technology partners to unlock and validate new platform coverage.
- Be the person other teams come to when they need to understand how a virtualization platform behaves.

#### Qualifications

**Must have**

- BSc/BEng or master's in computer science, or equivalent experience
- 5+ years of professional cloud infrastructure experience
- Deep hands-on experience with at least one major VDI/EUC platform — Citrix CVAD, Omnissa Horizon, Microsoft AVD / Windows 365, or Amazon WorkSpaces — and willingness to learn the others
- Strong Windows Server and hybrid identity foundations (Active Directory, Entra ID)
- A bias toward automation — Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, or whatever you've used to stop clicking through the same setup twice
- English proficiency.

**Where you've built depth** — we don't expect all of these; tell us which are yours

- Additional VDI platforms, brokers, or gateways (NetScaler/ADC, UAG)
- Hypervisor administration (vSphere/ESXi, Nutanix) and golden image lifecycle — build, optimization, patching, FSLogix
- Networking for virtual desktops — VLANs, firewalling, TLS, site-to-site VPN to AWS or Azure
- Cloud infrastructure on Azure or AWS, and CI/CD or image pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Packer)
- Secure administration — RBAC, PIM, secrets management, vulnerability management
- Thin client and endpoint management — IGEL UMS, Dell Wyse Management Suite, Intune
- Synthetic testing / benchmarking — Login Enterprise (Login VSI) or similar

**How you work**

- You can explain a platform constraint to a product manager and a design trade-off to an engineer on the same day
- You're drawn to unfamiliar technology rather than wary of it — this role puts something new in front of you every quarter

#### Additional Information

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

IIf you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! **Check what we offer:**

- Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
- 📍 Amazing centrally located offices near the Bernabeu Stadium.
- 🩺 Private Health Insurance (Sanitas) and daily meal vouchers of 11 EUR will be entirely covered by us.
- 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work, with a structured approach for new hires to foster connections and onboarding.
- 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 23 days of holidays we offer) plus 3 company-paid volunteer days.
- 🤸 Up to 25 EUR per month for a gym subscription.
- 🛴 Flexible compensation plan for childcare & public transportation.
- 🧑‍🏫 Reimbursement of up to 50% of the cost of English & Spanish classes.
- 🍉 Fresh fruit, cookies, soft drinks and protein shakes at the offie.
- 🍕 Regular company and team events like Pizza talks, Team Building activities, Christmas parties, hosting Meetups at the office and more!
- 📣 Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.
- 🚚 We offer a relocation package to people who are coming from another country.

Please note that not all the benefits listed above are available for temporary, contract, and internship roles. To ensure you have the most up-to-date information, we recommend checking with your Recruitment Partner.

_The base salary for this role is €42,000 – €70,000 gross per year, with a total on-target earnings (OTE) range of €46,000 – €77,000 including an annual performance bonus. You'll also be part of our broader total rewards package — including benefits tailored to where you live and how you work best._

_We set our pay ranges using objective criteria: the scope and level of the role, the skills it takes to do it well, and the relevant market data. Ranges are reviewed every year to remain competitive and fair. We're transparent about this because we think you deserve to know what you're working towards from day one. In accordance with the EU Pay Transparency Directive (2023/970), we publish salary ranges on every Nexthink role. We won't ask what you currently earn or your previous salary. What matters to us is what this role is worth and whether it works for you. Nexthinkers come from all kinds of backgrounds, and that's what makes us stronger. We welcome applications from everyone._

Description

The client is seeking a highly experienced Microsoft Intune Consultant / Endpoint Modernization Engineer to partner with their Endpoint Engineering team on a critical modernization initiative. The organization currently operates in a co-managed SCCM and Intune environment and is looking to accelerate its transition toward a modern cloud-managed endpoint strategy. The consultant will work closely with the Desktop Manager and Senior Endpoint Engineer to assess, rationalize, and migrate approximately 160+ Group Policies into Intune while establishing a roadmap for future-state endpoint management.

The primary focus of the engagement will be evaluating existing GPOs, determining which policies should be migrated, modified, and implementing Intune Configuration Profiles aligned with best practices. This resource will provide both hands-on engineering support and strategic guidance around endpoint modernization, helping the client overcome bandwidth constraints and make meaningful progress toward its Intune adoption goals.

Skills

Microsoft, intune, group policy objects, sccm, Endpoint, powershell, azure ad, application package, Active directory, O365, Windows server, Support, System administrator

Top Skills' Details

• Expert-level experience designing, implementing, and managing Microsoft Intune in enterprise environments.

• Will be responsible for evaluating the client's current Intune configuration, building and optimizing configuration profiles, managing device policies, and helping drive the transition from SCCM to a more modern cloud-managed endpoint environment.

• Success requires hands-on experience with multiple Intune migration or modernization projects and the ability to provide best-practice recommendations.

2. Group Policy (GPO) Analysis & Migration (5+ years required)

• Deep understanding of Active Directory Group Policies and experience translating GPOs into Intune Configuration Profiles and cloud-based policy management.

• Success requires strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to rationalize legacy policies rather than simply recreating them in Intune.

3. SCCM / Microsoft Configuration Manager (5+ years required)

• Will assess the current SCCM footprint, identify dependencies, and advise on the modernization strategy while minimizing operational disruption.

4. Endpoint Modernization / Windows Device Management (5+ years required)

• Experience supporting Windows 10/11 device management, compliance policies, configuration profiles, application deployment, and modern workplace initiatives.

• Will help establish the roadmap for future-state device provisioning and endpoint management, including Autopilot readiness and cloud provisioning strategies.

5. Consulting & Stakeholder Communication (3+ years required)

• Proven ability to partner with technical teams, provide strategic guidance, and influence decisions through expertise and best practices.

Experience utilizing Intune Group Policy Analytics to assess, analyze, and map existing GPOs into Intune policies.

Experience working in co-managed SCCM and Intune environments and supporting organizations through endpoint management modernization efforts.

Ability to evaluate legacy Group Policies and determine which settings should be migrated, modified.

Experience collaborating with infrastructure, endpoint, and security teams to overcome technical and policy-related roadblocks.

Strong understanding of Windows endpoint management, device configuration, and policy deployment.

Ability to provide strategic recommendations and best practices based on prior Intune migration and modernization engagements.

jobs.description:
Our client, a multinational cruise line, is looking for a SCCM Engineer to take ownership of enterprise endpoint engineering and security. This is a high-impact role where you will directly shape how thousands of devices are deployed, secured, and maintained across a global fleet.

Why This Role Matters:

You will be the engineering force behind mission-critical systems: Operating System Deployment (OSD), automated patching, and third-party application management. Your work keeps a global fleet secure, compliant, and running smoothly, and your decisions will have visible, measurable impact across the organization.

What You Will Do:

Deployment Engineering (OSD):
- Architect and govern zero-touch OSD task sequences
- Manage boot images and driver packages across a diverse hardware fleet

Automated Patching (ADRs):
- Design and maintain Automatic Deployment Rules in SCCM/MECM
- Drive consistent, phased rollouts of Windows updates and security patches

Third-Party Patch Management:
- Automate deployment of third-party app updates (Chrome, Adobe, etc.)
- Build closed-loop remediation processes using enterprise patching tools

Security Analysis and Reporting:
- Analyze vulnerability reports and compliance data
- Spot trends in endpoint health and turn insights into action plans

Modern Management Integration:
- Support the shift to Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot
- Ensure stable co-management as the environment modernizes

Vulnerability Remediation:
- Translate security scan findings into PowerShell remediation scripts
- Deploy configuration changes that close security gaps fast

Endpoint Health and Automation:
- Use PowerShell and WQL to automate collection management
- Build custom reports that track deployment success and compliance

Why You Will Want This Job:

- Own high-visibility systems that protect a global enterprise
- Grow your skills in modern endpoint management (Intune, Autopilot, co-management)
- Work at the intersection of security and IT operations, a career path in high demand
- Make a measurable impact on fleet-wide security posture and performance

If you would like to learn more, please reach out to Elite Technical.

Required Skills

Technical Skills Required:

- Proven expertise in building and managing SCCM/MECM OSD task sequences and boot images.
- Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting Automatic Deployment Rules (ADRs).
- Strong background in third-party application patching and packaging.
- Proficiency in PowerShell for automation and remediating security findings.
- Ability to analyze enterprise security reports and translate them into technical tasks.
- Familiarity with Intune and Autopilot in a co-managed environment.
- Certifications: Relevant industry certifications (e.g., MD-102: Endpoint Administrator, or security-focused certifications) are preferred.

Soft Skills:
- Analytical Mindset: Ability to look at a security report and methodically plan a remediation strategy.
- Strategic Thinking: Focus on long-term automation rather than one-off manual fixes.
- Communication: Clear ability to report on security status and technical progress to both technical teams and management.

jobs.description:
Nuestro cliente, compañía líder en España en el sector asegurador, necesita incorporar un Jefe de Proyecto con experiencia en **Informática MDM SaaS** para dar soporte al proyecto de migración de la versión on-premise a la versión SaaS. Se trata de un perfil senior, con conocimiento técnico de la herramienta, capaz de participar de forma autónoma en el proyecto y asegurar la calidad de la implantación.

Para reforzar el equipo del proyecto de implantación de Informática MDM SaaS, como solución de gestión de datos maestros, se necesita un perfil con experiencia contrastada en la plataforma que pueda incorporarse con autonomía, aportando criterio técnico y capacidad de seguimiento sin necesidad de supervisión continua.

La principal misión del puesto será acompañar al equipo durante las fases clave de la implantación, asegurando la calidad de la documentación técnica, validando los desarrollos realizados por el proveedor y colaborando en la preparación de la salida a producción.

El profesional trabajará de manera coordinada con las áreas de Tecnología, Arquitectura, Infraestructura y Operaciones, así como con el proveedor encargado de la implantación, garantizando el cumplimiento de los hitos del proyecto y facilitando la continuidad del servicio durante la ausencia temporal del responsable actual.

La duración inicial de la colaboración es de **3 meses (de octubre a diciembre) en formato interim**, aunque existe la posibilidad de una incorporación previa para poder realizar un adecuado traspaso de conocimiento.

Es una posición fija en Madrid, con **dedicación Full-time y en formato híbrido**(3 días presencial, 2 en remoto).

**En este contexto, sus funciones principales incluyen:**

• Validación de la documentación técnica del proyecto (diseño técnico, manuales de operación y documentación asociada), garantizando que cumple los estándares de calidad y el nivel de detalle requerido

• Realización y coordinación de pruebas funcionales para validar el correcto funcionamiento de la solución implantada

• Soporte durante la implantación en Producción, coordinándose con los equipos de Infraestructura y Operaciones (IO), Arquitectura y el resto de las áreas técnicas implicadas

• Seguimiento de la planificación y de los principales hitos del proyecto, identificando riesgos y asegurando el cumplimiento de los plazos establecidos

• Revisión técnica de los desarrollos realizados por el proveedor, verificando que se ajustan a las buenas prácticas y mantienen un nivel adecuado de calidad, sin necesidad de realizar una auditoría formal

• Colaboración con los distintos equipos implicados para asegurar una implantación estable y una correcta transición al modelo operativo

**Capacidades imprescindibles:**

• Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas de Información o similar

• Experiencia demostrable en proyectos de implantación de MDM SaaS y conocimiento técnico de la plataforma de Informática

• Experiencia en validación de documentación técnica y revisión de desarrollos

• Experiencia en ejecución de pruebas funcionales y soporte a despliegues en producción

• Capacidad de interlocución con equipos técnicos y proveedores

• Capacidad analítica, orientación a la calidad y seguimiento de proyectos

**Capacidades valorables:**

• Experiencia previa en proyectos similares dentro del sector asegurador o financiero

• Conocimiento de metodologías de gestión de proyectos

jobs.title: IT Automation Engineer - Business Technology (Central/Mountain Time - US)
jobs.summary: Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. Rithum ™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers,...
jobs.description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences.

Rithum ™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As an Automation Engineer, you design, build, and maintain the scripts, workflows, and tools that let Rithum ’s Business Technology team spend less time on manual, repetitive IT work and more time solving problems that matter. You also administer and support the end-user, identity, and collaboration platforms Rithum runs on, so the automation you build is grounded in hands-on ownership of those systems. You partner closely with the Service Desk, Infrastructure Engineering, and Information Security teams to identify where automation can reduce risk and free up capacity, and you are accountable for the reliability of the automation you build.

All team members are expected to leverage AI to work smarter, accelerate decision-making, automate repeatable work, and improve outcomes. You are encouraged to continuously identify opportunities to apply AI, data, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, drive innovation, and deliver greater value for our clients, partners, and teams while maintaining appropriate judgment, quality, security, confidentiality, and compliance.

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Engineering

- Design, build, and maintain automation scripts and workflows (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash) that streamline IT service delivery, endpoint provisioning, and systems administration tasks.

- Design, build, and own automated workflows across user lifecycle, device provisioning, and identity lifecycle using Rithum 's existing platforms (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Jamf) and API and webhook integrations.

- Instrument automations with logging and alerting so every action is auditable and measurable, tracking hours saved and errors reduced rather than only whether a workflow ran.

- Translate manual, repetitive IT operations processes into reliable, documented, automated solutions, adapting existing scripts and tools to address new and evolving business needs.

- Use AI tools to accelerate script development, troubleshoot automation failures, and draft technical documentation, verifying outputs before they are applied to production systems.

Enterprise Systems Administration & Support

- Administer, configure, and monitor end-user and identity platforms such as Active Directory, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Jamf, and Tanium, escalating architectural decisions on complex integrations to senior IT Operations teammates.

- Administer and support collaboration and productivity platforms such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams.

- Resolve end-user computing issues across Windows and macOS through the ticketing queue, direct messaging, and voice or video sessions, owning requests end-to-end and escalating critical incidents and system alerts to senior IT Operations.

- Document technical solutions so they are accurate, secure, and aligned with corporate IT and Information Security standards and policies.

- Partner with the Service Desk, Infrastructure Engineering, and Information Security teams to identify recurring manual tasks that are strong candidates for automation.

- Collaborate with partner teams to test, deploy, and monitor automation workflows, tailoring communication to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Provide occasional guidance to Service Desk teammates on scripting fundamentals and automation best practices as your experience grows.

Process Documentation & Continuous Improvement

- Document automation workflows, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides so that solutions remain supportable and repeatable across the IT organization.

- Own the automation knowledge base, keeping runbooks and integration notes current so what you build is repeatable and supportable by others rather than dependent on you.

- Apply lessons learned from prior automation efforts to improve reliability, reduce inefficiencies, and anticipate dependencies in future builds.

- Monitor the performance and reliability of deployed automations, escalating and resolving issues within your area of ownership.

AI-Enabled Productivity & Innovation

- Use AIas your starting point for recurring IT work — configuration research, scripting, troubleshooting, documentation, and solution design — so your output is clearer and needs less rework.

- Validate AI-generated scripts, configurations, and recommendations in non-production environments before applying them, following Rithum 's responsible AI use and data security standards.

- Share effective AI-assisted approaches and prompts with teammates when they meaningfully improve automation quality or speed.

- Continuously identify opportunities where automation and AI can be applied to Business Technology workflows, escalating larger opportunities to your manager.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

- 2+ years of experience in IT systems administration, service desk operations, or a related technical role, including hands-on experience writing and maintaining automation scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar).

- Hands-on experience administering or supporting enterprise identity, collaboration, and productivity platforms such as Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams.

- Demonstrated experience adapting or troubleshooting existing automation, scripts, or workflows to resolve moderately complex, ambiguous technical issues.

- Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude) to improve productivity through research, communication, analysis, documentation, automation, workflow optimization, and decision-making.

- Demonstrated hands-on use of AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to build, ship, or automate a working solution, evidenced by a portfolio, repository, or project example.

- Located in the United States Central or Mountain time zone, with working hours aligned to that time zone.

- Handle escalations requiring cross-team coordination. Participate in an on-call rotation for urgent issues outside business hours.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Must be available for occasional travel to Rithum offices - anticipated quarterly.

- Successful professional experience working in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in IT automation, systems engineering, or a DevOps-adjacent role.

- Certifications such as CompTIA Server+, CompTIA Linux+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, or equivalent scripting/automation certifications.

- Experience integrating automation with IT service management or endpoint management tooling (e.g., ServiceNow, Microsoft Intune, Jira).

- Experience with workflow orchestration or automation tooling (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato).

- Familiarity with REST API integration patterns and event-driven concepts such as webhooks, triggers, and conditional logic.

- Exposure to endpoint management and protection platforms (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Jamf, Tanium, CrowdStrike).

- Personal projects, repositories, or hackathon work demonstrating scripting or automation ability.

What it’s like to work at Rithum

When you join Rithum , you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

At Rithum you will:

- Partner with the leading brands and retailers.

- Connect with passionate professionals who will help support your goals.

- Participate in an inclusive, welcoming work atmosphere.

- Achieve work-life balance through remote-first working conditions, generous time off, and wellness days.

- Receive industry-competitive compensation and total rewards benefits.

We believe in transparency and fairness in our compensation practices.

For this position, the expected base pay range is: $75,000-$115,000 per year.

This range represents the base pay for the role across all U.S. locations and is determined based on market data, internal equity, and experience. Final compensation may vary depending on geographic location, skills, and relevant experience. jobs.description:
Iovance Biotherapeutics aims to be the global leader in innovating, developing and delivering tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapy for people with cancer.

Iovance Biotherapeutics aims to be the global leader in innovating, developing and delivering tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapy for people with cancer. We are pioneering a transformational approach to treating cancer by harnessing the ability of the human immune system to recognize and attack diverse cancer cells in each patient. The Iovance TIL platform has demonstrated promising clinical data across multiple solid tumors. We are committed to continuous innovation in cell therapy, including gene-edited cell therapy, which may be a promising option for patients with cancer.

Overview

The Lead Endpoint Engineering Architect will own the architecture and build-out of Iovance’s endpoint management platform, covering roughly 1,000 Windows devices across corporate, lab, and field locations. This role exists to design a modern, reliable endpoint platform on Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, and Entra ID, build it, document it, and hand off day-to-day operations to the existing support team with clear runbooks. This is a hands-on technical role, not a management role. The Lead Endpoint Engineering Architect will partner with IT Security, Quality Assurance, and business stakeholders across the company, but the core of the job is engineering work: designing configurations, packaging applications, writing PowerShell, testing deployments, and solving problems.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

- Own the design and implementation of our Intune and Autopilot environment end-to-end: enrollment profiles, configuration profile architecture, compliance policies, Conditional Access, and update ring strategy.

- Build Autopilot provisioning workflows that let us ship a factory-sealed laptop to any employee and have it arrive fully configured without a technician touching it. This includes selecting the right deployment modes for different device scenarios and troubleshooting the enrollment edge cases that inevitably come up.

- Create a layered configuration profile structure in Intune: security baselines that apply to everything, role-specific profiles for different groups, and exception policies where needed.

- Set up Windows Update for Business with proper ring management so updates deploy in controlled phases.

- Design and own application deployment approach using Intune’s Win32 packaging model. This means proper dependency chains, detection rules that actually verify successful installs, and a consistent test-before-deploy process. Application packaging is a significant part of this role, especially during the initial platform build-out.

- Build Proactive Remediations that detect and auto-fix common problems like dropped network drives, configuration drift, and application health issues before users have to call the help desk.

- Establish and maintain laptop performance baselines and remediation workflows — including startup time optimization, memory and CPU utilization profiling, background service rationalization, and bloatware removal — using Intune Proactive Remediations (detection + remediation script pairs), Endpoint Analytics scores, and Windows performance counters to identify degradation patterns before they generate tickets, and to enforce consistent performance standards across both hardware models.

- Work with IT Security to implement compliance policies and Conditional Access rules that give us continuous, auditable proof that our endpoints meet our security baseline.

- Write and maintain the documentation that makes this platform operable by others on the team: architecture diagrams, runbooks, application packaging standards, and troubleshooting guides.

- Train and mentor our deskside and help desk staff on Intune operations, including how to look up a device, check compliance, verify app assignments, trigger syncs, and know when to escalate.

- Evaluate endpoint management tools and technologies as needed, particularly OEM driver management solutions for our hardware fleet.

- Design, build, and maintain SharePoint Online sites, libraries, and lists that support departmental workflows. Configure site permissions, access controls, and governance policies aligned with Iovance's security and compliance requirements. Manage site lifecycle including provisioning, decommissioning, and archival. Troubleshoot site performance, broken permissions, and content issues. Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into functional SharePoint solutions

- Develop and maintain Power Automate flows to automate business processes such as approvals, notifications, document routing, and data collection. Integrate Power Automate with SharePoint, Microsoft Forms and other M365 services. Monitor flow run history, troubleshoot failures, and optimize performance. Maintain documentation of all automated workflows including flow diagrams, trigger conditions, and error-handling logic

- Create and manage Microsoft Forms for internal data collection, surveys, and intake processes. Connect Forms to SharePoint lists and Power Automate flows for end-to-end process automation. Ensure form designs meet accessibility and usability standards

- Must adhere to Iovance Biotherapeutics ’ core values, policies, procedures, and business ethics.

- Perform miscellaneous duties as assigned.

Required Education, Skills, and Knowledge

- 8+ years in enterprise IT, with at least 4–5 of those years spent deep in Intune, Autopilot, Entra ID, Conditional Access, and Windows Update for Business.

- Experience architecting and operating an Intune environment managing 1,000+ devices. Understanding of profile layering, group targeting, policy conflicts, and the operational realities of managing a fleet this size, not just the theory.

- Strong PowerShell skills at a production-automation level. Experience writing scripts that run unattended across hundreds of devices, handle errors gracefully, and are maintainable by others. Proactive Remediations, device config scripts, and reporting.

- Real experience packaging Win32 applications for Intune: silent installs, detection rules, dependency chains, supersedence.

- Solid understanding of Entra ID dynamic groups, Conditional Access policy design, and how the identity, device management, and security layers interact in a Microsoft 365 environment.

- Experience managing drivers across a mixed hardware fleet using OEM tools (Dell Command Update, Lenovo System Update, HP Client Management) or Windows Update for Business driver management.

- Experience working in a regulated industry such as pharma, biotech, medical device, or financial services, where change control and documentation aren’t optional.

- Experience working across IT, security, quality, and business teams.

- Experience documenting and writing runbooks for others to follow.

Preferred Education, Skills, and Knowledge

- Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) or equivalent.

- Experience migrating from SCCM/MECM to Intune, including co-management and hybrid identity scenarios.

- Familiarity with how endpoint changes map to validation and qualification requirements in regulated environments.

- Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 E3/E5 licensing and what security, compliance, and device management capabilities come with each tier.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

Physical Demands and Activities Required

The physical demands described here represent those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable individuals to perform these functions.

- Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods

- Ability to move about within an office or remote workspace and exert up to 10 pounds of force occasionally

- Visual acuity sufficient for preparing and analyzing data, viewing computer screens, and extensive reading

- Repetitive motion involving wrists, hands, and/or fingers

- Ability to communicate effectively to exchange information

- Ability to engage in analytical, conceptual, and problem‑solving activities in a dynamic business environment

Mental: Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgment, troubleshooting, problem-solving, analysis, and discretion; ability to handle work-related stress; ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously with a sense of urgency; and ability to meet deadlines

Work Environment

This job operates in a professional or remote office environment and requires operating standard office equipment and keyboards.

#li-remote

The annual base salary we reasonably expect to pay is listed. Individual pay decisions depend on various factors, such as primary work location, complexity and responsibility of the role, job duties/requirements, and relevant education, experience and skills.

Pay Transparency

$195,000—$210,000 USD

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

IT SECURITY ENGINEER - TOP SECRET CLEARANCE

SpaceX is looking for an IT Security Engineer with deep knowledge and broad experience across enterprise security technologies, in addition to broader experience with identity, endpoint protection, SIEM, and vulnerability management. This employee will be a member of the Information Technology team and will support SpaceX personnel and systems on classified networks. The ideal candidate will be flexible and flourish in a fast-paced and challenging environment. They should be a self-starter, self-motivator, and possess the ingenuity to excel at this position.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Work closely with o ther SpaceX IT administrators and engineers to gather requirements, research, evaluate, design, plan, deploy, and support security solutions and related technologies in a world-class environment that meets the needs of the demanding SpaceX engineering teams. Build highly resilient, high-performance, scalable, and flexible systems.

- Take lessons learned and technology standards from the SpaceX Enterprise and apply them in smaller classified environments.

- Exercise a high degree of responsibility for the processes, systems, and tools you create and manage; all supporting the goal of making humanity an interplanetary species.

- Design, deploy, and operate security controls for classified corporate-style IT networks, including authentication and identity services (hardware tokens, certificate-based authentication, privileged access), on-premises SIEM for logging and detection, endpoint/host protection, and vulnerability management.

- Harden and secure traditional IT services used by engineering staff (email, file servers/shares, directory services, collaboration tools, and internal applications); review and improve permissions, group membership, and access models to reduce standing privilege.

- Partner with systems, network, and application owners to securely design, deploy, and operate applications (authentication/authorization, logging, patching, least privilege).

- Lead or support detection, triage, and incident response for the classified IT environment.

- Make recommendations, justify, and implement improvements using an accepted change control methodology .

- Work within a diverse group to design and deliver creative solutions and resolve problems in a timely and proactive manner by interacting with internal business units.

- Define, document, and follow standards and best practices for systems design, testing, and implementation.

- Drive scripting and automation to develop solutions to common problems and repeatable security tasks (baselines, evidence collection, health checks).

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, or another STEM discipline; OR 4+ years of professional experience in enterprise IT security engineering in lieu of a degree.

- 3+ years of hands-on experience securing traditional IT environments (identity/MFA, endpoint security, SIEM, vulnerability scanning, email or file services).

- Experience administering or operating at least two of the following: on-premises SIEM, enterprise EDR/AV, enterprise vulnerability management platform.

- Active Top Secret / SCI (TS/SCI) clearance.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- Experience securing IT for engineering or corporate users in classified or restricted networks.

- Strong practical experience with hardware-token / FIDO2 / smart-card MFA and directory-integrated identity.

- SIEM administration or detection engineering experience (on-premises).

- Enterprise EDR/AV policy and operations experience.

- Enterprise vulnerability management and remediation workflows.

- Hardening Windows and Linux servers; securing file shares, email gateways, and internal applications.

- Permissions/access reviews, least privilege, and privilege-escalation reduction.

- SOC or blue-team incident response experience on enterprise IT estates.

- Scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash, Ansible) for security operations.

- Familiarity with NIST 800-53 control families as implemented by IT security engineering.

- Excellent communication skills with IT systems engineers and engineering end users.

- Ability to work independently in a closed environment and deliver durable security operations.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $130,000.00 - $160,000.00
Level 2: $150,000.00 - $195,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here .

jobs.description:
Computer World Services Corp (CWS) is seeking a detail-oriented and results-driven Desktop Engineer – Windows responsible for engineering, configuring, securing, and maintaining Windows-based environments in an enterprise federal IT setting.

A primary focus of this position is the identification and remediation of security vulnerabilities through Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), NinjaOne, PowerShell, and other enterprise management technologies. The Desktop Engineer develops, tests, deploys, and maintains SCCM application and remediation packages designed to correct software vulnerabilities, configuration deficiencies, outdated applications, and other security exposures.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

Windows Vulnerability Remediation

Analyze Windows vulnerability findings and determine appropriate technical remediation strategies.
Develop and implement remediation solutions for vulnerabilities affecting Windows operating systems, third-party applications, drivers, utilities, and configurations.
Translate vulnerability findings, CVEs, security advisories, and remediation requirements into deployable technical solutions.
Support remediation activities associated with applicable CISA Binding Operational Directives, including BOD 26-04, and other federal cybersecurity requirements.
Coordinate with cybersecurity and vulnerability management teams to validate vulnerability findings and determine appropriate remediation actions.

Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain SCCM/MECM application packages, programs, task sequences, scripts, and remediation packages.
Monitor SCCM deployment status and produce reports identifying successful, failed, pending, and non-compliant devices.
Support the use and evaluation of NinjaOne as an enterprise endpoint management,

Troubleshoot operating system, application, hardware, driver, security, and performance problems.
Perform root cause analysis and develop sustainable solutions for recurring issues.

Test scripts to ensure they operate safely across supported Windows configurations.
Maintain reusable PowerShell libraries and documented automation procedures.

Monitoring & Reporting

Support development of dashboards and metrics showing vulnerability remediation progress.
Assist management and cybersecurity teams in measuring remediation performance against established service levels and federal requirements.

Application Packaging & Software Lifecycle Management

Package enterprise applications for automated deployment.
Test application compatibility with supported Windows configurations.
Maintain current versions of enterprise applications and identify obsolete or unsupported software.
Develop upgrade and migration packages to replace vulnerable or end-of-life applications.
Develop automated removal packages for prohibited, unsupported, or vulnerable applications.
Coordinate application testing with application owners and technical stakeholders before enterprise deployment.
Maintain documentation covering packaging standards, installation procedures, dependencies, rollback procedures, and known issues.

User Support & System Access

Provide Tier 3 technical support for complex Windows issues.
Support Active Directory, Group Policy, configuration, and user environment troubleshooting.
Resolve issues resulting from application deployments, security remediation, operating system updates, and configuration changes.
Coordinate with Tier 1 and Tier 2 support teams to resolve incidents and recurring problems.
Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to desktop support personnel.

Required Skills & Competencies

Strong knowledge of Microsoft Windows desktop operating systems.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft SCCM/MECM, particularly application packaging and software deployment.
Experience creating and troubleshooting SCCM applications, packages, deployment collections, detection methods, and task sequences.
Experience developing PowerShell automation and remediation scripts.
Understanding of Windows vulnerability remediation and patch management.
Ability to interpret vulnerability findings and translate them into technical remediation actions.
Understanding of CVEs, security advisories, vulnerability severity, and remediation concepts.
Knowledge of Active Directory and Group Policy.

Education & Experience

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline

Experience

5+ years of experience in desktop engineering, Windows system administration, management, or enterprise IT support.
Demonstrated experience supporting Windows operating systems in enterprise client/server environments.
Demonstrated experience with SCCM/MECM application packaging, deployment, or administration.
Advanced PowerShell scripting experience.
NinjaOne administration or engineering experience.
Experience working in federal government IT environments.

Certifications

Desired: Microsoft Endpoint, Windows, Azure, or related technical certifications.
Desired: ITIL Foundation certification.

Security Clearance

Applicants must be able to obtain a Public Trust clearance
