jobs.description:
GAQ125R25

As Head of Corporate Engineering, you will be responsible for Enterprise engineering and operations globally. You will be responsible for building and managing a highly technical enterprise engineering team, developing first principled-based strategies, and enabling strong enterprise security. Key responsibilities include engineering, securing and optimizing cloud infrastructure, Identity and Access Management, Endpoints, Collaboration tools, and ensuring compliance with SOX, PCI DSS, and FedRAMP compliance. The Head of Corporate Engineering will work closely with R&D on managing engineering tools like Jira, Confluence, and GitHub, driving efficient adoption and integration. Strong technical and influencing leadership principles coupled with the ability to manage a complex, scaling, and fast-moving enterprise environment are essential.

This role reports directly to the Vice President, Infrastructure and Operations

Responsibilities:

In this influential role, you will be responsible for:

- Securing the Enterprise: Working closely with Enterprise Security organization to harden and secure our cloud environments, secret management, collaboration tools, endpoints, SaaS environments, IAM tools, and more. Success measured in continuous improvement of our enterprise security hardening standards

- Building and Scaling our Cloud Infrastructure : Your team will be responsible for establishing and implementing enterprise cloud infrastructure including establishing Infrastructure Provisioning, SRE services, 24/7 on-call support, Infra as Code, observability, and more. In addition, you will be responsible for managing cloud budgets, vendor management, and establishing cost optimization initiatives. Success is measured in increased developer velocity while securing & scaling the cloud infrastructure

- Engineering Tooling : Partner closely with R&D teams to establish policies, configurations, run-books, SLAs, hardening, scalability and availability of engineering tools like Github, Jira, Atlassian, and more

- Endpoint Engineering : Enable extreme automation for endpoint management with zero-touch deployment, observability (synthetic and real-time), provisioning/de-provisioning, and establishing standards / SLAs. Enforce security policies, configure & manage security settings and ensure compliance across all endpoints and mobile devices. Success is measured in terms of end-user satisfaction and % of manual touch.

- Collaboration Management : Ensure we provide world class tools to our employees to be extremely productive and collaborative. This would include but not be limited to managing and scaling internal workplace products like Gmail, Slack, Atlassian, Moveworks, Glean, and more. Success is measured by user satisfaction

- Identity & Access Management : Manage the IAM team from IAM implementation, access standards enforcement, SLA management, and compliance to various standards like FedRamp, IL5, PCI, and more. Included are both internal and external identity providers to be managed. Success is measured by compliance, Identity governance, and availability

Desired Success Outcomes

- A high-performing enterprise engineering team capable of handling complex technical projects with agility and high quality.

- Well defined cloud strategy ensuring the stability, scalability, and security of cloud infrastructure. Overhaul of current processes and workflows to address inefficiencies and increase team velocity.

- Robust endpoint security with Implementation of comprehensive security measures for all endpoints, including Mac, Windows, and mobile devices.

- Deliver high-quality employee experience with productivity tools (Gmail, Slack, Atlassian tools, Moveworks, GitHub) with a robust forward-looking roadmap.

- Efficient operational support for Tier 3 IT services with minimized production incidents. Implementation of robust incident and change management processes with mature operational practice

- Efficient and mature processes for system integrations related to Mergers and Acquisitions (M&As), ensuring timely smooth transitions during M&A integrations.

- Development and implementation of automation tools and frameworks, Identification of automation opportunities to reduce manual toil and improve accuracy.

Qualifications:

- 10 years of experience managing Cloud infrastructure at large enterprises. Extensive experience managing public cloud implementations in AWS. Experience with GCP and Azure will be a plus.

- In-depth understanding of Cloud native technologies to lead and guide the team. Must have hands-on experience in troubleshooting and debugging issues in production environments

- Working experience in managing DevOps/SRE practices OKRs (Objective and Key Results), Agile development, Infra-as-code, SRE (Site Reliability Engineering), DevOps measurement such as DORA KPIs,

- In-depth understanding of each collaboration tool's features, functionalities, and configurations (e.g., Gmail for email, Slack for messaging). Ability to identify and integrate and optimize the use of various tools for seamless collaboration (e.g., connecting Jira with GitHub for Dev metrics).

- Experience leading a team of senior professionals working asynchronously in a remote, distributed team. Strong communication skills, with clear verbal communication and written communication skills.

- Collaborative style: partners well with cross-functional teams to solve hard problems and to complete complex deliverables with quality and business outcomes.

- Provide mentorship and guidance to team members to ensure that their skills and knowledge are kept up-to-date

**Company Description** Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. **Job Description** We are looking for a**Specialist IT Endpoint Management** profile to join our IT team. The position provides advanced technical support to internal users across different countries and global regions, while also contributing to system administration and network operations to ensure stable and secure IT services.

Join us in shaping the future of IT security, developing secure and sustainable endpoint architectures, and actively contributing to making our digital workplace resilient and compliant. With us, you'll have the freedom to contribute big ideas and take initiative. As part of an interdisciplinary and diverse team, you'll apply your expertise in endpoint management to ambitious projects, help shape standards and roadmaps, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are reliably implemented. We look forward to receiving your application for our office in Málaga.

**Key Responsibilities** **Endpoint Architecture \& Strategy**

* Develop and design a highly secure endpoint management environment with clear target architectures, standards, and governance models.
* Ensure that security, compliance, and regulatory requirements are embedded into endpoint architectures and operational processes.
* Evaluate, design, and implement new endpoint technologies and solutions to continuously improve the digital workplace experience.
* Lead endpoint management projects from planning and design through implementation and operational transition.

**Endpoint Operations \& Management**

jobs.description:
En TD SYNNEX estamos expandiendo la práctica de Endpoint en MCA y buscamos un Account Manager para Argentina que lidere el desarrollo del negocio multimarca de Endpoint (PCs, notebooks, monitores, periféricos, impresión y otras soluciones de usuario final; excluye Advanced Solutions). Tendrás a cargo una cartera definida de partners y cuentas clave, con foco en maximizar ingresos, rentabilidad y nuevas líneas de negocio. Serás un referente para nuestros socios del canal, impulsando planificación de cuentas, generación de pipeline, gestión de licitaciones y adopción de nuestras plataformas digitales.

Lo que harás

* Desarrollar y hacer crecer la cartera de partners: planificación de cuenta, mapeo de decisores, detección de oportunidades y activación de campañas.
* Ser una persona de confianza para los clientes, manteniendo relaciones estratégicas con visitas presenciales periódicas.
* Diseñar y ejecutar planes estratégicos para impulsar el negocio actual y el crecimiento incremental.
* Identificar, registrar y hacer seguimiento de oportunidades (pipeline) asegurando la calidad del funnel y el cumplimiento de metas.
* Coordinar recursos internos y liderar la interacción con Inside Sales, Operaciones de Venta y las Unidades de Negocio Especialistas (SBUs).
* Identificar oportunidades/proyectos conjuntamente con los BDM y equipos de Vendor Management.
* Relevar requerimientos del cliente y elaborar propuestas que agreguen valor, protegiendo el margen y el mix de productos/soluciones.
* Gestionar licitaciones y concursos (sector público y privado), coordinando inventario, plazos y documentación.
* Monitorear inventario y forecast, articulando con operaciones y vendors para asegurar disponibilidad y niveles de servicio.
* Detectar necesidades y problemas del cliente, resolviéndolos o escalándolos a las áreas correspondientes.
* Obtener insights mediante el perfilado y análisis de la cartera, generando acciones para maximizar oportunidades y expandir la base de partners.
* Completar en tiempo y forma el reporte y la administración en los sistemas de TD SYNNEX (CRM, reportes, profiling).
* Impulsar el uso de la plataforma de e‑commerce de TD SYNNEX (InTouch), promoviendo sus beneficios y aumentando la adopción.
* Mantener y mejorar los acuerdos de nivel de servicio (SLAs) con clientes y áreas internas.
* Operar bajo las mejores prácticas, políticas y objetivos de TD SYNNEX, asegurando el cumplimiento normativo y ético.

Lo que buscamos

* 3 años de experiencia relevante en ventas B2B o gestión de cuentas en la industria de tecnología (mayorista, fabricante u OEM, o reseller), preferentemente en categorías de Endpoint (computación personal, impresión, periféricos, colaboración).
* Red de relaciones y cartera activa en el canal de Argentina, con historial comprobable de desarrollo de partners y crecimiento de cuentas.
* Experiencia multimarca y trabajo con vendors/OEMs; capacidad para priorizar y balancear portafolio protegiendo margen.
* Sólida gestión de pipeline, pronóstico, negociación y cierre; dominio de CRM (ideal Salesforce) y Excel/herramientas de análisis.
* Experiencia en gestión de licitaciones y concursos, deseable con conocimiento del sector público.
* Enfoque a resultados, autonomía, capacidad de influencia sin autoridad formal y colaboración transversal.
* Habilidad para trabajo en campo con viajes frecuentes dentro del país.
* Inglés intermedio/avanzado para interactuar con equipos regionales y materiales de vendors.

Será un plus

* Experiencia previa en mayoristas o vendors líderes de Endpoint (p. ej., Dell y otros OEMs).
* Haber impulsado adopción de plataformas de e‑commerce B2B; conocimiento previo de InTouch.

At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.

**What's In It For You?**

* Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
* Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
* Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
* Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion: It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities.
* Make the Most of our Global Organization: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.
* Connect with Your Community: Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives.

**Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway.**At TD SYNNEX, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for!

jobs.description:
CDO is currently seeking an MDM Operations Associate based in our Monterrey office.

The Chief Data Office is driving Fitch's data transformation, building modern, scalable, and trusted data solutions that make innovation and smarter ways of working possible across the organization. The MDM (Master Data Management) squad plays an important role in this journey by improving the quality and reliability of Fitch master data, increasing automation through third-party data providers, and helping modernize legacy master data processes and solutions.

This is an exciting opportunity for an early-career professional interested in data, operations, and continuous improvement, offering the chance to join a collaborative team and contribute meaningfully to a broader transformation journey across the organization.

**What We Offer** This is a great opportunity to join the evolving CDO function and help shape the future of data across the organization. The role will work under the guidance of the local Team Lead and in close partnership with other MDM specialists, supporting the mastering and maintenance of legal entity, security, and other financial reference data.

* Be part of a growing MDM Operations team within the MDM Product, with increasing global visibility and impact across the organization.
* Join a supportive, collaborative, and learning-oriented team that works closely with product, technology, and data teams.
* Gain hands-on experience in data management, operations, and data governance within a business-critical domain.
* Contribute to the modernization of legacy processes and help identify opportunities for greater efficiency and automation.
* Build new skills through training, exposure to modern data tools, and collaboration with global stakeholders.
* Work in a hybrid environment that fosters collaboration and a supportive team culture.

**We'll Count On You To**

* Conduct entity data surveillance through research, validation, and accurate entry into MDM systems to ensure data integrity, consistency, and reliability.
* Interpret and use third-party data sources to support the mastering of entity and security data.
* Support stakeholders by managing and responding to data-related requests through established channels, ensuring timely, accurate, and service-oriented resolution.
* Deliver against agreed SLAs and follow established MDM workflows with a high level of quality and attention to detail.
* Partner with the Team Lead and broader MDM team on day-to-day data operations and continuous improvement across key data domains.
* Contribute to the enhancement of data operations processes, workflows, and procedures to improve efficiency, scalability, and operational effectiveness.
* Ensure data accuracy and coverage standards by maintaining robust documentation and supporting the refinement of data definitions and standards with the broader MDM team.

**What You Need To Succeed**

* Knowledge of legal entity, security, and other financial reference data, particularly including bonds, loans, and structured products, is preferred.
* Working knowledge of databases and experience handling large datasets.
* Strong organizational, administrative, and communication skills, with a methodical, proactive, and detail-oriented approach to work.
* A high level of accountability and ownership, with the ability to manage tasks reliably and follow through on deliverables.
* Ability to work within established workflows and service levels, managing tasks and stakeholder requests in a timely, accurate, and organized manner.
* A strong willingness to learn new tools, develop technical skills, and grow within a data and operations environment.
* Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, with particular strength in Excel.

**What Would Help You Stand Out**

* Familiarity with third-party data management platforms and external data providers such as Informatica, FactSet, GLEIF, Dun \& Bradstreet, ICE, or Bloomberg.
* Working knowledge of SQL or Python to support data analysis, processing, and workflow automation.
* Interest in using technology, including AI-enabled tools, to improve processes and operational efficiency.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to investigate data and solve problems in a practical way.
* Ability to adapt and perform effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

jobs.summary: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of...
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

BAW DEVICE ENGINEER (STARLINK/AKOUSTIS)

Akoustis is now operating as a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX, providing industry leading RF filters using patented XBAW technology to help drive the mission of making human life multi-planetary and connecting the world through Starlink. We design, build, launch, and operate the world's largest constellation of satellites, enabling us to operate a global internet network unbounded by traditional ground infrastructure limitations. The root of SpaceX’s success so far lies in our mission to keep all engineering and production in-house, which enables a tight feedback loop, nimble decision-making, and speedy deliverables. With millions of daily users worldwide already online, Starlink is truly a game-changer and levels the playing field for those who were previously unconnected.

XBAW technology utilizes MEMS-based thin film transfer process, enabling a broad range of piezoelectric material synthesis and compositions tailored for specific application needs with enhanced material properties and an optimized resonator performance including superior figure of merit from coupling and Q factor. Our Device Engineers plays a critical role in developing and improving XBAW resonators and supporting filter designs. This person will perform FEM simulations and experimental DOE to improve the figure of merit of BAW resonators, with an emphasis on developing efficient process integration and reduced cycle time for lean filter development.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Develop and improve FEA setups (COMSOL, HFSS) for BAW resonator simulations and optimization

- Improve the performance of bulk acoustic wave resonators for RF filter applications

- Develop and improve thin film bulk acoustic wave resonator process for better performance, accuracy, high yield as well as short cycle time

- Support BAW filter design with dimensions and process integration

- Define and generate resonator equivalent circuit models to be used in filter design

- Plan experimental setups with multiple parameters

- Scientific and statistical analysis of RF test results of BAW resonators

- Support problem solving in filter design, reliability, and yield improvement

SR. BAW DEVICE ENGINEER (STARLINK/AKOUSTIS)

Akoustis is now operating as a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX, providing industry leading RF filters using patented XBAW technology to help drive the mission of making human life multi-planetary and connecting the world through Starlink. We design, build, launch, and operate the world's largest constellation of satellites, enabling us to operate a global internet network unbounded by traditional ground infrastructure limitations. XBAW technology utilizes MEMS-based thin film transfer process, enabling a broad range of piezoelectric material synthesis and compositions tailored for specific application needs with enhanced material properties and an optimized resonator performance including superior figure of merit from coupling and Q factor. Our Device Engineers plays a critical role in developing and improving XBAW resonators and supporting filter designs. - Strong background in RF circuits and electromagnetics

- Work closely with other SpaceX IT administrators and engineers to gather requirements, research, evaluate, design, plan, deploy, and support enterprise software platforms and related technologies in a world-class environment that meets the needs of the demanding SpaceX engineering teams. Build highly-resilient, high-performance, scalable, and flexible systems.

- Take lessons learned and technology standards from the SpaceX Enterprise and apply them in smaller air-gapped environments.

- Exercise a high degree of responsibility for the processes, systems, and tools you create and manage; all supporting the goal of making humanity an interplanetary species.

- Make recommendations, justify, and implement improvements using an accepted change control methodology.

- Work within a diverse group to design and deliver creative solutions and resolve problems in a timely and proactive manner by interacting with internal business units.

- Define, document and follow standards and best practices for systems design, testing, and implementation.

- Drive scripting and automation to develop solutions to common problems.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- 4+ years of experience in IT systems administration.

- Experience with Windows servers in physical and virtualized enterprise level environments.

- Experience with Active Directory, Kerberos, and multi-platform authentication/identification environments.

- Experience with networking technologies and the Linux operating system environment.

- PowerShell scripting experience.

- Active Top Secret, Top Secret SCI, or DOE Level Q clearance

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Significant experience designing, deploying, supporting and troubleshooting classified networks.

- Working knowledge of Windows-based systems and services, including the ability to set up, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot.

- Expert working knowledge (including the ability to setup, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot) Windows-based systems and services such as DHCP, DNS, IIS, MS-SQL, NPS, etc.

- Familiarity with Active Directory and multi-platform authentication/identity environments

- Experience with Enterprise Microsoft Exchange and SharePoint deployments.

- Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and other DevOps concepts and tools.

- Hands-on experience with Windows Server 2012/2016 (AD, DNS, DHCP, etc.)

- Experience in IPv4, switching, routing, firewalls and HA architecture.

- Must be comfortable working with mission critical and sensitive systems, with a sense of urgency appropriate to the responsibilities.

- Excellent communications skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Active Top Secret or TS/SCI with Polygraph. Note that an active clearance may provide the opportunity for you to work on sensitive SpaceX missions. If so, you will be subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing.

- Willing to work after-hour on-call rotations, extended hours, and weekends when needed.

- Must be willing to do some travel domestically ( COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $95,000.00 - $120,000.00
Level 2: $115,000.00 - $150,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here .

jobs.description:
Figure is an AI Robotics company developing a general purpose humanoid. Our humanoid robot is designed for commercial tasks and the home. We are based in San Jose, CA and require 5 days/week in-office collaboration. It's time to build!
We are looking for a Client Engineer to own Figure's endpoint fleet everywhere it operates: our San Jose campus, our factories, our contract manufacturing partners, and connectivity-challenged field sites. Figure's most valuable asset is the design and software behind our humanoid, and this role is the technical owner of the controls that keep that IP on the devices, in the environments, and in the hands we intend. You will work closely with our Information Security team to define how devices are issued, hardened, monitored, and recovered; what data is allowed to land on them; and how quickly we can detect and cut off exposure when something goes wrong, whether the device sits on the corporate network or offline on a factory floor.
You are also the technical lead for client-side infrastructure company-wide. You will run endpoint management across macOS, Windows 11 Pro, and Ubuntu LTS, own SSO integration and identity lifecycle automation on Okta, and replace manual IT work with code. The ideal candidate is an engineer first and a systems administrator second: someone who responds to a repeated ticket by writing the script that eliminates it, documents the result, and is comfortable owning a security-sensitive program with real business consequences.
Responsibilities
Endpoint Engineering

Own zero-touch enrollment end to end: Apple Business Manager for macOS, Windows Autopilot for Windows, and PXE provisioning for Ubuntu workstations

Operate FleetDM as the cross-platform management agent across macOS, Windows, and Ubuntu LTS
Maintain standard, reproducible workstation builds with measured and enforced patch compliance
Build hardened device configurations for factories, contract manufacturers, and low-connectivity sites: loaner and clean-device programs, encryption enforcement and escrow, conditional access, and remote wipe and recovery
Deploy and maintain CrowdStrike Falcon coverage across the fleet in partnership with Security, closing gaps on unmanaged or drifted devices
Translate data handling and IP protection requirements from Security, Legal, and Engineering leadership into enforceable technical controls

Identity and SSO Engineering

Own SSO integration of applications into Okta (SAML and OIDC), including internal tools with no vendor documentation
Design application authentication and RBAC from first principles, in coordination with Security
Automate the identity lifecycle end to end: provisioning, entitlement, and deprovisioning driven by Okta Workflows and integrated with Google Workspace, Slack, and Jira

SaaS Operations and Automation

Build tooling in Python, Bash, or PowerShell to eliminate manual work across onboarding, offboarding, provisioning, reporting, and audit
Run license and access audits, surface inactive accounts and orphaned entitlements, and drive cost recovery with Procurement
Formalize change management for endpoint and SaaS changes and participate in the Change Advisory Board
Document standards, runbooks, and automation so the broader IT team can operate and extend what you build
Act as escalation point for complex client-side issues and mentor Operations Specialists

Qualifications

Hands-on experience managing macOS, Windows, and Linux (Ubuntu LTS) endpoint fleets in production
Practical experience with zero-touch enrollment and modern endpoint tooling: FleetDM or comparable osquery-based management, Apple Business Manager, Windows Autopilot or Microsoft Intune
Experience turning security benchmarks (CIS or similar) into enforced, validated configuration policy
Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell, with a track record of replacing manual processes with code
Working knowledge of authentication fundamentals: SAML, OIDC, SCIM, and the tradeoffs between them
Experience administering identity and SaaS platforms at scale: Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, including SCIM and API-driven provisioning
Sound judgment on security and risk tradeoffs, and the ability to explain technical controls to non-technical stakeholders
Detail-oriented and process-driven, particularly in documenting standards and policy
Great communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills

Bonus Qualifications

Experience supporting devices or users at manufacturing sites, contract manufacturers, or other high-IP-risk environments
Familiarity with export control, data residency, or IP protection frameworks in hardware and software R&D
Experience with employee-built AI applications: assess authentication and permissions risk, and redirec

Role Summary

We are looking for an junior or intermediate-level IT Support Engineer to provide general IT support for our global corporate environment. This role will support employees with day-to-day technical issues, Windows/macOS laptop setup, local admin, software access, Microsoft 365 support, Office Wi-Fi, badge and surveillant camera system and basic network troubleshooting, Windows365 Cloud PC support, and IT operational tasks.

The ideal candidate should have basic troubleshooting skills, good customer service mindset, and experience supporting users in a corporate IT environment. This role is suitable for someone who has moved beyond basic helpdesk support and can independently handle common IT issues, escalations, documentation, and operational follow-up.

Key Responsibilities

- Provide Tier 1/Tier 2 IT support for Windows/macOS devices, peripherals, Microsoft 365 applications, browsers, VPN, Wi-Fi, and conference room AV.

- Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, connectivity, and access-related issues for onsite and remote employees.

- Support employee onboarding and offboarding , including laptop setup, account/access provisioning, first-day IT support, equipment recovery, and access removal.

- Manage user accounts and application access, including password resets, MFA, shared mailboxes, distribution lists, group memberships, and SaaS applications.

- Maintain IT hardware and asset inventory , coordinate device shipping, replacements, repairs, warranty claims, and keep asset records up to date.

- Manage IT incidents and service requests through the ticketing system, ensuring timely resolution within SLAs and proper documentation and escalation.

- Provide basic network and office IT support , including Wi-Fi, VPN, conference room systems, and coordination with network/infrastructure teams or vendors when required.

- Create and maintain IT documentation, including troubleshooting guides, onboarding/offboarding checklists, asset procedures, and knowledge base articles.

- Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to IT support processes and the overall employee experience.

Required Qualifications:

- 1 – 3 years of experience in IT support, desktop support, service desk, or IT administration

- Strong experience supporting Windows laptops

- Basic to intermediate macOS support experience

- Experience with Microsoft 365: Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Office apps

- Experience troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and access issues

- Familiarity with ticketing systems such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Zendesk, or similar

- Good understanding of user accounts, groups, MFA, and basic access management

- Experience supporting remote users

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills

- Ability to work independently and follow documented processes

- Strong customer service mindset

Preferred Qualifications

-
Experience with Microsoft Intune, Jamf, or other device management tools

- Experience with Entra ID / Azure AD basic administration

- Experience with Zoom, Slack, Google Workspace, or other collaboration tools

- Basic PowerShell scripting knowledge

- Experience with asset management tools

- Experience supporting global teams

- ITIL Foundation certification preferred but not required

- Microsoft 365 Fundamentals or Azure Fundamentals certification preferred

jobs.description:
Job Description

Microsoft 365 and Endpoint Administrator
You Are
You are a hands-on, detail-oriented technology professional who takes ownership of Microsoft 365, Intune, and Entra ID environments. You thrive in fast-paced environments where security, reliability, and operational efficiency matter. You are skilled at managing endpoint policies, application deployments, device provisioning, identity and access, and Microsoft 365 services. Your proactive mindset, strong troubleshooting abilities, and automation-first approach help you identify issues before they impact users. You communicate clearly, document your work thoroughly, collaborate effectively across IT and security teams, and continuously look for ways to simplify, standardize, and improve the organization’s technology environment.
We Are

Compugen Systems, Inc. (CSI,) an affiliate of Compugen Inc., is an IT service delivery company that focuses on the business outcome of technology. We improve the human experience as organizations work to design, acquire, integrate, and operate technology for productivity improvement and competitive advantage. CSI provides innovative technology-based services to accelerate your transformation in the Modern Workspace and Hybrid IT with our uniquely crafted managed, professional, and field services. At CSI, we believe that every day we have, is another opportunity to innovate, inspire, and impact the world for the better. Our vision is to redefine customer experience, join us.

What We Need
We are looking for an experienced and solutions-oriented Microsoft 365 Administrator / Endpoint Administrator to join our team in a full-time, hourly, onsite position. The ideal candidate will have 2–3+ years of hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, and Windows endpoints. This is a hands-on onsite platform administration role. The successful candidate will be responsible for configuring, deploying, securing, troubleshooting, and maintaining Microsoft 365 and endpoint technologies while working closely with IT, Security, Network, vendors, and business teams. The role requires regular onsite presence to support endpoint deployments, device provisioning, hardware refreshes, troubleshooting, project rollouts, and other operational activities.
A Typical Day looks like

A typical day is focused on administering, securing, maintaining, and improving the Microsoft 365 and endpoint environment. This is a hands-on platform administration role, with most work performed through Microsoft 365 Admin Center, Intune, Entra ID, PowerShell, and ServiceNow.

Start the day by reviewing the environment: Check Intune device compliance, enrollment status, application deployment failures, security alerts, and Microsoft 365 service health.

Manage endpoints in Intune: Review Windows and iOS/iPadOS devices, troubleshoot enrollment and compliance issues, update configuration policies, and ensure devices meet organizational security requirements.

Deploy and manage applications: Package Win32/MSI applications, create detection and requirement rules, test deployments, and assign applications to the appropriate groups.

Manage Windows Autopilot: Configure and troubleshoot device provisioning, deployment profiles, enrollment status, and standardized Windows deployments.

Administer Entra ID: Create and manage users and groups, maintain dynamic group membership rules, manage MFA and access, and support identity-related administration.

Administer Microsoft 365: Manage Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, permissions, and licensing from the appropriate admin centers.

Automate repetitive tasks: Use PowerShell and Microsoft Graph to automate provisioning, licensing, reporting, device operations, and other administrative activities.

Manage ITSM activities: Review and work on ServiceNow incidents, requests, and changes while maintaining accurate asset and CMDB records.

Work with security teams: Assist with endpoint security, Microsoft Defender, compliance requirements, patching, and vulnerability remediation.

Support projects and rollouts: Participate in application deployments, hardware refreshes, Windows upgrades, migrations, Autopilot implementations, and Microsoft 365 platform improvements.

Document the environment: Update runbooks, SOPs, knowledge articles, configuration documentation, and deployment procedures.

How You’ll be Measured

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to keep the Microsoft 365 and endpoint environment secure, reliable, compliant, and well-managed, while continuously improving efficiency through automation.

Microsoft 365 Platform Health – Maintain reliable operation of Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Microsoft 365 services with minimal configuration-related issues.
Intune & Endpoint Compliance – Maintain high device enrollment and compliance rates, resolve policy and deployment failures, and ensure endpoints meet organizational security standards.
Application Deployment Success – Successfully package, test, and deploy Win32/MSI applications with accurate detection, requirement, and assignment rules.
Windows Autopilot Performance – Deliver consistent and reliable device provisioning with minimal manual intervention.
Identity & Access Management – Accurately manage Entra ID users, groups, dynamic membership, MFA, licensing, and role-based access while following security best practices.
Security & Compliance – Support timely remediation of endpoint vulnerabilities, security findings, and compliance issues in coordination with the security team.
Automation & Efficiency – Develop and maintain PowerShell/Graph automation that reduces repetitive manual work and improves administrative efficiency.
ITSM & Operational Excellence – Manage ServiceNow incidents, requests, and changes within expected service levels while maintaining accurate asset and CMDB information.
Documentation Quality – Maintain current SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles, and technical documentation so processes are repeatable and supportable.
Project Delivery – Successfully support Microsoft 365, Intune, endpoint, migration, hardware refresh, and platform improvement projects within agreed timelines.
Problem Solving – Identify root causes rather than simply resolving individual symptoms and implement sustainable platform-level solutions.
Cross-Team Collaboration – Work effectively with Security, Network, IT, vendors, and business teams to deliver reliable technology solutions.

Required Skills + Competencies

The ideal candidate combines hands-on Microsoft 365 and endpoint administration skills with strong troubleshooting, automation, security, and communication abilities.

Microsoft 365 Administration

Hands-on administration of Microsoft 365 tenant environments.
Experience with Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams.
Microsoft 365 licensing and user administration.
Ability to manage permissions, access, and tenant-level configurations.
Understanding of Microsoft 365 security and compliance fundamentals.

Microsoft Intune & Endpoint Management

Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune administration.
Ability to create and manage configuration profiles and compliance policies.
Windows and iOS/iPadOS device enrollment and management.
Application packaging and deployment using Win32/MSI.
Experience creating application detection, requirement, and assignment rules.
Ability to manage Required and Available application deployments.
Hands-on experience with Windows Autopilot.
Understanding of endpoint patching, vulnerability management, and device lifecycle management.

Entra ID & Identity Management

Hands-on experience administering Microsoft Entra ID.
User and group management.
Dynamic groups and membership rules.
MFA configuration and administration.
Role-based access control and identity security.
Understanding of hybrid identity with on-premises Active Directory.

PowerShell & Automation

Strong PowerShell scripting and automation skills.
Experience using Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK and Exchange Online PowerShell.
Ability to develop scripts for:

User provisioning
Licensing
Reporting
Device management
Administrative tasks

An automation-first mindset with the ability to identify and eliminate repetitive manual processes.

Security & Compliance

Security-conscious approach to Microsoft 365 and endpoint administration.
Basic experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
Familiarity with Microsoft Purview and Microsoft 365 compliance capabilities.
Understanding of endpoint security, vulnerability remediation, patch management, and access controls.

ITSM & Operational Management

Experience with ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform.
Ability to manage incidents, service requests, and changes.
Asset and CMDB/Configuration Item management.
Experience creating operational reports and dashboards.
Strong understanding of ITIL-based processes is a plus.

Troubleshooting & Problem Solving

Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to identify root causes rather than simply resolving symptoms.
Comfortable troubleshooting issues across Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, applications, devices, and identity.
Ability to translate technical issues into practical solutions.

Documentation & Communication

Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to create clear SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles, and technical documentation.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with Security, Network, IT, vendors, and business teams.

Desired Character + Culture Traits

Equal Employment Opportunity
Compugen Systems, Inc. (CSI) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees and do not discriminate on the basis of any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Ownership & Accountability – Takes responsibility and delivers results.
Proactive Mindset – Identifies issues and improvements before they become problems.
Security-Conscious – Prioritizes security, compliance, and data protection.
Automation-Driven – Looks for opportunities to simplify and automate repetitive tasks.
Problem Solver – Thinks analytically and focuses on root-cause solutions.
Collaborative Communicator – Works effectively with teams and communicates clearly.
Continuous Learner – Keeps up with evolving Microsoft technologies and best practices.

jobs.description:
Why Join Us?

We are seeking a highly motivated and customer-focused Technical Customer Success Manager (TCSM) to serve as a trusted advisor for our cyber security customers. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic customer engagement, ensuring customers maximize the value of their security investments while achieving their business objectives.

The ideal candidate possesses strong endpoint security knowledge, a startup mentality, exceptional problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate complex technical challenges into meaningful business outcomes. They are comfortable engaging with stakeholders ranging from security administrators to C-level executives and are passionate about driving customer success.

Key Responsibilities

**Job Description** **Customer Success \& Strategic Advisory**

* Serve as the primary post-sales technical advisor and trusted partner for assigned customers.
* Develop strong relationships with customer stakeholders, including security teams, IT leadership, and executive sponsors.
* Translate technical challenges and security risks into business-focused recommendations and outcomes.
* Drive customer adoption, engagement, and long-term success through strategic account planning.
* Lead customer success reviews, executive business reviews, and ongoing strategic discussions.

**Technical Leadership**

* Provide expertise in endpoint security technologies, cyber security best practices, and security operations.
* Own the customer onboarding experience post-sale, driving structured deployment plans that accelerate time-to-value. Partner with Professional Services and Support to ensure smooth rollouts across diverse endpoint environments, minimizing risk and maximizing early adoption milestones.
* Guide customers through deployments, integrations, configuration optimization, and adoption initiatives.
* Analyze customer environments and provide data-driven recommendations to improve security posture and product utilization.
* Design and deliver enablement programs tailored to customer security teams --- including workshops, product training sessions, and guided best-practice reviews --- ensuring customers build internal competency and maximize platform utilization independently.
* Leverage Check Point's threat intelligence capabilities to provide customers with contextually relevant security guidance --- translating global threat data into actionable recommendations specific to their endpoint environment.

Maintain awareness of product roadmap developments and communicate upcoming capabilities to customers in ways that align with their security strategy and drive continued investment.

* Collaborate with Support, Engineering, Product Management, and Sales to resolve complex customer issues.

**Escalation \& Problem Resolution**

* Own and drive resolution of critical customer escalations from identification through closure.
* Act as the customer advocate internally, ensuring timely communication and accountability across teams.
* Proactively identify risks to customer satisfaction and develop mitigation plans.
* Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills when navigating technical and business challenges.

**Business Partnership**

* Partner closely with Sales teams to support account growth, retention, and customer advocacy.
* Own and report on key customer success metrics including Net Revenue Retention (NRR), product adoption rates, CSAT/NPS scores, and renewal forecasts. Use these signals proactively to identify at-risk accounts and build data-driven action plans that protect and grow the customer base.
* Use customer health metrics, adoption data, and business insights to identify opportunities and risks.
* Maintain executive-level relationships and effectively communicate value realization to business leaders.
* Contribute to customer renewal and expansion strategies through technical and business guidance, including connecting endpoint security posture to broader platform discussions spanning email security, identity, cloud, and SASE.

**Qualifications**

* 5 years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Security Engineering, Professional Services, or related customer-facing cyber security roles.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of endpoint security technologies, including EDR/EPP platforms, antivirus and anti-malware solutions, and endpoint detection and response capabilities. Familiarity with OS-diverse environments (Windows, macOS, Linux), VDI and remote workforce deployments, MDM/UEM integrations, and common endpoint attack scenarios including ransomware and supply chain threats.
* Experience managing enterprise customer relationships.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience handling high-priority customer escalations and driving cross-functional resolution.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to analyze data and use customer insights to drive recommendations and business outcomes.
* Familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST, CIS Controls, and Zero Trust.
* Experience presenting to executive leadership, including CIOs, CISOs, and other C-suite stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in SaaS cyber security organizations.
* Knowledge of endpoint protection, email security, identity security, cloud security, or workspace security solutions.

This role ensures consistency in execution, adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and alignment of revision changeover processes across all assigned sites. The Lead drives cross-functional coordination between Operations, Planning, Purchasing, Manufacturing Engineering, and the MDM CCO (Commercialization Change Order) Team to minimize operational disruptions and optimize inventory utilization during revision transitions. He/she is accountable for team performance, process standardization, escalation management, and continuous improvement across the regional CCO operations footprint.

**Responsibilities**

* Directly manage and develop a team of 8 analysts across multiple manufacturing plants
* Ensure all revision changeover processes are executed consistently and within defined SLAs across all assigned plants
* Standardize workflows, templates, and reporting across the regional team to drive operational excellence
* Monitor and manage workload distribution across analysts to ensure balanced coverage and timely execution
* Serve as the escalation point for complex or high-risk revision changeover issues that cannot be resolved at the analyst level
* Coordinate cross-plant dependencies and communicate regional impacts to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
* Analyst trends in changeover disruptions, scrap, rework, and inventory costs to drive data-informed decision-making
* Support the development and refinement of standard operating procedures (SOPs) for CCO operations
* Provide regular status updates and executive summaries to MDM Operations leadership on regional performance and risks
* Gather, scrub, manipulate data to generate average to complex reports and analysis related to Part and Supplier requirement
* Ensure predefined process is followed to ensure accuracy of information
* Oversee task tracking sheet for CCO revision updates, ensuring updates provided timely by all cross-functional teams
* Maintain knowledge of products and parts

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Intermediate MS Excel knowledge
* Intermediate MS PowerPoint knowledge
* Strong written and communication skills
* Experience in using ERP systems
* Intermediate knowledge and experience on Bill of Materials Management and Item Creation in ERP
* Knowledge and experience in using Power BI
* Demonstrated ability to manage remote/distributed teams across multiple sites
* 5-7 years of experience in operations, supply chain, or manufacturing environment

**EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS**

jobs.description:
About Us:

Join the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA), where we deliver the secure IT and communications capabilities that keep our Nation’s Warfighters and senior leaders connected anytime, anywhere. Within Command, Control, Communications and Computers (C4) Enterprise Directorate (J-6), we empower our Nation’s senior leaders and the warfighter community with assured enterprise services to win in an evolving global landscape.

Position Overview: Serving as the Senior End-User Computing Engineer, you provide hands-on technical leadership and engineering expertise for the enterprise digital workspace ecosystem. In this role, you drive modern workplace engineering across the full hardware and virtualization spectrum—architecting and managing cloud-hosted Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) environments as well as physical thick client workstations and dedicated thin/zero client endpoints.

You lead the development of automated Standard Operating Environments (SOE), master OS imaging pipelines, zero-touch provisioning workflows, and enterprise application packaging (MSIX/Win32) for hybrid delivery. Leveraging modern management platforms including Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, and MECM, you author robust automation code (PowerShell) to eliminate administrative toil, enforce Zero Trust device hardening at the edge, and optimize digital experience telemetry to guarantee a secure, high-performance computing environment across all client endpoints.

Salary: $127,624 to $187,093 per year (inclusive of TLMS and locality adjustments)

Location: Fort Meade, MD; Arlington, VA; Scott AFB, IL; San Antonio, TX

Major Duties:

Engineer Hybrid Workspaces (AVD & Virtual Sessions): Build, configure, and optimize enterprise Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) environments and virtual application delivery, ensuring seamless, low-latency desktop experiences across both thin and thick client access points.Manage Physical Device Fleets (Thick & Thin Clients): Engineer, evaluate, and maintain the organization’s hardware fleet—including high-performance thick clients (workstations, laptops) and dedicated thin/zero clients—standardizing hardware baselines, BIOS/firmware configurations, and peripheral compatibility.Master OS Imaging & SOE Engineering: Build, automate, and maintain Standard Operating Environments (SOE) using automated image pipelines (OSD/MECM) and cloud imaging solutions across physical thick clients, thin client operating systems, and virtual desktop master images.Modernize Unified Endpoint Management (UEM): Implement modern device management workflows using Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, and MECM for zero-touch provisioning, compliance baselines, and configuration policy management across all physical and virtual endpoints.Drive Application Packaging & Hybrid Delivery: Package, test, and distribute enterprise software (MSIX, Win32, App-V), determining the optimal delivery method (native installation for thick clients vs. remote application streaming for thin/AVD environments).Enforce Endpoint Security & Zero Trust: Partner with cyber engineering teams to harden thick, thin, and virtual endpoints, deploying conditional access policies, endpoint detection and response (EDR), and Zero Trust access controls at the hardware and OS level.Automate Endpoint Operations & Telemetry: Author robust PowerShell automation scripts and configuration policies to streamline patching, provisioning, and driver updates; monitor digital experience telemetry to optimize boot times, peripheral performance, and session quality across all device types.

Key Skills

End-User ComputingAzure Virtual DesktopMicrosoft IntuneVirtual Desktop InfrastructureOperating System DeploymentPowerShellApplication PackagingMECMWindows Autopilot

Conditions of Employment:

Must be a U.S. Citizen.This national security position, which may require access to classified information, requires a favorable suitability review and security clearance as a condition of employment. Failure to maintain security eligibility may result in termination.Incumbent is required to submit a Financial Disclosure Statement, OGE-450.This is a drug testing designated positionIncumbent is required to travel away from their normal duty station to other locations within the continental United States (CONUS) and/or other locations outside the continental United States (OCONUS) up to 30 percent of the time.

Security Clearance:

Minimum Requirement: Must possess an active Top Secret (TS) security clearance at the time of application.Preferred Requirement: An active Top Secret / SCI (TS/SCI) clearance is highly preferred.Condition of Employment: Candidates holding a TS clearance must be eligible for, and successfully obtain and maintain, SCI access upon hire.

A career with the U.S. government provides employees with a comprehensive benefits package. As a federal employee, you and your family will have access to a range of benefits that are designed to make your federal career very rewarding.

* No direct supervision responsibilities though technical leadership required within assigned projects.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Advanced skills in planning, designing, and solving complex security solutions and services
* Advanced technical proficiency in designing and implementing at least one or more of the following security solutions within multi-cloud environments such Azure, AWS, GCP or similar technologies including:

* Anti-Malware tools

* Privilege Management

* Mobile Security

* Data Encryption

* Data Protection
* Communicate fluently in English, both written and verbal and able to communicate technical concepts effectively
* Excellent interpersonal communication and organizational skills and the ability to work within tight timeframes
* Rapidly learn new and emerging technologies with ability to rapidly define engineering standards

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Desire to work in a diverse, multi-cultural, global environment
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent work experience required
* 4+ years of Information Security experience
* 3+ years demonstrated ability in an engineering function
* Technical proficiency in Endpoint or Data security solutions on Linux, Mac and Windows OS Platforms
* Technical proficiency with writing custom, scripting tools (Python, Ansible, PowerShell, etc), interacting with API's and shell scripting
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Understanding of other technologies required to run a secure, enterprise level infrastructure that adhere to security best practices
* Excellent time management, organizational, and decision-making skills
* Ability to document processes, procedures, and security designs clearly and accurately for distribution to internal teams and customers
* Demonstrated experience in dealing with external vendors and suppliers in the security industry

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Technical experience in a large, complex, global IT environment
* Involved in large scale global IT deployments or application cloud migrations
* Experience with Microsoft suite of Security products

**What We Look For** A self-starter, independent-thinker, curious and creative person with ambition to learn and passion for delivering security solutions and services.

**What We Offer** As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here's a snapshot of what we offer:

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations.

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer, and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.

**If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.** **Make your mark.** **Apply now.**

jobs.description:
Job Title: NeXT Think OR Digital Employee Experience (DEX) Engineer

Location: Spring, TX (Onsite)

Duration: Long term
Skillset:
NeXT Think Engineer seeking a highly skilled Digital Experience Engineer to support and enhance the company’s Digital Employee Experience (DEX) strategy. This role is centered around using Nexthink (or equivalent endpoint observability platforms such as Splunk, ControlUp, SysTrack, or Microsoft Endpoint Analytics) to monitor device health, quantify user experience, proactively detect issues, and design automations that improve overall endpoint performance and user satisfaction.
The ideal candidate is both technically deep and operationally minded—capable of analyzing telemetry, building automated remediations, collaborating across IT teams, and driving measurable improvements in the employee digital experience. This individual will work onsite at the ExxonMobil campus, partnering closely with multiple engineering, support, and operations teams to operationalize insights and accelerate issue resolution.

Key Responsibilities
Platform Ownership & Nexthink Engineering
Manage and optimize Nexthink configuration, governance, and feature onboarding.

Promote Nexthink adoption and best practices across IT and business units.

Ensure data quality, reliable telemetry, and consistent use-case development.

Design and maintain Nexthink dashboards, NQL queries, DEX Score views, and leadership reporting metrics.

Use Case Development & Observability

Translate endpoint telemetry into actionable insights that reduce “frustrated users.”

Build and deploy experience-driven use cases to enhance:

endpoint observability compliance visibility performance monitoring digital experience measurement

Continuously analyze data to identify patterns, degraders, or emerging issues.

Automation & Remediation

Develop advanced Remote Actions using PowerShell (including script signing and guardrails).

Build automated workflows through Nexthink Flow to enable proactive and self-healing remediations.

Create user-facing campaigns to guide self-service or gather targeted feedback.

Trigger or coordinate incident escalations and remediation workflows across teams.

Cross-Team Collaboration & Operational Enablement

Serve as a DEX advocate by working with endpoints, networking, application, security, and service management teams.

Integrate Nexthink insights into IT operations and enterprise initiatives.

Provide clear communication, documentation, and influence to drive action based on data.

Support leadership through KPI tracking and experience analytics (DEX Score, performance trends, compliance posture).

Required Technical Skills
Nexthink Expertise
(Or equivalent experience with Splunk or similar observability platforms)
Advanced Remote Action development (PowerShell, automation chaining).

Nexthink Flow workflow design and system integrations.

Campaign creation, user engagement strategies, and remediation logic.

NQL query writing, dashboard development, and DEX Score interpretation.

Deep understanding of endpoint telemetry, device health signals, and digital experience metrics.

Scripting & Automation

Strong PowerShell scripting capabilities (diagnostics, remediation, automation-at-scale).

Experience with REST APIs, authentication, and platform integrations.

Troubleshooting & Endpoint Performance

Skilled in Windows OS performance analysis and root-cause troubleshooting.

Ability to correlate endpoint, network, and application performance signals.

Understanding of device health fundamentals (CPU/memory pressure, disk I/O, startup times, resource contention).

Analytics & Reporting

Strong data analysis and problem-solving abilities.

Experience converting telemetry into insights, KPIs, and actionable recommendations.

Dashboard creation for both technical and executive audiences.

Workplace & Cloud Knowledge

Familiarity with modern device management ecosystems (Intune, MECM/SCCM, M365).

Understanding of cloud concepts (Azure preferred).

The Enterprise Client Engineering team designs and implements systems for virtual and physical infrastructures across various operating systems. This team enhances productivity and security while reducing costs, downtime, and repetitive processes, delivering industry-leading solutions.

Partner with the best

As a Systems Engineer II, responsibilities include managing endpoint security for client systems through software deployments, installations, patching, and security tools. Tasks involve handling EDR, DLP, browser security, and overall security management for Windows, macOS, and Ubuntu endpoints.

As a Systems Engineer II, you will be responsible for (across macOS, Windows and Ubuntu):

- Managing browser functionality and security across various platforms using extensions and agents.

- Enforcing Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Endpoint Privileged Management (EPM) within a zero-trust model.

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

- Demonstrate 5+ experience in engineering, administration, UEM systems (KACE, JAMF, SCCM, Workspace One, Intune, etc.) + High School Diploma/ Bachelor's Degree in a related field.

- Demonstrate 2-3 years of experience collaborating with EDR and DLP security systems or overseeing related platforms like CrowdStrike or Proofpoint.

- Have good experience in writing technical documentation and procedural materials for multiple audiences (SOPs, architectural, administration and support guides, etc.)

- Demonstrate expertise with Windows, macOS, and Ubuntu through hands-on experience and providing comprehensive support for these operating systems.

- Demonstrate hands-on expertise across scripting and packaging implementation for macOS, Windows, and Ubuntu operating systems.

- Manage and troubleshoot virtual machines running on Windows and Ubuntu operating systems effectively and efficiently.

jobs.description:
About IonQ: IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security.

About IonQ :

IonQ , Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location: Seattle, WA (preferred); open to College Park, MD or Remote
Travel: 10% domestic or international
Job ID: 1714

The Role:

We are seeking a high-caliber Staff Client Systems Engineer to own, integrate, and optimize our global endpoint ecosystem and employee lifecycle automation. In this role, you will be the principal designer of our core operating system configurations and "Gold Images" across a diverse enterprise environment (Mac, Windows, and Ubuntu Linux).

Beyond endpoint management, you will serve as the strategic technical bridge between IT and HR. You will architect, implement, and troubleshoot advanced onboarding, offboarding, and transfer workflows—specifically engineering the automated enterprise identity pipeline between Workday and Okta. This role is critical to scaling our global infrastructure, eliminating manual IT overhead, and ensuring a secure, flawless day-one experience for our workforce.

Responsibilities :

Enterprise Endpoint Architecture & Imaging

- Design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade "Gold OS Images" and deployment configurations for macOS, Windows 10/11, and Ubuntu Linux.

- Architect zero touch provisioning workflows leveraging Autopilot and ADE.

- Partner closely with the IT Provisioning Team to optimize hardware staging workflows, ensuring images deploy flawlessly and efficiently to end-user machines.

- Own and optimize modern Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) and MDM platforms (e.g., Jamf, Intune, Kandji) for zero-touch provisioning, automated patching, and security compliance enforcement.

HR & IT Lifecycle Automation (Workday ⇄ Okta)

- Architect and manage the end-to-end automated lifecycle pipeline using Workday and Okta Lifecycle Management.

- Design and implement intelligent, automated intake forms and workflows (via Jira Service Management, or Okta Workflows) for hiring managers to submit new-hire technical profiles.

- Build automated solutions for employee transfers, role changes, and terminations to ensure instant down-stream SaaS provisioning, precise access revocation, and tight security governance.

Tier-3 Escalation & Mentorship

- Act as the ultimate technical escalation point for complex identity, access management (IAM), and automated provisioning failures.

- Proactively troubleshoot and resolve deep architectural mismatches between Workday data attributes and Okta downstream applications.

- Establish and maintain robust troubleshooting runbooks and technical documentation, empowering Helpdesk and Systems Administrators to independently resolve lifecycle and imaging issues.

- Provide continuous technical mentorship to junior administrators, helpdesk technicians, and contractor teams to elevate the organization's overall technical capability and operational self-sufficiency.

Requirements:

- Experience: 6+ years of experience in Client Systems Engineering, Endpoint Architecture, or IT Infrastructure Automation.

- Workday & Okta Integration: Proven track record of configuring and maintaining Workday-driven identity provisioning within Okta. Must understand Workday attribute mapping, lifecycle states, and troubleshooting Okta expression language/workflows.

- Multi-OS Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of configuring, securing, and imaging Windows, macOS, and Ubuntu Linux at enterprise scale.

- Modern Provisioning: Deep familiarity with modern, zero-touch deployment frameworks such as Windows Autopilot and Apple Business Manager (ABM).

- Experience with Configuration Management tools: Ansible, Chef, Puppet.

- Automation & Form Building: Hands-on experience building dynamic service catalogs, custom forms, and conditional routing workflows for business stakeholders.

- Scripting Capabilities: Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Bash, PowerShell, Python) to automate API integrations, custom packaging, and OS configurations.

- Experience in engaging with multiple hardware vendors and VARs.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Advanced certifications: Okta Certified Consultant/Developer , Jamf Certified Admin , or Workday Extend/Integration certification .

- Experience with API integration tools (Postman, Workato, or Okta Workflows).

The approximate base salary range for this position is $126,887- $166,127. The total compensation package includes base, bonus, equity, and a range of benefit options found on our career site.

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.

Senior Systems Engineer / Solutions Architect (Remote)

Why Digacore ?

We’re a fast-paced, people-first MSP with:

- Real career growth

- Autonomy to own projects and make decisions

- A collaborative culture (we back each other up, no egos)

- Paid certs, hybrid flexibility, and a leadership team that gets IT

About the Role:

Are you the go-to engineer who handles the toughest issues and loves designing smarter infrastructure? We’re looking for a senior-level engineer with a builder’s mindset — someone ready to design cloud-first environments and lead escalations while working directly with clients to create solutions that best fit their needs. This role combines high-level systems engineering with solution architecture. You’ll handle critical escalations, run client assessments, and architect end-to-end solutions — particularly around Azure, networking, server building and advanced troubleshooting.

What You’ll Do:

- Lead technical assessments and translate business needs into secure, scalable infrastructure designs.

- Design and implement solutions in Azure, Microsoft 365, and Intune/Endpoint Manager, including Autopilot deployments, compliance/conditional access policies, and application packaging.

- Advanced networking – redesign and optimize networks (firewalls, switching, routing, VLANs) for performance, security, and cost efficiency.

- Comfortable using the CLI for common network tasks.

- Experience troubleshooting loops, configuring switches, and supporting HP/Dell switch environments and SonicWall/Fortinet firewalls.

- Support and administer Microsoft’s core stack: Windows Server roles, Office 365, Azure services.

- Build and harden servers/workstations to ensure reliability, security, and lifecycle longevity.

- Create accurate, detailed SOWs and scopes that define deliverables, timelines, and technical requirements.

- Own and resolve complex Level 3+ escalations — performing deep-dive troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and long-term remediation.

- Deliver clean, repeatable documentation for architectures, deployments, and operational processes.

- Mentor junior and mid-level techs and elevate team-wide technical capability.

- Partner with sales department by reviewing proposals, validating technical scope, and identifying potential pitfalls.

- Coordinate account managers, PMs, and clients to ensure clear communication and smooth project execution.

- Help drive best practices in cloud security, automation, monitoring, and MSP tooling — always bringing a figure-it-out and outside-the-box problem-solving mindset.

What you Bring:

- 5+ years in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) or high-volume IT support environment

- Strong experience with:

- Windows Server (2016/2019/2022), Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS

- Microsoft 365 administration and security

- Azure infrastructure and virtual networks (AZ-104 or higher preferred)

- Virtualization tools: VMware, Hyper-V, AVD

- Networking: Layer 2/3, VPNs, firewalls (SonicWall, Meraki, etc.)

- Scripting & automation (PowerShell preferred)

- Strong documentation habits and familiarity with ConnectWise

- Confident communication with the ability to explain solutions to non-technical users

- Bonus if you have: AZ-305, CCNA/CCNP, or any cybersecurity-related certs

Perks & Benefits

- Nationwide medical, dental, life, and LTD insurance (we cover LTD + life 100%)

- Generous PTO + Mental Health Days

- 401(k) with company match

- HSA & FSA options

- Paid training & certification assistance

- $500 sign-on bonus

- Quarterly team events and career coaching

- Equal opportunity employer — veterans encouraged to apply

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer!
Salary: $95,000-$105,000 annually
