jobs.description:
The End User Computing (EUC) Architect is a senior technical leadership role responsible for defining and executing enterprise endpoint, security, and identity architecture across Windows, macOS, and mobile device environments.

The End User Computing (EUC) Architect is a senior technical leadership role responsible for defining and executing enterprise endpoint, security, and identity architecture across Windows, macOS, and mobile device environments. The position leads the modernization of traditional endpoint management toward cloud-first Modern Management using Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, Windows Autopilot, Jamf Pro, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and CyberArk Endpoint Privilege Management.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Architecture & Modernization

- Own and maintain the enterprise EUC and endpoint management roadmap across Windows and macOS.

- Architect Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, and Jamf Pro environments.

- Lead SCCM-to-Intune modernization and co-management initiatives.

- Design modern provisioning strategies using Windows Autopilot and Apple Automated Device Enrollment.

- Establish enterprise endpoint architecture, governance, standards, and operational procedures.

macOS & Jamf Management

- Architect and manage enterprise Jamf Pro capabilities.

- Design macOS enrollment, provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management strategies.

- Manage configuration profiles, policies, application deployment, patching, compliance, and inventory.

- Implement FileVault encryption, macOS security controls, and configuration standards.

- Develop macOS upgrade and lifecycle strategies.

- Integrate Jamf with Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Conditional Access, and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

Cross-Platform Endpoint Management

- Establish consistent endpoint management standards across Windows and macOS.

- Develop enterprise strategies for provisioning, application deployment, patching, compliance, security, and device lifecycle management.

- Ensure Windows and macOS platforms meet enterprise security and compliance requirements.

Windows Lifecycle Management

- Lead large-scale Windows migration and modernization projects.

- Design OS deployment, in-place upgrade, and device replacement strategies.

- Develop deployment rings, pilot programs, and risk mitigation plans.

- Create automated deployment and upgrade frameworks capable of supporting tens of thousands of endpoints.

Engineering & Automation

- Develop automation using PowerShell, shell scripting, .NET, SQL, REST APIs, and other scripting technologies.

- Automate endpoint provisioning, application deployment, security remediation, patching, and compliance processes.

- Develop custom inventory, compliance, reporting, and endpoint management solutions.

- Integrate endpoint management platforms with identity and security technologies.

Endpoint Security

- Architect Microsoft Defender for Endpoint across Windows and macOS.

- Develop security baselines, vulnerability remediation processes, and endpoint detection and response capabilities.

- Implement Attack Surface Reduction, endpoint compliance, disk encryption, and device security controls.

- Partner with Cybersecurity and SOC teams to improve endpoint detection, response, and threat monitoring.

- Support Zero Trust initiatives through device compliance, device health, Conditional Access, and identity-driven security controls.

Identity & Privileged Access

- Integrate endpoints with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, PIM, PAM, and identity governance technologies.

- Architect CyberArk Endpoint Privilege Manager and Microsoft Endpoint Privilege Management solutions.

- Develop least-privilege strategies for Windows and macOS.

- Govern local administrator rights and application elevation.

- Partner with IAM teams to integrate endpoint management with enterprise identity and access management architecture.

Security Analytics

- Develop KQL queries for Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Log Analytics, and Advanced Hunting.

- Build security and compliance dashboards using PowerBI and SQL.

- Develop threat-hunting queries and correlate endpoint telemetry with identity, vulnerability, and configuration data.

- Automate security reporting and operational workflows.

Technical Leadership

- Serve as the senior technical escalation point for Endpoint Engineering.

- Act as the architectural authority for Windows, macOS, Intune, SCCM, Jamf, endpoint security, and endpoint/identity integration.

- Mentor endpoint engineers and administrators.

- Lead architecture reviews and enterprise technology decisions.

- Develop standards, documentation, reference architectures, and operational procedures.

- Drive collaboration across Endpoint Engineering, Cybersecurity, IAM, Infrastructure, and Application teams.

Candidate Profile:

The ideal candidate has extensive experience architecting and managing large-scale enterprise endpoint environments across Windows and macOS. They should possess deep expertise in Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, Jamf Pro, Windows Autopilot, Apple Automated Device Enrollment, Windows 10/11, macOS, iOS, Android, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Entra ID, Conditional Access, CyberArk EPM, PowerShell, shell scripting, KQL, endpoint security, and Zero Trust architecture.

The candidate should have demonstrated experience leading enterprise endpoint transformation initiatives and be capable of bridging Endpoint Engineering, Cybersecurity, and IAM while providing senior-level architecture and technical leadership.

In short, this is a Senior EUC / Endpoint Security & Identity Architect responsible for the architecture, modernization, security, and lifecycle management of the organization's complete Windows, macOS, and mobile device endpoint ecosystem, with Intune, SCCM, and Jamf serving as the core endpoint management platforms.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive ’s essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. We’re a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

IT Systems Engineer
Location: Carlsbad, New Mexico (Onsite)

Build the Technology That Powers an Essential Industry
Hire Virtue is recruiting on behalf of our mining client for an experienced IT Systems Engineer to support and continuously improve the organization's enterprise technology infrastructure.

This is an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled technology professional who enjoys working across networking, systems administration, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, telecommunications, and end-user support. You'll serve as a trusted technical expert responsible for maintaining a secure, reliable, and highly available IT environment that supports critical mining operations.

If you're passionate about technology, enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges, and thrive in a hands-on environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Position Summary
The IT Systems Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, administering, maintaining, and supporting the organization's enterprise technology environment, including servers, networking, cloud platforms, telecommunications, cybersecurity, Microsoft 365, hardware, software, and business-critical applications.

This role serves as the primary escalation point for infrastructure-related issues while partnering with internal departments and third-party vendors to ensure the availability, security, and performance of all technology systems.

Infrastructure & Systems Administration

jobs.summary: The Basics: Tanium's Product Management team is actively seeking a Director, Product Management to lead Policy and Configuration Management for the Endpoint Management portfolio . This is a senior individual contributor role responsible for owning the...
jobs.description:
The Basics:

Tanium's Product Management team is actively seeking a Director, Product Management to lead Policy and Configuration Management for the Endpoint Management portfolio . This is a senior individual contributor role responsible for owning the strategy, roadmap, and execution of how Tanium defines, applies, and proves configuration state across the enterprise — giving IT and Security teams a single way to set policy once and enforce it consistently across Windows, Linux, and macOS endpoints, regardless of whether those endpoints are on-premises, remote, or in the cloud.

The successful candidate will own the product strategy behind Tanium's centralized policy engine: application allow/deny control, full-disk encryption, device and removable media control, host firewall management, and machine- and user-scoped administrative template (Group Policy-style) policy. This includes the migration tooling that lets customers import existing Group Policy backups and industry hardening standards — such as CIS Build Kits and vendor security baselines — directly into managed policy. You will also shape the next generation of policy types that supersede legacy mechanisms as customers modernize off traditional, on-premises group policy infrastructure.

You will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to set vision, drive roadmap, ship capabilities customers trust for compliance and audit, and turn consistent configuration state into measurable risk reduction for customers.

A successful candidate is a strong communicator and influencer who can operate fluently across executive stakeholder conversations, deep technical architecture discussions, and customer-facing storytelling. Must have a successful track record of shipping enterprise configuration management, compliance, or policy products at scale.

What you'll do

- Own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Tanium's endpoint policy and configuration management capabilities, end to end from ideation to launch.

- Drive the roadmap for Windows policy and configuration management — application control (allow/deny rules), full-disk encryption, device and removable storage control, host firewall management, and machine- and user-scoped administrative template policy — ensuring parity with and differentiation from traditional Group Policy infrastructure.

- Expand Linux configuration management capabilities (e.g., host firewall management and hardening controls), building out coverage on top of an established Windows foundation.

- Own the strategy for legacy migration and baseline import tooling — Group Policy backup import and industry hardening standard support (CIS Build Kits, vendor security baselines) that automatically convert a downloaded benchmark file into a ready-to-enforce compliance policy, complete with conflict detection across overlapping settings and automatic content-set mapping — and for next-generation policy types that supersede legacy equivalents as customers modernize.

- Define and evolve policy enforcement state and compliance reporting (applied, partially applied, superseded, not applied) so customers can prove configuration compliance and audit posture at any time.

- Partner with incident response, reporting, and guidance capabilities across the platform to turn security findings into durable preventive policy and to surface actionable configuration drift and remediation guidance to operators.

- Document customer use cases, product requirements, and business justifications for new policy and configuration investments; prioritize ruthlessly based on customer risk reduction, compliance mandates, and platform leverage.

- Partner with Product Marketing and Sales to develop go-to-market motions, enablement, and messaging ; support launches, analyst engagements, and customer briefings.

- Cultivate strategic customer relationships to validate direction, surface gaps, and turn lighthouse deployments into reference architectures.

- Establish and track KPIs — policy adoption, time-to-compliance, configuration drift and remediation rates, and platform pull-through — and use them to drive continuous improvement.

- Leverage emerging trends in agentic AI and autonomous IT to shape the roadmap for self-healing, continuously enforced endpoint configuration.

Requirements

Education

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

- Masters in Computer Science or MBA preferred.

Experience

- 8+ years of total professional experience in enterprise B2B software, with at least 5 years in product management supporting a SaaS or enterprise platform.

- Required: hands-on experience with Windows policy and configuration management — Group Policy, ADMX administrative templates, security baselines, full-disk encryption, application control, or comparable endpoint configuration tooling.

- Strong bonus: in-depth experience with Linux configuration management — configuration/hardening frameworks, host firewall management, or compliance baselines for Linux systems.

- Demonstrated success owning and shipping policy, compliance, or configuration management products at enterprise scale.

- Deep familiarity with endpoint management and IT operations — including the customer workflows that span IT and Security teams.

- Strong fluency with compliance frameworks and industry baselines (e.g., CIS benchmarks, vendor security baselines) and how they translate into enforceable policy.

- Experience working with executive stakeholders to align on vision, secure investment, and unblock execution.

- Proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, marketing, and sales without direct authority.

Other

- Align with the Tanium values: we win as a team, we do the right thing, and we are unstoppable .

- Intuition to identify high-leverage configuration and compliance gaps that align with Tanium's platform and present opportunities for rapid growth.

- Willingness to take on firmly-entrenched, legacy configuration management incumbents with creative approaches to technology and a tenacious pursuit to build and grow a product's customer base.

- Ability to establish and nurture strong customer champions who can serve as advocates and an informal advisory board.

- Strong written communication, verbal communication, and executive presentation skills.

- Adept at understanding and navigating complex organizations in order to inspire and influence internal and external stakeholders.

- Grit; ability to deal with and overcome challenges, and to thrive in ambiguity.

About Tanium

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. Driven by AI and real-time endpoint intelligence, Tanium Autonomous IT empowers IT and security teams to make their organizations unstoppable.

Many of the world’s leading organizations trust Tanium’s single, unified platform for endpoint management and security to innovate faster, stay resilient and move business forward with confidence, at scale. To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business – visit www.tanium.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

On a mission. Together.

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.

Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most.

What you’ll get

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $214,000 to $328,000. This range is an estimate for what Tanium will pay a new hire. The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, location, education, skills, training, and experience.

In addition to an annual base salary, team members will receive equity awards and a generous benefits package consisting of medical, dental and vision plan, family planning benefits, health savings account, flexible spending account, transportation savings account, 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, life, accident and disability coverage, business travel accident insurance, employee assistance programs, disability insurance, and other well-being benefits.

Tanium is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected Veteran status, or other legally protected categories. If you require a reasonable accommodation in searching for a job opening, completing an application, interviewing, or completing any pre-employment testing or requirements, please contact accommodations@tanium.com . For more information refer to the “Know Your Rights” poster which is available here - https://www.eeoc.gov/poster .

Please be aware of job offers coming from people claiming to be Tanium employees. Tanium employees will only use @tanium.com email addresses to communicate with you, will have video interviews with you, and will never ask you for money.

jobs.summary: WHY HARVEY At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come....
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey runs on a fleet of Macs and Windows devices, and every one of them is the front door to how each Harvey employee does their work. We're seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to own client engineering end to end - Jamf, Intune, Autopilot, Okta device trust, and more, and the automation that ties them together. This is the person who decides how a laptop gets built, secured, patched, recovered, and retired, and who makes those decisions hold up as we scale across offices globally.

The ideal candidate has run a production device management environment at scale and can move between writing the deployment tooling, debugging a broken enrollment, and pushing for improvements to policy, process, and systems along the way.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the endpoint platform. Jamf Pro for macOS, Intune and Autopilot for Windows, and the mobile fleet alongside them. You set configuration standards, patching cadence, and compliance baselines in partnership with Security, and you're accountable for the fleet actually meeting them.

- Engineer the device lifecycle. Zero-touch provisioning through Apple Business Manager and Autopilot, automated onboarding and offboarding, hardware refreshes, DLP, and forensics. Where the lifecycle still depends on someone remembering to do something, replace that with code.

- Build the automation the fleet runs on. Most of this role's leverage comes from tooling - Python and scripts against Jamf, Intune, and Okta APIs, event-driven workflows, and self-service that lets employees fix their own problems.

- Partner with Security on endpoint posture. Work directly with Security on endpoint policies, EDR coverage, device trust and Okta FastPass, disk encryption and key escrow, browser management, and more.

- Be the final escalation for endpoint issues. IT Operations handles tier 1 and 2 globally; the problems that reach you are the strange ones. You'll fix them, and then fix the class of problem so the next person doesn't file the ticket.

- Support a global, in-person-heavy company. Harvey has offices across the US, EMEA, and APAC. You'll build for time zones you aren't in, and document and train the team well enough that someone in each location can resolve issues independently.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- Minimum 5 years in endpoint, client, or IT systems engineering, including direct ownership of a macOS MDM environment at 1000+ devices.

- Deep hands-on Jamf experience, plus real Windows management experience via Intune, Autopilot, and Entra.

- Strong scripting and automation ability in Python, Bash, or Swift, with a track record of building tooling against vendor APIs rather than clicking through admin consoles.

- Working fluency with an IdP, Okta preferred, covering SSO, MFA, device trust, and how identity and endpoint policy interact.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, especially with non-technical teams.

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, and global environment.

BONUS POINTS:

- Experience running endpoint security tooling in a production environment - CrowdStrike or equivalent EDR, managed Chrome Enterprise, DLP.

- Endpoint work inside a compliance program (SOC 2, ISO 27001).

COMPENSATION

$153,000 - $210,500 USD

jobs.summary: Overview The ITSM Operations Administrator reports to the Sr Manager, IT Service Desk. This role administers, deploys, secures, maintains, and continuously optimizes the organization’s enterprise endpoint management environment, with a primary focus on...
jobs.description:
Overview

The ITSM Operations Administrator reports to the Sr Manager, IT Service Desk. This role administers, deploys, secures, maintains, and continuously optimizes the organization’s enterprise endpoint management environment, with a primary focus on Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID.

This role manages the lifecycle of corporate Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices, including enrollment, configuration, application deployment, compliance, operating system updates, vulnerability remediation, and device retirement.

The Endpoint Management Administrator partners closely with IT Support Services, Infrastructure, Information Security, Field Technology, and application owners to provide a secure, standardized, and reliable endpoint experience across corporate and property environments.

Key Responsibilities

Administer and maintain the Microsoft Intune environment

Create, test, deploy, and maintain Intune configuration profiles and policies

Manage Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices through Microsoft Intune

Maintain device enrollment profiles, enrollment restrictions, and device configuration standards

Monitor enrollment failures, device health, compliance status, and policy deployment results

Troubleshoot Intune synchronization, enrollment, configuration, and policy issues

Maintain appropriate role-based access and administrative permissions within the endpoint management environment

Review the environment regularly for opportunities to improve reliability, standardization, security, and automation

Manage Autopilot hardware hashes, device records, group tags, and deployment profiles

Configure and maintain Enrollment Status Page settings

Support standardized provisioning processes for laptops, desktops, and all-in-one devices

Troubleshoot Windows Out-of-Box Experience and Autopilot deployment failures

Maintain established device naming and provisioning standards

Support device wipe, reset, reimage, replacement, and reassignment processes

Package, test, deploy, update, and maintain applications through Microsoft Intune

Create and maintain Win32 application packages

Coordinate pilot and phased application deployments before broad production rollout

Publish approved applications to Company Portal when appropriate

Maintain application versions and retire outdated packages

Work with business and technical application owners to validate application functionality prior to production deployment

Troubleshoot application installation and deployment failures

Support the complete endpoint lifecycle from initial provisioning through retirement

Perform new device provisioning, enrollment, replacement, reassignment, wipe/reset, reimaging, retirement, and decommissioning.

Remove stale device records and maintain accurate device information within Intune and Entra ID

Follow established change management requirements for production endpoint changes

Maintain accurate technical documentation for endpoint configurations and processes

Serve as a technical escalation point for endpoint management issues that cannot be resolved through standard Service Desk troubleshooting

Provide escalation support for Intune enrollment failures, Windows Autopilot issues, application deployment failures, device compliance issues, configuration policy conflicts, Windows Update failures, Entra device registration issues, Company Portal issues, and device provisioning failures

Qualifications

Experience administering Microsoft Intune in an enterprise environment

Experience with Microsoft Entra ID

Experience managing Windows endpoints

Experience with Windows Autopilot

Experience packaging and deploying applications through Microsoft Intune

Experience creating and maintaining Intune configuration profiles and policies

Working knowledge of Active Directory and Group Policy

Experience troubleshooting Windows enrollment, configuration, and application deployment issues

Experience with Windows Update for Business

Working knowledge of endpoint security and compliance concepts

PowerShell scripting experience

Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills

Strong documentation and organizational skills

Ability to manage multiple deployments and technical initiatives simultaneously

Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with other IT teams

Critical Skills

Strong ownership and follow-through

Endpoint management expertise

Technical troubleshooting

Attention to detail

Security-focused decision-making

Change management discipline

Documentation skills

Effective communication

Ability to prioritize based on operational and security impact

Ability to independently manage assigned work through completion

Working Relationships

Will interact with all employees of Omni Hotels & Resorts on a regular basis, including IT and other cross-functional team members at the Corporate Offices and property locations.

Expectations

Work closely with IT Support Services, Information Security, Infrastructure, Field Technology, Network Engineering, application owners, property IT teams, Microsoft, and third-party vendors. Coordinate testing and deployments to minimize business disruption and ensure enterprise endpoint standards are followed

Responsibilities will require being on call and at times working off hours based on critical system outages, upgrades, etc.

No regular travel required.

EEOC is the Law Poster.

Omni Hotels & Resorts does not discriminate on the basis ofany protected category with respect to the payment of wages.

If you are interested in applying for employment with Omni Hotels & Resorts and need special assistance to apply for a posted position, please send an email to: applicationassistance@omnihotels.com.

Compensation depends on experience but is $75-115K plus bonus.

THIS ROLE IS ONSITE IN ANAHEIM, CA. 20% TRAVEL TO ONTARIO IS REQUIRED.

jobs.description:
About Gallatin

At Gallatin, we are rebuilding logistics infrastructure for the national security missions of the United States and allied partners. We build AI systems that determine how logistics decisions are made — not just how they're executed. From factory to foxhole, we operate at the layer where data becomes decisions, and decisions make the advantage.

About The Role

We’re looking for an IT Systems Engineer to help build and scale the systems Gallatin employees rely on every day.

As the second dedicated IT hire, you will work across endpoint engineering, identity and access management, SaaS administration, security and compliance, office infrastructure, automation, and employee support. You will own systems end to end and help define how IT operates as Gallatin grows.

This is a broad systems role with a strong endpoint focus. You should be able to operate across macOS, Windows, mobile, identity, and cloud applications, with hands-on experience in Jamf Pro, Microsoft Intune, Google Workspace, and Okta. Experience managing Windows devices and access controls in Microsoft 365 GCC High is especially important.

The level is flexible. We care more about technical judgment, ownership, and the ability to build reliable systems than a specific title or number of years.

What You'll Do

Build and Own Endpoint Management

Own the lifecycle of Gallatin’s macOS, Windows, and mobile environments, from enrollment through deprovisioning. Build and maintain Jamf Pro policies, profiles, packages, scripts, smart groups, compliance controls, and Self Service workflows. Implement and operate Windows device management through Microsoft Intune in GCC High. Design Google Workspace mobile application management controls for employee-owned devices. Automate provisioning, application deployment, patching, security baselines, inventory, and compliance reporting.

Scale Identity and Enterprise Systems

Own identity lifecycle workflows across Okta, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 GCC High, Slack, and other business-critical platforms. Automate onboarding, role changes, access reviews, and offboarding using APIs, scripts, and workflow tools. Design access controls around least privilege, device trust, role-based access, and data sensitivity. Administer and integrate Gallatin’s core productivity, collaboration, engineering, and business applications. Establish guardrails for enterprise AI tools and AI-enabled SaaS applications, including authentication, provisioning, data handling, retention, integrations, and audit logging. Partner with Security and Engineering to protect sensitive company and government data while enabling employees to use approved AI tools productively. Replace brittle manual processes with systems that are repeatable, observable, and difficult to misuse.

Strengthen and Operate the Environment

Translate CMMC, NIST 800-171, and other requirements into technical controls that work in practice. Build reliable device compliance, access enforcement, evidence collection, and audit-readiness workflows. Troubleshoot complex issues across endpoints, identity, SaaS applications, networking, authentication, and operating systems. Provide direct employee support while eliminating recurring failure modes through engineering and automation. Create clear documentation, runbooks, standards, and employee-facing guidance. Take ownership of unfamiliar problems and drive them through resolution.

What We’re Looking For

Experience as an IT Systems Engineer, Endpoint Engineer, Systems Administrator, or in a similarly broad technical role. Strong hands-on Okta administration, including SSO, MFA, application integrations, lifecycle management, and access policies. Strong hands-on management of macOS, Windows, and mobile devices using Jamf Pro, Microsoft Intune, and Google Workspace. Experience operating Microsoft 365 and Intune in GCC High or another regulated Microsoft cloud environment. Ability to independently design, implement, operate, and improve production IT systems. Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, networks, identity platforms, and cloud applications. Automation skills using Bash, PowerShell, Python, APIs, or workflow platforms. Understanding of identity lifecycle management, device trust, least privilege, conditional access, and role-based access. Strong communication, documentation, and judgment in fast-moving environments. Comfort operating in a small team where ownership is broad and outcomes matter more than organizational boundaries.

Bonus Points

Endpoint privilege management and application control. Enterprise browser management, secure web gateways, or SaaS security posture management. macOS Platform SSO or Windows Hello for Business. PKI, device certificates, and certificate lifecycle management. Configuration-as-code or infrastructure-as-code for corporate IT systems.

Mission and Identity

We are building the system that enables faster, smarter logistics decisions in contested environments, and we're doing it with a team of seasoned entrepreneurs, operators, and technologists who have built and scaled solutions in this space before. We hold ourselves to an extremely high standard. We value clear thinking, direct communication, and the kind of ownership that doesn't stop until something actually works.

Our mission is to create decision advantage when the stakes are the highest. If we succeed, the system doesn't just run; it gets smarter. We're not building AI for its own sake. We're building it because faster, smarter decisions in the most demanding environments on earth can't wait. If you want to work somewhere the stakes are real and the mission is urgent — you'll fit in here.

Why Gallatin?

The logistics infrastructure that supports America's warfighters and humanitarian disaster responders is overdue for transformation, and we are building it. From defense operations to disaster response, we're solving the hardest problems that keep missions moving when it matters most. Join a team where the mission is the point.

Compensation: Gallatin offers competitive compensation commensurate with experience. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location. In addition to base salary, we offer a generous equity grant, full healthcare coverage, 401k, unlimited PTO, and the perks of working in a high-caliber, mission-driven environment.

Gallatin is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

This position may require the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance. The successful candidate must be able to work in a classified environment when necessary.

We comply with the United States Department of Labor's Pay Transparency provision.

Note: Due to the nature of certain government contracts held by this organization, U.S. citizenship is a requirement for all positions at Gallatin. Proof of citizenship will be required prior to employment if selected.

jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale --- unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data --- securing and protecting private information more effectively --- Elastic's complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

**What is The Role:** The Elastic Security Endpoint Protections team builds the visibility, prevention, and on-device machine learning capabilities at the core of Elastic Defend, our endpoint and SIEM security solution. We work in kernel and user mode across Windows, macOS, and Linux, against adversaries who study how to defeat what we build. Our work reaches the security community as well as the product, through original research and conference talks. We are looking for a Senior Manager who has done this work personally and can still review a design or write code. You will lead a globally distributed team and set the tone for a group that values candid feedback, collaborative learning, and mentorship.

We believe security is a team sport, and our efficacy is independently verified rather than simply claimed: in recent third-party enterprise protection testing, Elastic Security earned a perfect malware protection score with zero false alarms, the top result in the field. If you are energized by leading world-class engineers and making a measurable dent in how the industry defends the endpoint, we would love to hear from you!

**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a world-class engineering team. Guide senior research engineers across endpoint internals, prevention engineering, and machine learning. Coach career development, deliver candid feedback, own the hiring pipeline, and set new engineers up to contribute quickly.
* Own the roadmap and drive delivery. Decide where to invest in new visibility and where to deepen existing protection engines, balancing efficacy, performance, and stability across millions of endpoints. Work with product managers to define requirements and land high-quality features on release timelines.
* Connect your team's work to the rest of Elastic Security. Every event source your team adds unlocks new detection and protection capabilities across the product. Invest in the joint planning, working relationships, and shared accountability that get your team's work into customers' hands.
* Direct the team's machine learning work. Set direction on model development, training data quality, and the telemetry features those models depend on, and connect that work to the broader machine learning strategy across Elastic Security.
* Drive cross-platform protection parity. Bring the depth Elastic has on Windows to macOS and Linux, keep the team ahead of new hardware architectures, and sustain the platform vendor relationships that give you early access to emerging operating system security APIs.
* Represent the team externally. Support your engineers in presenting at conferences and publishing on Elastic Security Labs, engage with customers and partners on protection capabilities, and be a credible voice for Elastic in the endpoint security community.

**What You Bring:**

* People-leadership experience managing senior technical individual contributors on a globally distributed team. You lead with curiosity rather than authority, actively solicit feedback, and have a track record of growing people, not just shipping releases.
* You have been a practitioner. Substantial hands-on experience as a security researcher before moving into leadership: analyzing attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), building the protections that counter them, and shipping into software that runs on customer machines at scale.
* Operating system internals knowledge, in both kernel and user mode, earned hands-on rather than through oversight, and deep enough to reason about undocumented behavior and challenge a design on its technical merits. Windows depth is what we need most, with macOS or Linux close behind.
* Hands-on reverse engineering and malware analysis experience. You have done this work yourself, and can still read a disassembly, assess a research finding on its merits, and judge which threats warrant investment.
* An adversarial instinct. You anticipate how a protection will be evaded before it ships, and hold the team to designing for resilience rather than for the proof of concept in front of them.
* Clear communication skills, comfortable writing for technical and executive audiences and distilling deeply technical work for non-expert stakeholders.
* Motivation to thrive in a distributed, autonomous environment, with a genuine passion for protecting customers from real-world adversaries.
* Demonstrated experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate feature development, debug complex systems, and optimize existing codebases.
* You possess the ability to comfortably rotate across projects, collaborate across functions and teams, and seamlessly adapt to evolving team structures.

**Bonus Points:**

* Prior ownership of an EDR, EPP, or other endpoint security product.
* Personal research output: published vulnerabilities, patents, in-depth technical writing, or conference talks.
* Experience leading machine learning engineers working on security problems.
* Experience partnering with product engineering teams to take research prototypes through to GA release.
* Conference speaking experience (e.g., Black Hat, DEF CON, CODE BLUE, Virus Bulletin).
* Familiarity with the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) and Elastic Security.

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:** As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you're looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn't matter if you're just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
* Generous number of vacation days each year
* Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
* Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
* Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

**Security \& Privacy Responsibilities:** Take ownership of protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of organizational data and systems by following applicable privacy and security policies, standards, and procedures. Ensure that all individual contributions follow Elastic's Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF). Proactively participate in mandatory role-based training to ensure personal technical execution consistently aligns with the highest standards of data protection, data privacy, and system resilience.

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Job Title: Windows Endpoint Engineer, Senior

Job Summary: The Windows Endpoint Engineer, Senior is responsible for managing and maintaining enterprise Windows-based endpoint environments using Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM), Microsoft Intune, and IBM BigFix for our NIH client. This role implements patching, application deployment, and system compliance to ensure secure and efficient workstation and laptop operations across the organization. The position serves as a Tier-3 escalation point, providing expert-level troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and advanced technical support for complex endpoint issues. Collaboration with the Client Security Team and Server Team is essential to support imaging, Group Policy management, and server patching initiatives. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical proficiency, hands-on experience with endpoint management platforms, and exceptional problem-solving and communication skills.

Key Responsibilities:

Endpoint Management and Administration

Administer, monitor, and maintain Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM), Microsoft Intune, and IBM BigFix to ensure comprehensive management of workstations and laptops across the enterprise.
Monitor system health and performance in Ivanti, Intune, and BigFix.
Track and manage incidents, service requests, and changes using Ivanti Service Manager, with proven ability and experience executing the same functions through Microsoft Intune.

Patching and Compliance

Implement Windows and third-party application patching using Ivanti and Intune, including testing, deployment, and compliance reporting.
Develop and maintain automated patching schedules across all platforms to ensure timely remediation of vulnerabilities and alignment with security policies.

Application Deployment and Configuration

Package and deploy applications via Ivanti, Intune, and BigFix, ensuring consistency and reliability across environments.
Provide assistance to the server team as needed in server image creation and deployment, software package creation and deployment, and server patching.
Collaborate with the Client Security Team on Group Policy Objects (GPOs), user profiles, imaging, and endpoint configurations within Active Directory.

Support and Troubleshooting

Serve as the final escalation point for complex end-user and Windows endpoint issues, providing Tier-3 technical support with advanced diagnostics, root cause analysis, and expert-level troubleshooting and resolution.
Troubleshoot endpoint connectivity, software deployment, and patching issues across distributed environments.

Documentation and Training

Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation for systems, processes, patching procedures, and configuration standards.
Facilitate hands-on training sessions for all staff members on Ivanti and Intune software, ensuring comprehensive understanding and effective usage.

Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field required; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Windows-based endpoint administration, desktop engineering, or systems management within a medium to large enterprise environment.

3+ years of experience with Ivanti products and solutions.
1+ years of experience with Intune products and solutions
2 – 3+ years of experience with BigFix products and solutions.

Certifications:

CompTIA Security+ (required)
Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (nice to have)

Hands-on experience providing mentorship and training.
Demonstrated expertise in troubleshooting Windows operating systems and executing software patching to ensure system stability and security.
Experienced in performing server patching and updates to maintain optimal performance and compliance across environments. (preferred)
Excellent communication and customer service skills.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

**Your Role** This role is designed for a JDE professional who enjoys connecting functional Order Management, Hardware Tracking, Supply Chain, Finance, and Master Data expertise, and global or regional transformation initiatives. The position will provide visibility across enterprise data governance, business process standardization, rollouts, upgrades, and continuous improvement for JDE-enabled operations.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Master Data Management (MDM) Functional Lead with deep expertise in JD Edwards ERP to oversee and drive the management, governance, and optimization of master data within our organization. The ideal candidate will have extensive knowledge of MDM best practices, with hands-on experience in implementing and supporting master data processes, workflows, and system integrations specifically within JD Edwards. The MDM Functional Lead will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity, while providing functional guidance and support for the ongoing evolution of master data processes to meet business needs.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead the functional design and implementation of Master Data Management (MDM) processes within JD Edwards, ensuring data consistency, accuracy, and integrity across the organization. Including item, customer, supplier, product, inventory, sales order, purchasing, and manufacturing-related master data touchpoints where applicable.
* Act as the primary point of contact for MDM strategy, governance, and best practices within the JD Edwards ERP ecosystem, ensuring alignment with global business requirements.
* Define and document data management standards, processes, and workflows for key master data domains, including customers, suppliers, materials, and products within JD Edwards. Extend the scope to distribution, supply chain, inventory, sales order management, purchasing, manufacturing, and finance data touchpoints that depend on accurate and governed master data.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders (e.g., supply chain, finance, IT) to understand business requirements and translate them into functional specifications for MDM solutions. Strong cross-functional facilitation translating business needs into practical JDE functional designs.
* Configure and maintain master data processes within JD Edwards, including data creation, updates, and deletions, ensuring seamless integration between JD Edwards and other systems.
* Ensure data governance, quality, and compliance by implementing controls, policies, and procedures for managing master data in alignment with organizational objectives.
* Lead the data migration efforts for master data when migrating from legacy systems into JD Edwards, ensuring data integrity and completeness.
* Develop and maintain MDM reporting and analytics within JD Edwards to track master data health and compliance with established standards.
* Manage the integration of JD Edwards with other systems (e.g., CRM, PLM, third-party applications) to ensure master data flows seamlessly across the enterprise.
* Collaborate with the technical team to define and manage integration points, ensuring accurate and efficient data synchronization between JD Edwards and external systems.
* Contribute functional and technical JDE expertise to reporting, development-tool related analysis, issue resolution, and data-related enhancements, partnering with technical teams when required.
* Provide Subject Matter Expert leadership across JD Edwards EnterpriseOne/World environments, helping translate lessons learned from global and regional deployments into scalable MDM practices.
* Partner on project planning and execution activities using structured delivery practices and collaboration tools to support on-time milestones, stakeholder alignment, and business readiness.
* Provide functional support and training to business users, ensuring effective usage of the MDM processes within JD Edwards and driving continuous improvements.
* Ensure compliance with internal standards and regulatory requirements regarding master data management, ensuring that all data is maintained in a secure, compliant, and auditable manner.
* Lead initiatives for data quality improvements, identifying areas for enhancement, automating processes where possible, and optimizing data-related workflows to support business decision-making. Use hands-on reporting and analytical experience to make master data quality, compliance, and process adoption visible to business and IT stakeholders.
* Manage MDM projects, working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure on-time and on-budget delivery of MDM-related initiatives.
* Provide practical end-user training, hypercare support, and process coaching to drive adoption and sustainable improvements across regions.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Data Management, or a related field.
* At least 5 years of hands-on experience working with JD Edwards ERP, specifically in the management of master data across multiple domains (customers, suppliers, products, etc.).
* Proven expertise in Master Data Management practices, including data governance, data quality, and data integration within an ERP environment.
* Experience with JD Edwards 9.2 or later versions, including the configuration and management of master data modules.
* Ability to create functional specifications for system requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions for MDM processes.
* Proven track record in data migration, ensuring the successful transition of data from legacy systems to JD Edwards ERP.
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks and industry best practices for maintaining master data integrity and quality.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to assess the quality of master data and implement solutions to address data issues.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with business and technical teams.
* Experience in project management, particularly in leading MDM-related projects or ERP system upgrades and enhancements.
* Knowledge of data analytics and reporting tools to monitor and improve master data quality and compliance.
* Ability to provide functional training and support to end-users, helping them understand the importance of master data and ensuring adoption of MDM practices.
* Experience with data cleansing, enrichment, and validation processes, with the ability to identify and resolve data quality issues proactively.
* A solid understanding of data security and compliance requirements related to master data management.

jobs.description:
Description

We are looking for an experienced Systems Administrator III to support and enhance a complex enterprise technology environment. This role is ideal for a hands-on infrastructure specialist who can manage Windows-based systems, strengthen identity and access services, and contribute to reliable IT operations across both on-premises and cloud platforms. The successful candidate will bring strong technical judgment, practical scripting ability, and a proactive approach to system performance, security, and continuity.

Responsibilities:
Administer and maintain Windows server and desktop environments to ensure stable, secure, and efficient day-to-day operations.
Manage identity and access services across on-premises Active Directory, Group Policy, and Entra ID to support user lifecycle and policy enforcement.
Develop and use PowerShell scripts to automate routine administration, streamline support tasks, and improve operational consistency.
Support a broad Microsoft ecosystem that may include Intune, Azure, SharePoint, virtualization platforms, SaaS applications, and endpoint management tools.
Monitor infrastructure health, troubleshoot technical issues, and resolve escalated incidents involving systems, access, performance, and connectivity.
Contribute to IT planning by recommending infrastructure improvements, aligning technical solutions with operational goals, and supporting long-term system strategy.
Apply best practices for security, storage, backup, disaster recovery, and data protection to strengthen resilience and reduce operational risk.
Assist with advanced infrastructure technologies such as clustering, Hyper-V, and related Microsoft platform services when required.

Requirements

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
At least 5 years of systems administration experience in a Windows-centric enterprise environment.
Advanced knowledge of current Windows operating systems, including server and desktop administration.
Strong hands-on experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, and Entra ID in hybrid environments.
Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation, administration, and troubleshooting.
Experience supporting technologies such as Microsoft Windows Server, Windows 10, Azure, Intune, SharePoint, VMware, SaaS platforms, or comparable infrastructure tools.
Solid understanding of IT operations best practices, including security controls, storage management, backup processes, cloud services, and disaster recovery.
Strong communication, organization, and planning skills with the ability to document work clearly and collaborate across teams.

As a Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer within the Networking organization, you will spearhead the development of innovative services in the Networking Automation & Health domain to enable AI super clusters. This initiative involves building a robust software stack from the ground up to monitor and manage network infrastructure, automatically resolve network issues, and ensure high bandwidth with low-latency connections essential for AI workloads. You will assemble and lead a team that combines software engineering excellence with network control expertise, collaborating with senior technical leaders to design and deliver solutions to complex and impactful challenges.

This is an exciting and transformative time for us. We are rapidly growing, still in the early stages, and driving ambitious initiatives such as network control plane development, network health monitoring, and auto-recovery services. We are seeking an experienced engineer with a deep understanding of systems design and distributed systems to build scalable, high-performance solutions.

This role is based out of Nashville, TN.

jobs.description:
Role: Digital Workplace Architect

Work Location: Houston, TX (3 days onsite minimum)

Number of Positions: 1

Position Type: Full-Time / Exempt — Senior Individual Contributor

Reports To: Senior Director, Enterprise Applications

Department: Information Technology

US CITIZENS AND GREEN CARD HOLDERS ARE ENCOURAGED TO APPLY. WE ARE UNABLE TO PROVIDE SPONSORSHIP AT THIS TIME.

LOCAL CANDIDATES ONLY OR THOSE WILLING TO RELOCATE AT OWN EXPENSE. THERE WILL BE NO RELOCATION ASSISTANCE PROVIDED.

JOB SUMMARY

Our client is an organization operating in a regulated, industrial environment with field-operations and distributed workforce needs. The company relies on enterprise-grade Microsoft 365 collaboration and productivity platforms to enable secure, scalable communication, knowledge management, and AI-driven productivity across its workforce.

The Digital Workplace Architect owns the organization's Microsoft 365 collaboration and productivity ecosystem, including SharePoint Online, Teams, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Search, and Power Platform governance. This role establishes secure, scalable standards for collaboration, AI enablement, automation, records, external sharing, and workforce productivity.

REQUIREMENTS

· Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or related discipline; equivalent experience considered.

· Demonstrated hands-on experience architecting, administering, engineering, and supporting enterprise Microsoft 365 solutions, including SharePoint Online, Teams, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Power Platform governance.

· Strong knowledge of SharePoint information architecture, permissions, search, content management, governance, and site lifecycle.

· Ability to translate business requirements into practical architectures, technical standards, implementation plans, and operating models.

· Proficiency with PowerShell and working knowledge of Microsoft Graph, APIs, integration patterns, and automation.

· Excellent communication, facilitation, prioritization, influence, and execution skills.

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience in a regulated, industrial, or field-operations environment.

· Experience establishing centers of excellence, champion programs, citizen-developer guardrails, or enterprise adoption programs.

· Relevant Microsoft certifications such as MS-102, SC-100, SC-400, or current Microsoft Copilot and AI credentials.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Microsoft 365 Architecture & Strategy

· Own the Microsoft 365 collaboration roadmap, reference architectures, technical standards, and lifecycle strategy.

· Architect secure, scalable solutions across SharePoint Online, Teams, Microsoft Search, Copilot, and approved integrations.

SharePoint Online, Content & Knowledge Architecture

· Serve as the primary technical authority for SharePoint Online architecture, administration, and modernization.

· Design information architecture, hub structures, taxonomy, metadata, content types, search, permissions, and provisioning standards.

· Govern SharePoint site creation, ownership, external sharing, guest access, and lifecycle standards.

· Lead content migration and modernization efforts while keeping content organized, discoverable, secure, and governed.

Microsoft 365 Copilot & AI Enablement

· Lead readiness, governance, architecture, and adoption for Microsoft 365 Copilot.

· Assess permissions hygiene, oversharing risk, search quality, retention controls, and compliance readiness before AI enablement.

· Define standards for Copilot usage, AI-enabled solutions, enterprise search, approved connectors, and future agent governance.

· Partner with stakeholders to prioritize high-value AI use cases while balancing innovation, security, governance, and business value.

Governance, Security, Compliance & Risk

· Partner with Cybersecurity, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Records Management to define and enforce governance.

· Design controls for least-privilege administration, access reviews, external collaboration, guest access, and permissions governance.

· Own Power Platform governance standards and identify security, operational, legal, privacy, and governance risks.

Engineering, Automation & Operational Excellence

· Use PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, APIs, administrative portals, and automation to improve governance, reporting, maintenance, and operations.

· Perform discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and operational transition activities.

· Define monitoring, resiliency, release management, support requirements, and service health standards.

· Create documentation, mentor administrators and citizen developers, and promote governed adoption and platform standardization.

BENEFITS

Medical, dental, vision, coverage in addition to life and disability insurance plans.Paid Vacation Days and Paid Holidays.Retirement and Savings (401K) Plan with Company match.Referral bonus with no cap on amount of referrals.Paid Training.

jobs.description:
WHAT IS BOX?

Box(NYSE: BOX)は インテリジェントコンテンツ管理（ICM）プラットフォームのリーディングカンパニーです。Boxのプラットフォームは、企業のコラボレーション促進や、コンテンツのライフサイクル全体の管理、重要なコンテンツの保護、そしてエンタープライズAIによるビジネスワークフローの変革を実現することを目指しています。2005年に米国で設立され、JLL、モルガン・スタンレーなどを含む大手グローバル企業や、日本では23,000社超および日経225の86%の企業の業務効率化を支援しています。

Boxは、カリフォルニア州レッドウッドシティーに本社を置き、米国、ヨーロッパ、アジアにも拠点を持っています。株式会社Box Japanは2013年に設立された日本法人です。

Boxでは、重要なコンテンツを扱うプラットフォームをさらに推進し、お客様の働き方に大きな変革を提供する、またとない機会があります。コンテンツは私達の業務の中心にあります。契約書、請求書、社員情報、財務情報、製品仕様、マーケティング資産などの部署間に跨る重要なビジネス・プロセスに含まれる数十億ものファイルや情報が日々流れています。私達のミッションは、コンテンツ管理にインテリジェンスをもたらし、お客様がデジタル・トランスフォーメーションを実現するお手伝いをさせていただくことです。このAIと膨大な業務コンテンツの融合による、大規模な働き方の変革期に、そのビジネスの最前線に貢献することが、Boxではできます。

WHY BOX NEEDS YOU

Box Japan は、日本企業のコンテンツ活用と AI 活用を次のステージへ進めるフェーズにあります。 Enterprise Solutions Engineer は、経営・ IT ・現場それぞれの課題を理解し、 Box のプラットフォーム価値を業務成果に結びつける技術パートナーです。

西日本エリアの民間大手企業（従業員数2000名以上）を担当するEnterprise Solutions Engineeringチーム の一員として、営業、カスタマーサクセス、プロフェッショナルサービス、パートナーと連携し、構想策定から技術検証、導入、定着・拡張までお客様の変革を支援します。

- 経営／業務課題に紐づくデモ、ワークショップ、テクニカルディスカッション

- PoC 、パイロット、アーキテクチャ設計、価値検証のリード

- RFP 対応、セキュリティ・コンプライアンス監査、 AI 利用ガバナンスの支援

- お客様の声をプロダクトマネジメント／エンジニアリングへ届け、改善を推進

単なる製品説明ではなく、コンテンツを起点に AI ・ワークフロー・セキュリティを組み合わせ、お客様の意思決定、業務効率、リスク低減をどう実現するかを描くポジションです。

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Enteprise顧客の 経営層、 IT 部門、業務部門、パートナーとの対話を通じて課題と成功指標を整理し、技術的な知見を交えた提案を行う

- Box AI、AI エージェント、 AI Studio 、検索／ Deep Research 、データ抽出、ワークフロー自動化を含むユースケースを設計し、デモ・ワークショップ・提案資料・プレゼンテーションに落とし込む

- Microsoft 365／Teams、Salesforce、Google Workspace、Slack、ServiceNow 等の業務アプリや、お客様のカスタムアプリケーションとの連携を設計・支援する

- コンテンツの分類、アクセス制御、脅威対策、監査、データレジデンシーなど、 Enterprise のセキュリティ／ガバナンス要件に沿った提案を行う

- 担当営業、 CSM 、コンサルタント、パートナーとアカウントチームを組み、導入後の定着・利活用・拡張まで見据えた計画と実行をリードする

- API、SDK、MCP 等の開発者向け機能やエコシステムを活用し、 Box をお客様の業務基盤・ AI 基盤に組み込むための技術支援を行う

Box ではコミュニティと対面でのコラボレーションを重要視していてます。Box の社員（Boxers）は、少なくとも毎週3日間以上はオフィスで勤務することが求められます。選考プロセスの中で、リクルーターが働き方や企業文化についてさらに詳しくご説明します。

WHO YOU ARE

私たちは「AIファースト」の企業です。
すなわち、常に成長マインドセットを持ちながら仕事に取り組み、AIを活用し、より迅速かつ適切な意思決定を行い、インパクトを高める方法を見つけていくことが求められます。

- 5 年以上の IT 業界経験、かつ 2 年以上のプリセールス、ソリューションアーキテクト、 IT コンサルティング、またはプロジェクトマネジメント経験

- クラウド、 SaaS 、インフラ、アプリケーション、データ、セキュリティのいずれかに関する実務知識

- お客様の曖昧な課題を構造化し、価値仮説、技術アーキテクチャ、導入ステップまで自ら描ける方

- API、OAuth／SSO、SaaS 連携、ワークフロー自動化、生成 AI／AI エージェントに関する知識または強い関心

- 大手企業への提案、複数ステークホルダーとの合意形成、またはパートナー／アライアンス協業の経験

- ビジネス使用が可能な流暢レベル以上の日本語力

- 読み書き可能レベル以上の英語力

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation.

For details on how we protect your information when you apply, please see our Personnel Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Técnico/a SCCM/INTUNE
jobs.summary: Buscamos un Técnico/a de Administración de Endpoints con al menos 3 años de experiencia en entornos Microsoft Endpoint Management, especializado en SCCM (Microsoft Configuration Manager) e Intune. Será responsable de la administración, mantenimiento y...
jobs.description:
Buscamos un Técnico/a de Administración de Endpoints con al menos 3 años de experiencia en entornos Microsoft Endpoint Management, especializado en SCCM (Microsoft Configuration Manager) e Intune. Será responsable de la administración, mantenimiento y evolución de la plataforma de gestión de dispositivos, garantizando el despliegue seguro y eficiente de sistemas operativos, aplicaciones y políticas corporativas. Las funciones están alineadas con actividades de despliegue, empaquetado, distribución de software y gestión del ciclo de vida del puesto de trabajo identificadas en documentación interna.

Las responsabilidades principales del puesto son las siguientes:

* Administración y soporte de plataformas SCCM y Microsoft Intune.
* Gestión del ciclo de vida de dispositivos Windows.
* Despliegue y distribución de aplicaciones mediante SCCM e Intune.
* Creación, validación y mantenimiento de paquetes de software.
* Administración de políticas de configuración y cumplimiento (Compliance Policies).
* Implementación y mantenimiento de Configuration Profiles.
* Gestión de Windows Update for Business y despliegue de actualizaciones.
* Soporte en proyectos de migración de SCCM hacia Intune y Modern Workplace.
* Diagnóstico y resolución de incidencias relacionadas con la gestión de endpoints.
* Automatización de tareas mediante PowerShell.
* Elaboración y mantenimiento de documentación técnica.
* Coordinación con equipos de soporte, seguridad y workplace.

Requisitos obligatorios

Experiencia

* Mínimo 3 años administrando SCCM y/o Microsoft Intune.
* Experiencia en despliegue de aplicaciones y sistemas operativos.
* Experiencia en troubleshooting de entornos Windows empresariales.
* Experiencia en gestión de inventario hardware y software.

Conocimientos técnicos

* Microsoft SCCM / MECM.
* Microsoft Intune.
* Microsoft Endpoint Manager.
* Windows 10 y Windows 11.
* Azure AD / Entra ID.
* Microsoft 365.
* PowerShell.
* Gestión de GPOs y su transición a políticas modernas de Intune.
* Compliance Policies y Security Baselines.
* Conocimientos de Autopilot (muy valorables).

Requisitos valorables

* Experiencia en proyectos de migración SCCM → Intune.
* Conocimientos de Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
* Certificaciones Microsoft:
*

* MD-102 Endpoint Administrator.

* AZ-104 Azure Administrator.

* MS-102 Microsoft 365 Administrator.
* Experiencia en integración con ServiceNow.
* Conocimientos de Nexthink u otras soluciones DEX.

Competencias personales

* Capacidad analítica y de resolución de problemas.
* Orientación al cliente y al servicio.
* Capacidad de documentación y organización.
* Trabajo en equipo y colaboración multidisciplinar.
* Proactividad e iniciativa.
* Capacidad para trabajar en entornos internacionales.

Perfil ideal

Profesional con experiencia sólida en la administración de SCCM e Intune, habituado a gestionar grandes volúmenes de dispositivos corporativos, despliegues masivos de software, automatización mediante PowerShell y proyectos de modernización del puesto de trabajo basados en Microsoft 365 y Endpoint Management.

jobs.title: Analista de Segurança da Informação - foco em Endpoint (Operação)
jobs.summary: **Sobre a empresa:** Há 20 anos, a XSITE atua com soluções em Segurança da Informação, ajudando empresas a proteger seus ambientes digitais com inteligência, zelo e conexão. Mais do que integrar produtos e serviços, cultivamos relações de confiança com...
jobs.description:
**Sobre a empresa:** Há 20 anos, a XSITE atua com soluções em Segurança da Informação, ajudando empresas a proteger seus ambientes digitais com inteligência, zelo e conexão.

Mais do que integrar produtos e serviços, cultivamos relações de confiança com nossos clientes. Chamamos esse espaço de Território de Proteção: um ambiente onde a segurança da informação permite que as empresas trabalhem com tranquilidade, foco e produtividade.

Nosso propósito é simples e poderoso: proporcionar paz para o ambiente corporativo.

Nossa cultura é inspirada no conceito Teknoporã, uma adaptação do "bem viver", que conecta tecnologia, equilíbrio e colaboração. Acreditamos em relações de parceria, respeito e confiança, dentro e fora da empresa.

Aqui, nos vemos como uma tribo de guardiões digitais, profissionais que unem conhecimento, atitude e conexão para proteger o ambiente digital dos nossos clientes com leveza, responsabilidade e excelência técnica.

Se você acredita que tecnologia também pode ser humana, colaborativa e feita com propósito, a XSITE pode ser o seu lugar 🌳✨

**Descrição da vaga:** Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados que queiram se desenvolver na área de Segurança da Informação e evoluir sua carreira em um ambiente inovador e colaborativo!

Foco da vaga: Endpoint Security para atuar na proteção de estações de trabalho e servidores contra ameaças avançadas, no nosso time de Operações (MSSP/SOC).

**Principais Atividades**

* Gerenciamento e Proteção de Endpoints:
* Administração e configuração de soluções de segurança para endpoints (EPP, EDR, XDR).
* Monitoramento e resposta a incidentes relacionados a malwares, ransomware e ameaças avançadas.
* Aplicação de políticas de segurança para controle de acesso, firewall local e regras de execução de aplicações.
* Gerenciamento de soluções como Cortex XDR, CrowdStrike, Trellix, FortiClient, entre outras.
* Investigação e mitigação de incidentes de segurança em endpoints corporativos.
* Detecção e Resposta a Ameaças:
* Implementação de estratégias de Threat Hunting e análise de comportamento de ameaças.
* Uso de ferramentas de SIEM/SOAR para correlacionar eventos e automatizar respostas a incidentes.
* Análise e criação de regras personalizadas para aumentar a eficácia das soluções de segurança.
* Gerenciamento de Vulnerabilidades e Correção:
* Aplicação de melhores práticas de hardening em sistemas operacionais Windows, Linux e macOS.
* Análise e priorização de vulnerabilidades detectadas em endpoints, alinhando-se a frameworks como MITRE ATT\&CK.
* Suporte na implementação de políticas de patch management e controle de versões de software.
* Controle de Acesso e Proteção de Identidades:
* Integração de soluções de segurança de endpoints com ferramentas de Identity \& Access Management (IAM).
* Aplicação de políticas de Zero Trust para minimizar riscos de credenciais comprometidas.
* Monitoramento de acessos suspeitos e prevenção de movimentações laterais dentro da rede.

**Principais Requisitos**

* Graduação completa na área de TI;
* Experiência na administração de soluções de Endpoint Security;
* Conhecimento em proteção contra ameaças avançadas e resposta a incidentes;
* Experiência com soluções de EPP, EDR e XDR;
* Familiaridade com frameworks de segurança como MITRE ATT\&CK, NIST e CIS Controls;
* Capacidade de trabalhar com diferentes ferramentas de segurança de ponta.

**Jornada De Trabalho**

* Segunda a sexta-feira das 08h às 17h (com 1 hora de intervalo);
* Presencial nos 3 primeiros meses (a partir do 4º mês, híbrido).

**Benefícios**

* - Cartão flexível (uso livre): Alimentação: R$ 32,14/dia + Transporte: R$ 23,60/dia;
* - Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (Cobertura de 70% para o colaborador titular e 50% para o primeiro dependente);
* - Auxílio Internet;
* - Bonificação mensal (baseada no Plano de Conformidade Operacional);
* - Premiação trimestral (OKR);
* - Planejamento de capacitação e certificações;
* - Incentivo ao curso de inglês (50%);
* - Plano de Carreira.

Salário: a combinar

Contrato: CLT (Efetivo)

jobs.title: MDM Sales Manager – Tijuana (M/F)
jobs.summary: With 1,700 employees and 14 factories across 3 continents, STERIMED is the world's leading manufacturer of materials and packaging systems for the sterilization of medical devices. Sterimed develops, produces, converts, and markets various solutions such...
jobs.description:
With 1,700 employees and 14 factories across 3 continents, STERIMED is the world's leading manufacturer of materials and packaging systems for the sterilization of medical devices. Sterimed develops, produces, converts, and markets various solutions such as bacterial barrier substrates and preformed sterilization packaging, serving both hospitals and medical device manufacturers.

Sterimed stands out with its strong entrepreneurial DNA and has been pursuing a highly dynamic external growth policy for several years. Since its founding in 2016, the group's size has quadrupled, and 10 acquisitions have been completed since 2017.

To support this growth, we are looking for a Sales Manager M/F for our MDM business. Reporting to the MDM Sales Team Leader Americas, the role will be responsible for managing, developing, and closing profitable new business across Tijuana, the Mexican maquiladora, and the U.S. West Coast. This is a remote role based in Tijuana, Mexico.

The primary focus of this role is selling medical packaging solutions to medical device manufacturers while also managing and expanding an existing portfolio of strategic customer accounts. In addition to new busi-ness development, the role has a strong key account management dimension, ensuring long-term custom-er growth, satisfaction, and partnership. To successfully manage this portfolio, the Sales Manager fosters alignment and effective collaboration across the regional sales organization.

This position requires a strong commercial mindset, excellent prospecting skills, and the ability to convert business opportunities into sustainable and profitable orders. The Sales Manager works closely with cus-tomers, internal technical teams, and key stakeholders to support product validation, strengthen strategic customer relationships, identify growth opportunities within existing accounts, and drive order intake and market expansion.

The ideal candidate will be a collaborative and transparent team player who can operate successfully in a multicultural, cross-border environment. This role also requires strong project management skills, the ability to build annual sales forecasts and budgets, and a commitment to delivering results in a dynamic, international business setting.

The position involves frequent travel throughout the assigned territory, including Tijuana, Mexico, the Mexican maquiladora, and the U.S. West Coast, as well as occasional travel to France for company seminars and business meetings.

**Responsibilities and Duties**

• Grow sales within the assigned territory of Tijuana, the Mexican maquiladora, and the U.S. West Coast.

• Develop new business opportunities with medical device manufacturers.

• Manage and expand an existing customer portfolio.

• Prospect actively to identify and convert new commercial opportunities.

• Support product validation projects in coordination with customers and the technical department.

• Act as the link between customers and internal stakeholders to ensure effective communication and follow-up.

• Turn business opportunities into profitable orders.

• Build annual sales budgets based on customer forecasts and new business opportunities.

• Maintain accurate reporting and CRM updates.

• Apply company marketing and commercial policies consistently.

• Travel regularly within the territory and occasionally internationally as required.

**Qualifications**

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, International Trade, Business Negotiation, Packaging En-gineering, or a related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an export sales or B2B sales position.

• Experience in medical sterile packaging is preferred; experience in general packaging or food packaging will also be considered.

• Strong understanding of sales processes, customer development, and account management.

• Experience working with technical or project-based sales cycles is an asset.

**Skills and Competencies**

• Strong prospecting and business development skills.

• Excellent negotiation and communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and customer projects simultaneously.

• Strong reporting, planning, and forecasting capabilities.

• Proficiency in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and CRM tools.

• Knowledge of Incoterms is preferred.

• Able to work effectively in an international and multicultural environment.

• Customer-focused, proactive, self-driven, and results-oriented.

• Strong relationship-building and problem-solving abilities.

• Adaptable and eager to learn about a new industry or market segment.

**Language Requirement**

• Bilingual in English and Spanish is required.

**Travel Requirement**

• Travel approximately 50% to 70% of the time within the assigned territory.

• Occasional travel outside of territory but within the Americas and France for company seminars or business meetings.

*Sterimed is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible work environment. Feel free to let us know about any accommodations you may need to participate in the recruitment process.*
