jobs.description:
Are you looking for a role where you're critical to every part of the business? Do you want to help ensure that our teams deliver software so that our analysts can deliver service to our customers? How about being a crucial part of making sure our internal teams operate efficiently?

You're not afraid of new technology. In fact, you love diving in and figuring out how it works. Whether it's a successful launch or a few bumps in the road, you're always up for a challenge. Balancing multiple projects at once is no easy feat, but when everything clicks into place, there's nothing quite like that sense of satisfaction.

The best part of the job? Seeing someone use a capability you've built and hearing them exclaim, "Wow, I can't believe how easy that was." You care about the success of your colleagues and take pride in helping them achieve it.

As a cloud-based IT organization, we're breaking the traditional mold and thinking creatively about how we can make the day-to-day life of our employees simple. We're always looking for innovative solutions, and we need someone with the wit and determination to help us achieve our goals.

In this role, you'll keep Expel's IT infrastructure and services secure and highly available, from our cloud platforms all the way down to the equipment in our conference rooms. You'll manage access across the employee lifecycle, own large cross-functional projects from beginning to end, and take manual work out of how we operate before anyone feels the friction. It's based onsite at our Herndon, Virginia headquarters, so you'll also be the person who makes sure the technology people walk up and touch works exactly like it should.

If you're up for the challenge, we want to hear from you!

* * *

### **What Expel Can Do For You**

- Provide the autonomy to define problems and propose solutions.
- Deliver never-ending opportunities to tackle business problems.
- Give you real ownership of large cross-functional projects, end to end.
- Surround you with a team of problem solvers.
- Ensure you get support, mentoring, and feedback to make you successful.

* * *

### **What You Can Do For Expel**

- Manage and maintain IT systems in a cloud first environment.
- Provide friendly and unflappable technical support.
- Make sure new hires have the accounts, access, and hardware they need on day one, and that access goes away promptly when people leave.
- Be the point of contact for the systems and services you own.
- Own large cross-functional projects from beginning to end.
- Collaborate with multi-functional teams to identify integration issues, solve errors, and optimize performance.
- Proactively find opportunities for improvement and build automations that streamline operations and reduce manual work.
- Apply AI tooling, like Claude and Gemini, to accelerate day-to-day work.
- Manage IT-owned technology at Expel's HQ, including network equipment, conference room and AV equipment, kiosk computers, and other shared-space systems.
- Keep people in the loop on service disruptions and changes.
- Work alongside our security team to protect our information.
- Contribute to the team's roadmap and work in two week sprints against quarterly and yearly goals.
- Build and routinely update documentation on automations, configurations, and operating procedures.

* * *

### **What You Should Bring With You**

- Proficiency managing core enterprise SaaS products such as Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft 365.
- Experience automating tasks and integrating systems using platforms like Workato, Okta Workflows, or Microsoft Power Automate.
- Experience with AI platforms like Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini, including prompt engineering and connecting systems through emerging standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Knowledge of concepts like SAML, OIDC, SCIM, REST APIs, webhooks, JWT, and OAuth 2.0.
- Knowledge of programming and scripting languages like Python, Bash, PowerShell, and Ruby.
- macOS and Windows operating system administration skills, including experience with MDMs like Jamf and Intune.
- Familiarity with conference room AV and shared-space technology, like Zoom Rooms and Neat devices.
- Knowledge of Cisco Meraki and basic networking concepts like VLANs, DNS, DHCP, and wireless networking.
- Strong project management skills, especially on large cross-functional projects.
- Capacity to balance a mix of urgent, interrupt-driven tasks and project-level work.
- Excellent customer service and communication skills, written and verbal, with a habit of treating colleagues like customers.
- Adept at translating technical concepts and communicating to non-technical audiences.
- Outstanding problem solving abilities, with a desire to get to the root of sophisticated issues.
- Well-versed in IT operations best practices.
- 5+ years of professional experience with IT, 2+ of which were in an engineering or sysadmin capacity.
- A college degree or credible panache.

* * *

### **Additional Notes**

This is an onsite, in-person role working out of our headquarters in Herndon, Virginia. Individuals must be located within the Washington D.C. metropolitan area.

The base salary range for this role is between $93,900 USD and $136,200 USD + bonus eligibility and equity. While the full salary band reflects our long-term compensation framework, we're primarily targeting candidates between $105,000 and $125,000 based on experience, skills, and market data.

You’ll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We’re only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We’ll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

#LI-Onsite

$93,900—$136,200 USD

Join us in shaping the future of IT security, developing secure and sustainable endpoint architectures, and actively contributing to making our digital workplace resilient and compliant. With us, you’ll have the freedom to contribute big ideas and take initiative. As part of an interdisciplinary and diverse team, you’ll apply your expertise in endpoint management to ambitious projects, help shape standards and roadmaps, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are reliably implemented in accordance with BSI-CON-11.1. We look forward to receiving your application for our office in Málaga.

Due to the international scope of the role, working hours are not fixed and may include evening, night, weekend, or rotating shifts, depending on the regions being supported.

Key responsibilities

- Developing and designing a highly secure endpoint management environment with clear target architectures and standards

- Leading endpoint management projects from planning through design to implementation, as well as actively participating in project teamwork

- Ensuring that security, compliance, and regulatory requirements (e.g., in accordance with guidelines from the Federal Office for Information Security, including BSI-CON-11.1) are met in the endpoint architectures

- Managing external service providers and coordinating the interfaces between IT security, infrastructure, and operations

- Evaluating and implementing new solutions and technologies in the endpoint environment to continuously improve the IT workstations

- Degree in computer science, business informatics, or a comparable qualification in the IT field

- At least 5 years of professional experience in endpoint management (operations and/or architecture) in medium-sized or large IT environments

- Good knowledge of common endpoint management tools, ideally such as Microsoft Intune and Tanium

- In-depth understanding of IT security, compliance, and regulatory requirements, preferably in regulated environments and in accordance with BSI guidelines

- A structured, independent work style, as well as strong communication and collaboration skills

- Willingness to undergo a security clearance screening in accordance with the Security Clearance Act (SÜG)

- A high level of English is required (C1)

- To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working

- We promote your professional and personal development through individually tailored student mentoring

- Make valuable contacts within Drees & Sommer and expand your professional network

- Modern workplace and equipment; Teams meetings and participation in corporate workshops

- Receive compensation that gives you financial independence during your studies

Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let’s create a world we want to live in.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

IT SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR, LAUNCH

SpaceX is looking for a highly skilled and knowledgeable IT Systems Administrator to support the networking, compute administration, and application support needs of our launch environment. This role will be pivotal to the enablement of safe and sustained launch cadence, directly supporting our goals of making humanity a multiplanetary species. Candidate must be comfortable working on mission-critical systems with a sense of urgency appropriate to the responsibilities while maintaining attention to detail and operational excellence.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Augment and deploy new IT infrastructure, including networking, server, and desktop hardware directly supporting mission critical networks across the country.

- Perform periodic systems upgrades and patches in between critical operations, sometimes on weekends and evenings.

- Monitor IT services and respond aggressively to incidents to maintain systems performance.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to proactively identify and resolve potential technical issues with systems deployments.

- Author and maintain documentation for IT systems, from systems overview documents and design drawings to procedures.

- Leverage automation tools and contribute to IT systems engineering efforts.

- Ensure that systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g. ITAR, ISO, NIST).

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

- 3+ years of experience in IT systems administration.

- Hands-on experience with Linux or Windows server administration.

- Experience with enterprise network administration and deployment.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Working knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, NTP, PTP etc), firewalls administration and cybersecurity technologies.

- Proficiency in scripting (Bash/Powershell/Python) and automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet).

- Familiarity with Active Directory and multi-platform authentication/identification environments.

- Experience with virtualization platforms and tools.

- Understanding of Layer 1 configuration best practices and multiplexing technologies.

- Working knowledge, including the ability to setup, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot, Windows-based systems and services (i.e. SCCM, Active Directory).

- Exposure to real-time systems and industrial telemetry networks.

- Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and other DevOps concepts and tools.

- Excellent communications skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Ability to pass Air Force background checks for Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg.

- Must have valid driver's license.

- Willing to work extended hours or weekends as necessary.

- Willing to be on after-hours on-call rotation.

- Ability to lift up to 30lbs.

- Ability to work at heights.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here .

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com .

### **Company Overview**

ID.me is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with ID.me once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 152 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with ID.me at 20 federal agencies, 45 state government agencies, and 70+ healthcare organizations. More than 600+ consumer brands use ID.me to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. ID.me’s technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. ID.me is committed to “No Identity Left Behind” to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit [https://network.id.me/](https://network.id.me/).

ID.me is a full-time, in-office culture. Unless a specific job description explicitly states otherwise, all roles are on-site five days per week at one of our offices in McLean, VA; Mountain View, CA; New York City, NY; or Tampa, FL. Certain roles — such as field-based sales or other remote-by-design positions — may have different work arrangements as noted in their individual postings.

At ID.me, we embrace the thoughtful use of AI tools in our daily work and there are even occasions where we leverage AI in our hiring process. However, during the interview process, we want to understand your individual skills and experiences. Therefore, we have guidelines on how AI can be appropriately used during your application and interviews which can be found [here](https://insider.id.me/candidate-ai-use-in-interviewing/).

## IT Engineer, IT Operations

### Role Overview

We are seeking an **IT Engineer** to join our **IT Operations team** — the group that keeps the core systems a ~1,000-person company runs on, reliable, secure, and continuously improving. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who takes ownership end to end: you will build the integrations and automations that connect our IT and business platforms, keep critical services highly available, and be a dependable technical resource the rest of the team can rely on.

You will operate with a high degree of autonomy. Much of the work here isn't handed to you fully specified — you will investigate unfamiliar systems, reverse-engineer how things fit together in a fast-moving environment, and decide what's worth doing next. You will ship pragmatically, favoring solid, incremental improvements that land over perfect solutions that don't, and you will keep Security, Compliance, and Data close so everything you build stays governed. Throughout, you will raise issues early, communicate clearly with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, and help the people around you.

If you like owning hard problems in a complex environment, working independently, and being the calm, capable engineer a team is glad to have, this is a meaningful opportunity to shape how our IT organization operates.

### Role Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain integrations and automations that connect our IT and business systems, eliminating manual, repetitive work.
- Administer, configure, and optimize core IT platforms and business SaaS applications, ensuring consistent performance and reliability.
- Script and deploy solutions organization-wide (Python, Bash, or similar) and automate repeatable operational processes.
- Integrate systems through APIs and webhooks — handling authentication, rate limits, retries, and error cases.
- Handle advanced technical troubleshooting across IT systems, endpoints, identity, and integrations, and support escalations from the IT Support team.
- Implement proactive measures for high availability, monitor system performance, and remediate availability and performance issues before users feel them.
- Contribute to disaster recovery planning and execution, ensuring swift restoration of critical services.
- Proactively identify improvements to systems and processes, then scope and deliver them without waiting to be told.
- Create and maintain clear documentation, configuration standards, and runbooks for both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Partner with engineering, security, and compliance teams to develop responsible, well-governed solutions.
- Share knowledge with teammates and contribute to the overall capability of the IT Operations team.
- Communicate technical concepts, risks, and trade-offs clearly and calmly to teammates and stakeholders.
- Perform other duties as assigned to meet team and organizational needs.

### Required Skills / Abilities

- 3+ years of hands-on experience as an IT / systems engineer (or similar) in an enterprise environment, able to carry technical work independently.
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
- Strong API fluency (REST / JSON, OAuth, webhooks) and the ability to read and write code in Python, Bash, or similar.
- Demonstrated experience integrating and automating across SaaS platforms and business systems.
- Experience with applying AI and LLM-based automation to reduce operational toil.
- A self-starter who works with a high degree of autonomy — identifies what needs doing, gathers context independently, and drives it to completion.
- Comfortable operating amid ambiguity and incomplete documentation, quickly building understanding of unfamiliar and fast-changing systems.
- Solid fundamentals in systems administration, corporate directory / identity, networking, and endpoint management.
- Excellent written and verbal communication, with the maturity to keep stakeholders informed and to raise risks constructively.
- A pragmatic, iterative delivery style — ship "good enough, then iterate" rather than stalling on perfection.

### Ideal Qualifications

_The qualifications below are ideal, but not all are required. We encourage candidates to apply if they satisfy some, but not all of these qualifications._

- Experience with MDM solutions (Jamf, Intune) and supporting macOS at scale.
- Familiarity with modern automation and workflow tooling, and version control systems.
- Experience with monitoring, observability, and building resilient, highly available services.
- Relevant industry certifications.

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS :

• Une mission longue durée à forte valeur ajoutée chez un client de référence à Genève.

• Un environnement technique riche, exigeant et à la hauteur de votre expertise.

• Un accompagnement et un plan de certifications Microsoft avancées.

• Des perspectives d'évolution au sein du groupe Sword.

jobs.title: Architecte Cloud M365
jobs.summary: Mission Objectif du poste : L’architecte Cloud & Digital Workplace chez Microsoft est chargé de définir, de concevoir et de piloter la mise en oeuvre de solutions cloud et d’environnement de travail d’entreprise sur Microsoft Azure et Microsoft 365. Ce...
jobs.description:
Mission

Objectif du poste : L’architecte Cloud & Digital Workplace chez Microsoft est chargé de définir, de concevoir et de piloter la mise en oeuvre de solutions cloud et d’environnement de travail d’entreprise sur Microsoft Azure et Microsoft 365. Ce poste de direction stratégique et technique combine des compétences en architecture cloud, en environnement de travail moderne, en sécurité, en gestion des identités, en collaboration et en infrastructure afin de fournir des services numériques sécurisés, évolutifs, résilients et centrés sur l’utilisateur.

L’architecte dirige le comité cloud, qui fait office d’instance d’approbation pour l’adoption et le déploiement de nouveaux services cloud au sein du groupe.

Principales responsabilités

Stratégie et architecture cloud

• Définir et maintenir la stratégie et la feuille de route d’entreprise relatives au cloud Microsoft.

• Concevoir des architectures cloud sécurisées, évolutives, hautement disponibles et rentables.

• S’assurer que les solutions cloud sont en adéquation avec les objectifs métier, les exigences de sécurité et les normes de conformité.

• Mettre en place des « Azure Landing Zones » et des modèles de gouvernance du cloud.

Architecture de l’environnement de travail numérique

• Définir la vision et l’architecture de l’environnement de travail numérique.

• Concevoir des plateformes de collaboration et de productivité à l’aide de Microsoft 365.

• Diriger les initiatives de transformation de l’environnement de travail favorisant le travail hybride et à distance.

• Améliorer la productivité des collaborateurs et leur expérience numérique grâce à des services innovants liés à l’environnement de travail.

Identité, sécurité et conformité

• Concevoir la gestion des identités et des accès de l’entreprise à l’aide de Microsoft Entra ID.

• Définir et mettre en oeuvre une sécurité « Zero Trust » Principes de sécurité.

• Concevoir des solutions d’accès conditionnel, de gouvernance des identités, d’authentification multifactorielle (MFA) et de gestion des accès privilégiés.

• Mettre en place des contrôles de sécurité maîtrisant : la suite Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, la prévention des pertes de données (DLP) et la protection des informations.

Garantir la conformité aux réglementations du secteur et aux politiques d’entreprise.

Gestion des terminaux et des appareils

• Définir une stratégie moderne de gestion des terminaux.

• Diriger l’initiative Microsoft Intune.

• Mettre en oeuvre : Windows Autopilot, la gestion des appareils mobiles (MDM), la gestion des applications mobiles (MAM), la sécurité des terminaux et les politiques de conformité des appareils

Leadership technique

• Agir en tant qu’autorité technique senior pour les technologies cloud et d’environnement de travail.

• Diriger les comités d’examen de l’architecture et les comités de gouvernance technique.

• Définir les normes d’ingénierie et les meilleures pratiques.

• Servir de point de relais pour les problèmes techniques critiques.

Votre profil

Qualifications et compétences

• Plus de 10 ans d’expérience dans les infrastructures informatiques, le cloud et les services liés à l’environnement de travail.

• Plus de 5 ans d’expérience dans la conception de solutions cloud Azure.

• Plus de 5 ans d’expérience dans l’architecture d’environnements Microsoft 365 d’entreprise.

• Expérience avérée dans la direction de programmes de transformation numérique et de migration vers le cloud.

• Expérience dans la gestion de plateformes cloud et d’environnement de travail à l’échelle de l’entreprise.

• Solide expérience en matière de sécurité, de conformité et de gestion des identités.

Compétences techniques requises

• Technologies cloud : Microsoft Azure, Azure Landing Zones, Azure Networking, AKS, Azure Virtual Desktop, AzureSurveillance, Azure Backup & Recovery, gouvernance Azure, gestion des coûts Azure.

• Microsoft 365 : Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, OneDrive Entreprise, Microsoft Viva, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform.

• Sécurité et identité : Microsoft Entra ID, accès conditionnel, gestion des identités privilégiées (PIM), Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Purview, architecture Zero Trust

• Gestion des terminaux : Microsoft Intune, Windows 11, Autopilot, Endpoint Analytics, gestion des appareils mobiles

• Automatisation et DevOps : PowerShell, Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Power Automate, API Microsoft Graph

Certifications souhaitées :

Microsoft Certified : Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

Microsoft 365 Certified : Enterprise Administrator Expert

Microsoft Certified : Cybersecurity Architect Expert

Microsoft Certified : Identity and Access Administrator Associate

Microsoft Certified : DevOps Engineer Expert

Microsoft Certified : Power Platform Solution Architect Expert.

jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on technical role. You will join during a period of high growth for the IT team as the company expands its headcount, global footprint and opens new offices.

You will work closely with the Security and Operations teams to keep our endpoints, offices, networks, and SaaS tools secure, while making sure people stay as productive as possible with the tools we have.

You'll own and deliver technical projects across identity, endpoint management, office infrastructure, automation, and compliance, helping us build scalable IT systems that support the company as it grows.

REQUIREMENTS

- Strong hands-on background in IT Engineering, Technical Operations, or a DevOps-adjacent role, with an automation-first mindset and experience managing enterprise scale IT systems

- Strong knowledge of identity and access management technologies (SAML, SCIM, OIDC) with tools such as Okta and Google Workspace

- Expertise with Mobile Device Management tooling (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Fleet) across a device fleet.

- Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) with a proven track record of automating compliance checks, device configuration, and other IT security tasks.

- Experience managing office network equipment (e.g. Cisco Meraki, Ubiquiti), including office buildouts.

- Proven ability to maintain compliance with SOC 2 / ISO 27001 (or similar) standards, paired with a friendly, end-user-focused attitude.

- Prior experience in a high-growth or startup environment.

BONUS

- Experience implement corporate security controls / previous security role experience

- Strong hands-on experience with VPNs, firewalls, and secure network environments, including modern practices such as Zero Trust networking.

- Experience with OSquery and Santa

- Terraform or other infrastructure as code experience.

- Open source contributions (e.g. a tool you built to automate something).

LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.summary: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re...
jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior IT Engineer to join our IT Engineering — Device Infrastructure Services team. This role goes beyond technical execution, it requires a strong engineer with excellent project management skills, capable of guiding complex device infrastructure initiatives from concept to delivery. They’ll be responsible for driving endpoint management best practices, leading change management processes, and ensuring a seamless, thoughtful end-user experience in a fast-paced SaaS security environment.

The ideal candidate is not only technically skilled in cloud-hosted endpoint management but also a strategic communicator who can collaborate effectively across teams, engage stakeholders at all levels, and advocate for scalable, secure, and efficient enterprise device solutions. They bring a strong user experience focus to everything they ship — from rollout design to end-user communication.

This role reports to the Team Lead, IT Engineering.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

- 5+ years of technical work experience in an IT role, with 2+ years in an IT engineering or systems administrator role focused on cloud-first endpoint management

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and CI/CD workflows applied to device management In an enterprise fleet at scale (500+ endpoints), meeting security benchmarks such as third-party patch compliance goals.

- Demonstrated senior level experience with Apple MDM platforms e.g Iru

- Hands-on experience designing and shipping automation with agentic or LLM-based components in an IT or device management context — and the judgment to know when existing tooling is the better answer.

- Professional-level scripting abilities in Bash, as well as other shell scripts for endpoint automation and fleet operations

- Hands-on experience implementing device trust principles including phishing-resistant authentication, conditional access, and endpoint compliance policies at scale

Bonus points for:

- Knowledge of IT change management and service management best practices (ITIL, etc.)

- Global-level admin experience with Microsoft Intune

- Ability to script in Powershell

- Admin experience with 1Password Enterprise Password Manager (EPM)

What you can expect:

- Lead the planning and implementation of large-scale device infrastructure projects with broad impact across the organization

- Drive IT Change Management initiatives related to endpoint management, software patching, and fleet operations

- Manage and administer cloud-based Apple MDM platforms (Iru), including custom configuration profiles and advanced policy management

- Apply AI tooling to real infrastructure problems (automated remediation, smarter alerting, reducing the manual toil that slows device ops) and have a hand in deciding where it goes next.

- Own third-party software patching workflows that keep the fleet current with minimal disruption to employees

- Approach all rollouts with a strong user experience focus. Phasing thoughtfully, communicating proactively, and designing for minimal disruption

- Contribute to designing and implementing best practices, policies, and procedures for the Device Infrastructure Services team

- Build relationships with key stakeholders across the organization

- Be available for occasional 24/7 on-call shifts to ensure uninterrupted support and resolve incidents.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $117,000 USD and $164,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $103,000 CAD and $144,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.

Our approach to remote work
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. See here https://www.ashbyhq.com/downloadables/ashby-bias-audit-08-2024.pdf for the latest third party bias audit information. If you prefer not to have your application assessed using AI/ML features, you may opt out by completing this form https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/1password/automation-notice. For additional information see our Candidate Privacy Notice https://1password.com/files/candidate-privacy-notice.pdf.

jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .

The IT Tooling team sits within IT Support & Services (ITSS) and builds the automations that power ITSS's own operations. Our in-house bot, Ask IT, deflects the majority of company-wide IT requests before they reach a human. Beyond that, we automate ITSS's core day-to-day workflows — ticket triage, access reviews, onboarding and offboarding — which employees experience as self-service. You'll own technical domains within the IT Tooling platform and partner with regional IT teams across APAC, EMEA, and AMER through platforms including n8n, Jira, Okta, Airflow, and Temporal.

What You'll Do

- Own the technical architecture of IT Tooling automations, driving design decisions on system structure, integration patterns, and tooling across n8n, Airflow, Temporal, and Jira

- Establish architecture standards and code review practices that raise the team's overall engineering bar

- Lead as technical DRI on the most complex, highest-impact automation projects, from discovery and design through production delivery

- Partner with Security, Corporate Engineering, and IAM to resolve technical blockers and represent the team in cross-functional architecture discussions

- Build shared frameworks and reusable components that reduce single points of failure across the platform

- Produce architecture documentation and decision records that enable the team to scale with minimal dependency on any single individual

- Manage your own workload with a high degree of independence, translating loosely scoped problems into production-ready technical specifications

Required Skills and Experience

- 5+ years of experience in IT engineering, automation, or systems engineering, with demonstrated ownership of architecture decisions, engineering standards, or platform-level systems that others build on top of

- Deep expertise building and maintaining complex automations using n8n, Airflow, Temporal, Jira Automation, or Workato, paired with strong Git-based development workflows including branching, CI/CD, and code review

- Working knowledge of Okta, Slack API, and Google Workspace administration sufficient to design secure, scalable automation architecture

- Ability to operate in ambiguous environments and translate loosely scoped problems into production-ready technical specifications

- Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.summary: Truveta provides unprecedented real-world data and real-time intelligence, powered by a dataset built with and owned by US health systems united in a mission of Saving Lives with Data. Together, we power breakthrough medical discoveries, accelerate...
jobs.description:
Truveta provides unprecedented real-world data and real-time intelligence, powered by a dataset built with and owned by US health systems united in a mission of Saving Lives with Data. Together, we power breakthrough medical discoveries, accelerate regulatory-grade evidence, and improve patient care. Today, Truveta enables research on more than 130 million de-identified patients across the US.

Achieving Truveta’s ambitious mission requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values .

Who We Need

Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. We are seeking candidates inspired by the opportunity to securely apply data in the development of real-world health solutions. Beyond core capabilities, we seek problem solvers, passionate and collaborative teammates, and those willing to roll up their sleeves while making a difference. We do things the right way. Our commitment to security and compliance assurance cannot be stressed enough. This position is critical to ensuring we are successful.

If you are interested in the opportunity to pursue purposeful work, join a mission-driven team, and build a rewarding career while having fun, Truveta may be the perfect fit for you.

This Opportunity

The successful candidate will design and support solutions that support the company’s Digital Workplace strategy. They will work on leading edge technologies that help modernize endpoint management by leveraging the cloud to quickly deliver end-user improvements.

Responsibilities:

- Device Management: Define, implement and maintain endpoint hardening baselines for Windows, macOS, and Linux systems with MDM such as Microsoft Intune, and JAMF.

- Policy & Hardening: Develop and enforce security policies, standards, and procedures for all endpoint devices. Implement system hardening configurations based on industry best practices.

- Deploy & Manage Security Tools: Implement, configure, and maintain endpoint security solutions, including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Extended Detection and Response (XDR), antivirus/anti-malware software, and host-based firewalls.

- Incident Response: Collaborate with IT and Security team to respond to endpoint-related incidents. Triage, remediate, and contain security incidents and threats on endpoints. Perform forensic analysis when necessary.

- Vulnerability Management: Manage the endpoint vulnerability lifecycle, from discovery and assessment to remediation, using scanning tools and patch management systems.

- Patch Management: Design and oversee the deployment of updates, security patches for operating system and applications.

- Automation & Scripting: Develop scripts and automation (e.g., using Python, PowerShell) to streamline security operations, automate repetitive tasks, and improve response times.

- AI Protection: Secure endpoints used for AI development, including devices accessing model weights, training data, and production inference systems, implementing guardrails on AI tool usage (e.g., prompt injection prevention in local LLM dev tools, restricted plugins/add-ons).

- Data Loss Prevention: Enforce data loss prevention (DLP) and encryption policies on devices used to handle sensitive AI training datasets, including PHI/PII and proprietary corporation data.

- On-call: Ability to participate in On-call rotation.

- On-site: This position requires daily onsite work at Truveta office in Hyderabad.

Qualifications

- Experience: 3-5 years of hands-on experience in an endpoint security, cybersecurity engineering, or similar role.

- Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of modern operating systems (Windows, macOS) and their architecture, configuration and deployment in a large enterprise environment.

- Cloud Experience : Strong hands-on experience on Azure Cloud PC, VM, Azure Firewall and Azure Networking.

- MDM Expertise: Strong hands-on experience on Microsoft Intune and JAMF administration, such as device enrollment, OS upgrade/patch, configuration, profile.

- Policy Management: Define and assign compliance/security policies to ensure corporation devices meet organizational security standards.

- Application Management: Strong hands-on experience on applications control, deployment, patch and upgrade.

- EPM: Proven experience with industry-leading EPM platforms such as CyberArk and BeyondTrust to control user privileged access and provide advanced threat protection and vulnerability management.

- Networking: Solid understanding of TCP/IP IPv4/v6, experience of office network (Routing / Switching / WAN, Wi-Fi & Security) management and network security concepts.

- Security Principles: Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST, MITRE), threat intelligence, and incident response methodologies.

- Compliance: Experiences with SOC 2 Type 2, HITRUST, and ISO compliance frameworks. Interact with the compliance team to ensure the company compliant and remediate gaps during compliance finding and controls.

- Collaboration: Excellent verbal and written communication/presentation, ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Enterprise Engineering organization manages one of the largest macOS client fleets in the world. Our focus is to consistently raise Amazon's security bar while ensuring a smooth productivity experience for our end users. We are a team of builders managing the solutions for Amazon's global macOS client fleets. We use AWS products to evolve traditional enterprise tools and services at a large scale.

We are looking for a Systems Development Engineer with extensive macOS knowledge of Fleet Management, troubleshooting expertise, development background, and strong knowledge of macOS performance troubleshooting. If you are passionate about technology, enjoy working with others, and like to solve technical challenges, keep reading. In this role, you and your team will directly influence Amazon's macOS experience roadmap. You will use native AWS services, external 3rd party services, and DevOps patterns to manage a growing fleet of macOS client devices. This is a hands-on position where your daily activities include macOS administration, integrations, developing tools and automation, root cause analysis, performance analysis, and maintaining service infrastructures. You will contribute to operations and development activities as we build the next generation of macOS management tools.

Every day will bring new and exciting opportunities. Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Troubleshoot and solve issues in a globally scaled enterprise environment

- Build automation and tooling using scripting (PowerShell, Python, Bash) to streamline operations and reduce manual work

- Create operational documentation (runbooks, standards, guides). Partner with Engineering on infrastructure projects

- Strong proficiency in macOS and Windows endpoint administration

- Solid experience with endpoint management platforms (Jamf Pro, Intune)

- Working knowledge of Microsoft 365/Entra ID administration

- Proficiency in at least one scripting language (PowerShell, Python, Bash)

- Understanding of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi) and directory services (Active Directory, Entra ID, LDAP)

- Familiarity with backup and disaster recovery solutions (Veeam, Time Machine)

- Experience with collaboration platforms (Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace)

The Infrastructure team is looking for someone who has a commitment to excellence, self‑management, continuous improvement, and automation for maintenance and configuration.

The Endpoint Administrator responsibilities include installed applications and configurations for Windows PCs, Windows servers, mobile devices (MDM), and BYOD. Responsibilities include core Microsoft applications and standard legal‑industry applications. This role provides administration and support for the PC/mobile/cloud experience using Microsoft's endpoint delivery platform (Endpoint Manager/Intune) and third‑party tools such as Aiden. Works with other IT teams to seamlessly align security, compliance, other technology, and client needs. Familiar with change management, building runbooks, and thorough testing/QA/backout planning when implementing changes to the environment. Researches, installs, analyzes, tests, and evaluates applications, systems, policies, methodologies, processes, and procedures to ensure the Firm's infrastructure and facilities meet expectations and service level agreements for availability, performance, growth, and functionality. Position: Desktop Engineer - End User Computing Specialist

Location: Jersey City, NJ

Hiring: W2 Contract

Job Description:

Overview: As an End User Computing Specialist, you will be responsible for managing and optimizing the end-user computing environment within our organization. Your role will focus on ensuring that all users have reliable access to the necessary technology resources, providing technical support, and implementing solutions to enhance user productivity and satisfaction.

Working Conditions:

This role typically operates in an office environment, with occasional travel to different locations as needed.May require flexibility in working hours to accommodate after-hours support or project deadlines.Conclusion: Join our team as an End User Computing Specialist and contribute to the optimization and support of our organization s end-user computing environment.This role offers opportunities to leverage your technical expertise, drive innovation, and ensure that our users have reliable access to technology resources that enable them to perform their roles effectively.If you are passionate about technology and delivering exceptional user experiences, we invite you to apply and be a part of our dynamic team.

Responsibilities:

Technical Support and Issue Resolution:

Serve as a subject matter expert for all end-user computing technologies, including desktops, laptops, mobile devices, and associated software.Provide advanced troubleshooting and technical support for complex issues escalated from Level 1 and Level 2 support teams.Ensure timely resolution of critical incidents to minimize downtime and impact on business operations.System Administration and Optimization:

Manage and maintain desktop operating systems (e.g., Windows, macOS) and software applications, ensuring they are up-to-date and secure.Implement and maintain endpoint management solutions for efficient software distribution, patch management, and remote support.Optimize end-user computing environments to enhance performance, reliability, and security.User Training and Documentation:

Implement and enforce security policies and procedures to protect end-user devices, data, and systems from security threats.Conduct regular audits and assessments to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and organizational standards.Technology Evaluation and Implementation:

Research, evaluate, and recommend new technologies, tools, and solutions to improve end-user computing capabilities and user experience.Lead or participate in projects related to the deployment, integration, and migration of end-user computing systems and applications.Customer Service and Relationship Management:

Foster positive relationships with end users and stakeholders, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction through responsive and effective support.Communicate technical information and updates to non-technical users in a clear and understandable manner.Requirements:

Proven experience as an End User Computing Specialist, Desktop Support Engineer, or similar role, with a strong technical background in supporting end-user technologies.In-depth knowledge of desktop operating systems, productivity software (e.g., Microsoft Office, collaboration tools), and endpoint security principles.Experience with endpoint management tools (e.g., SCCM, Jamf, Intune) and remote support technologies.Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues independently.Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer-focused approach.Bachelor s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field;relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate) are a plus.

Job Description

At K&L Gates, we are looking for smart, imaginative and hard-working people with diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas to join us. Perhaps our search for talented visionaries and your search for important and impactful work lead to the same place.

We are seeking a Team Lead: Digital Workplace Engineer to join the firm. The Team Lead: Digital Workplace Engineer oversees user experience, performance, and reliability of all digital workplace services firmwide. This position provides strategic, technical, and operational leadership for endpoint engineering, ensuring improved productivity, service quality, and user experience outcomes. The role sets direction, governance, and standards for workplace technologies, driving excellence and alignment across Engineering, Service Desk, and Infrastructure teams. Responsibilities include eliminating user experience friction, reducing recurring issues, and delivering scalable, consistent global services. This is achieved through automation, standardization, and disciplined execution to enhance service delivery and operational efficiency.

KEY RELATIONSHIPS

Cloud Platform Engineering, Enterprise Applications, Security, Global Support Services, Deskside Support, Network & Collaboration, Business Stakeholders

ESSENTIAL DUTIES

• Owning the entire digital workplace user experience while driving continuous improvement

• Establishing metrics for DEX and monitoring user sentiment to ensure alignment with objectives and enhance overall experience.

• Defining standard operating procedures and RACI models while ensuring accountability is upheld consistently across all relevant areas.

• Conducting root cause analysis and removing recurring issues.

• Partnering with the Service Desk to minimize incidents while enhancing resolution efficiency and effectiveness.

jobs.description:
About Gen:

Gen (NASDAQ: GEN) is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion, Avira, AVG, CCleaner, GOBankingRates, ReputationDefender, and Trellis Technologies. Gen brings award-winning products and services in cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection, financial wellness, and insurance to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.

Working at Gen is more than just a job. It's where passion meets purpose, driving our mission to power Digital Freedom. Our culture fosters collaboration, innovation, and a giving mindset - enabling our team to deliver exceptional employee experiences and positive impact to the world around us.

About the Role:

The Senior Digital Workplace Engineer - AI & Collaboration is a senior individual contributor and technical lead responsible for the architecture, deployment, administration, and continuous improvement of Gen's enterprise collaboration and AI platforms. This role sits at the intersection of engineering depth and strategic vision - owning the technical execution of Gen's collaboration ecosystem (Microsoft 365, OneDrive/SharePoint, Slack, and emerging AI productivity tools). This role also serves as the primary lead for collaboration platform integrations during mergers and acquisitions.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that combines deep hands-on technical expertise with strong strategic vision. Gen is an AI-first company, and this role anticipates how AI and automation will reshape the collaboration landscape and positions Gen to continue its rapid transformation.

Key Responsibilities:

Collaboration Platform Engineering & Administration

Serve as the primary technical owner and senior subject matter expert for Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, OneDrive, Power Platform) and Slack Enterprise Grid. Additional experience with Google Workspace & Microsoft Teams preferred.

Architect, configure, and manage these platforms end to end, including solution design, configuration, standards/best practices, documentation, and integrations with other core enterprise systems.

Oversee day-to-day operations, ensuring timely request fulfillment, proactive monitoring and maintenance, incident management, and coordination with vendors and support partners.

Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal to ensure collaboration solutions meet enterprise security, privacy, and regulatory requirements, including access controls, DLP, eDiscovery, and auditability.

Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, and other IT teams to translate requirements into scalable, well-governed solutions, balancing innovation, risk, and operational readiness.

Design and implement automation solutions to streamline business processes, reduce manual effort, and improve employee experience.

Provide L3/L4 escalation support and mentor junior engineers and administrators, building reusable runbooks, documentation, and knowledge articles to continually mature operational discipline.

M&A Integration & Platform Migrations

Lead the technical execution of collaboration platform integrations for acquired companies, including assessment, planning, and migration of:

Slack-to-Slack workspace migrations (grid-to-grid, workspace consolidation, channel/app/data migration)

Microsoft Teams-to-Slack migrations (greenfield and lift-and-shift approaches)

Google Workspace-to-Microsoft 365 migrations (Google Drive & Shared Drives to OneDrive/SharePoint)

Develop and maintain M&A integration playbooks for collaboration-stack consolidation, covering identity, workspace provisioning, app re-enablement, data migration, and user communication.

Conduct pre-acquisition technical assessments of target company collaboration environments, identifying risks, dependencies, and integration complexity.

Coordinate with Security, Legal, Compliance, and People & Culture teams to ensure migrations meet data retention, eDiscovery, DLP, and regulatory requirements.

AI & Emerging Technology

Drive the evaluation, deployment, and governance of AI-powered productivity tools across the company, including Slack AI, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Glean, Claude, and ChatGPT Enterprise.

Architect AI agents and AI-assisted workflow automations using these platforms to reduce manual processes, improve operational efficiency, and enhance employee experience.

Design and build foundational Power Platform and M365 Copilot/Copilot Studio environments to support the secure, scalable launch of new AI capabilities.

Define and enforce guardrails, policies, and best practices for the safe, secure, and responsible use of AI tools (prompting, data access, retention, and human review), in partnership with Security, Legal, and Compliance teams.

Drive adoption and change management for AI solutions, including enablement materials, office hours, and meaningful metrics to measure usage, outcomes, and ROI.

Partner with the CTO and IT leadership to define Gen's AI collaboration strategy, identifying and prioritizing high-value use cases where agents, copilots, and automation can meaningfully improve productivity.

Stay current on the rapidly evolving AI collaboration landscape and provide recommendations on emerging tools, vendor roadmaps, and industry best practices.

Documentation, Operations & Stakeholder Engagement

Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, architecture diagrams, admin runbooks, and knowledge base articles in ServiceNow and Confluence.

Manage ServiceNow catalog items and workflows for collaboration service requests (Slack guest access, app approvals, SharePoint provisioning, etc.).

Serve as the escalation point for collaboration platform issues, working directly with vendors (Slack, Microsoft, OpenAI, & Glean) to diagnose and resolve platform-level issues.

Communicate technical decisions, project status, and platform changes to IT leadership, business stakeholders, and end users through clear written and verbal communication.

Mentor junior team members and contribute to the broader team's technical growth.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, with a strong focus on collaboration, communication, and digital workplace platforms.

Deep expertise in Slack Enterprise Grid administration, including workspace governance, external collaboration enablement, app management, and multi-workspace architecture.

Expert-level proficiency with Microsoft 365 collaboration and AI services, including OneDrive, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365 Copilot.

Proven experience leading collaboration platform migrations, such as Slack-to-Slack, Teams-to-Slack, and Google Workspace-to-M365, across large or complex environments.

Demonstrated M&A integration experience, including technical assessment, platform consolidation strategy, and end-to-end migration execution for acquired companies' collaboration environments.

Strong proficiency with API-based integrations, webhooks, and workflow automation tools (e.g., Power Automate, Slack Workflow Builder, REST APIs).

Experience integrating collaboration platform logs into SIEM solutions (e.g., Splunk) and building monitoring/alerting to support security and operations use cases.

Strong project management and communication skills, with a track record of managing multiple concurrent work-streams, clearly communicating status and risk, and delivering against aggressive timelines.

About You:

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with enterprise AI search and knowledge platforms (e.g., Glean, Microsoft 365 Copilot, or similar), including connector configuration and agentic use case design.

Hands-on experience rolling out and governing AI productivity tools at scale (e.g., Glean, M365 Copilot, Slack AI, ChatGPT Enterprise), including policy design, enablement programs, and adoption measurement.

Familiarity with the ServiceNow ITSM platform, including catalog item design, workflow configuration, and CMDB integration for collaboration and AI services.

Relevant industry certifications, such as Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, Slack Certified Administrator, or other equivalents

Experience working in a global, multi-brand enterprise with diverse collaboration tool ecosystems and regional requirements.

Background in change management and user enablement for new collaboration/AI capabilities (training content, office hours, champions programs, or similar).

What's Next:

Recruiter Interview

Hiring Manger Interview

Technical Interview

Job Description An exciting career awaits you

At MPC, we re committed to being a great place to work one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.

Position Summary

The Senior Platforms Engineer is responsible for the strategic design, deployment, and optimization of complex infrastructure platforms and systems, ensuring high availability, scalability, and security. This qualified candidate will have proven experience as a technical lead or platform owner for digital workplace or AI initiatives.

This role will maintain ownership throughout the entire lifecycle of AI agents and automation, handling intake, governance, versioning, monitoring, and retirement in production environments. An expected focus of this role is to deliver impactful AI value and usage reports, presenting productivity improvements, risk assessments, and cost optimization metrics to leadership and business stakeholders.

This role leads advanced troubleshooting, performance tuning, and technical support activities, serving as the primary escalation point for complex issues and collaborating across teams to drive continuous improvement. The Senior Platforms Engineer also oversees resiliency, disaster recovery and backup strategies, develops comprehensive reporting frameworks, and ensures compliance with industry standards and best practices.

The candidate will have designed and implemented secure, enterprise-grade low-code applications for regulated and sensitive data, ensuring compliance and robust protection measures.

Additionally, this position fosters a culture of knowledge sharing by mentoring junior engineers, organizing training sessions, and promoting cross-functional collaboration to enhance documentation and information sharing.

This position belongs to a family of jobs with increasing responsibility, competency, and skill level. Actual position title and pay grade will be based on the selected candidate s experience and qualifications.

Key Responsibilities

Identifies performance bottlenecks, conducts root cause analysis, and proposes and implements solutions to enhance platform & system performance and resource utilization. Establishes performance benchmarks, conducts capacity planning, and collaborates with other teams, including junior engineers and cross functional teams to optimize infrastructure performance and activities.
Contributes to the development and improvement of troubleshooting procedures, measures to minimize platform & system downtime, and documentation. Partners with technical support to drive for resolution. Leads and manages platform & system technical support activities and troubleshooting efforts, including handling escalated and complex issues. Performs advanced system tuning and optimization to maximize performance using IT Service Management practices. Collaborates with Systems and Solution Architects, Governance, Regulatory and Compliance as well as other organizational teams to enhance support processes and methodologies.
Participates in future platform & system backup planning. Leads the design of disaster/system recovery and testing.
Analyzes Power Platform, Copilot Studio, AI agent, and digital workplace platform performance and utilization data to identify trends and patterns. Provides recommendations for optimization, cost efficiency, reliability, and value realization. Prepares executive ready reporting and drives corrective actions to continuously improve platform and AI service outcomes.
Leads development of advanced troubleshooting procedures and operational runbooks for Power Platform solutions, AI agents, and automations. Serves as the primary escalation point for complex platform, automation, or agent issues. Coordinates with vendors and internal teams to resolve incidents and continuously improve service reliability and operational maturity.
Leads the creation and maintenance of a comprehensive knowledge base for platforms & systems, including troubleshooting guides, configuration documentation, and best practices. Promotes knowledge sharing culture by organizing training sessions, mentoring junior engineers, and encouraging cross-team collaboration.

Education and Experience

Bachelor s Degree in Information Technology, related field or equivalent experience required
Five (5) or more years of relevant experience required.

Administered and supported Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Copilot Agents, Azure Services) in enterprise environments highly preferred.
Experience applying automation design patterns, managed error handling, monitoring, and provided operational support for platforms highly preferred.
Developed and delivered platform usage, reliability, and adoption reporting for leadership and stakeholders preferred.
Implemented environment strategies, solution packaging, and application lifecycle management practices for low-code platforms preferred.
Managed security, identity, and access controls within Microsoft 365 and Power Platform preferred.

Cloud Infrastructure Management - Setting up, configuring, monitoring, and optimizing the components of cloud infrastructure.
Computer Networking - A system in which multiple computers are connected to each other to share information and resources.
Cybersecurity Risk Management - The process of developing cyber risk assessment and treatment techniques that can effectively pre-empt and identify significant security loopholes and weaknesses, demonstrating the business risks associated with these loopholes and providing risk treatment and prioritization strategies to effectively address the cyber-related risks, threats and vulnerabilities, ensuring appropriate levels of protection, confidentiality, integrity and privacy in alignment with the security framework.
DevSecOps - A set of practices that automates the integration of security at every phase of the software development lifecycle, from initial design through integration, testing, deployment, and software delivery, with an aim towards shortening the systems development life cycle and pas well as continuous delivery and a security first approach.
General Programming - Applies a computer language to communicate with computers using a set of instructions and to automate the execution of tasks.

Performance Monitoring - The process of measuring the performance of a system in real time in order to determine problems and identify other factors that may cause problems in the future.
Policy Management - The process of creating, implementing and maintaining policies and procedures within an organization.
Process Automation - Also known as business automation or digital transformation, this is the technology-enabled automation of complex business processes. It can streamline a business for simplicity, achieve digital transformation, increase service quality, improve service delivery or contain costs. It consists of integrating applications, restructuring labor resources and using software applications throughout the organization.

It provides a standardized and cohesive infrastructure, allowing for the development, deployment, and integration of various technologies and services.
Systems Testing - The process of testing conducted on a complete integrated system to evaluate the system's compliance with its specified requirements.
Systems Integration - The process of linking together various IT systems, services and/or software to enable all of them to work functionally together.
Troubleshooting - The act or process of discovering and resolving problems, disputes, or mechanical issues through a systematic, usually iterative, approach.
